English: PRESS RELEASE: JUNE 29, 2020 The EU through its Civil Protection and Humanitarian Aid Operations department (ECHO) has donated KES 270 million (2,573,105 Million Euros) to WHO Kenya.
Kiswahili: TAARIFA KWA VYOMBO VYA HABARI: JUNI 29, 2020 EU kupitia idara yake ya Ulinzi wa Raia na Uendeshaji wa Misaada ya Kibinadamu (ECHO) imetoa KES milioni 270 (Euro milioni 2,573,105) kwa WHO Kenya.

English: This grant will be used by the WHO to support the Government of Kenya’s efforts to control the spread of the pandemic.
Kiswahili: Ruzuku hii itatumiwa na WHO kuunga mkono juhudi za Serikali ya Kenya za kudhibiti kuenea kwa janga hili.

English: Specifically, WHO Kenya will boost the response effort by training frontline health workers at national and county levels and strengthen the current work being done by the COVID-19 rapid response and clinical teams across all counties.
Kiswahili: Hasa, WHO Kenya itaongeza juhudi za kukabiliana na janga hili kwa kuwafunza wafanyakazi wa afya walio mstari wa mbele katika ngazi za kitaifa na kaunti na kuimarisha kazi inayofanywa sasa na timu za mwitikio wa haraka wa COVID-19 na kliniki katika kaunti zote.

English: Strengthening clinical care for high-consequence infectious diseases in East Africa Nairobi - Following successive Ebola and Marburg outbreaks across East Africa, countries are shifting how preparedness is defined, placing greater emphasis on the quality of clinical care delivered to patients.
Kiswahili: Kuimarisha huduma ya kimatibabu kwa magonjwa ya kuambukiza yenye matokeo makubwa Afrika Mashariki Nairobi - Kufuatia milipuko mfululizo ya Ebola na Marburg kote Afrika Mashariki, nchi zinabadilisha jinsi maandalizi yanavyofafanuliwa, zikiweka msisitizo mkubwa juu ya ubora wa huduma ya kimatibabu inayotolewa kwa wagonjwa.

English: In recent years, investments in surveillance, laboratory systems and rapid response have strengthened the region’s ability to detect outbreaks earlier and respond faster.
Kiswahili: Katika miaka ya hivi karibuni, uwekezaji katika ufuatiliaji, mifumo ya maabara na mwitikio wa haraka umeimarisha uwezo wa eneo hilo kugundua milipuko mapema na kujibu haraka zaidi.

English: Across Tanzania, Uganda and Ethiopia, early warning systems are functioning more effectively, and laboratory confirmation is increasingly timely.
Kiswahili: Kote Tanzania, Uganda na Ethiopia, mifumo ya tahadhari za mapema inafanya kazi kwa ufanisi zaidi, na uthibitisho wa maabara unazidi kuwa wa wakati unaofaa.

English: Yet patient outcomes continue to vary, pointing to a different challenge.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo matokeo ya mgonjwa yanaendelea kutofautiana, yakiashiria changamoto tofauti.

English: Clinical management has emerged as the determining factor.
Kiswahili: Usimamizi wa kimatibabu umeibuka kama kigezo cha kuamua.

English: Caring for patients with high-consequence infectious diseases requires highly skilled teams operating in full personal protective equipment under strict infection prevention protocols.
Kiswahili: Kuwatunza wagonjwa wenye magonjwa ya kuambukiza yenye matokeo makubwa kunahitaji timu zenye ujuzi wa hali ya juu zinazofanya kazi katika vifaa kamili vya kinga binafsi chini ya itifaki kali za kuzuia maambukizi.

English: These conditions are physically demanding and technically complex, requiring sustained precision in environments where even routine care becomes high risk.
Kiswahili: Hali hizi zinahitajika kimwili na kitaalamu ni ngumu, zinahitaji usahihi endelevu katika mazingira ambapo hata utunzaji wa kawaida unakuwa hatari kubwa.

English: Where bedside capacity is limited, mortality increases, regardless of how quickly cases are identified.
Kiswahili: Pale ambapo uwezo wa kando ya kitanda ni mdogo, vifo huongezeka, bila kujali jinsi visa vinavyogunduliwa haraka.

English: To address this gap, countries are strengthening the systems that underpin clinical care, from building multidisciplinary teams and improving intensive and supportive care practices, to reinforcing infection prevention and WASH standards and ensuring facilities are equipped to operate safely during outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Ili kushughulikia pengo hili, nchi zinaimarisha mifumo inayounga mkono huduma ya kliniki, kuanzia kujenga timu za taaluma mbalimbali na kuboresha mbinu za utunzaji makini na unaounga mkono, hadi kuimarisha viwango vya kuzuia maambukizi na WASH na kuhakikisha vifaa vina vifaa vya kufanya kazi kwa usalama wakati wa milipuko.

English: From 27 April to 1 May 2026, clinicians, infection prevention specialists and experts from across the East African Community convened in Nairobi for a training focused on these priorities.
Kiswahili: Kuanzia tarehe 27 Aprili hadi 1 Mei 2026, madaktari, wataalamu wa kuzuia maambukizi na wataalamu kutoka kote katika Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki walikutana jijini Nairobi kwa ajili ya mafunzo yaliyolenga vipaumbele hivi.

English: Organized by the East African Community, with funding from GIZ and support from Charité, Universitätsmedizin Berlin, the training brought together expertise from across all eight Member States to strengthen the competencies that influence patient outcomes.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo hayo yaliyoandaliwa na Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki, kwa ufadhili kutoka GIZ na usaidizi kutoka Charité, Universitätsmedizin Berlin, yalileta pamoja utaalamu kutoka katika Nchi zote nane Wanachama ili kuimarisha uwezo unaoathiri matokeo ya wagonjwa.

English: The programme focused on critical care, patient monitoring, safe use of personal protective equipment, and maintaining high-quality clinical operations under outbreak conditions.
Kiswahili: Programu hiyo ililenga katika utunzaji muhimu, ufuatiliaji wa wagonjwa, matumizi salama ya vifaa vya kinga binafsi, na kudumisha shughuli za kliniki zenye ubora wa hali ya juu chini ya hali ya mlipuko.

English: Designed as a training-of-trainers platform, it aims to build a cadre of experts who can cascade knowledge nationally, ensuring that capacity is not limited to individual facilities but embedded within health systems.
Kiswahili: Imeundwa kama jukwaa la mafunzo ya wakufunzi, inalenga kujenga kundi la wataalamu ambao wanaweza kusambaza maarifa kitaifa, kuhakikisha kwamba uwezo hauzuiliwi tu kwa vituo vya kibinafsi bali pia ndani ya mifumo ya afya.

English: World Health Organization supported this effort through technical guidance, coordination and the strengthening of regional networks, helping to ensure that clinical capacity continues to grow across countries and is sustained between outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Afya Duniani liliunga mkono juhudi hii kupitia mwongozo wa kiufundi, uratibu na uimarishaji wa mitandao ya kikanda, na kusaidia kuhakikisha kwamba uwezo wa kliniki unaendelea kukua katika nchi mbalimbali na unaendelea kudumu kati ya milipuko.

English: This approach reflects a broader shift toward institutionalizing expertise.
Kiswahili: Mbinu hii inaonyesha mabadiliko mapana kuelekea kurasimisha utaalamu.

English: Rather than rebuilding capacity during each emergency, countries are working to retain and expand it over time, supported by regional collaboration.
Kiswahili: Badala ya kujenga upya uwezo wakati wa kila dharura, nchi zinafanya kazi ya kuuhifadhi na kuupanua baada ya muda, zikiungwa mkono na ushirikiano wa kikanda.

English: East Africa has demonstrated that it can detect outbreaks faster.
Kiswahili: Afrika Mashariki imeonyesha kuwa inaweza kugundua milipuko haraka zaidi.

English: The next phase is to ensure that every patient benefits from the same standard of high-quality care.
Kiswahili: Hatua inayofuata ni kuhakikisha kwamba kila mgonjwa anafaidika na kiwango sawa cha huduma bora.

English: Nairobi—Kenya is strengthening its national cholera outbreak preparedness and response during the current long rainy season, expected to last until the end of May.
Kiswahili: Nairobi—Kenya inaimarisha utayari wake wa kitaifa wa mlipuko wa kipindupindu na mwitikio wakati wa msimu wa mvua mrefu wa sasa, unaotarajiwa kudumu hadi mwisho wa Mei.

English: Four counties ‒ Nairobi, Kisumu,Migori and Kwale ‒ are experiencing a cholera outbreak, which was declared in late February 2025.
Kiswahili: Kaunti nne - Nairobi, Kisumu, Migori na Kwale - zinakabiliwa na mlipuko wa kipindupindu, ambao ulitangazwa mwishoni mwa Februari 2025.

English: So far, 256 suspected cases and 13 deaths have been reported, with a case fatality rate of 5.2%, exceeding the 1% threshold which indicates early and adequate treatment of cholera patients.
Kiswahili: Hadi sasa, visa 256 vinavyoshukiwa na vifo 13 vimeripotiwa, huku kiwango cha vifo kikiwa 5.2%, kikizidi kiwango cha 1% ambacho kinaonyesha matibabu ya mapema na ya kutosha kwa wagonjwa wa kipindupindu.

English: Press Statement: Kenyan Government, World Health Organization, Bloomberg Philanthropies launch new initiative to reduce road crash deaths Road traffic crashes are a top-five cause of death for Kenyans between the ages of five and 70, and the leading killer of boys aged 15-19.
Kiswahili: Taarifa kwa Vyombo vya Habari: Serikali ya Kenya, Shirika la Afya Duniani, Bloomberg Philanthropies yazindua mpango mpya wa kupunguza vifo vya ajali za barabarani Ajali za barabarani ni miongoni mwa sababu tano kuu za vifo kwa Wakenya wenye umri wa kati ya miaka mitano na 70, na ni miongoni mwa wauaji wakuu wa wavulana wenye umri wa kati ya miaka 15-19.

English: Kenya: Country health profile Kenya is a lower-middle-income country with an estimated population of over 54 million people.
Kiswahili: Kenya: Wasifu wa afya ya nchi Kenya ni nchi yenye kipato cha chini cha kati yenye idadi ya watu inayokadiriwa kuwa zaidi ya milioni 54.

English: The country operates a devolved health system across 47 counties, with the national government responsible for health policy and county governments managing service delivery.
Kiswahili: Nchi inaendesha mfumo wa afya uliogatuliwa katika kaunti 47, huku serikali ya kitaifa ikiwa na jukumu la sera za afya na serikali za kaunti zikisimamia utoaji wa huduma.

English: Kenya has made significant strides in improving health outcomes over the past two decades, though substantial challenges remain in achieving Universal Health Coverage (UHC) and addressing persistent health inequities between regions and populations.
Kiswahili: Kenya imepiga hatua kubwa katika kuboresha matokeo ya kiafya katika miongo miwili iliyopita, ingawa changamoto kubwa bado zipo katika kufikia Ufikiaji wa Afya kwa Wote (UHC) na kushughulikia ukosefu wa usawa wa kiafya unaoendelea kati ya maeneo na idadi ya watu.

English: WHO Kenya works through three strategic clusters; (1) Health Promotion, Disease Prevention and Control, (2) Health Emergencies, and (3) Health Systems and Services, to support the Government of Kenya in building resilient health systems and advancing toward UHC.
Kiswahili: WHO Kenya inafanya kazi kupitia makundi matatu ya kimkakati; (1) Kukuza Afya, Kuzuia na Kudhibiti Magonjwa, (2) Dharura za Afya, na (3) Mifumo na Huduma za Afya, ili kuisaidia Serikali ya Kenya katika kujenga mifumo imara ya afya na kusonga mbele kuelekea UHC.

English: The world is confronted with a global food crisis fueled by conflict, climate change and the pandemic of coronavirus disease.
Kiswahili: Dunia inakabiliwa na mgogoro wa chakula duniani unaosababishwa na migogoro, mabadiliko ya tabianchi na janga la ugonjwa wa virusi vya korona.

English: A record 349 million people globally are facing acute food insecurity Meanwhile, tobacco is grown in over 124 countries, taking up 3.2 million hectares of fertile land that could be used to grow food, address food insecurity and nutrition challenges and help feed families.
Kiswahili: Watu milioni 349 waliorekodiwa duniani kote wanakabiliwa na uhaba mkubwa wa chakula Wakati huo huo, tumbaku inalimwa katika zaidi ya nchi 124, ikichukua hekta milioni 3.2 za ardhi yenye rutuba ambayo inaweza kutumika kulima chakula, kushughulikia changamoto za uhaba wa chakula na lishe na kusaidia kulisha familia.

English: Samburu County, Kenya - In Lolmolong village, in Samburu County in northern Kenya, Neshoo Leaungokiok laboured through the night, far from the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Samburu, Kenya - Katika kijiji cha Lolmolong, katika Kaunti ya Samburu kaskazini mwa Kenya, Neshoo Leaungokiok alifanya kazi usiku kucha, mbali na kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.

English: With no transport available and a six-hour journey on foot to reach care, she had no choice but to give birth at home, assisted only by a traditional birth attendant.
Kiswahili: Kwa kukosa usafiri na safari ya saa sita kwa miguu ili kufika kwenye huduma ya afya, hakuwa na chaguo ila kujifungulia nyumbani, akisaidiwa tu na mkunga wa jadi.

English: In this remote part of Kenya, long distances, difficult terrain and insecurity continue to limit access to skilled care during childbirth, placing mothers and newborns at significant risk.
Kiswahili: Katika sehemu hii ya mbali ya Kenya, umbali mrefu, ardhi ngumu na ukosefu wa usalama vinaendelea kupunguza upatikanaji wa huduma stadi wakati wa kujifungua, na hivyo kuwaweka akina mama na watoto wachanga katika hatari kubwa.

English: Kenya launches 5-year health security plan to strengthen health emergency readiness Nairobi- Kenya has launched its Second National Action Plan for Health Security 2026–2030, marking a significant step toward strengthening the country’s ability to prevent, detect, and respond to public health threats.
Kiswahili: Kenya yazindua mpango wa usalama wa afya wa miaka 5 ili kuimarisha utayari wa dharura wa afya Nairobi- Kenya imezindua Mpango wake wa Pili wa Kitaifa wa Utekelezaji wa Usalama wa Afya 2026–2030, ikiashiria hatua muhimu kuelekea kuimarisha uwezo wa nchi kuzuia, kugundua, na kukabiliana na vitisho vya afya ya umma.

English: The plan outlines Kenya’s priorities for health security over the next five years.
Kiswahili: Mpango huo unaelezea vipaumbele vya Kenya kwa usalama wa afya katika kipindi cha miaka mitano ijayo.

English: It is informed by findings from Kenya’s Joint External Evaluation conducted in September 2024 and aligns with all 19 technical areas, spanning areas such as surveillance, antimicrobial resistance, health emergency management, risk communication and more.
Kiswahili: Imechangiwa na matokeo kutoka kwa Tathmini ya Pamoja ya Nje ya Kenya iliyofanywa mnamo Septemba 2024 na inaendana na maeneo yote 19 ya kiufundi, ikijumuisha maeneo kama vile ufuatiliaji, upinzani wa vijidudu, usimamizi wa dharura za kiafya, mawasiliano ya hatari na mengineyo.

English: Speaking at the launch, Cabinet Secretary for health Aden Duale stated that, "A health system that cannot detect and respond to threats cannot guarantee coverage.
Kiswahili: Akizungumza wakati wa uzinduzi huo, Waziri wa Afya Aden Duale alisema kwamba, "Mfumo wa afya ambao hauwezi kugundua na kujibu vitisho hauwezi kuhakikisha huduma."

English: And one that excludes people cannot sustain security."
Kiswahili: Na mtu anayewatenga watu hawezi kudumisha usalama."

English: The evaluation identified three persistent gaps.
Kiswahili: Tathmini ilibaini mapengo matatu yanayoendelea.

English: Sub-national health systems remain under-resourced, limiting their ability to contain outbreaks before they escalate nationally.
Kiswahili: Mifumo ya afya ya nchi ndogo bado haina rasilimali za kutosha, na hivyo kupunguza uwezo wake wa kudhibiti milipuko kabla haijaenea kitaifa.

English: Emergency funds exist but are often slow to be released.
Kiswahili: Fedha za dharura zipo lakini mara nyingi hutolewa polepole.

English: Surveillance, laboratory and emergency response systems are also not well connected, delaying real-time decision-making.
Kiswahili: Mifumo ya ufuatiliaji, maabara na majibu ya dharura pia haijaunganishwa vizuri, na hivyo kuchelewesha kufanya maamuzi kwa wakati halisi.

English: In addition, five operational plans have also been developed and lauched to translate these strategies into action, strengthening surveillance, workforce coordination, digital integration, and One Health approaches across human, animal, and environmental health sectors.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, mipango mitano ya uendeshaji pia imetengenezwa na kuanzishwa ili kutafsiri mikakati hii kuwa vitendo, kuimarisha ufuatiliaji, uratibu wa wafanyakazi, ujumuishaji wa kidijitali, na mbinu za One Health katika sekta za afya ya binadamu, wanyama, na mazingira.

English: "Today's event reflects Kenya's continued commitment to building a strong, resilient and coordinated system for preventing, detecting and responding to public health threats," said Dr Neema Rusibamayila Kimambo, Acting WHO representative to Kenya.
Kiswahili: "Tukio la leo linaonyesha kujitolea kwa Kenya kuendelea kujenga mfumo imara, imara na ulioratibiwa kwa ajili ya kuzuia, kugundua na kukabiliana na vitisho vya afya ya umma," alisema Dkt. Neema Rusibamayila Kimambo, Kaimu mwakilishi wa WHO nchini Kenya.

English: "But if we do not put commensurate resources behind this plan, it just becomes a document on the shelf.
Kiswahili: "Lakini tusipoweka rasilimali zinazolingana nyuma ya mpango huu, unakuwa hati tu kwenye rafu."

English: That is the challenge for all of us."
Kiswahili: Hiyo ndiyo changamoto kwetu sote."

English: Progress will be reviewed quarterly against set targets.
Kiswahili: Maendeleo yatapitiwa kila robo mwaka kulingana na malengo yaliyowekwa.

English: The Kenya Health Security Convention, scheduled for May 5–8, was also announced at the launch; it will bring together policymakers, scientists, and health workers to translate evidence into action.
Kiswahili: Mkutano wa Usalama wa Afya wa Kenya, uliopangwa kufanyika Mei 5-8, pia ulitangazwa katika uzinduzi huo; utawaleta pamoja watunga sera, wanasayansi, na wafanyakazi wa afya ili kutafsiri ushahidi kuwa vitendo.

English: The convention aims to advance Universal Health Coverage through a bottom-up, stakeholder-driven approach.
Kiswahili: Mkataba huu unalenga kuendeleza Bima ya Afya kwa Wote kupitia mbinu inayoongozwa na wadau kuanzia chini hadi juu.

English: Narok County—Cholera remains a significant public health concern in Kenya.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Narok—Kipindupindu kinasalia kuwa tatizo kubwa la afya ya umma nchini Kenya.

English: Since 1 October 2025, over 231 cases and 13 deaths were reported across three counties, including Narok, one of the hardest hit.
Kiswahili: Tangu tarehe 1 Oktoba 2025, zaidi ya visa 231 na vifo 13 viliripotiwa katika kaunti tatu, ikiwa ni pamoja na Narok, mojawapo ya zilizoathiriwa zaidi.

English: Welcome to Nairobi - let’s build together at World Health Summit Regional Meeting 2026 Nairobi - World Health Organization (WHO) is poised to be a significant presence at the upcoming World Health Summit (WHS) Regional Meeting 2026 in Nairobi, Kenya.
Kiswahili: Karibu Nairobi - tujenge pamoja katika Mkutano wa Kikanda wa Mkutano wa Afya Duniani 2026 Nairobi - Shirika la Afya Duniani (WHO) liko tayari kuwa na uwepo muhimu katika Mkutano ujao wa Kikanda wa Mkutano wa Afya Duniani (WHS) 2026 jijini Nairobi, Kenya.

English: For the first time at either a global or regional level, WHO is co-organizing a meeting with the World Health Summit.
Kiswahili: Kwa mara ya kwanza katika ngazi ya kimataifa au kikanda, WHO inaandaa mkutano kwa pamoja na Mkutano wa Afya Duniani.

English: This initiative has been spearheaded by WHO in the African region and is the result of an innovative partnership with WHS and Aga Khan University, Kenya.
Kiswahili: Mpango huu umeongozwa na WHO katika eneo la Afrika na ni matokeo ya ushirikiano bunifu na WHS na Chuo Kikuu cha Aga Khan, Kenya.

English: The regional meeting, taking place from 27‒29 April 2026, will bring together global health leaders, policymakers, researchers and development partners to advance solutions for stronger and more resilient health systems.
Kiswahili: Mkutano wa kikanda, unaofanyika kuanzia tarehe 27-29 Aprili 2026, utawakutanisha viongozi wa afya duniani, watunga sera, watafiti na washirika wa maendeleo ili kuendeleza suluhisho kwa mifumo ya afya yenye nguvu na thabiti zaidi.

English: Hosted by WHS and Aga Khan University and held in partnership with WHO, the Ministry of Health in Kenya and the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, the meeting will bring together over 1000 delegates from around 50 countries, participating in 80 sessions focused on strengthening health systems resilience, advancing universal health coverage and accelerating innovation in global health.
Kiswahili: Mkutano huo, ulioandaliwa na WHS na Chuo Kikuu cha Aga Khan na kufanyika kwa ushirikiano na WHO, Wizara ya Afya nchini Kenya na Vituo vya Afrika vya Kudhibiti na Kuzuia Magonjwa, utawaleta pamoja zaidi ya wajumbe 1000 kutoka nchi takriban 50, wakishiriki katika vikao 80 vinavyolenga kuimarisha ustahimilivu wa mifumo ya afya, kuendeleza huduma za afya kwa wote na kuharakisha uvumbuzi katika afya ya kimataifa.

English: WHO has been actively engaged in the development of 80% of the meeting sessions, helping shape an agenda which focuses on strengthening health systems resilience, advancing universal health coverage and accelerating practical solutions to emerging health challenges.
Kiswahili: WHO imekuwa ikishiriki kikamilifu katika uundaji wa 80% ya vikao vya mikutano, ikisaidia kuunda ajenda inayolenga kuimarisha ustahimilivu wa mifumo ya afya, kuendeleza huduma za afya kwa wote na kuharakisha suluhisho za vitendo kwa changamoto zinazoibuka za kiafya.

English: “The World Health Summit Regional Meeting will focus on a theme that is important for the continent of Africa.
Kiswahili: "Mkutano wa Kikanda wa Mkutano wa Afya Duniani utazingatia mada ambayo ni muhimu kwa bara la Afrika."

English: We will be looking at the rising burden of chronic disease, changing patterns of infectious diseases and the health financing landscape in Africa and beyond,” says Professor Lukoye Atwoli, Dean of Medical College East Africa at The Aga Khan University, Kenya, and President of WHS Regional Meeting 2026.
Kiswahili: Tutaangalia mzigo unaoongezeka wa magonjwa sugu, mabadiliko ya mifumo ya magonjwa ya kuambukiza na mazingira ya ufadhili wa afya barani Afrika na kwingineko,” anasema Profesa Lukoye Atwoli, Mkuu wa Chuo cha Tiba cha Afrika Mashariki katika Chuo Kikuu cha Aga Khan, Kenya, na Rais wa Mkutano wa Kikanda wa WHS 2026.

English: Dr Mohamed Janabi, WHO Regional Director for Africa, is a keynote speaker in six high-level sessions, including the opening ceremony which will be attended by His Excellency Williams Ruto, President of Kenya.
Kiswahili: Dkt. Mohamed Janabi, Mkurugenzi wa Kanda ya WHO barani Afrika, ni mzungumzaji mkuu katika vikao sita vya ngazi ya juu, ikiwa ni pamoja na sherehe ya ufunguzi ambayo itahudhuriwa na Mheshimiwa Williams Ruto, Rais wa Kenya.

English: Dr Janabi will also be speaking at 4 sessions that are being led and organized by WHO in the African Region.
Kiswahili: Dkt. Janabi pia atazungumza katika vikao 4 vinavyoongozwa na kuandaliwa na WHO katika Kanda ya Afrika.

English: “The WHO Regional Office for Africa is honoured to co-convene this World Health Summit Regional Meeting.
Kiswahili: "Ofisi ya Kanda ya WHO kwa Afrika inaheshimiwa kuitisha kwa pamoja Mkutano huu wa Kanda wa Mkutano wa Afya Duniani."

English: Over these three days we will consolidate proof and deepen resolve.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hizi tatu tutaimarisha uthibitisho na kuimarisha azimio.

English: We will leave with regional commitments that are global in ambition,” says Dr Janabi.
Kiswahili: Tutaondoka na ahadi za kikanda ambazo ni za kimataifa,” anasema Dkt. Janabi.

English: Aside from Dr Janabi, Dr Hanan Balkhy, WHO Regional Director for the Eastern Mediterranean Region, and Dr Hans Kluge, WHO Regional Director for the European Region, will attend the summit and give keynote speeches in several sessions.
Kiswahili: Mbali na Dkt. Janabi, Dkt. Hanan Balkhy, Mkurugenzi wa Kanda ya WHO kwa Kanda ya Mediterania Mashariki, na Dkt. Hans Kluge, Mkurugenzi wa Kanda ya WHO kwa Kanda ya Ulaya, watahudhuria mkutano huo na kutoa hotuba kuu katika vikao kadhaa.

English: Eleven WHO programme directors from around the globe will attend as speakers and seven WHO staff are panel chairs for sessions.
Kiswahili: Wakurugenzi kumi na mmoja wa programu za WHO kutoka kote ulimwenguni watahudhuria kama wazungumzaji na wafanyakazi saba wa WHO ni wenyeviti wa jopo kwa ajili ya vikao.

English: WHO has a confirmed speaker in 22 of the 80 sessions.
Kiswahili: WHO ina mzungumzaji aliyethibitishwa katika vikao 22 kati ya 80.

English: In total, almost 90 WHO staff are participating in the regional meeting.
Kiswahili: Kwa jumla, karibu wafanyakazi 90 wa WHO wanashiriki katika mkutano wa kikanda.

English: This includes around 20 support staff who will provide administrative, logistics and communications support to WHO speakers, chairs and other delegates.
Kiswahili: Hii inajumuisha takriban wafanyakazi 20 wa usaidizi ambao watatoa usaidizi wa kiutawala, vifaa na mawasiliano kwa wazungumzaji wa WHO, wenyeviti na wajumbe wengine.

English: Staff are drawn from 4 country offices—Kenya, Ethiopia, Eritrea and Ghana—the three regional offices and WHO headquarters in Geneva.
Kiswahili: Wafanyakazi wametoka katika ofisi 4 za nchi—Kenya, Ethiopia, Eritrea na Ghana—ofisi tatu za kikanda na makao makuu ya WHO huko Geneva.

English: The WHO exhibition booth promises to be a dynamic and meaningful space, featuring latest WHO publications, an interactive virtual reality installation which simulates polio vaccination in a community, and a demonstration of a WHO-developed AI application for emergency response.
Kiswahili: Kibanda cha maonyesho cha WHO kinaahidi kuwa nafasi yenye nguvu na yenye maana, kikiwa na machapisho ya hivi karibuni ya WHO, usakinishaji shirikishi wa uhalisia pepe ambao huiga chanjo ya polio katika jamii, na onyesho la programu ya AI iliyotengenezwa na WHO kwa ajili ya kukabiliana na dharura.

English: Nairobi—Countries in the African region faced more than 140 health emergencies in 2025, ranging from infectious disease outbreaks to climate-related shocks and humanitarian crises.
Kiswahili: Nairobi—Nchi katika eneo la Afrika zilikabiliwa na dharura zaidi ya 140 za kiafya mwaka wa 2025, kuanzia milipuko ya magonjwa ya kuambukiza hadi mishtuko inayohusiana na hali ya hewa na migogoro ya kibinadamu.

English: World Health Organization (WHO)’s regional Emergency Preparedness and Response Hub in Nairobi, Kenya, plays a critical role in preparing for and responding to these health emergencies, providing operational support and logistics, storing and distributing medical supplies and equipment, and facilitating rapid response.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Maandalizi na Majibu ya Dharura cha Shirika la Afya Duniani (WHO) huko Nairobi, Kenya, kina jukumu muhimu katika kujiandaa na kukabiliana na dharura hizi za kiafya, kutoa usaidizi wa uendeshaji na vifaa, kuhifadhi na kusambaza vifaa na vifaa vya matibabu, na kuwezesha majibu ya haraka.

English: Recognizing the strategic position of the hub, members of The Elders—an independent group of global leaders founded by Nelson Mandela in 2007 working for peace, justice, human rights and a sustainable planet—visited the hub on 14 May 2026 to witness firsthand WHO health emergency operations, including cutting-edge disease surveillance and operations support and logistics.
Kiswahili: Kwa kutambua nafasi ya kimkakati ya kituo hicho, wanachama wa The Elders—kikundi huru cha viongozi wa kimataifa kilichoanzishwa na Nelson Mandela mwaka wa 2007 kinachofanya kazi kwa ajili ya amani, haki, haki za binadamu na sayari endelevu—walitembelea kituo hicho mnamo tarehe 14 Mei 2026 ili kushuhudia shughuli za dharura za afya za WHO, ikiwa ni pamoja na ufuatiliaji wa magonjwa wa hali ya juu na usaidizi wa uendeshaji na vifaa.

English: Three of The Elders four programmes—climate crisis, pandemics, conflicts and nuclear weapons—link directly to the work carried out by WHO’s Emergency Preparedness and Response programme.
Kiswahili: Programu tatu kati ya The Elders nne—mgogoro wa hali ya hewa, magonjwa ya mlipuko, migogoro na silaha za nyuklia—zinahusiana moja kwa moja na kazi inayofanywa na mpango wa Maandalizi na Majibu ya Dharura wa WHO.

English: In 2025 alone, more than 2000 consignments of medical supplies and equipment were shipped from the hub’s warehouse to around 20 countries in the region.
Kiswahili: Mnamo mwaka wa 2025 pekee, zaidi ya shehena 2000 za vifaa vya matibabu na vifaa vilisafirishwa kutoka ghala la kituo hicho hadi karibu nchi 20 katika eneo hilo.

English: All these countries were responding to complex and urgent health emergencies, such as Ebola virus disease, Marburg virus disease, cholera, flooding and refugee crises.
Kiswahili: Nchi hizi zote zilikuwa zikiitikia dharura ngumu na za dharura za kiafya, kama vile ugonjwa wa virusi vya Ebola, ugonjwa wa virusi vya Marburg, kipindupindu, mafuriko na migogoro ya wakimbizi.

English: A critical role of WHO’s health emergency operations is to build the capacity of countries’ ability to prepare and respond, leaving behind a more resilient health system and sustainable health response once the emergency has ended.
Kiswahili: Jukumu muhimu la shughuli za dharura za afya za WHO ni kujenga uwezo wa nchi kujiandaa na kujibu, na kuacha mfumo wa afya imara zaidi na mwitikio endelevu wa afya mara tu dharura itakapoisha.

English: At its core PDX is an embedded artificial intelligence assistant that allows health officials to query live preparedness data in plain language and receive source-cited, auditable answers grounded in validated WHO datasets.
Kiswahili: Katika msingi wake, PDX ni msaidizi wa akili bandia aliyepachikwa ambaye huruhusu maafisa wa afya kuuliza data ya maandalizi ya moja kwa moja kwa lugha rahisi na kupokea majibu yanayoweza kukaguliwa kutoka chanzo yaliyotokana na seti za data za WHO zilizothibitishwa.

English: “The visual impact of what we have seen here is something we should make public, to bring home the importance of countries working together, and with WHO, using cutting-edge tools to address pandemic preparedness and response,” said Ernesto Zedillo, former President of Mexico and member of The Elders.
Kiswahili: "Athari inayoonekana ya kile tulichokiona hapa ni jambo ambalo tunapaswa kulifanya hadharani, ili kukumbusha umuhimu wa nchi kufanya kazi pamoja, na WHO, kutumia zana za kisasa kushughulikia utayari na mwitikio wa janga," alisema Ernesto Zedillo, Rais wa zamani wa Mexico na mwanachama wa The Elders.

English: The Elders were also taken through a facilitated simulation exercise to stimulate discussion on how they can shape high-level advocacy on pandemic preparedness and response ahead of the UN General Assembly later this year.
Kiswahili: Wazee pia walipitia zoezi la kuiga lililowezeshwa ili kuchochea majadiliano kuhusu jinsi wanavyoweza kuunda utetezi wa kiwango cha juu kuhusu maandalizi na mwitikio wa janga kabla ya Mkutano Mkuu wa Umoja wa Mataifa baadaye mwaka huu.

English: This gathering will be an important forum for The Elders to advocate with Member States on the benefits of bringing the WHO Pandemic Agreement into force.
Kiswahili: Mkutano huu utakuwa jukwaa muhimu kwa Wazee kutetea na Nchi Wanachama kuhusu faida za kuanzisha utekelezaji wa Mkataba wa Janga la WHO.

English: This is a best practice in Africa and a great cause for humanity," said Elbegdorj Tsakhia, former Prime Minister and President of Mongolia and member of The Elders.
Kiswahili: Huu ni utaratibu bora barani Afrika na ni sababu kubwa ya ubinadamu," alisema Elbegdorj Tsakhia, Waziri Mkuu wa zamani na Rais wa Mongolia na mwanachama wa The Elders.

English: "The Elders have a voice and people listen to us.
Kiswahili: "Wazee wana sauti na watu wanatusikiliza."

English: I am sure we will have great cooperation as a result of this visit."
Kiswahili: Nina uhakika tutakuwa na ushirikiano mkubwa kutokana na ziara hii."

English: Together for a healthier world WHO’s work is founded on the principle that all people, everywhere, should enjoy the highest standard of health.
Kiswahili: Pamoja kwa ajili ya ulimwengu wenye afya njema Kazi ya WHO imejengwa juu ya kanuni kwamba watu wote, kila mahali, wanapaswa kufurahia kiwango cha juu cha afya.

English: WHO offers a dynamic work environment, opportunities for professional development and a competitive pay and benefits package.
Kiswahili: WHO inatoa mazingira ya kazi yenye mabadiliko, fursa za maendeleo ya kitaaluma na kifurushi cha malipo na marupurupu chenye ushindani.

English: We are committed to achieving a diverse, multicultural and gender balanced workforce with broad representation from our Member States.
Kiswahili: Tumejitolea kufikia nguvu kazi yenye uwiano wa kijinsia, tamaduni nyingi na uwakilishi mpana kutoka Nchi Wanachama wetu.

English: Can you imagine by 2023 one billion more people with access to health services, one billion more kept safer from outbreaks and emergencies, and another billion living healthier?
Kiswahili: Je, unaweza kufikiria ifikapo mwaka 2023 watu bilioni moja zaidi wakiwa na upatikanaji wa huduma za afya, bilioni moja zaidi wakiwa salama kutokana na milipuko na dharura, na bilioni nyingine kuishi kwa afya njema?

English: Join us on the drive to provide health for all.
Kiswahili: Jiunge nasi katika harakati za kutoa afya kwa wote.

English: Each day, our teams meet the emerging challenges in all the areas of the Organization, from senior leaders to emergency administration staff, and from health specialists to data managers.
Kiswahili: Kila siku, timu zetu hukabiliana na changamoto zinazojitokeza katika maeneo yote ya Shirika, kuanzia viongozi wakuu hadi wafanyakazi wa usimamizi wa dharura, na kuanzia wataalamu wa afya hadi mameneja wa data.

English: Public health We are proud of our public health experts.
Kiswahili: Afya ya umma Tunajivunia wataalamu wetu wa afya ya umma.

English: They are results oriented and drive programmes in all areas of health and emergencies.
Kiswahili: Ni programu zinazolenga matokeo na zinazoongoza katika maeneo yote ya afya na dharura.

English: They are agile and work at the country, regional and headquarters levels to achieve the highest standards of health through evidence-based programmes and goals.
Kiswahili: Wao ni wepesi na hufanya kazi katika ngazi za nchi, kikanda na makao makuu ili kufikia viwango vya juu zaidi vya afya kupitia programu na malengo yanayotegemea ushahidi.

English: They are our driving force and our face to the public.
Kiswahili: Wao ndio nguvu yetu inayotusukuma na uso wetu kwa umma.

English: They are committed to upholding WHO’s role in our changing world and inspiring the next generation of leaders.
Kiswahili: Wamejitolea kuunga mkono jukumu la WHO katika ulimwengu wetu unaobadilika na kuwatia moyo viongozi wa kizazi kijacho.

English: The stronger our leaders, the healthier our world will be.
Kiswahili: Kadiri viongozi wetu wanavyokuwa na nguvu, ndivyo dunia yetu itakavyokuwa na afya njema.

English: Operations Our administration is dedicated to business strategy and innovative practices.
Kiswahili: Uendeshaji Utawala wetu umejitolea kwa mikakati ya biashara na mbinu bunifu.

English: WHO recognizes the importance of a strong management administration structure, committed to enabling people to work to the best of their ability and to optimizing the resources available throughout the organization.
Kiswahili: WHO inatambua umuhimu wa muundo imara wa utawala wa usimamizi, uliojitolea kuwawezesha watu kufanya kazi kwa uwezo wao wote na kuboresha rasilimali zinazopatikana katika shirika lote.

English: Emergency At any one time, the WHO workforce is actively responding to dozens of infectious disease outbreaks and natural disasters around the world.
Kiswahili: Dharura Wakati wowote, wafanyakazi wa WHO wanashughulikia kikamilifu milipuko mingi ya magonjwa ya kuambukiza na majanga ya asili kote ulimwenguni.

English: WHO staff have an essential role to play in supporting Member States to prepare for, respond to and recover from emergencies with public health consequences.
Kiswahili: Wafanyakazi wa WHO wana jukumu muhimu la kuchukua katika kusaidia Nchi Wanachama kujiandaa, kukabiliana na kupona kutokana na dharura zenye matokeo ya kiafya.

English: WHO Talent Programmes Help us reach our Triple Billion targets by joining us through one of our talent programmes.
Kiswahili: Programu za Vipaji za WHO Tusaidie kufikia malengo yetu ya Bilioni Tatu kwa kujiunga nasi kupitia moja ya programu zetu za vipaji.

English: Junior Professional Officer Programme The Junior Professional Officer (JPO) Programme allows young professionals to gain practical experience in multi-lateral technical co-operation at an early stage in their career.
Kiswahili: Programu ya Afisa Mtaalamu wa Kijana Programu ya Afisa Mtaalamu wa Kijana (JPO) inaruhusu wataalamu wachanga kupata uzoefu wa vitendo katika ushirikiano wa kiufundi wa pande nyingi katika hatua za mwanzo za kazi zao.

English: Positions are available at our headquarters and at our regional and country offices.
Kiswahili: Nafasi zinapatikana katika makao makuu yetu na katika ofisi zetu za kikanda na za nchi.

English: Internship Programme WHO's Internship Programme offers a wide range of opportunities for students and recent graduates to gain insight into our technical programmes and administration; to acquire knowledge in specific areas and benefit from hands on work experience.
Kiswahili: Programu ya Mafunzo ya Ufundi Programu ya Mafunzo ya WHO inatoa fursa mbalimbali kwa wanafunzi na wahitimu wa hivi karibuni kupata ufahamu kuhusu programu na utawala wetu wa kiufundi; kupata maarifa katika maeneo maalum na kunufaika na uzoefu wa kazi.

English: UN Volunteers Programme WHO offers opportunities for UN Volunteers in many areas of expertise to strengthen capacity at the country and regional levels.
Kiswahili: Programu ya Wajitolea ya Umoja wa Mataifa WHO inatoa fursa kwa Wajitolea wa Umoja wa Mataifa katika maeneo mengi ya utaalamu ili kuimarisha uwezo katika ngazi za nchi na kikanda.

English: UN Volunteers support WHO by contributing their skills to help reach our Triple Billion targets.
Kiswahili: Wajitolea wa Umoja wa Mataifa wanaunga mkono WHO kwa kuchangia ujuzi wao ili kusaidia kufikia malengo yetu ya Bilioni Tatu.

English: Young Professionals Programme This WHO programme offers young professionals from a specific list of “Least Developed Countries” structured opportunities to engage in WHO’s work and build skills and competencies in key public health areas and incorporates exposure at country level.
Kiswahili: Programu ya Wataalamu Vijana Programu hii ya WHO inawapa wataalamu vijana kutoka orodha maalum ya fursa zilizopangwa za "Nchi Zisizoendelea" kushiriki katika kazi ya WHO na kujenga ujuzi na uwezo katika maeneo muhimu ya afya ya umma na inajumuisha kufichuliwa katika ngazi ya nchi.

English: Join us on the drive to provide health for all, apply to WHO vacancies today
Kiswahili: Jiunge nasi katika harakati za kutoa afya kwa wote, tuma maombi kwa nafasi zilizo wazi za WHO leo

English: Nairobi – Five years ago, Esther Omagwa was one of only two nurses at the Railways Health Centre in Kisumu County, western Kenya.
Kiswahili: Nairobi – Miaka mitano iliyopita, Esther Omagwa alikuwa mmoja wa wauguzi wawili pekee katika Kituo cha Afya cha Reli katika Kaunti ya Kisumu, magharibi mwa Kenya.

English: The immense workload often exhausted her, forcing her to turn away clients.
Kiswahili: Mzigo mkubwa wa kazi mara nyingi ulimchosha, na kumlazimisha kuwafukuza wateja.

English: Today, the scene at the community health centre is remarkably different.
Kiswahili: Leo, hali katika kituo cha afya cha jamii ni tofauti sana.

English: With the nursing staff now expanded to a team of four, Omagwa and her colleagues are better equipped to deal with the load.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa wafanyakazi wa uuguzi sasa wameongezeka hadi kufikia timu ya watu wanne, Omagwa na wenzake wamejiandaa vyema kukabiliana na mzigo huo.

English: Nairobi—Kenya has made notable progress in health workforce production, including a doubling of nurses, doctors, and other health professionals over the past decade.
Kiswahili: Nairobi—Kenya imepata maendeleo makubwa katika uzalishaji wa wafanyakazi wa afya, ikiwa ni pamoja na kuongezeka maradufu kwa wauguzi, madaktari, na wataalamu wengine wa afya katika muongo mmoja uliopita.

English: However, findings from the Health Labour Market Analysis also identify persisting and emerging gaps in the availability of health workers.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, matokeo kutoka kwa Uchambuzi wa Soko la Ajira ya Afya pia yanabainisha mapengo yanayoendelea na yanayojitokeza katika upatikanaji wa wafanyakazi wa afya.

English: The analysis projects that to meet the population's health needs, more than 114,000 additional health professionals across 31 different roles will need to be trained, employed, and retained within the health system by 2031.
Kiswahili: Uchambuzi unaonyesha kwamba ili kukidhi mahitaji ya afya ya idadi ya watu, zaidi ya wataalamu wa afya 114,000 zaidi katika majukumu 31 tofauti watahitaji kufunzwa, kuajiriwa, na kubaki ndani ya mfumo wa afya ifikapo mwaka wa 2031.

English: Mobile health services in Kenya reduce the risk of stillbirths Samburu County, Kenya - In Lolmolong village, in Samburu County in northern Kenya, Neshoo Leaungokiok laboured through the night, far from the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Huduma za afya zinazohamishika nchini Kenya hupunguza hatari ya kuzaliwa watoto mfu Kaunti ya Samburu, Kenya - Katika kijiji cha Lolmolong, katika Kaunti ya Samburu kaskazini mwa Kenya, Neshoo Leaungokiok alifanya kazi usiku kucha, mbali na kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.

English: As labour intensified, Lucy Makena, a reproductive health officer from a nearby mobile outreach clinic supported by World Health Organization (WHO), reached the home.
Kiswahili: Kadri leba ilivyozidi kuongezeka, Lucy Makena, afisa wa afya ya uzazi kutoka kliniki ya karibu inayoweza kuhamishwa inayoungwa mkono na Shirika la Afya Duniani (WHO), alifika nyumbani.

English: These clinics operate from off-road trucks fitted with a consultation room, patient beds, a small laboratory, and a pharmacy, designed to bring essential care directly to communities far from any permanent facility.
Kiswahili: Kliniki hizi hufanya kazi kutoka kwa malori ya barabarani yaliyo na chumba cha ushauri, vitanda vya wagonjwa, maabara ndogo, na duka la dawa, iliyoundwa ili kuleta huduma muhimu moja kwa moja kwa jamii zilizo mbali na kituo chochote cha kudumu.

English: Trained in emergency obstetric and newborn care through programmes also supported by WHO, she quickly assessed Leaungokiok’s condition and began monitoring the progress of labour.
Kiswahili: Akiwa amefunzwa katika huduma ya dharura ya uzazi na watoto wachanga kupitia programu zinazoungwa mkono pia na WHO, alitathmini haraka hali ya Leaungokiok na kuanza kufuatilia maendeleo ya uchungu wa kujifungua.

English: “I found her already in active labour” Makena recalls.
Kiswahili: "Nilimkuta tayari akiwa katika uchungu wa uzazi" Makena anakumbuka.

English: “I stayed with her, monitored her progress closely and supported the delivery.” Makena’s presence came at a critical moment.
Kiswahili: "Nilikaa naye, nikafuatilia maendeleo yake kwa karibu na kuunga mkono utoaji." Uwepo wa Makena ulikuja wakati muhimu.

English: In settings where complications can go unrecognized and timely care is often out of reach, skilled support can mean the difference between life and death.
Kiswahili: Katika mazingira ambapo matatizo yanaweza kutotambuliwa na huduma ya wakati unaofaa mara nyingi haipatikani, usaidizi wa kitaalamu unaweza kumaanisha tofauti kati ya maisha na kifo.

English: With Makena’s support and care, Leaungokiok safely delivered a healthy baby girl.
Kiswahili: Kwa msaada na utunzaji wa Makena, Leaungokiok alijifungua salama mtoto wa kike mwenye afya njema.

English: Shortly after birth, however, Leaungokiok began to bleed heavily, a potentially life-threatening complication if not managed quickly.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, muda mfupi baada ya kuzaliwa, Leaungokiok alianza kutokwa na damu nyingi, tatizo ambalo linaweza kuhatarisha maisha ikiwa halitashughulikiwa haraka.

English: Acting immediately, Lucy administered lifesaving medicine to control the bleeding.
Kiswahili: Lucy alitenda mara moja, akampa dawa ya kuokoa maisha ili kudhibiti kutokwa na damu.

English: She also supported the mother to initiate breastfeeding within the first hour, an essential step in protecting the newborn’s health.
Kiswahili: Pia alimsaidia mama kuanza kunyonyesha ndani ya saa ya kwanza, hatua muhimu katika kulinda afya ya mtoto mchanga.

English: I am grateful to have delivered safely and to have a healthy baby,” says Leaungokiok, cradling her daughter.
Kiswahili: Ninashukuru kujifungua salama na kupata mtoto mwenye afya njema,” anasema Leaungokiok, akimbeba binti yake.

English: For Makena, moments like this reflect the importance of reaching women wherever they are.
Kiswahili: Kwa Makena, nyakati kama hizi zinaonyesha umuhimu wa kuwafikia wanawake popote walipo.

English: “In many of these communities, there may be no doctor nearby” she explains.
Kiswahili: "Katika jamii nyingi hizi, huenda kusiwe na daktari karibu" anaelezea.

English: “The training we receive helps us to act quickly, manage complications and support mothers safely through delivery.” Through collaboration with county health authorities, WHO is supporting the expansion of emergency obstetric and newborn care services in northern Kenya, including training health workers and strengthening outreach services to reach remote communities.
Kiswahili: "Mafunzo tunayopokea hutusaidia kuchukua hatua haraka, kudhibiti matatizo na kuwasaidia akina mama salama wakati wa kujifungua." Kupitia ushirikiano na mamlaka za afya za kaunti, WHO inaunga mkono upanuzi wa huduma za dharura za uzazi na huduma za watoto wachanga kaskazini mwa Kenya, ikiwa ni pamoja na kuwafunza wafanyakazi wa afya na kuimarisha huduma za uhamasishaji ili kufikia jamii za mbali.

English: In the past year, WHO has supported 14 of the 47 counties in Kenya to develop a pool of facility-based mentors of emergency obstetric and newborn care, helping ensure that more women can access skilled care during pregnancy and childbirth, even in the most hard-to-reach areas.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka uliopita, WHO imesaidia kaunti 14 kati ya 47 nchini Kenya kuunda kundi la washauri wa dharura wa uzazi na watoto wachanga wanaopatikana katika vituo vya afya, na kusaidia kuhakikisha kwamba wanawake wengi zaidi wanaweza kupata huduma stadi wakati wa ujauzito na kujifungua, hata katika maeneo ambayo ni magumu kufikiwa.

English: While access to skilled birth care remains limited in some parts of the African Region, targeted investments in health workforce training and service delivery are helping to close the gap, as in Leaungokiok’s case.
Kiswahili: Ingawa upatikanaji wa huduma ya uzazi yenye ujuzi bado ni mdogo katika baadhi ya maeneo ya Kanda ya Afrika, uwekezaji unaolengwa katika mafunzo ya wafanyakazi wa afya na utoaji wa huduma unasaidia kuziba pengo hilo, kama ilivyo kwa kisa cha Leaungokiok.

English: WHO and Kenya hand over theatre beds and cancer equipment to strengthen maternal and women's health services Nairobi - Kenya's Ministry of Health and the World Health Organization (WHO) handed over 108 electric obstetric theatre beds and a package of women's cancer screening and management equipment at Kenyatta National Hospital on 9 June 2026, in a move intended to strengthen the country's capacity to manage obstetric emergencies and expand access to cervical and breast cancer services.
Kiswahili: WHO na Kenya zakabidhi vitanda vya kuigiza na vifaa vya saratani ili kuimarisha huduma za afya ya akina mama na wanawake Nairobi - Wizara ya Afya ya Kenya na Shirika la Afya Duniani (WHO) zilikabidhi vitanda 108 vya kuigiza vya umeme na kifurushi cha vifaa vya uchunguzi na usimamizi wa saratani ya wanawake katika Hospitali ya Kitaifa ya Kenyatta mnamo tarehe 9 Juni 2026, katika hatua iliyokusudiwa kuimarisha uwezo wa nchi hiyo wa kusimamia dharura za uzazi na kupanua ufikiaji wa huduma za saratani ya shingo ya kizazi na matiti.

English: Valued at KSh 43 million, the theatre beds will be distributed to 45 health facilities across 11 priority counties, while the cancer equipment will go to eight facilities in two counties, Bungoma and Nyandarua.
Kiswahili: Vikiwa na thamani ya KSh milioni 43, vitanda vya kuigiza vitasambazwa katika vituo 45 vya afya katika kaunti 11 zilizopewa kipaumbele, huku vifaa vya saratani vikitumika katika vituo nane katika kaunti mbili, Bungoma na Nyandarua.

English: Maternal mortality remains a significant public health challenge in Kenya.
Kiswahili: Vifo vya akina mama bado ni changamoto kubwa ya afya ya umma nchini Kenya.

English: According to the Every Woman Every Newborn Everywhere (EWENE) Acceleration Plan, an estimated 355 women die for every 100,000 live births, and the country records around 30,400 stillbirths a year, with neonatal mortality at 21 per 1,000 live births against a 2030 target of 12.
Kiswahili: Kulingana na Mpango wa Kuongeza Kasi wa Kila Mwanamke Kila Mtoto Anayezaliwa Kila Mahali (EWENE), inakadiriwa kuwa wanawake 355 hufariki kwa kila vizazi 100,000 vilivyo hai, na nchi hiyo inarekodi takriban vizazi 30,400 vilivyokufa kwa mwaka, huku vifo vya watoto wachanga vikifikia 21 kwa kila vizazi 1,000 vilivyo hai dhidi ya lengo la 2030 la 12.

English: Although 89 per cent of births are attended by a skilled health worker, only 5 per cent of facilities offering maternity services have all the equipment required for comprehensive emergency obstetric care, and just 63 per cent have a functioning maternity theatre, with only 18 per cent able to conduct caesarean sections.
Kiswahili: Ingawa asilimia 89 ya vizazi huhudumiwa na mfanyakazi wa afya mwenye ujuzi, asilimia 5 pekee ya vituo vinavyotoa huduma za uzazi vina vifaa vyote vinavyohitajika kwa ajili ya huduma kamili ya dharura ya uzazi, na asilimia 63 pekee vina chumba cha uzazi kinachofanya kazi, huku asilimia 18 pekee ikiweza kufanya upasuaji wa kujifungua.

English: The handover builds on commitments made on 28 May 2026, when President William Ruto launched the EWENE Acceleration Plan 2026 to 2028 and the Maternal and Newborn Health Rapid Results Initiative at State House, Nairobi, pledging KES 7.5 billion towards maternal, newborn and reproductive health services.
Kiswahili: Makabidhiano hayo yanatokana na ahadi zilizotolewa tarehe 28 Mei 2026, wakati Rais William Ruto alipozindua Mpango wa Kuongeza Kasi wa EWENE 2026 hadi 2028 na Mpango wa Matokeo ya Haraka ya Afya ya Mama na Mtoto Mchanga katika Ikulu ya Serikali, Nairobi, akiahidi shilingi bilioni 7.5 kwa huduma za afya ya uzazi, watoto wachanga na uzazi.

English: Speaking at that launch, Dr Neema Rusibamayila Kimambo, WHO's Acting Representative in Kenya, said Africa accounts for roughly 70 per cent of global maternal deaths and half of all newborn deaths, and that in Kenya, an estimated 16 mothers and 90 newborns die every day.
Kiswahili: Akizungumza katika uzinduzi huo, Dkt. Neema Rusibamayila Kimambo, Kaimu Mwakilishi wa WHO nchini Kenya, alisema Afrika inachangia takriban asilimia 70 ya vifo vya akina mama duniani na nusu ya vifo vyote vya watoto wachanga, na kwamba nchini Kenya, inakadiriwa kuwa akina mama 16 na watoto wachanga 90 hufa kila siku.

English: "These are not statistics," she said.
Kiswahili: "Hizi si takwimu," alisema.

English: These are absences at dinner tables, at school gates, and economic loss to the country."
Kiswahili: Hizi ni kutokuwepo kwenye meza za chakula cha jioni, kwenye malango ya shule, na hasara ya kiuchumi kwa nchi."

English: She said WHO and its partners had pledged support behind the initiative.
Kiswahili: Alisema WHO na washirika wake wameahidi kuunga mkono mpango huo.

English: At the equipment handover in Nairobi, Kimambo said the donation reflected that broader commitment.
Kiswahili: Katika makabidhiano ya vifaa jijini Nairobi, Kimambo alisema mchango huo ulionyesha kujitolea huko kwa upana zaidi.

English: "Today's handover is not simply about equipment," she said.
Kiswahili: "Makabidhiano ya leo si kuhusu vifaa tu," alisema.

English: "It is about strengthening health systems, expanding access to quality care, and ensuring that women, newborns and communities receive the services they need, when and where they need them."
Kiswahili: "Ni kuhusu kuimarisha mifumo ya afya, kupanua upatikanaji wa huduma bora, na kuhakikisha kwamba wanawake, watoto wachanga na jamii wanapata huduma wanazohitaji, wakati na mahali wanapozihitaji."

English: Dr Ouma Oluga, Principal Secretary for Medical Services in Kenya's State Department for Medical Services, said the investments were meant to translate into improved quality of care, earlier diagnosis and safer deliveries for women and newborns.
Kiswahili: Dkt. Ouma Oluga, Katibu Mkuu wa Huduma za Kimatibabu katika Idara ya Huduma za Kimatibabu ya Nchi ya Kenya, alisema uwekezaji huo ulikusudiwa kutafsiri ubora wa huduma, utambuzi wa mapema na uzazi salama kwa wanawake na watoto wachanga.

English: "Behind every bed and every piece of equipment is a woman whose life may be saved, a newborn who will have a healthier start in life, and a family whose future will be protected," he said.
Kiswahili: "Nyuma ya kila kitanda na kila kifaa kuna mwanamke ambaye maisha yake yanaweza kuokolewa, mtoto mchanga ambaye atakuwa na mwanzo mzuri wa maisha, na familia ambayo mustakabali wake utalindwa," alisema.

English: He added that a resilient health system must support women across the life course, not only during pregnancy and childbirth, central to the government's commitment to Universal Health Coverage.
Kiswahili: Aliongeza kuwa mfumo thabiti wa afya lazima uwasaidie wanawake katika maisha yao yote, si tu wakati wa ujauzito na kujifungua, jambo muhimu katika ahadi ya serikali ya Bima ya Afya kwa Wote.

English: Alongside the maternal health investment, WHO and the Ministry of Health also provided a comprehensive package of cancer screening, diagnostic, laboratory, pathology and treatment equipment to the eight facilities in Bungoma and Nyandarua, including cervical cancer screening tools, laboratory and pathology equipment for investigating pre-cancerous conditions, diagnostic and imaging equipment, and treatment devices for pre-cancerous lesions.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na uwekezaji wa afya ya uzazi, WHO na Wizara ya Afya pia walitoa kifurushi kamili cha uchunguzi wa saratani, uchunguzi, maabara, magonjwa na vifaa vya matibabu kwa vituo vinane huko Bungoma na Nyandarua, ikiwa ni pamoja na vifaa vya uchunguzi wa saratani ya shingo ya kizazi, vifaa vya maabara na magonjwa kwa ajili ya kuchunguza hali za kabla ya saratani, vifaa vya uchunguzi na upigaji picha, na vifaa vya matibabu kwa vidonda vya kabla ya saratani.

English: The equipment is being delivered through the Women's Integrated Cancer Services (WICS) Project, a partnership between the Ministry of Health, WHO and Roche that has, since its launch in October 2024, integrated breast and cervical cancer screening into primary healthcare and screened 8,440 women, against a target of 10,000.
Kiswahili: Vifaa hivyo vinatolewa kupitia Mradi wa Huduma Jumuishi za Saratani za Wanawake (WICS), ushirikiano kati ya Wizara ya Afya, WHO na Roche ambao, tangu kuzinduliwa kwake Oktoba 2024, umejumuisha uchunguzi wa saratani ya matiti na shingo ya kizazi katika huduma ya afya ya msingi na kuwapima wanawake 8,440, dhidi ya lengo la 10,000.

English: By bringing screening, diagnosis and treatment closer together, the project aims to reduce loss to follow-up, a persistent barrier in cancer care that can delay treatment once an abnormal result is identified.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuleta uchunguzi, utambuzi na matibabu karibu zaidi, mradi unalenga kupunguza hasara kwa ufuatiliaji, kizuizi kinachoendelea katika huduma ya saratani ambacho kinaweza kuchelewesha matibabu mara tu matokeo yasiyo ya kawaida yanapogunduliwa.

English: Kimambo said the new equipment would directly address this challenge, describing loss to follow-up as one of the most persistent barriers to successful cancer care.
Kiswahili: Kimambo alisema vifaa hivyo vipya vitashughulikia moja kwa moja changamoto hii, akielezea hasara ya ufuatiliaji kama mojawapo ya vikwazo vinavyoendelea kwa mafanikio ya huduma ya saratani.

English: To support effective use, WHO and the Ministry of Health matched the equipment to facilities with capacity to deliver the relevant services and coordinated installation, training and mentorship support.
Kiswahili: Ili kusaidia matumizi bora, WHO na Wizara ya Afya walilinganisha vifaa hivyo na vifaa vyenye uwezo wa kutoa huduma husika na kuratibu usakinishaji, mafunzo na usaidizi wa ushauri.

English: Oluga called on beneficiary counties and facilities to ensure proper use, maintenance and accountability.
Kiswahili: Oluga alitoa wito kwa kaunti na vifaa vinavyonufaika kuhakikisha matumizi, matengenezo na uwajibikaji unaofaa.

English: "The true value of this equipment will be measured by the lives saved, the complications prevented, the women treated with dignity, the cancers detected early, and the health workers empowered to provide quality care," Kimambo said.
Kiswahili: "Thamani halisi ya vifaa hivi itapimwa kwa maisha yaliyookolewa, matatizo yaliyozuiliwa, wanawake watakaotendewa kwa heshima, saratani zilizogunduliwa mapema, na wafanyakazi wa afya waliowezeshwa kutoa huduma bora," Kimambo alisema.

English: WHO's mandate in Kenya centres on strengthening health systems and expanding access to quality maternal, newborn and women's health services in support of Universal Health Coverage.
Kiswahili: Agizo la WHO nchini Kenya linalenga kuimarisha mifumo ya afya na kupanua upatikanaji wa huduma bora za afya za akina mama, watoto wachanga na wanawake ili kuunga mkono Bima ya Afya kwa Wote.

English: This includes technical and operational support for the EWENE Acceleration Plan and Rapid Results Initiative, and its partnership in the Women's Integrated Cancer Services Project.
Kiswahili: Hii inajumuisha usaidizi wa kiufundi na kiutendaji kwa Mpango wa Kuongeza Kasi wa EWENE na Mpango wa Matokeo ya Haraka, na ushirikiano wake katika Mradi wa Huduma Jumuishi za Saratani za Wanawake.

English: WHO and Aga Khan University partnership to strengthen women's cancer services in Africa Nairobi - The World Health Organization (WHO) and Aga Khan University-Kenya (AKU) today launched a new partnership to accelerate the fight against breast and cervical cancer, the two leading cancers claiming women's lives in Africa.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano wa WHO na Chuo Kikuu cha Aga Khan kuimarisha huduma za saratani kwa wanawake barani Afrika Nairobi - Shirika la Afya Duniani (WHO) na Chuo Kikuu cha Aga Khan-Kenya (AKU) leo wamezindua ushirikiano mpya ili kuharakisha mapambano dhidi ya saratani ya matiti na shingo ya kizazi, saratani mbili zinazoongoza zinazoua maisha ya wanawake barani Afrika.

English: In Kenya, an estimated 7 243 women are diagnosed with breast cancer each year, with 3 398 deaths, while cervical cancer accounts for 5 845 new cases and 3 600 deaths annually.
Kiswahili: Nchini Kenya, inakadiriwa kuwa wanawake 7,243 hugunduliwa na saratani ya matiti kila mwaka, huku vifo 3,398 vikitokea, huku saratani ya shingo ya kizazi ikichangia visa vipya 5,845 na vifo 3,600 kila mwaka.

English: Across the African region, between 60 and 70% of women are diagnosed at a late stage, and only one in two women with breast cancer will survive five years, compared with more than 90% in high-income countries.
Kiswahili: Kote barani Afrika, kati ya 60 na 70% ya wanawake hugunduliwa wakiwa katika hatua za mwisho za ugonjwa, na ni mwanamke mmoja tu kati ya wawili wenye saratani ya matiti atakayeishi kwa miaka mitano, ikilinganishwa na zaidi ya 90% katika nchi zenye kipato cha juu.

English: Too many cancers that can be prevented, found early and treated are still catching women too late.
Kiswahili: Saratani nyingi sana ambazo zinaweza kuzuiwa, kupatikana mapema na kutibiwa bado zinawapata wanawake kuchelewa sana.

English: Under a Memorandum of Understanding running through September 2028, the Aga Khan University Centre of Excellence in Women and Child Health in Nairobi will anchor technical and research support for WHO's Global Breast Cancer Initiative and the Cervical Cancer Elimination Initiative, with a focus on low- and middle-income countries.
Kiswahili: Chini ya Mkataba wa Maelewano unaoendelea hadi Septemba 2028, Kituo cha Ubora cha Chuo Kikuu cha Aga Khan katika Afya ya Wanawake na Watoto jijini Nairobi kitaunga mkono usaidizi wa kiufundi na utafiti kwa Mpango wa Saratani ya Matiti wa WHO Duniani na Mpango wa Kutokomeza Saratani ya Kizazi, kwa kuzingatia nchi zenye kipato cha chini na cha kati.

English: The collaboration will advance three pillars: generating evidence to inform WHO norms and national policy; building the skills of health workers, from specialists to community providers, to detect and manage these cancers earlier; and validating innovative tools, including AI-enabled breast ultrasound and AI-assisted cervical screening, for use in primary care.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano huo utaendeleza nguzo tatu: kutoa ushahidi ili kuelimisha kanuni za WHO na sera ya kitaifa; kujenga ujuzi wa wafanyakazi wa afya, kuanzia wataalamu hadi watoa huduma za jamii, ili kugundua na kudhibiti saratani hizi mapema; na kuthibitisha zana bunifu, ikiwa ni pamoja na uchunguzi wa matiti unaotumia akili bandia (AI) na uchunguzi wa shingo ya kizazi unaosaidiwa na akili bandia (AI), kwa ajili ya matumizi katika huduma ya msingi.

English: "This Memorandum of Understanding reflects AKU's commitment to advancing awareness, research, innovation, and capacity building to improve access to equitable, quality cancer prevention and care.
Kiswahili: "Muamala huu wa Maelewano unaonyesha kujitolea kwa AKU katika kukuza uelewa, utafiti, uvumbuzi, na kujenga uwezo ili kuboresha upatikanaji wa kinga na huduma bora za saratani zenye usawa na zenye ubora."

English: It is also aligned with WHO's 14th General Programme of Work, which prioritises improved access to quality cancer care as part of universal health coverage," said Professor Marleen Temmerman, Director of the Centre of Excellence in Women and Child Health, AKU East Africa.
Kiswahili: Pia inaendana na Programu ya 14 ya Kazi ya WHO, ambayo inapa kipaumbele upatikanaji bora wa huduma bora ya saratani kama sehemu ya huduma ya afya kwa wote," alisema Profesa Marleen Temmerman, Mkurugenzi wa Kituo cha Ubora katika Afya ya Wanawake na Watoto, AKU Afrika Mashariki.

English: "The new initiative in Africa will support countries to design and deliver integrated one-stop service models for women's cancers.
Kiswahili: "Mpango mpya barani Afrika utasaidia nchi kubuni na kutoa huduma jumuishi za saratani za wanawake."

English: It will also strengthen the health workforce through training and specialist mentorship, while generating practical solutions to persistent barriers in screening, diagnosis, referral, and follow-up," said Dr Hanan Balkhy, WHO Regional Director for the Eastern Mediterranean (EMRO).
Kiswahili: Pia itaimarisha nguvu kazi ya afya kupitia mafunzo na ushauri wa kitaalamu, huku ikitoa suluhisho la vitendo kwa vikwazo vinavyoendelea katika uchunguzi, utambuzi, rufaa, na ufuatiliaji," alisema Dkt. Hanan Balkhy, Mkurugenzi wa Kanda wa WHO wa Mediterania ya Mashariki (EMRO).

English: Dr Balkhy drew on parallels with WHO's collaboration with AKU in Pakistan, where joint efforts have advanced patient safety, strengthened sexual and reproductive health and rights, and supported clinical and implementation research that informs policy and improves care.
Kiswahili: Dkt. Balkhy alitumia sambamba na ushirikiano wa WHO na AKU nchini Pakistani, ambapo juhudi za pamoja zimeimarisha usalama wa wagonjwa, kuimarisha afya ya ngono na uzazi na haki zao, na kuunga mkono utafiti wa kimatibabu na utekelezaji unaotoa taarifa kuhusu sera na kuboresha huduma.

English: "For Kenya, this collaboration strengthens the National Cervical Cancer Elimination Action Plan 2026 to 2030 and the wider push to integrate women's cancer services into primary health care, so that every woman, in every county, can access lifesaving services close to home," said Dr Xu Hongyi, WHO Kenya.
Kiswahili: "Kwa Kenya, ushirikiano huu unaimarisha Mpango wa Kitaifa wa Kutokomeza Saratani ya Shingo ya Mlango wa Kizazi wa 2026 hadi 2030 na msukumo mpana wa kuunganisha huduma za saratani ya wanawake katika huduma ya afya ya msingi, ili kila mwanamke, katika kila kaunti, aweze kupata huduma za kuokoa maisha karibu na nyumbani," alisema Dkt. Xu Hongyi, WHO Kenya.

English: Speaking on behalf of Kenya's Cabinet Secretary for Health, Dr Omar Albush, Director of Health Sector Coordination and International Affairs, said the collaboration will help accelerate the scale-up of HPV screening, strengthen referral networks, improve diagnostic turnaround times, and optimise treatment including access to existing radiotherapy assets.
Kiswahili: Akizungumza kwa niaba ya Waziri wa Afya wa Kenya, Dkt. Omar Albush, Mkurugenzi wa Uratibu wa Sekta ya Afya na Masuala ya Kimataifa, alisema ushirikiano huo utasaidia kuharakisha upanuzi wa uchunguzi wa HPV, kuimarisha mitandao ya rufaa, kuboresha muda wa uchunguzi, na kuboresha matibabu ikiwa ni pamoja na upatikanaji wa mali zilizopo za tiba ya mionzi.

English: "Implementation research will help identify scalable models that reduce late-stage presentation and increase timely access to treatment and care," he added.
Kiswahili: "Utafiti wa utekelezaji utasaidia kutambua mifumo inayoweza kupanuliwa ambayo hupunguza uwasilishaji wa wagonjwa katika hatua za mwisho na kuongeza upatikanaji wa matibabu na huduma kwa wakati unaofaa," aliongeza.

English: "The rising burden of chronic disease is placing further strain on already stretched health systems.
Kiswahili: "Mzigo unaoongezeka wa magonjwa sugu unaweka mzigo zaidi kwenye mifumo ya afya ambayo tayari imechakaa."

English: This partnership will help drive action to improve prevention, cancer diagnosis and care," said Professor Tania Bubela, Provost and Vice President Academic, Aga Khan University.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano huu utasaidia kuchochea hatua za kuboresha kinga, utambuzi wa saratani na utunzaji," alisema Profesa Tania Bubela, Msimamizi na Makamu wa Rais wa Taaluma, Chuo Kikuu cha Aga Khan.

English: WHO estimates that premature deaths from all noncommunicable diseases in the African Region are projected to rise to 3.8 million by 2030 if action is not accelerated.
Kiswahili: WHO inakadiria kwamba vifo vya mapema kutokana na magonjwa yote yasiyoambukiza katika Ukanda wa Afrika vinakadiriwa kuongezeka hadi milioni 3.8 ifikapo mwaka wa 2030 ikiwa hatua hazitaharakishwa.

English: For the thousands of women in Kenya and across the region whose cancers can be prevented, found early and treated, this partnership is one step towards ensuring that a diagnosis is the start of a treatment journey, not the end of hope.
Kiswahili: Kwa maelfu ya wanawake nchini Kenya na kote katika eneo hilo ambao saratani zinaweza kuzuiwa, kupatikana mapema na kutibiwa, ushirikiano huu ni hatua moja kuelekea kuhakikisha kwamba utambuzi ni mwanzo wa safari ya matibabu, si mwisho wa matumaini.

English: Kenya Commemorates The 12th World No-Tobacco Day As Global Tobacco Survey Report Is Launched 31 May 2003 World No Tobacco Day 2003 whose theme is "Tobacco Free Film.
Kiswahili: Kenya Yaadhimisha Siku ya 12 ya Dunia ya Kupinga Tumbaku Huku Ripoti ya Utafiti wa Tumbaku Duniani Ikizinduliwa Mei 31, 2003 Siku ya Dunia ya Kupinga Tumbaku 2003 ambayo mada yake ni "Filamu Isiyo na Tumbaku."

English: Action ", was nationally commemorated on 31 May 2003 in Nakuru District, Rift Valley Province.
Kiswahili: "Action", iliadhimishwa kitaifa tarehe 31 Mei 2003 katika Wilaya ya Nakuru, Mkoa wa Bonde la Ufa.

English: The Director of Medical Services, Dr. Richard Muga, represented the Chief Guest, Hon.
Kiswahili: Mkurugenzi wa Huduma za Kimatibabu, Dkt. Richard Muga, alimwakilisha Mgeni Mkuu, Mhe.

English: Charity Ngilu, Minister for Health.
Kiswahili: Charity Ngilu, Waziri wa Afya.

English: Behind the scenes of Ebola disease outbreak response Nairobi—Fifty-year-old Milton Oloo has worked as a cargo loading agent at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport in Nairobi, Kenya for the last 30 years.
Kiswahili: Nyuma ya pazia la mwitikio wa mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Ebola Nairobi—Milton Oloo mwenye umri wa miaka hamsini amefanya kazi kama wakala wa upakiaji mizigo katika Uwanja wa Ndege wa Kimataifa wa Jomo Kenyatta jijini Nairobi, Kenya kwa miaka 30 iliyopita.

English: Although he handles several tonnes of cargo daily, every now and again a memorable load comes his way.
Kiswahili: Ingawa anashughulikia tani kadhaa za mizigo kila siku, mara kwa mara mzigo wa kukumbukwa huja kwake.

English: It was the case with the shipment of cargo from World Health Organization (WHO)’s Emergency Preparedness and Response hub in Nairobi, Kenya, on 20 May 2026.
Kiswahili: Ilikuwa hivyo kwa usafirishaji wa mizigo kutoka kituo cha Maandalizi na Majibu ya Dharura cha Shirika la Afya Duniani (WHO) huko Nairobi, Kenya, mnamo tarehe 20 Mei 2026.

English: The hub has shipped 11 tonnes of health emergency supplies and equipment from Jomo Kenyatta International Airport directly to Bunia in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where an outbreak of Ebola disease outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus was declared on 15 May 2026.
Kiswahili: Kituo hicho kimesafirisha tani 11 za vifaa na vifaa vya dharura vya afya kutoka Uwanja wa Ndege wa Kimataifa wa Jomo Kenyatta moja kwa moja hadi Bunia katika Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Kongo, ambapo mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Ebola unaosababishwa na virusi vya Bundibugyo ulitangazwa tarehe 15 Mei 2026.

English: Oloo has been part of the team that has loaded two consignments: an initial five tonnes followed two days later by another six tonnes.
Kiswahili: Oloo amekuwa sehemu ya timu ambayo imepakia mizigo miwili: tani tano za awali zikifuatiwa na tani zingine sita siku mbili baadaye.

English: “I need to ensure that the cargo leaving for the Democratic Republic of the Congo is well taken care of and loaded in a clear way so that it may not be damaged,” says Oloo.
Kiswahili: "Ninahitaji kuhakikisha kwamba mizigo inayoondoka kwenda Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Kongo inatunzwa vizuri na kupakiwa kwa njia iliyo wazi ili isiharibike," anasema Oloo.

English: The consignment included personal protective equipment, case management kits and supplies to facilitate safe and dignified burials.
Kiswahili: Shehena hiyo ilijumuisha vifaa vya kinga binafsi, vifaa vya usimamizi wa kesi na vifaa ili kuwezesha mazishi salama na ya heshima.

English: These supplies save lives and protect health workers, family and community members.
Kiswahili: Vifaa hivi huokoa maisha na kuwalinda wafanyakazi wa afya, familia na wanajamii.

English: Oloo’s careful and considerate handling of the cargo is his way of expressing solidarity with people affected by this disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Utunzaji makini na wa busara wa Oloo wa mizigo ni njia yake ya kuonyesha mshikamano na watu walioathiriwa na mlipuko huu wa ugonjwa.

English: “The cargo should reach the Democratic Republic of the Congo safely in order to save lives of the people living there,” he says.
Kiswahili: "Mzigo unapaswa kufika Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Kongo salama ili kuokoa maisha ya watu wanaoishi huko," anasema.

English: How Kenya's health system is responding to devastating floods Catherine Kemuto had no warning when the floodwaters came.
Kiswahili: Jinsi mfumo wa afya wa Kenya unavyoitikia mafuriko makubwa Catherine Kemuto hakuwa na onyo lolote wakati mafuriko yalipotokea.

English: The 32-year-old mother of five from Gatwekera in Kibera sub-county, Nairobi County, returned home to find everything submerged, including her children's vaccination records.
Kiswahili: Mama huyo mwenye umri wa miaka 32 mwenye watoto watano kutoka Gatwekera katika kaunti ndogo ya Kibera, Kaunti ya Nairobi, alirudi nyumbani na kukuta kila kitu kikiwa kimezama, ikiwa ni pamoja na rekodi za chanjo za watoto wake.

English: A week of displacement left her children ill, and access to safe water remained a struggle long after the floods receded.
Kiswahili: Wiki moja ya kuhama makazi iliwaacha watoto wake wakiwa wagonjwa, na upatikanaji wa maji salama ulibaki kuwa mgumu muda mrefu baada ya mafuriko kupungua.

English: "It was so abrupt and vicious this time.
Kiswahili: "Ilikuwa ya ghafla na ya kikatili wakati huu."

English: I lost most of my things, including all the vaccination documents," she said.
Kiswahili: Nilipoteza vitu vyangu vingi, ikiwa ni pamoja na hati zote za chanjo," alisema.

English: Seasonal long rains have caused widespread flooding across Kenya, resulting in loss of life, destruction of critical infrastructure, mass displacement, and significant disruption to health services.
Kiswahili: Mvua ndefu za msimu zimesababisha mafuriko makubwa kote Kenya, na kusababisha vifo, uharibifu wa miundombinu muhimu, kuhama kwa watu wengi, na usumbufu mkubwa kwa huduma za afya.

English: As of 30 March 2026, flooding had claimed 112 lives across 27 counties.
Kiswahili: Kufikia tarehe 30 Machi 2026, mafuriko yalikuwa yamesababisha vifo vya watu 112 katika kaunti 27.

English: Impassable roads, damaged water systems, power outages, and school closures severely limited communities' access to essential services.
Kiswahili: Barabara zisizopitika, mifumo ya maji iliyoharibika, kukatika kwa umeme, na kufungwa kwa shule kulipunguza sana upatikanaji wa huduma muhimu kwa jamii.

English: Health facilities were also directly affected, with several inundated and forced to scale down or suspend services.
Kiswahili: Vituo vya afya pia viliathiriwa moja kwa moja, huku kadhaa zikifurika na kulazimika kupunguza au kusimamisha huduma.

English: In Kiambu County, for example, Gachororo Health Centre was identified during rapid assessments as one of the facilities impacted by flooding, illustrating the strain on primary healthcare delivery.
Kiswahili: Kwa mfano, katika Kaunti ya Kiambu, Kituo cha Afya cha Gachororo kilitambuliwa wakati wa tathmini za haraka kama mojawapo ya vituo vilivyoathiriwa na mafuriko, ikionyesha mkazo katika utoaji wa huduma ya afya ya msingi.

English: Flooding creates immediate public health crises by contaminating water sources and destroying infrastructure.
Kiswahili: Mafuriko husababisha matatizo ya afya ya umma mara moja kwa kuchafua vyanzo vya maji na kuharibu miundombinu.

English: This particularly endangers vulnerable groups like children, seniors, and the chronically ill as displacement rapidly cuts off access to essential medications, vaccines, and routine medical care.
Kiswahili: Hii inahatarisha hasa makundi yaliyo hatarini kama vile watoto, wazee, na wagonjwa sugu kwani kuhama makazi yao kunapunguza upatikanaji wa dawa muhimu, chanjo, na huduma za kawaida za matibabu.

English: "The impact of the long rains underscores the importance of preparedness, early warning, and coordinated response.
Kiswahili: "Athari za mvua ndefu zinasisitiza umuhimu wa maandalizi, tahadhari ya mapema, na mwitikio ulioratibiwa."

English: Strengthening disease surveillance, maintaining access to safe water and sanitation, and safeguarding continuity of essential health services are all critical during this period," said Dr. Neema Rusibamayila Kimambo, Acting WHO representative to Kenya A multiagency Vulnerability, Risk, Capacity Assessment identified critical gaps in county health departments' ability to manage displaced populations and contain potential outbreaks.
Kiswahili: "Kuimarisha ufuatiliaji wa magonjwa, kudumisha upatikanaji wa maji salama na usafi wa mazingira, na kulinda mwendelezo wa huduma muhimu za afya ni muhimu sana katika kipindi hiki," alisema Dkt. Neema Rusibamayila Kimambo, Kaimu mwakilishi wa WHO nchini Kenya. Tathmini ya Udhaifu, Hatari, na Uwezo wa mashirika mengi ilibaini mapengo muhimu katika uwezo wa idara za afya za kaunti kudhibiti idadi ya watu waliohamishwa na kudhibiti milipuko inayowezekana.

English: The Incident Management Support Team was activated at national and county Public Health Emergency Operations Centres, and active disease surveillance was established across all affected areas.
Kiswahili: Timu ya Usaidizi wa Usimamizi wa Matukio ilianzishwa katika Vituo vya Uendeshaji wa Dharura vya Afya ya Umma vya kitaifa na vya kaunti, na ufuatiliaji hai wa magonjwa ulianzishwa katika maeneo yote yaliyoathiriwa.

English: The Ministry of Health deployed eight field teams of 41 health professionals across 14 counties to strengthen coordination, surveillance, infection prevention, and WASH measures.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya ilituma timu nane za wataalamu wa afya 41 katika kaunti 14 ili kuimarisha uratibu, ufuatiliaji, kinga dhidi ya maambukizi, na hatua za WASH.

English: WHO supported the response with cholera kits, water treatment supplies, and trauma kits, reaching 5,000 people, with additional supplies positioned to serve over 100,000 people.
Kiswahili: WHO iliunga mkono mwitikio huo kwa vifaa vya kipindupindu, vifaa vya matibabu ya maji, na vifaa vya majeraha, na kufikia watu 5,000, huku vifaa vya ziada vikiwa tayari kuhudumia zaidi ya watu 100,000.

English: Surge-trained personnel were also deployed to support assessment and response activities.
Kiswahili: Wafanyakazi waliofunzwa kwa upasuaji pia walitumwa kusaidia shughuli za tathmini na mwitikio.

English: At Huruma Lions Health Centre in Nairobi County, Clinical Officer and Officer-in-Charge Joyce was caring for a community of 32,000 people with only four nurses when displaced families began arriving without medical records or medication.
Kiswahili: Katika Kituo cha Afya cha Huruma Lions katika Kaunti ya Nairobi, Afisa wa Kliniki na Afisa Mkuu Joyce alikuwa akihudumia jamii ya watu 32,000 huku wauguzi wanne pekee wakipoteza makazi yao wakati familia zilizopoteza makazi zilipoanza kufika bila kumbukumbu za matibabu au dawa.

English: "The hardest part was patients with chronic illness, those on long-term medication like antiretroviral drugs.
Kiswahili: "Sehemu ngumu zaidi ilikuwa wagonjwa wenye magonjwa sugu, wale wanaotumia dawa za muda mrefu kama vile dawa za kupunguza makali ya virusi."

English: But with time, we were able to figure out which medicines they were on," she said.
Kiswahili: Lakini baada ya muda, tuliweza kubaini ni dawa gani walikuwa wakitumia," alisema.

English: When a burst in a draingage water source caused a sharp rise in diarrhoeal diseases, her team distributed water treatment tablets through community health promoters.
Kiswahili: Wakati mlipuko katika chanzo cha maji ya mifereji ya maji ulisababisha ongezeko kubwa la magonjwa ya kuhara, timu yake ilisambaza vidonge vya kutibu maji kupitia wahamasishaji wa afya ya jamii.

English: As immunization coverage dropped because families had lost child health booklets, the facility regenerated records and re-enrolled affected children into care.
Kiswahili: Kadri chanjo ilivyopungua kwa sababu familia zilikuwa zimepoteza vijitabu vya afya ya watoto, kituo kilirejesha kumbukumbu na kuwaandikisha tena watoto walioathiriwa katika huduma ya uangalizi.

English: Community health promoters proved essential throughout, serving as the most trusted link between the health system and displaced families, delivering supplies, information, and support to households that could not reach a facility.
