Kiswahili: Wahamasishaji wa afya ya jamii walithibitika kuwa muhimu sana, wakitumika kama kiungo kinachoaminika zaidi kati ya mfumo wa afya na familia zilizohamishwa, wakitoa vifaa, taarifa, na usaidizi kwa kaya ambazo hazikuweza kufikia kituo.

English: Psychosocial support emerged as a critical and often overlooked needs.
Kiswahili: Usaidizi wa kisaikolojia uliibuka kama mahitaji muhimu na ambayo mara nyingi hayazingatiwi.

English: "The county does not employ psychosocial practitioners.
Kiswahili: "Kaunti haiajiri wataalamu wa kisaikolojia.

English: We had gaps we had never planned for," Joyce said.
Kiswahili: Tulikuwa na mapengo ambayo hatukuwahi kuyapanga," Joyce alisema.

English: The floods also drove lasting improvements.
Kiswahili: Mafuriko hayo pia yalisababisha maboresho ya kudumu.

English: The facility now holds a three-month medicine buffer stock and a cold chain system keeping vaccines safe for 90 days without power.
Kiswahili: Kituo hicho sasa kina akiba ya dawa ya miezi mitatu na mfumo wa mnyororo wa baridi unaoweka chanjo salama kwa siku 90 bila umeme.

English: "We learned a lesson that time.
Kiswahili: "Tulijifunza somo wakati huo."

English: This time around, we are well stocked, we are ready," Joyce reflected.
Kiswahili: Wakati huu, tumejaa vitu vingi, tuko tayari,” Joyce alitafakari.

English: WHO remains committed to supporting the Government to strengthen preparedness and response capacities.
Kiswahili: WHO bado imejitolea kuisaidia Serikali kuimarisha uwezo wa kujiandaa na kukabiliana na hali hiyo.

English: The Ministry of Health and WHO are working to ensure these lessons translate into stronger emergency plans, better-resourced facilities, and more resilient communities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya na WHO zinafanya kazi kuhakikisha masomo haya yanatafsiriwa kuwa mipango imara ya dharura, vifaa vyenye rasilimali bora, na jamii zenye ustahimilivu zaidi.

English: For Catherine and families like hers, that resilience is the difference between losing everything and being protected when the rains return.
Kiswahili: Kwa Catherine na familia kama yake, ustahimilivu huo ndio tofauti kati ya kupoteza kila kitu na kulindwa mvua zinaporudi.

English: Nairobi, 21 May 2020 – Over three million children across 13 counties of Kenya are to be vaccinated against polio by the Government, UNICEF, WHO and partners, after the virus was confirmed to be circulating in Garissa and Mombasa.
Kiswahili: Nairobi, 21 Mei 2020 - Zaidi ya watoto milioni tatu katika kaunti 13 za Kenya watapewa chanjo dhidi ya polio na Serikali, UNICEF, WHO na washirika, baada ya virusi hivyo kuthibitishwa kuenea Garissa na Mombasa.

English: The immunisation campaign was launched today in Garissa.
Kiswahili: Kampeni ya chanjo imezinduliwa leo mjini Garissa.

English: A door-to-door campaign will now take place from 22 to 27 of May in Garissa, Isiolo, Kajiado, Kiambu, Kilifi, Kitui, Lamu, Machakos, Mandera, Mombasa, Nairobi, Tana River and Wajir counties, as well as in the Dadaab refugee camps.
Kiswahili: Kampeni ya nyumba kwa nyumba sasa itafanyika kuanzia tarehe 22 hadi 27 mwezi wa Mei katika kaunti za Garissa, Isiolo, Kajiado, Kiambu, Kilifi, Kitui, Lamu, Machakos, Mandera, Mombasa, Nairobi, Tana River na Wajir, na pia katika kambi za wakimbizi za Dadaab.

English: Mzee Lekimain stands firmly in the baraza, his voice steady, carrying the weight of decades of memory and wisdom.
Kiswahili: Mzee Lekimain anasimama imara kwenye baraza, sauti yake ikiwa imara, ikiwa na uzito wa kumbukumbu na hekima ya miongo kadhaa.

English: Yet beneath the calm, there is a quiet sadness as he recalls the past.
Kiswahili: Lakini chini ya utulivu, kuna huzuni tulivu anapokumbuka yaliyopita.

English: “Long ago,” he begins, “our Samburu warriors left home to protect our grazing lands from neighboring communities.
Kiswahili: “Zamani sana,” anaanza, “mashujaa wetu wa Samburu waliondoka nyumbani ili kulinda ardhi zetu za malisho kutoka kwa jamii jirani.

English: They were away for many months, guarding what belongs to us.” During their absence, women stayed behind in the manyattas, managing homesteads, raising children, and keeping families together.
Kiswahili: Walikuwa mbali kwa miezi mingi, wakilinda mali yetu.” Wakati wa kutokuwepo kwao, wanawake walibaki nyuma katika manyatta, wakisimamia makazi, kulea watoto, na kuweka familia pamoja.

English: When the warriors returned, they discovered that many women were pregnant.
Kiswahili: Wapiganaji waliporudi, waligundua kuwa wanawake wengi walikuwa wajawazito.

English: “The community felt betrayed,” Mzee Lekimain recalls, his voice tinted with sorrow.
Kiswahili: "Jumuiya ilihisi kusalitiwa," Mzee Lekimain anakumbuka, sauti yake ikiwa na rangi ya huzuni.

English: “Anger and shock spread among the elders.” In response, a decision was made that would shape the lives of women and girls for generations.
Kiswahili: "Hasira na mshtuko vilienea miongoni mwa wazee." Katika kujibu, uamuzi ulifanywa ambao ungebadilisha maisha ya wanawake na wasichana kwa vizazi vingi.

English: The elders declared that women must undergo circumcision, believing it would prevent such situations from happening again.
Kiswahili: Wazee walitangaza kwamba wanawake lazima watahiriwe, wakiamini kwamba ingezuia hali kama hizo kutokea tena.

English: According to Mzee Lekimain, this marked the beginning of female genital mutilation (FGM) in the community a practice that crippled the potential of young Samburu women for decades.
Kiswahili: Kulingana na Mzee Lekimain, hii ilikuwa mwanzo wa ukeketaji wa wanawake (FGM) katika jamii, kitendo ambacho kilidhoofisha uwezo wa wanawake vijana wa Samburu kwa miongo kadhaa.

English: Older women often enforced FGM, while men held near-total authority over households and community matters.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wazee mara nyingi walilazimisha ukeketaji, huku wanaume wakiwa na mamlaka karibu yote juu ya masuala ya kaya na jamii.

English: Decision-making was deeply gendered; women who spoke out risked physical and emotional punishment.
Kiswahili: Uamuzi ulikuwa wa kina kirefu; wanawake waliozungumza walihatarisha adhabu ya kimwili na kihisia.

English: The Mkuki system, which allowed Morans to claim preferential conjugal rights within their age group, compounded the challenges.
Kiswahili: Mfumo wa Mkuki, ambao uliwaruhusu Wamorani kudai haki za upendeleo za ndoa ndani ya kundi lao la umri, ulizidisha changamoto hizo.

English: With the rise of sexually transmitted diseases and social tension, entire villages suffered quietly, carrying grief and loss from one generation to the next.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuongezeka kwa magonjwa ya zinaa na mvutano wa kijamii, vijiji vizima viliteseka kimya kimya, vikibeba huzuni na hasara kutoka kizazi kimoja hadi kingine.

English: But today, a few kilometers from Maralal town, the story is remarkably different.
Kiswahili: Lakini leo, kilomita chache kutoka mji wa Maralal, hadithi ni tofauti sana.

English: In Baawa Village, a new hope is taking root.
Kiswahili: Katika Kijiji cha Baawa, matumaini mapya yanaota mizizi.

English: Women living with disabilities speak of empowerment and opportunity.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wanaoishi na ulemavu huzungumzia uwezeshaji na fursa.

English: Their smiles tell a story of resilience and transformation.
Kiswahili: Tabasamu zao zinaelezea hadithi ya ustahimilivu na mabadiliko.

English: In the nearby schoolyard, children’s laughter fills the air, a symbol of change and promise.
Kiswahili: Katika uwanja wa shule ulio karibu, vicheko vya watoto vinajaa hewani, ishara ya mabadiliko na ahadi.

English: Manyatta marriages; where girls were married off young, and the beading system are fading.
Kiswahili: Ndoa za Manyatta; ambapo wasichana waliolewa wakiwa wadogo, na mfumo wa shanga unafifia.

English: The Mkuki system is largely rejected.
Kiswahili: Mfumo wa Mkuki unakataliwa kwa kiasi kikubwa.

English: “People now understand that these practices increase disease risk and cause conflict,” says elder Etemesi Lentoijoni.
Kiswahili: "Watu sasa wanaelewa kwamba desturi hizi huongeza hatari ya magonjwa na kusababisha migogoro," anasema mzee Etemesi Lentoijoni.

English: “The community sees that these systems are unfit and dangerous.” Girls now choose their partners freely.
Kiswahili: "Jamii inaona kwamba mifumo hii haifai na ni hatari." Wasichana sasa huchagua wenzi wao kwa uhuru.

English: Marriages are increasingly voluntary, sometimes crossing tribal lines, and elders actively support these changes rather than enforcing outdated norms.
Kiswahili: Ndoa zinazidi kuwa za hiari, wakati mwingine huvuka mipaka ya kikabila, na wazee wanaunga mkono kikamilifu mabadiliko haya badala ya kutekeleza kanuni zilizopitwa na wakati.

English: “The change is blessed by the elders,” says Stella Leleruk, a young woman from Baawa.
Kiswahili: "Mabadiliko yanabarikiwa na wazee," anasema Stella Leleruk, mwanamke kijana kutoka Baawa.

English: “Our voices are heard, and our choices respected.” Schools have become safe spaces and engines of transformation.
Kiswahili: "Sauti zetu zinasikika, na chaguzi zetu zinaheshimiwa." Shule zimekuwa maeneo salama na injini za mabadiliko.

English: Alice Muthoni, a clinician and education advocate highlights the role of awareness campaigns in keeping girls in school.
Kiswahili: Alice Muthoni, daktari na mtetezi wa elimu anaangazia jukumu la kampeni za uhamasishaji katika kuwaweka wasichana shuleni.

English: “In cases of early pregnancy, girls are now allowed to return and complete school,” she notes.
Kiswahili: "Katika visa vya mimba za mapema, wasichana sasa wanaruhusiwa kurudi na kukamilisha shule," anabainisha.

English: “In 2025, two cases were reported but both girls went back and have since completed Grade Nine.” Community sensitization has reinforced a clear message: every child has a right to education.
Kiswahili: "Mwaka 2025, visa viwili viliripotiwa lakini wasichana wote wawili walirudi na tangu wakati huo wamemaliza Darasa la Tisa." Uhamasishaji wa jamii umeimarisha ujumbe ulio wazi: kila mtoto ana haki ya kupata elimu.

English: “No school means jail,” Alice emphasizes.
Kiswahili: "Hakuna shule inamaanisha jela," Alice anasisitiza.

English: “Education is a fundamental right.
Kiswahili: "Elimu ni haki ya msingi."

English: In the past, girls as young as 12 were married off.
Kiswahili: Hapo awali, wasichana wenye umri wa miaka 12 waliolewa.

English: That is no longer acceptable.” Local administrators are actively seizing early marriage cases and working closely with schools, health facilities, and the justice system to enforce children’s rights.
Kiswahili: Hilo halikubaliki tena.” Wasimamizi wa mitaa wanashughulikia kikamilifu kesi za ndoa za mapema na kufanya kazi kwa karibu na shule, vituo vya afya, na mfumo wa haki ili kutekeleza haki za watoto.

English: Where injustices once went unreported, the Samburu community now has structured pathways for addressing gender-based violence, or as they call it, nkutorogonyo.
Kiswahili: Ambapo hapo awali ukosefu wa haki haukuripotiwa, jamii ya Samburu sasa imeunda njia za kushughulikia unyanyasaji wa kijinsia, au kama wanavyouita, nkutorogonyo.

English: Cases are first raised with village elders, then the chief, followed by health facilities, police, and courts.
Kiswahili: Kesi huwasilishwa kwanza na wazee wa kijiji, kisha chifu, ikifuatiwa na vituo vya afya, polisi, na mahakama.

English: Legal aid has been introduced to guide survivors through the justice process and help them understand their rights.
Kiswahili: Msaada wa kisheria umeanzishwa ili kuwaongoza walionusurika katika mchakato wa haki na kuwasaidia kuelewa haki zao.

English: “Women now reject kangaroo courts because they offer no justice,” notes a local activist.
Kiswahili: "Wanawake sasa wanakataa mahakama za kangaroo kwa sababu hazitoi haki," anasema mwanaharakati wa eneo hilo.

English: “We demand proper legal processes that protect survivors rather than punish them further.” The Kenya Red Cross has held community sessions to educate residents on presenting their cases in court.
Kiswahili: "Tunadai michakato sahihi ya kisheria inayowalinda manusura badala ya kuwaadhibu zaidi." Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya limefanya vikao vya kijamii ili kuwaelimisha wakazi kuhusu kuwasilisha kesi zao mahakamani.

English: Chief Lenaitukusho of Baawa Sub-location emphasizes the importance of involving both men and women in these conversations.
Kiswahili: Chifu Lenaitukusho wa kata Ndogo ya Baawa anasisitiza umuhimu wa kuwashirikisha wanaume na wanawake katika mazungumzo haya.

English: “The Kenya Red Cross Society called for men’s and women’s engagement forums to speak openly about GBV,” he explains.
Kiswahili: "Chama cha Msalaba Mwekundu cha Kenya kimetoa wito kwa mabaraza ya ushiriki wa wanaume na wanawake kuzungumza waziwazi kuhusu GBV," anaelezea.

English: “That openness has helped families confront issues they once ignored.” As harmful practices declined locally, some perpetrators tried to move girls to other areas to continue FGM in secret.
Kiswahili: "Uwazi huo umesaidia familia kukabiliana na masuala ambayo hapo awali yalipuuzwa." Kadri desturi zenye madhara zilivyopungua katika maeneo hayo, baadhi ya wahalifu walijaribu kuwahamisha wasichana hadi maeneo mengine ili kuendelea na ukeketaji kwa siri.

English: To counter this, boda boda riders often the first to notice unusual travel were trained as frontline defenders.
Kiswahili: Ili kukabiliana na hili, waendesha bodaboda ambao mara nyingi waligundua usafiri usio wa kawaida walifunzwa kama walinzi wa mstari wa mbele.

English: They now identify and report suspicious movements involving girls, playing a vital role in prevention.
Kiswahili: Sasa wanatambua na kuripoti mienendo inayotiliwa shaka inayowahusisha wasichana, na kuchukua jukumu muhimu katika kuzuia.

English: The riders have also organized themselves into savings groups, improving livelihoods while strengthening community protection.
Kiswahili: Waendeshaji pia wamejipanga katika vikundi vya kuweka akiba, wakiboresha riziki huku wakiimarisha ulinzi wa jamii.

English: In Leserian Village, north of Baragoi, Community Health Promoters guide survivors and educate the community.
Kiswahili: Katika Kijiji cha Leserian, kaskazini mwa Baragoi, Wahamasishaji wa Afya ya Jamii huwaongoza manusura na kuwaelimisha jamii.

English: They refer cases to Baragoi Sub-County Hospital, which offers maternal and child health services, HIV/TB care, GBV support, and ensures legal documentation is complete for court proceedings.
Kiswahili: Wanapeleka kesi katika Hospitali ya Kaunti Ndogo ya Baragoi, ambayo hutoa huduma za afya ya mama na mtoto, huduma ya VVU/TB, usaidizi wa GBV, na kuhakikisha nyaraka za kisheria zimekamilika kwa ajili ya kesi mahakamani.

English: “The smiles on women’s faces today tell the story of transformation,” says one health promoter.
Kiswahili: "Tabasamu kwenye nyuso za wanawake leo zinaelezea hadithi ya mabadiliko," anasema mtetezi mmoja wa afya.

English: “From empowerment to safety, the impact of training and awareness is visible in every home.” Economic empowerment has further shifted cultural practices.
Kiswahili: "Kuanzia uwezeshaji hadi usalama, athari ya mafunzo na ufahamu inaonekana katika kila nyumba." Uwezeshaji wa kiuchumi umebadilisha zaidi desturi za kitamaduni.

English: Ipele Lengeriai, chairman of the Mpagas Village Self-Help Group, recounts how Village Savings and Loans Association (VSLA) programs helped change perceptions among Morans.
Kiswahili: Ipele Lengeriai, mwenyekiti wa Kikundi cha Kujisaidia cha Kijiji cha Mpagas, anasimulia jinsi programu za Chama cha Akiba na Mikopo cha Kijiji (VSLA) zilivyosaidia kubadilisha mitazamo miongoni mwa Wamorani.

English: “We meet every Friday at 2 p.m. without fail,” he explains.
Kiswahili: "Tunakutana kila Ijumaa saa nane mchana bila kukosa," anaelezea.

English: “If you are late, you are fined 100 shillings.
Kiswahili: "Ukichelewa, utatozwa faini ya shilingi 100."

English: Each of the ten members contributes 50 shillings weekly.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja wa wanachama kumi huchangia shilingi 50 kila wiki.

English: From the 50,000 shillings funding we received, we started a goat farming business with five rams, now grown to 23.
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwa ufadhili wa shilingi 50,000 tuliopokea, tulianza biashara ya ufugaji wa mbuzi na kondoo waume watano, ambao sasa umeongezeka hadi 23.

English: We also manage several beehives.” This economic stability has fostered social change.
Kiswahili: Pia tunasimamia mizinga kadhaa ya nyuki.” Utulivu huu wa kiuchumi umechochea mabadiliko ya kijamii.

English: Morans now marry uncircumcised girls, consult wives on household decisions, and share chores and resources.
Kiswahili: Wamorani sasa wanaoa wasichana wasiotahiriwa, wanashauriana na wake kuhusu maamuzi ya nyumbani, na wanashiriki kazi za nyumbani na rasilimali.

English: “The community feels safer, and women feel secure in their homes,” Ipele adds.
Kiswahili: "Jamii inahisi salama zaidi, na wanawake wanahisi salama majumbani mwao," Ipele anaongeza.

English: Despite progress, challenges remain.
Kiswahili: Licha ya maendeleo, changamoto bado zipo.

English: Under-reporting of gender-based violence is still high, particularly in remote areas.
Kiswahili: Ripoti chache za ukatili wa kijinsia bado ziko juu, hasa katika maeneo ya mbali.

English: Stigma, cultural pressures, fear of retaliation, and illiteracy prevent survivors from seeking help.
Kiswahili: Unyanyapaa, shinikizo la kitamaduni, hofu ya kulipiza kisasi, na kutojua kusoma na kuandika huwazuia manusura kutafuta msaada.

English: Coordination between police and health facilities is not always seamless, and some local administrators hesitate to act due to threats from perpetrators.
Kiswahili: Uratibu kati ya polisi na vituo vya afya si mara zote huwa laini, na baadhi ya watendaji wa eneo hilo husita kuchukua hatua kutokana na vitisho kutoka kwa wahalifu.

English: “SGBV cases are often silent because survivors fear speaking out,” explains Esther, a clinician at Baragoi Sub-County Hospital.
Kiswahili: "Visa vya SGBV mara nyingi huwa kimya kwa sababu manusura huogopa kusema," anaelezea Esther, daktari katika Hospitali ya Kaunti Ndogo ya Baragoi.

English: “We still have work to do, especially in remote areas.” For John Lentapanya, a community member and signatory to the Kisima Agreement, accountability among men has been crucial.
Kiswahili: "Bado tuna kazi ya kufanya, hasa katika maeneo ya mbali." Kwa John Lentapanya, mwanajamii na mtiaji saini wa Mkataba wa Kisima, uwajibikaji miongoni mwa wanaume umekuwa muhimu.

English: “We inform women about what men agreed during Kisima,” he says.
Kiswahili: "Tunawafahamisha wanawake kuhusu kile ambacho wanaume walikubaliana wakati wa Kisima," anasema.

English: “If a man commits domestic violence, elders summon him to a baraza.
Kiswahili: "Ikiwa mwanamume anafanya unyanyasaji wa nyumbani, wazee humwita kwenye baraza."

English: He is counseled, fined, and warned.
Kiswahili: Anashauriwa, anatozwa faini, na anaonywa.

English: If the behavior continues, separation or divorce may follow.” The project also recognizes that men can be victims of GBV.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa tabia hiyo itaendelea, kutengana au talaka kunaweza kufuata.” Mradi huo pia unatambua kwamba wanaume wanaweza kuwa waathiriwa wa GBV.

English: Psychosocial support is now extended to men, addressing stress, conflict, and potential violence before escalation.
Kiswahili: Usaidizi wa kisaikolojia sasa unawafikia wanaume, ukishughulikia msongo wa mawazo, migogoro, na vurugu zinazoweza kutokea kabla ya kuongezeka.

English: In Naiborkejo and Baawa, women note that continued awareness is needed, but the progress is undeniable.
Kiswahili: Katika Naiborkejo na Baawa, wanawake wanabainisha kuwa ufahamu unaoendelea unahitajika, lakini maendeleo hayawezi kupingwa.

English: Survivor groups report improved family relationships, shared decision-making on livestock and household matters, and better communication between spouses.
Kiswahili: Vikundi vya walionusurika vinaripoti kuimarika kwa mahusiano ya kifamilia, kufanya maamuzi ya pamoja kuhusu mifugo na masuala ya kaya, na mawasiliano bora kati ya wanandoa.

English: Problem-solving skills taught in training sessions have allowed families to resolve conflicts peacefully.
Kiswahili: Ustadi wa kutatua matatizo unaofundishwa katika vipindi vya mafunzo umeruhusu familia kutatua migogoro kwa amani.

English: “Women are now opening up,” one participant notes.
Kiswahili: "Wanawake sasa wanafunguka," mshiriki mmoja anabainisha.

English: “We don’t carry stress in silence anymore.” Faith-based dialogue has also encouraged couples to talk openly, resolving conflicts with understanding, though pockets of resistance remain.
Kiswahili: "Hatubebi msongo wa mawazo kimya kimya tena." Mazungumzo yanayotegemea imani pia yamewatia moyo wanandoa kuzungumza waziwazi, wakisuluhisha migogoro kwa uelewa, ingawa bado kuna upinzani.

English: At the barazas, elders recall the historic Samburu Declaration made in early 2021, witnessed by former President Uhuru Kenyatta.
Kiswahili: Katika mabaraza hayo, wazee wanakumbuka Azimio la kihistoria la Samburu lililotolewa mapema 2021, lililoshuhudiwa na aliyekuwa Rais Uhuru Kenyatta.

English: The declaration marked the official blessing of a new way of life: no FGM, no domestic violence, and zero tolerance for sexual abuse.
Kiswahili: Tamko hilo liliashiria baraka rasmi ya mtindo mpya wa maisha: kutokeketwa kwa wanawake, kutokunyanyaswa majumbani, na kutovumilia kabisa unyanyasaji wa kijinsia.

English: “The combined efforts of education, legal reform, health services, and community dialogue are reshaping the Samburu experience,” one elder reflects.
Kiswahili: "Juhudi za pamoja za elimu, mageuzi ya kisheria, huduma za afya, na mazungumzo ya kijamii zinabadilisha uzoefu wa Samburu," mzee mmoja anatafakari.

English: The journey continues, but transformation is clear.
Kiswahili: Safari inaendelea, lakini mabadiliko ni wazi.

English: Early marriages, FGM, and harmful marital systems are now exceptions.

English: CENTRE FOR PUBLIC HEALTH RESEARCH (CPHR) NAIROBI Overview Before a formal transfer to KEMRI, CPHR operated by the name of Medical Research Centre (MRC), which was managed by the Royal Tropical Institute of Amsterdam (KIT) until 1987.

English: The research in this discipline is conducted by social scientists following a systematic plan that utilizes both quantitative and qualitative designs.

English: Infectious and Parasitic Diseases About IPD Program Infectious and parasitic diseases are not only a matter that threatens the lives of individuals in developing countries but also pose a serious impediment to the social and economic development of these countries.
Kiswahili: Magonjwa ya Kuambukiza na Vimelea Kuhusu Programu ya IPD Magonjwa ya kuambukiza na vimelea si tu kwamba yanatishia maisha ya watu binafsi katika nchi zinazoendelea bali pia ni kikwazo kikubwa kwa maendeleo ya kijamii na kiuchumi ya nchi hizi.

English: Infectious and parasitic diseases take a particularly heavy toll on the poor.
Kiswahili: Magonjwa ya kuambukiza na ya vimelea huwaathiri sana maskini.

English: The risk of infection in developing countries is heightened by the high rate of population growth, poverty, gender disparities, fragile healthcare and medical systems, inadequate preventive, care and treatment services, lack of safe water supply, malnutrition, etc.
Kiswahili: Hatari ya maambukizi katika nchi zinazoendelea inaongezeka kutokana na kiwango cha juu cha ukuaji wa idadi ya watu, umaskini, tofauti za kijinsia, mifumo dhaifu ya huduma za afya na matibabu, huduma duni za kinga, huduma za utunzaji na matibabu, ukosefu wa maji salama, utapiamlo, n.k.

English: Poor health in turn aggravates poverty.
Kiswahili: Afya mbaya huzidisha umaskini.

English: There is therefore a pressing need to break such vicious cycle of poor health and poverty.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo kuna haja kubwa ya kuvunja mzunguko mbaya kama huo wa afya mbaya na umaskini.

English: Fighting Infectious and parasitic diseases should be a central part of the development programs of developing countries, particularly in the efforts of poverty reduction.
Kiswahili: Kupambana na magonjwa ya kuambukiza na vimelea kunapaswa kuwa sehemu muhimu ya programu za maendeleo za nchi zinazoendelea, hasa katika juhudi za kupunguza umaskini.

English: Mandate of IPD Program To this end and out of this need KEMRI developed the Infectious and Parasitic Diseases Research Programme.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Programu ya IPD Kwa lengo hili na kutokana na hitaji hili, KEMRI iliunda Programu ya Utafiti wa Magonjwa ya Kuambukiza na Vimelea.

English: The programme is conducted with the aim of developing tools and technologies for the reduction of disease burden due to infectious and parasitic agents.
Kiswahili: Programu hii inafanywa kwa lengo la kutengeneza zana na teknolojia za kupunguza mzigo wa magonjwa unaosababishwa na vimelea vya kuambukiza na vimelea.

English: In this regard, research is conducted on vector control, bacterial, fungal and viral infections such as HIV/AIDS,TB, Ebola, Malaria, Chikugunya, Dengue Fever and other Neglected Tropical Disease like Kala azar and Bilharzia among others.Out of 1.6 million people living with HIV Virus in Kenya, 900,000 are on Anti-retroviral – ARVs treatment.
Kiswahili: Katika suala hili, utafiti unafanywa kuhusu udhibiti wa vijidudu, maambukizi ya bakteria, fangasi na virusi kama vile VVU/UKIMWI, Kifua Kikuu, Ebola, Malaria, Chikugunya, Homa ya Dengue na Magonjwa mengine ya Kitropiki Yasiyopuuzwa kama Kala azar na Bilharzia miongoni mwa mengine. Kati ya watu milioni 1.6 wanaoishi na Virusi vya UKIMWI nchini Kenya, 900,000 wanatumia dawa za kupunguza makali ya virusi vya ukimwi - ARV.

English: Although ARV’s have reduced AIDS – related morbidity and mortality, they have resulted in HIV – 1 drug resistance and emergence of new strains whose virulence is yet to be established.
Kiswahili: Ingawa ARV zimepunguza magonjwa na vifo vinavyohusiana na UKIMWI, zimesababisha upinzani dhidi ya VVU na kuibuka kwa aina mpya za virusi ambazo bado hazijabainika.

English: The Center for Virus Research laboratory has identified new and evolving HIV genotypes in Kenya including the very rare subtype O, HIV -2 and a myriad of recombinants.
Kiswahili: Maabara ya Kituo cha Utafiti wa Virusi imetambua jenomu mpya na zinazobadilika za VVU nchini Kenya ikiwa ni pamoja na aina ndogo ya O, HIV -2 na idadi kubwa ya viambatanishi vya VVU.

English: Unlike other viruses, the AIDS virus is highly evolving with a very high turnover rate of its genome.
Kiswahili: Tofauti na virusi vingine, virusi vya UKIMWI vinabadilika sana vikiwa na kiwango cha juu sana cha mabadiliko ya jenomu yake.

English: It is therefore critical to monitor the evolution of the HIV virus infecting the population to determine the prevalent genotypes and its impact especially on existing diagnostic and screening systems and antiretroviral.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo ni muhimu kufuatilia mageuko ya virusi vya UKIMWI vinavyoambukiza idadi ya watu ili kubaini aina za jeni zilizoenea na athari zake hasa kwenye mifumo iliyopo ya uchunguzi na uchunguzi na dawa za kupunguza makali ya virusi.

English: Through the research centers in Busia and Nairobi, KEMRI has established the first ever HIV genotyping program in the country.
Kiswahili: Kupitia vituo vya utafiti huko Busia na Nairobi, KEMRI imeanzisha mpango wa kwanza kabisa wa uainishaji wa jeni za VVU nchini.

English: Perhaps the greatest clinical impact of KEMRI has been its contribution to HIV drug resistance testing in Kenya.
Kiswahili: Labda athari kubwa zaidi ya kimatibabu ya KEMRI imekuwa mchango wake katika upimaji wa usugu wa dawa za VVU nchini Kenya.

English: Information from this study is expected to assist in the designing of a vaccine as well as help in making decisions on the change of treatment regimen among others.
Kiswahili: Taarifa kutoka kwa utafiti huu inatarajiwa kusaidia katika kubuni chanjo na pia kusaidia katika kufanya maamuzi kuhusu mabadiliko ya utaratibu wa matibabu miongoni mwa mengine.

English: Similarly, in order to better understand how the body responds during the critical moments of early HIV infection, the Kericho site of KEMRI is also participating in an innovative study focusing on the earliest stages of HIV infection to help understand what is needed to create an effective HIV vaccine.
Kiswahili: Vile vile, ili kuelewa vyema jinsi mwili unavyoitikia wakati wa nyakati muhimu za maambukizi ya VVU mapema, tovuti ya Kericho ya KEMRI pia inashiriki katika utafiti bunifu unaozingatia hatua za mwanzo za maambukizi ya VVU ili kusaidia kuelewa kinachohitajika ili kuunda chanjo bora ya VVU.

English: The interventions used include very early broadly neutralizing antibodies which are substances produced by the body to fight infections using the state of the art laboratories certified by the esteemed Collage of American Pathologists (CAP), the study continues to monitor the progress of two babies and six adults who are apparently doing well.KEMRI and Nagasaki University Institute of Tropical Medicine – NUITM jointly established a bacteriology department that has been involved in a hospital based surveillance of diarrhoea and septicemia.
Kiswahili: Hatua zilizotumika ni pamoja na kingamwili za awali sana zinazopunguza kasi ambazo ni vitu vinavyozalishwa na mwili kupambana na maambukizi kwa kutumia maabara za kisasa zilizoidhinishwa na Collage of American Pathologists (CAP), utafiti unaendelea kufuatilia maendeleo ya watoto wawili na watu wazima sita ambao inaonekana wanaendelea vizuri. KEMRI na Taasisi ya Tiba ya Kitropiki ya Chuo Kikuu cha Nagasaki - NUITM kwa pamoja walianzisha idara ya bakteria ambayo imekuwa ikihusika katika ufuatiliaji wa kuhara na septicemia hospitalini.

English: The study being carried out at Kiambu County Hospital in Central Province and Mbita Sub-county hospital in Western Kenya seeks to determine factors that influence severe diarrhoea among children below 5 years of age whereas surveillance for septicemia was for all age groups.
Kiswahili: Utafiti unaofanywa katika Hospitali ya Kaunti ya Kiambu katika Mkoa wa Kati na hospitali ya Kaunti Ndogo ya Mbita Magharibi mwa Kenya unalenga kubaini mambo yanayoathiri kuhara kali miongoni mwa watoto walio chini ya umri wa miaka 5 ilhali ufuatiliaji wa septicemia ulikuwa kwa makundi yote ya rika.

English: After almost seven years, scientist at KEMRI have been able to clarify the burden of rotavirus and enteric bacterial pathogens among children below 5 years in Kiambu and Mbita.
Kiswahili: Baada ya karibu miaka saba, wanasayansi wa KEMRI wameweza kufafanua mzigo wa vimelea vya rotavirus na bakteria wa tumbo miongoni mwa watoto walio chini ya miaka 5 huko Kiambu na Mbita.

English: In the process, the research team has also been able to isolate new and unusual strains of rotavirus in the country.
Kiswahili: Katika mchakato huo, timu ya utafiti pia imeweza kutenga aina mpya na zisizo za kawaida za virusi vya rotavirus nchini.

English: The assessment of the impact of the newly introduced rotavirus vaccine in the country has also been completed.
Kiswahili: Tathmini ya athari za chanjo mpya ya rotavirus iliyoanzishwa nchini pia imekamilika.

English: This study is being conducted because the stomach environment in relation to HIV and AIDS has not been properly studied yet the virus causes a decrease in the stomach’s ability to safeguard itself.
Kiswahili: Utafiti huu unafanywa kwa sababu mazingira ya tumbo kuhusiana na VVU na UKIMWI hayajasomwa ipasavyo lakini virusi husababisha kupungua kwa uwezo wa tumbo kujilinda.

English: This therefore allows for microbial translocation and infectious agents that could have been controlled by the mucosal barrier to cause disease.

English: One of the major findings of the study is that the presence of infectious agents in the stomach induces chronic systemic immune activation.
Kiswahili: Mojawapo ya matokeo makubwa ya utafiti huo ni kwamba uwepo wa vimelea vya kuambukiza tumboni husababisha uanzishaji sugu wa kinga mwilini.

English: The Centre for Infectious and Parasitic Diseases Control Research has for a long time been the main site for superficial fungal infection research in the context of human immunodeficiency virus – HIV in Western Kenya.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Utafiti wa Kudhibiti Magonjwa ya Kuambukiza na Vimelea kwa muda mrefu kimekuwa tovuti kuu ya utafiti wa juu juu wa maambukizi ya fangasi katika muktadha wa virusi vya UKIMWI - VVU Magharibi mwa Kenya.

English: Here, a study by KEMRI in the spectrum of superficial fungal infection is being undertaken at an outpatient clinic in Busia.
Kiswahili: Hapa, utafiti uliofanywa na KEMRI kuhusu wigo wa maambukizi ya juu juu ya fangasi unafanywa katika kliniki ya wagonjwa wa nje huko Busia.

English: The study has found that tinea as the most prevalent superficial and opportunistic infection in HIV patients in the area.

English: It was therefore established that antifungal susceptibility testing plays an important role in managing and guiding treatment decisions.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo ilibainika kuwa upimaji wa uwezekano wa kuambukizwa na vimelea una jukumu muhimu katika kusimamia na kuongoza maamuzi ya matibabu.

English: The Centre for Virus Research which is one of the oldest centres at the Kenya Medical Research Institute has seven laboratories and located at the headquarters of KEMRI as well as its research campuses within Kenyatta National Hospital compound.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Utafiti wa Virusi ambacho ni mojawapo ya vituo vya zamani zaidi katika Taasisi ya Utafiti wa Kimatibabu ya Kenya kina maabara saba na kiko katika makao makuu ya KEMRI pamoja na kampasi zake za utafiti ndani ya eneo la Hospitali ya Kitaifa ya Kenyatta.

English: The Centre also has several clinical research sites in Western Kenya, the Rift Valley and Coastal Regions of the country with laboratories that handle overall research component among them:Arboviruses and Hemorrhagic Fevers Unit.
Kiswahili: Kituo hiki pia kina maeneo kadhaa ya utafiti wa kimatibabu Magharibi mwa Kenya, Mikoa ya Bonde la Ufa na Pwani ya nchi hiyo ikiwa na maabara zinazoshughulikia sehemu ya jumla ya utafiti miongoni mwao: Kitengo cha Arbovirusi na Homa ya Kutokwa na Damu.

English: Influenza and other Respiratory Viral Diseases Unit Viral Diarrhea Unit Viral Hepatitis Unit EPI Disease HIV and AIDS and Human Papilloma Virus Since its inception 37 years ago the centre has made great strides and achievements in terms of developing laboratory and human resource capacity which has placed it among the best in the world.
Kiswahili: Kitengo cha Mafua na Magonjwa Mengine ya Virusi vya Kupumua Kitengo cha Kuhara Virusi Kitengo cha Homa ya Ini ya Virusi Kitengo cha EPI Ugonjwa wa VVU na UKIMWI na Virusi vya Papilloma vya Binadamu Tangu kuanzishwa kwake miaka 37 iliyopita kituo hiki kimepiga hatua kubwa na mafanikio katika kukuza uwezo wa maabara na rasilimali watu ambao umekiweka miongoni mwa bora zaidi duniani.

English: The laboratory Projects have been investigating on: Specialization on molecular aspects of microbial infectious and epidemiology.
Kiswahili: Miradi ya maabara imekuwa ikichunguza kuhusu: Utaalamu katika vipengele vya molekuli vya maambukizi ya vijidudu na magonjwa ya mlipuko.

English: This unit is a part of the Consortium for Pathogen Ecology and Epidemiology – (CoPEEG) that was formed in 2017 Molecular Epidemiology of Urinary Tract Infectious (UTI) pathogens which generally form the most resistant populations of any infectious bacteria.
Kiswahili: Kitengo hiki ni sehemu ya Muungano wa Ikolojia na Epidemiolojia ya Vimelea vya Magonjwa – (CoPEEG) ambao uliundwa mwaka wa 2017 katika Epidemiolojia ya Molekuli ya Vimelea vya Kuambukiza Njia ya Mkojo (UTI) ambavyo kwa ujumla huunda kundi sugu zaidi la bakteria yoyote inayoambukiza.

English: CoPEEG unit is now a part of the initiative known as Holistic Approach Towards Unravelling Antibiotic Resistance in East Africa – HATUA.
Kiswahili: Kitengo cha CoPEEG sasa ni sehemu ya mpango unaojulikana kama Mbinu Holistic Towards Unraveling Antibiotic Resistance in East Africa – HATUA.

English: The unit was the core facility that supported diagnosis and molecular analysis of viral cholera strains implicated in multiple outbreaks in 2017 in Nairobi Neglected Tropical Diseases are the most dilapidating ailments that pose socio-economic challenges to the affected families and communities at large.
Kiswahili: Kitengo hicho kilikuwa kituo kikuu kilichounga mkono utambuzi na uchambuzi wa molekuli wa aina za kipindupindu za virusi zilizohusishwa na milipuko mingi mwaka wa 2017 jijini Nairobi. Magonjwa ya Kitropiki Yaliyopuuzwa ndiyo magonjwa yanayoharibika zaidi ambayo yanaleta changamoto za kijamii na kiuchumi kwa familia na jamii zilizoathiriwa kwa ujumla.

English: Since they are chronic in nature they impoverish families and they are not small in number anyway.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ni wa kudumu kwa asili, wanazifanya familia kuwa maskini na hata hivyo si ndogo kwa idadi.

English: They manifest themselves in the form of viruses, bacteria as well as parasites, and they include infections such as leishmaniasis, leprosy, buruli, ulcers, dengue fever, tuberculosis and many more.
Kiswahili: Hujidhihirisha katika mfumo wa virusi, bakteria pamoja na vimelea, na hujumuisha maambukizi kama vile leishmaniasis, ukoma, buruli, vidonda, homa ya dengue, kifua kikuu na mengine mengi.

English: In this regard, KEMRI’s Infectious and Parasitic Diseases Research Programme has been conducting research on the best strategies to deal with some of them.
Kiswahili: Katika suala hili, Programu ya Utafiti wa Magonjwa ya Kuambukiza na Vimelea ya KEMRI imekuwa ikifanya utafiti kuhusu mikakati bora ya kukabiliana na baadhi yake.

English: For instance the Neglected Tropical Diseases Unit has brought together different researchers working on disease specific issues .Their research work in Western Kenya has focused mainly on schistosomiasis and soil transmitted helminths.
Kiswahili: Kwa mfano, Kitengo cha Magonjwa ya Kitropiki Yaliyopuuzwa kimewaleta pamoja watafiti mbalimbali wanaofanya kazi katika masuala maalum ya magonjwa. Kazi yao ya utafiti katika Magharibi mwa Kenya imejikita zaidi katika kichocho na minyoo inayosambazwa kwenye udongo.

English: Eastern and Southern Africa Centre for International Parasite Control-ESACIPAC, is yet another platform for exchanging information on prevention and control of parasitic diseases .Being a regional consultative gathering of scientists on how to combat parasitic diseases within their respective countries a lot takes place in terms of information sharing at the periodic conferences of ESACIPACParasitic infections continue to be of major public health concern especially in the developing countries.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Kudhibiti Vimelea vya Kimataifa cha Mashariki na Kusini mwa Afrika-ESACIPAC, ni jukwaa jingine la kubadilishana taarifa kuhusu kinga na udhibiti wa magonjwa ya vimelea. Kwa kuwa ni mkutano wa mashauriano wa kikanda wa wanasayansi kuhusu jinsi ya kupambana na magonjwa ya vimelea ndani ya nchi zao, mengi hufanyika katika suala la kubadilishana taarifa katika mikutano ya mara kwa mara ya ESACIPC Maambukizi ya vimelea yanaendelea kuwa jambo muhimu kwa afya ya umma hasa katika nchi zinazoendelea.

English: Efforts towards their elimination have not yielded the expected results due to re-infection after each treatment.
Kiswahili: Juhudi za kuondoa vijidudu hivi hazijatoa matokeo yaliyotarajiwa kutokana na maambukizi mapya baada ya kila matibabu.

English: So far the only recommended strategy towards reduction of parasitic infections is through mass administration of drugs.
Kiswahili: Hadi sasa mkakati pekee unaopendekezwa wa kupunguza maambukizi ya vimelea ni kupitia utoaji wa dawa kwa wingi.

English: A major regulatory function by the infectious and parasitic diseases programme has been in the form of developing a National Diseases Surveillance and Rapid response capacity for major disease outbreaks and cholera, Chikungunya virus, H1N1 Flu, Ebola, Yellow Fever, Aflatoxicosis among others.
Kiswahili: Kazi kubwa ya udhibiti wa programu ya magonjwa ya kuambukiza na vimelea imekuwa katika mfumo wa kukuza uwezo wa Kitaifa wa Ufuatiliaji wa Magonjwa na Mwitikio wa Haraka kwa milipuko mikubwa ya magonjwa na kipindupindu, virusi vya Chikungunya, Homa ya H1N1, Ebola, Homa ya Njano, Aflatoxicosis miongoni mwa mengine.

English: Indeed viral Hepatitis is a significant public health challenge comparable to HIV and TB.
Kiswahili: Hakika Homa ya Ini inayosababishwa na virusi ni changamoto kubwa ya afya ya umma inayofanana na VVU na Kifua Kikuu.

English: The launching of KEMRI HEPCELL kit in 1991 was therefore a major milestone in the Institute’s research programmes.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo, uzinduzi wa vifaa vya KEMRI HEPCELL mwaka wa 1991 ulikuwa hatua muhimu katika programu za utafiti za Taasisi.

English: The test kit is for detection of Hepatitis B virus.
Kiswahili: Kifaa cha kupima ni cha kugundua virusi vya Hepatitis B.

English: It has a diagnostic sensitivity of 98 per cent and it is simple to use.Another type of virus with major public implications is the Human papilloma virus.
Kiswahili: Ina unyeti wa uchunguzi wa asilimia 98 na ni rahisi kutumia. Aina nyingine ya virusi yenye athari kubwa kwa umma ni virusi vya papilloma vya binadamu.

English: It spreads through skin to skin contact and it is the most common sexually transmitted virus in humans.
Kiswahili: Huenea kupitia mguso wa ngozi hadi ngozi na ndio virusi vya zinaa vinavyoenea zaidi kwa wanadamu.

English: Most HPV strains do not cause any health problems.
Kiswahili: Aina nyingi za HPV hazisababishi matatizo yoyote ya kiafya.

English: However, a few high risk strains have been associated with genital warts and cancers which include cervical and anogenital cancers among others.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, aina chache za saratani zilizo katika hatari kubwa zimehusishwa na vidonda vya sehemu za siri na saratani ambazo ni pamoja na saratani ya shingo ya kizazi na saratani ya kizazi miongoni mwa zingine.

English: However, this is largely a preventable cancer if detected early.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, hii kwa kiasi kikubwa ni saratani inayoweza kuzuilika ikiwa itagunduliwa mapema.

English: The HPV laboratory at KEMRI is capable of diagnosing the HPV virus.
Kiswahili: Maabara ya HPV katika KEMRI ina uwezo wa kugundua virusi vya HPV.

English: It is therefore recommended for women to have cervical cancer screening at around age 21 and continue to do so periodically until the age of 65.Through these efforts KEMRI has therefore been honored internationally by the following among others: Regional Laboratory Capacity Building in operation research under the East African Public Health Laboratory Networking Project-EAPHLN WHO designated Centre of Excellence in Malaria, Nutrition and Virology WHO Collaborating Center for HIV/AIDS Tropical Diseases Research, Polio Immunization Viral Hemorrhagic Fever and Microbial Résistance -WHO-NET USA National Research Council Recognized Training Institute for Post- Doctoral The Africa Regional Headquarters for Drugs for Neglected Diseases Initiative (DNDi) Africa Network for Drugs and Diagnostics Innovation (ANDI) Centre of Excellence in Manufacturing and Development of Diagnostic Kits ANDI Centre of Excellence for HIV Operational Research.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo inashauriwa wanawake kufanyiwa uchunguzi wa saratani ya shingo ya kizazi wakiwa na umri wa karibu miaka 21 na kuendelea kufanya hivyo mara kwa mara hadi umri wa miaka 65. Kwa hivyo, kupitia juhudi hizi, KEMRI imeheshimiwa kimataifa na yafuatayo miongoni mwa mengine: Kujenga Uwezo wa Maabara ya Kikanda katika utafiti wa uendeshaji chini ya Mradi wa Mtandao wa Maabara ya Afya ya Umma ya Afrika Mashariki-EAPHLN WHO iliteua Kituo cha Ubora katika Malaria, Lishe na Virusi Kituo cha Ushirika cha WHO cha Utafiti wa Magonjwa ya Kitropiki cha VVU/UKIMWI, Chanjo ya Polio Homa ya Virusi vya Kutokwa na Hewa na Upinzani wa Vijidudu -WHO-NET Marekani Baraza la Kitaifa la Utafiti Taasisi ya Mafunzo ya Uzamili Makao Makuu ya Afrika ya Mpango wa Dawa za Kulevya kwa Magonjwa Yasiyopuuzwa (DNDi) Mtandao wa Afrika wa Ubunifu wa Dawa na Utambuzi (ANDI) Kituo cha Ubora katika Utengenezaji na Maendeleo ya Vifaa vya Utambuzi Kituo cha Ubora cha ANDI cha Utafiti wa Uendeshaji wa VVU.

English: A Designated “Good Clinical Practice Centre for Clinical Trials”.
Kiswahili: "Kituo Kilichoteuliwa cha Mazoezi Bora ya Kliniki kwa Majaribio ya Kliniki".

English: Global Centre of Excellence in Parasite Control under Hashimoto Initiative Programme.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Kimataifa cha Ubora katika Udhibiti wa Vimelea chini ya Programu ya Mpango wa Hashimoto.

English: Regional Headquarters for Emerging & Re- merging Diseases and Climate Change & Health.
Kiswahili: Makao Makuu ya Kanda ya Magonjwa Yanayoibuka na Kuunganisha Upya na Mabadiliko ya Tabianchi na Afya.

English: KEMRI is a health research institution with a formidable research culture that is robust, responsive and result – oriented.
Kiswahili: KEMRI ni taasisi ya utafiti wa afya yenye utamaduni mzuri wa utafiti ambao ni imara, unaoitikia na unaozingatia matokeo.

English: It is for this reason that it has developed a critical mass of scientists, technical and support staff who have been able to turn it into one of the best research institutions globally.
Kiswahili: Ni kwa sababu hii kwamba imeunda kundi muhimu la wanasayansi, wafanyakazi wa kiufundi na wasaidizi ambao wameweza kuibadilisha kuwa moja ya taasisi bora za utafiti duniani.

English: Ongoing Projects Community driven discovery and development of bioproducts to treat and/or manage human diseases: - We are prospecting for natural products from medicinal plants, fungi, bacteria, venoms, and assessing their potential as treatment/management products against human diseases, including; - Non communicable diseases (NCDs such as cancer, hypertension and diabetes); - Neglected Tropical Diseases (NTDs such as Leishmaniasis, Schistosomiasis, and helminths); - Communicable diseases by targeting WHO priority drug-resistant bacterial pathogens and Malaria parasite as well as vector.
Kiswahili: Miradi Inayoendelea Ugunduzi na uundaji wa bidhaa za kibiolojia zinazoendeshwa na jamii ili kutibu na/au kudhibiti magonjwa ya binadamu: - Tunatafuta bidhaa asilia kutoka kwa mimea ya dawa, kuvu, bakteria, sumu, na kutathmini uwezo wao kama bidhaa za matibabu/usimamizi dhidi ya magonjwa ya binadamu, ikiwa ni pamoja na; - Magonjwa yasiyoambukiza (NCD kama vile saratani, shinikizo la damu na kisukari); - Magonjwa ya Tropiki Yasiyopuuzwa (NTD kama vile Leishmaniasis, Skistosomiasis, na helminth); - Magonjwa ya kuambukiza kwa kulenga vimelea vya bakteria sugu kwa dawa na vimelea vya Malaria pamoja na wadudu.

English: Turkana Health Genomic Project (THGP), a multi-institutional (KEMRI, Vanderbilt University and UC Berkeley) and multi-disciplinary study answering the following broad questions: - The adaptations of Turkana people to water stress and pastoralism - The role of lifestyle change and genotype in the development of non-communicable diseases.
Kiswahili: Mradi wa Jenomu wa Afya wa Turkana (THGP), utafiti wa taasisi nyingi (KEMRI, Chuo Kikuu cha Vanderbilt na UC Berkeley) na utafiti wa taaluma mbalimbali unaojibu maswali mapana yafuatayo: - Marekebisho ya watu wa Turkana kwa msongo wa maji na ufugaji - Jukumu la mabadiliko ya mtindo wa maisha na aina ya jenomu katika maendeleo ya magonjwa yasiyoambukiza.

English: My research competence cut across the fields of drug discovery, cancer biology, immunology, biological aging and how our environment influence our vulnerability or resilience to diseases.
Kiswahili: Umahiri wangu wa utafiti ulihusisha nyanja zote za ugunduzi wa dawa, biolojia ya saratani, kinga mwilini, kuzeeka kibiolojia na jinsi mazingira yetu yanavyoathiri udhaifu wetu au ustahimilivu wetu kwa magonjwa.

English: In my training and research activities at Leibniz Institute on Ageing, Paul Ehrlich Institute – Germany, and Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI), he has acquired valuable sets of multi-Omic and biochemistry skills including, developing an easy to use library preparation method for NGS RNA-sequencing, preparing samples for proteomics, Lipidomics, Peptidomics, and Nanostring.
Kiswahili: Katika mafunzo na shughuli zangu za utafiti katika Taasisi ya Leibniz kuhusu Uzee, Taasisi ya Paul Ehrlich - Ujerumani, na Taasisi ya Utafiti wa Kimatibabu ya Kenya (KEMRI), amepata seti muhimu za ujuzi wa multi-Omic na biokemia ikiwa ni pamoja na, kutengeneza mbinu rahisi ya utayarishaji wa maktaba kwa ajili ya mpangilio wa NGS RNA, kuandaa sampuli za proteomics, Lipidomics, Peptidomics, na Nanostring.

English: In addition, Dr. Njeru has is proficient in Western blotting, PCR approaches, Immunohistochemistry and Immunocytochemistry, cell culture, CRISPR/Cas9 knockout, CRISPRi, and shRNA knockdown approaches, among others.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, Dkt. Njeru ana ujuzi katika mbinu za Western blotting, PCR, Immunohistochemistry na Immunocytochemistry, utamaduni wa seli, CRISPR/Cas9 knockout, CRISPRi, na mbinu za shRNA knockdown, miongoni mwa zingine.

English: He has used these approaches to decipher molecular targets and mechanistic changes upon genetic manipulation or chemical treatments in both in vitro and in vivo experimental model systems.
Kiswahili: Ametumia mbinu hizi kubaini malengo ya molekuli na mabadiliko ya kiufundi katika ujanjaji wa kijenetiki au matibabu ya kemikali katika mifumo ya majaribio ya vitro na vivo.

English: Presently, he is part of a team that is using community participatory approaches to profile disease burdens, vulnerability and/or resilience as people transition from rural to urban lifestyle in the context of Turkana Health Genomic Project (THGP).
Kiswahili: Kwa sasa, yeye ni sehemu ya timu inayotumia mbinu shirikishi za kijamii ili kuainisha mizigo ya magonjwa, udhaifu na/au ustahimilivu wakati watu wanapobadilika kutoka mtindo wa maisha wa vijijini hadi mijini katika muktadha wa Mradi wa Turkana Health Genomic (THGP).

English: He is also part of an African consortia – Grand Challenges Africa Drug Discovery Accelerator (GC-ADDA), where we are promoting drug discovery initiatives in Africa-specifically contributing on the use of BacPROTAC as potential innovative therapeutic approach against Mycobacteria tuberculosis.
Kiswahili: Pia ni sehemu ya muungano wa Kiafrika - Grand Challenges Africa Drug Discovery Accelerator (GC-ADDA), ambapo tunakuza mipango ya ugunduzi wa dawa barani Afrika - haswa tukichangia katika matumizi ya BacPROTAC kama mbinu bunifu ya matibabu dhidi ya kifua kikuu cha Mycobacteria.

English: As a way of giving back to the community and building the next crop of African scientists, Dr. Njeru mentors young scientists in Africa through initiatives such as KEMRI Graduate School (KGS), Pan African University Institute for Basic Sciences, Technology and Innovation (PAUSTI), German academic exchange service (DAAD), Turkana Health genomic Project (THGP) and Afrique Research Support Hub (ARSH) Program Contact Info Location At PI, in Mutithi on Embu-Meru highway.
Kiswahili: Kama njia ya kurudisha kwa jamii na kujenga zao lijalo la wanasayansi wa Kiafrika, Dkt. Njeru anawashauri wanasayansi wachanga barani Afrika kupitia mipango kama vile Shule ya Uzamili ya KEMRI (KGS), Taasisi ya Sayansi ya Msingi, Teknolojia na Ubunifu ya Chuo Kikuu cha Pan African (PAUSTI), huduma ya ubadilishanaji wa kitaaluma ya Ujerumani (DAAD), Mradi wa Jenomu wa Afya ya Turkana (THGP) na Kituo cha Usaidizi wa Utafiti wa Afrique (ARSH) Maelezo ya Mawasiliano Mahali pa PI, huko Mutithi kwenye barabara kuu ya Embu-Meru.

Kiswahili: ~KM 5 kutoka Makutano na ~KM 100 kutoka Nairobi.

English: CENTER FOR GLOBAL HEALTH RESEARCH (CGHR)-KISUMU Overview The Centre for Global Health Research (CGHR) is located in Kisumu, Western Kenya.
Kiswahili: KITUO CHA UTAFITI WA AFYA DUNIANI (CGHR)-KISUMU Muhtasari Kituo cha Utafiti wa Afya Duniani (CGHR) kiko Kisumu, Magharibi mwa Kenya.

English: The facility was originally inherited from the former East African Medical Research Council.
Kiswahili: Kituo hicho awali kilirithiwa kutoka kwa Baraza la Utafiti wa Kimatibabu la Afrika Mashariki.

English: In 1984, the station was named Malaria and Other Protozoal Diseases Centre (MOPDC) later changing to Vector Biology and Control Research Centre (VBCRC), then Centre for Vector Biology and Control Research (CVBCR) and finally Center for Global Health Research (CGHR).
Kiswahili: Mnamo 1984, kituo hicho kiliitwa Kituo cha Malaria na Magonjwa Mengine ya Protozoa (MOPDC) baadaye kikabadilishwa kuwa Kituo cha Utafiti wa Biolojia na Udhibiti wa Vector (VBCRC), kisha Kituo cha Utafiti wa Biolojia na Udhibiti wa Vector (CVBCR) na hatimaye Kituo cha Utafiti wa Afya Duniani (CGHR).

English: The Centre is today one of the 15 Research Centres of the Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI).
Kiswahili: Kituo hiki leo ni mojawapo ya Vituo 15 vya Utafiti vya Taasisi ya Utafiti wa Kimatibabu ya Kenya (KEMRI).

English: The Centre is strategically located in Kisumu City, western Kenya region, in an area that is endemic for major infectious diseases.
Kiswahili: Kituo hiki kiko katika eneo la kimkakati katika Jiji la Kisumu, magharibi mwa Kenya, katika eneo ambalo ni la kawaida kwa magonjwa makubwa ya kuambukiza.

English: Since its establishment in 1984, CGHR has been on the world map as the site of ground-breaking research focusing on infectious diseases of medical importance.
Kiswahili: Tangu kuanzishwa kwake mwaka wa 1984, CGHR imekuwa kwenye ramani ya dunia kama eneo la utafiti wa msingi unaozingatia magonjwa ya kuambukiza yenye umuhimu wa kimatibabu.

English: Specifically, the Centre has carried out cutting-edge research focusing on trials on the efficacy of drugs, emergence of drug and vector resistance, epidemiology, immunology, molecular biology, vector biology, climate and human health, characterization of malaria vaccine candidate antigens, malaria vaccine trials, malaria in pregnancy and interaction of malaria and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), schistosomiasis, intestinal helminthes, HIV/AIDS and its impact on the community, HIV interaction with other infectious diseases, tuberculosis and reproductive health.
Kiswahili: Hasa, Kituo kimefanya utafiti wa kina unaozingatia majaribio kuhusu ufanisi wa dawa, kuibuka kwa upinzani wa dawa na vekta, epidemiolojia, kinga mwilini, biolojia ya molekuli, biolojia ya vekta, hali ya hewa na afya ya binadamu, uainishaji wa antijeni zinazohitajika kwa chanjo ya malaria, majaribio ya chanjo ya malaria, malaria wakati wa ujauzito na mwingiliano wa malaria na virusi vya UKIMWI (VVU), kichocho, helminthi ya utumbo, VVU/UKIMWI na athari zake kwa jamii, mwingiliano wa VVU na magonjwa mengine ya kuambukiza, kifua kikuu na afya ya uzazi.

English: Mandates - To conduct evidence based research aimed at providing solutions for the reduction of infectious, parasitic, non-infectious diseases and other causes of ill-health in Kenya.This includes, but not limited to: - Epidemiology and control of Infectious, Non-Communicable and Lifestyle Diseases.
Kiswahili: Maagizo - Kufanya utafiti unaotegemea ushahidi unaolenga kutoa suluhisho za kupunguza magonjwa ya kuambukiza, vimelea, yasiyoambukiza na sababu zingine za afya mbaya nchini Kenya. Hii inajumuisha, lakini sio tu: - Epidemiolojia na udhibiti wa Magonjwa ya Kuambukiza, Yasiyoambukiza na ya Mtindo wa Maisha.

English: Some of the data from our Schistosomiasis Consortium for Operational Research (SCORE) studies is currently being shared with the Ministry of Health in order to provide evidence on the best combination of deworming strategies based on prevalence thresholds, both in terms of duration and frequency of MDAs.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya data kutoka kwa tafiti zetu za Skistosomiasis Consortium for Operational Research (SCORE) kwa sasa zinashirikiwa na Wizara ya Afya ili kutoa ushahidi kuhusu mchanganyiko bora wa mikakati ya kuondoa minyoo kulingana na vizingiti vya kuenea, kwa upande wa muda na marudio ya MDA.

English: Evidence of Schistosomiasis in pre-school age children (< 5 years) and need for change in deworming policy: The WHO recommended control strategy of Schistosomiasis is based on preventive chemotherapy interventions targeting the majority of the at-risk population The current gold standard treatment employs annual single oral dose of the drug Praziquantel (PZQ) 600 mg tablets for adults and school age children at 40 mg/kg.
Kiswahili: Ushahidi wa Skistosomiasis kwa watoto wa umri wa shule ya awali (< miaka 5) na hitaji la mabadiliko katika sera ya kuondoa minyoo: WHO ilipendekeza mkakati wa kudhibiti Skistosomiasis unategemea hatua za kinga za kidini zinazolenga idadi kubwa ya watu walio katika hatari. Matibabu ya kiwango cha dhahabu ya sasa hutumia kipimo kimoja cha kila mwaka cha dawa ya Praziquantel (PZQ) 600 mg kwa watu wazima na watoto wa umri wa kwenda shule kwa kipimo cha 40 mg/kg.

English: However, pre-School Aged Children (pre-SAC), which are a high-risk group for Schistosome infections accounting for 10-20 million of the global prevalence, are currently not included during treatment campaigns due to the lack of a suitable PZQ pediatric formulation.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, Watoto wa Zamani wa Shule ya Awali (kabla ya SAC), ambao ni kundi lenye hatari kubwa ya kupata maambukizi ya Skistosome yanayochangia milioni 10-20 ya maambukizi duniani, kwa sasa hawajajumuishwa wakati wa kampeni za matibabu kutokana na ukosefu wa fomula inayofaa ya PZQ kwa watoto.

English: These findings have informed the inclusion of such otherwise neglected settings in National deworming programs, and the strategies to use in such settings.
Kiswahili: Matokeo haya yamesababisha kuingizwa kwa mipangilio kama hiyo iliyopuuzwa katika programu za Kitaifa za kuondoa minyoo, na mikakati ya kutumia katika mipangilio kama hiyo.

English: Deworming activities targeting Schistosomiasis and Soil-transmitted Helminths: Over the last 5 years, and in partnership with the Ministry of Health, over 70,000 individuals in most at risk areas were dewormed annually in our annual Mass Drug Administration programs targeting Schistosomiasis and Soil-Transmitted Helminths (STH), conducted by three key NTD projects in western Kenya.
Kiswahili: Shughuli za kuondoa minyoo zinazolenga Skistosomiasis na Helminth zinazosambazwa na Udongo: Katika kipindi cha miaka 5 iliyopita, na kwa ushirikiano na Wizara ya Afya, zaidi ya watu 70,000 katika maeneo mengi yaliyo hatarini waliondolewa minyoo kila mwaka katika programu zetu za kila mwaka za Utawala wa Dawa za Kulevya zinazolenga Skistosomiasis na Helminth zinazosambazwa na Udongo (STH), zinazofanywa na miradi mitatu muhimu ya NTD magharibi mwa Kenya.

English: Health education and awareness campaigns were also embedded in the deworming activities, and are a continuous activity.
Kiswahili: Kampeni za elimu ya afya na uhamasishaji pia zilijumuishwa katika shughuli za kuondoa minyoo, na ni shughuli endelevu.

English: Annual NTD Conference: We have over the years successfully hosted the annual Neglected Tropical Diseases (NTD) Conference.
Kiswahili: Mkutano wa Mwaka wa NTD: Kwa miaka mingi tumefanikiwa kuandaa Mkutano wa kila mwaka wa Magonjwa ya Tropiki Yasiyopuuzwa (NTD).

English: In 2016, the 10th annual NTD Conference was jointly hosted by the KEMRI’s NTD Unit and the Ministry of Health’s NTD Unit.
Kiswahili: Mnamo mwaka wa 2016, Mkutano wa 10 wa kila mwaka wa NTD uliandaliwa kwa pamoja na Kitengo cha NTD cha KEMRI na Kitengo cha NTD cha Wizara ya Afya.

English: This annual event presents an important and unique forum for showcasing and disseminating research findings from our studies to other stakeholders and partners from the Ministry of Health, local universities and other Non-governmental agencies working on NTDs.
Kiswahili: Tukio hili la kila mwaka linatoa jukwaa muhimu na la kipekee la kuonyesha na kusambaza matokeo ya utafiti kutoka kwa tafiti zetu kwa wadau wengine na washirika kutoka Wizara ya Afya, vyuo vikuu vya ndani na mashirika mengine yasiyo ya kiserikali yanayofanya kazi kwenye magonjwa yasiyo ya kawaida.

English: Ongoing Projects - A demographic surveillance system (DSS) in the previous bed net study area aimed at establishing a high quality surveillance system in a population of 135,000 and provide an infrastructure that will yield reliable demographic data and serve as a platform to evaluate the impact of public health interventions on morbidity and mortality.
Kiswahili: Miradi Inayoendelea - Mfumo wa ufuatiliaji wa idadi ya watu (DSS) katika eneo la awali la utafiti wa vyandarua unaolenga kuanzisha mfumo wa ufuatiliaji wa hali ya juu kwa idadi ya watu 135,000 na kutoa miundombinu itakayotoa data ya kuaminika ya idadi ya watu na kutumika kama jukwaa la kutathmini athari za uingiliaji kati wa afya ya umma kwenye magonjwa na vifo.

English: The Unit addresses the critical need to align research program with national and current global agenda.
Kiswahili: Kitengo hiki kinashughulikia hitaji muhimu la kuoanisha programu ya utafiti na ajenda ya kitaifa na ya sasa ya kimataifa.

English: The bacteria that cause tuberculosis are spread from one person to another through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.
Kiswahili: Bakteria zinazosababisha kifua kikuu huenea kutoka kwa mtu mmoja hadi mwingine kupitia matone madogo yanayotolewa hewani kupitia kikohozi na kupiga chafya.
