English: GENERAL INFORMATION ABOUT COVID-19 Corona Virus Disease 2019 (COVID19) is a new respiratory illness that can easily be spread from person to person.
Kiswahili: TAARIFA ZA JUMLA KUHUSU COVID-19 Ugonjwa wa Virusi vya Corona 2019 (COVID19) ni ugonjwa mpya wa kupumua ambao unaweza kusambazwa kwa urahisi kutoka kwa mtu mmoja hadi mwingine.

English: COVID-19 is spread through contact with droplets produced by a person who is sneezing or coughing or contaminated surfaces or objects.
Kiswahili: COVID-19 huenea kupitia kugusana na matone yanayotokana na mtu anayepiga chafya au kukohoa au nyuso au vitu vilivyochafuliwa.

English: Recent studies indicate that people who are infected but do not have symptoms likely also play a role in the spread of COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Uchunguzi wa hivi karibuni unaonyesha kwamba watu walioambukizwa lakini hawana dalili huenda pia wana jukumu katika kuenea kwa COVID-19.

English: Flagship Projects and Activities being Undertaken COVID-19 Vaccination We offer 1, 2 and booster shots at the KEMRI Medical Centre every Tuesday and Wednesday.
Kiswahili: Miradi na Shughuli Zinazoendelea Kufanywa Chanjo ya COVID-19 Tunatoa chanjo 1, 2 na nyongeza katika Kituo cha Matibabu cha KEMRI kila Jumanne na Jumatano.

English: Whole Genome Sequencing Corona Virus Disease 2019 (COVID19) is a new respiratory illness that can easily be spread from person to person.
Kiswahili: Ugonjwa wa Virusi vya Corona wa Jenomu Nzima 2019 (COVID19) ni ugonjwa mpya wa kupumua ambao unaweza kusambazwa kwa urahisi kutoka kwa mtu mmoja hadi mwingine.

English: Evaluation of COVID-19 screening Kits The Institute has been tasked to evaluate all diagnostic kits in the market.
Kiswahili: Tathmini ya Vifaa vya Kupima COVID-19 Taasisi imepewa jukumu la kutathmini vifaa vyote vya uchunguzi sokoni.

English: • Arrangements are in place to collect both blood and nasal swabs samples from COVID-19 positive and suspected cases Virus Transport Media (VTM) VTM production is ongoing with over 3,000 liters already produced and some deliveries made to Mombasa Hospital among other Public Health facilities.
Kiswahili: • Mipango ipo ya kukusanya sampuli za damu na pua kutoka kwa wagonjwa chanya wa COVID-19 na wanaoshukiwa kuwa na virusi. Uzalishaji wa VTM unaendelea huku zaidi ya lita 3,000 zikiwa tayari zimetolewa na baadhi ya watu wamepelekwa Hospitali ya Mombasa miongoni mwa vituo vingine vya Afya ya Umma.

English: The VTM is not only being produced for Kenya, but some regional countries have also expressed interest such as Rwanda, Uganda & Somalia.
Kiswahili: VTM haitengenezwi tu kwa ajili ya Kenya, lakini baadhi ya nchi za kikanda pia zimeonyesha nia kama vile Rwanda, Uganda na Somalia.

English: At the moment, the Market demands at least 10 million quantities of VTM.
Kiswahili: Kwa sasa, Soko linahitaji angalau kiasi cha VTM milioni 10.

English: The KEMRI Production Department is able to produce up to 10,000 liters a day.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Uzalishaji ya KEMRI ina uwezo wa kuzalisha hadi lita 10,000 kwa siku.

English: The shelf life of VTM is six months, however, can be used up to 12 years from the date of manufacture.
Kiswahili: Muda wa kuhifadhi VTM ni miezi sita, hata hivyo, inaweza kutumika hadi miaka 12 tangu tarehe ya utengenezaji.

English: Although its Quality Control (QC) was done internally, plans are underway to have an external evaluation by the Africa CDC among other local & International Institutions Point of Care (PoCT) Kit Production The process has started and in a few weeks, the Institute will launch its own PoCTs kits.
Kiswahili: Ingawa Udhibiti wake wa Ubora (QC) ulifanyika ndani, mipango inaendelea ya kuwa na tathmini ya nje na CDC ya Afrika miongoni mwa Taasisi zingine za ndani na za Kimataifa za Uzalishaji wa Vifaa vya Huduma (PoCT). Mchakato umeanza na katika wiki chache zijazo, Taasisi itazindua vifaa vyake vya PoCT.

English: Branding, strategy and designing have already commenced Development of PCR Kits Plans are advanced to develop the PCR kits.
Kiswahili: Uundaji wa chapa, mkakati na usanifu tayari umeanza. Uundaji wa Vifurushi vya PCR umeendelezwa. Mipango imeendelezwa ili kutengeneza vifurushi vya PCR.

English: Already the procurement of the DNA synthesizer is being done by KEMRI.
Kiswahili: Tayari ununuzi wa synthesizer ya DNA unafanywa na KEMRI.

English: COVID-19 Primers have also been availed by our collaborators.
Kiswahili: Vidokezo vya awali vya COVID-19 pia vimetumika na washirika wetu.

English: RNA/DNA polymerase will be produced by KEMRI Testing Drug Efficacy To commence with testing certain formulations including herbal products Commercialization of KEMRI PoCTs PoCT production will increase from 3000 to 10,000 pieces in the coming months as the need increases.
Kiswahili: Polima ya RNA/DNA itatolewa na Ufanisi wa Dawa za Kupima KEMRI. Kuanza na majaribio ya michanganyiko fulani ikijumuisha bidhaa za mitishamba. Uzalishaji wa KEMRI PoCTs PoCT utaongezeka kutoka vipande 3000 hadi 10,000 katika miezi ijayo kadri mahitaji yanavyoongezeka.

English: PoCT prequalification by WHO and Africa CDC process to be put in place as soon as the kits are in place.
Kiswahili: Mchakato wa uhitimu wa PoCT na WHO na CDC ya Afrika utawekwa mara tu vifaa hivyo vitakapowekwa.

English: COVID-19 Vaccine Development Vaccine candidate for COVID-19 is also being explored.
Kiswahili: Ukuzaji wa Chanjo ya COVID-19 Chanjo inayotarajiwa kwa COVID-19 pia inachunguzwa.

English: A multi-centre approach has been put in place towards this end.
Kiswahili: Mbinu ya vituo vingi imewekwa kwa lengo hili.

English: Hand Sanitizers (KEM-rub) Approximately 100,000 litres of hand sanitizers have been produced and supplied to various stakeholders including counties such as Lamu, Taveta, Machakos & government facilities.
Kiswahili: Visafishaji vya Mikono (KEM-rub) Takriban lita 100,000 za vitakasa mikono zimetengenezwa na kutolewa kwa wadau mbalimbali ikiwa ni pamoja na kaunti kama vile Lamu, Taveta, Machakos na vituo vya serikali.

English: A proposal has been developed for the production of alcohol-based hand sanitizer (KEM-Rub) within KEMRI.
Kiswahili: Pendekezo limetengenezwa kwa ajili ya utengenezaji wa kitakasa mikono chenye pombe (KEM-Rub) ndani ya KEMRI.

English: Mass Testing Capabilities of about 37,600 cases with machines at KEMRI Centers in Nairobi, Kisumu, Busia, Kericho and Kilifi.
Kiswahili: Uwezo wa Kupima kwa Wingi wa takriban kesi 37,600 kwa mashine katika Vituo vya KEMRI jijini Nairobi, Kisumu, Busia, Kericho na Kilifi.

English: So far KEMRI laboratories have conducted over 7,000 tests.
Kiswahili: Hadi sasa maabara za KEMRI zimefanya vipimo zaidi ya 7,000.

English: Capacity Building & Training Improvement of skills and knowledge for health workers at county level.
Kiswahili: Kujenga Uwezo na Mafunzo Uboreshaji wa ujuzi na maarifa kwa wafanyakazi wa afya katika ngazi ya kaunti.

English: KEMRI is involved in the validation of laboratories to test against COVID-19 for all 47 counties.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inahusika katika uthibitishaji wa maabara ili kupima COVID-19 kwa kaunti zote 47.

English: Institute is also involved in training laboratory staff on actual testing and preparedness.
Kiswahili: Taasisi pia inahusika katika kuwafunza wafanyakazi wa maabara kuhusu upimaji halisi na maandalizi.

English: Lessons learned to inform future pandemic preparedness include equipping people with skills and equipment.
Kiswahili: Masomo yaliyopatikana ili kuelimisha maandalizi ya janga la siku zijazo ni pamoja na kuwapa watu ujuzi na vifaa.

English: ChAdOx1 nCOV -19 Vaccine Trial Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) 1.
Kiswahili: Maswali Yanayoulizwa Mara kwa Mara Kuhusu Chanjo ya ChAdOx1 nCOV -19 (Maswali Yanayoulizwa Mara kwa Mara) 1.

English: What is the ChAdOx1 Vaccine Trial?
Kiswahili: Jaribio la Chanjo ya ChAdOx1 ni nini?

English: This trial aims to assess whether the ChAdOx1 vaccine is safe, effective and provides immunity against COVID-19 in adults aged 18 years and above.
Kiswahili: Jaribio hili linalenga kutathmini kama chanjo ya ChAdOx1 ni salama, yenye ufanisi na hutoa kinga dhidi ya COVID-19 kwa watu wazima wenye umri wa miaka 18 na zaidi.

English: How long will the vaccine trial run?
Kiswahili: Jaribio la chanjo litadumu kwa muda gani?

English: After starting, the trial will run for 24 months.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuanza, jaribio litaendelea kwa miezi 24.

English: Why conduct the trial in Kenya?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini kesi ifanyike nchini Kenya?

English: A vaccine which works in one population does not necessarily work in all populations, therefore it’s important to find out whether the trial vaccine works among Kenyan populations to ensure that Kenyans can benefit from the vaccine if it proves to be successful.
Kiswahili: Chanjo inayofanya kazi katika kundi moja la watu haimaanishi kwamba inafanya kazi katika kundi lote la watu, kwa hivyo ni muhimu kujua kama chanjo ya majaribio inafanya kazi miongoni mwa watu wa Kenya ili kuhakikisha kwamba Wakenya wanaweza kufaidika na chanjo hiyo ikiwa itafanikiwa.

English: Where will the trial take place?
Kiswahili: Kesi itafanyika wapi?

English: The initial recruitment site will be Kilifi and recruitment outside Kilifi County will be responsive to the epidemic and may include Mombasa.
Kiswahili: Eneo la awali la kuajiri litakuwa Kilifi na kuajiri nje ya Kaunti ya Kilifi kutashughulikia janga hili na kunaweza kujumuisha Mombasa.

English: Why is the trial being conducted in Kilifi?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini kesi hiyo inaendeshwa Kilifi?

English: Effective follow up is very critical in a phase 1 and 2 trial, and this follow up is easier in a Demographic Surveillance System, which we have in Kilifi.
Kiswahili: Ufuatiliaji mzuri ni muhimu sana katika jaribio la awamu ya 1 na 2, na ufuatiliaji huu ni rahisi zaidi katika Mfumo wa Ufuatiliaji wa Idadi ya Watu, ambao tunao Kilifi.

English: How many people will be recruited into this trial?
Kiswahili: Ni watu wangapi wataajiriwa katika jaribio hili?

English: A total of 400 adult volunteers will be recruited for both phase 1b and phase 2.
Kiswahili: Jumla ya watu wazima 400 wa kujitolea wataajiriwa kwa awamu ya 1b na awamu ya 2.

English: 6. Who can participate in this trial?
Kiswahili: 6. Ni nani anayeweza kushiriki katika jaribio hili?

English: This trial will only enrol frontline workers in key service areas such as healthcare workers, truck drivers, security personnel among others, over the age of 18 years.
Kiswahili: Jaribio hili litasajili wafanyakazi walio mstari wa mbele pekee katika maeneo muhimu ya huduma kama vile wafanyakazi wa afya, madereva wa malori, wafanyakazi wa usalama miongoni mwa wengine, wenye umri wa zaidi ya miaka 18.

English: What are the phases of this vaccine trial?
Kiswahili: Je, ni awamu gani za jaribio hili la chanjo?

English: In the first phase 40 participants will be recruited; followed by 360 volunteers recruited in the second phase of the study.
Kiswahili: Katika awamu ya kwanza washiriki 40 wataajiriwa; wakifuatiwa na watu 360 wa kujitolea walioajiriwa katika awamu ya pili ya utafiti.

English: Potential risk to participants is low and is mainly related to collecting blood samples and vaccination.
Kiswahili: Hatari inayowezekana kwa washiriki ni ndogo na inahusiana zaidi na kukusanya sampuli za damu na chanjo.

English: This trial vaccine has so far been given to over 8000 volunteers in the UK, South Africa and Brazil, and no significant safety concerns have been seen.
Kiswahili: Chanjo hii ya majaribio hadi sasa imetolewa kwa zaidi ya wajitolea 8000 nchini Uingereza, Afrika Kusini na Brazil, na hakuna wasiwasi mkubwa wa usalama ulioonekana.

English: The vaccine trial was stopped in other countries, why are you testing it in Kenya?
Kiswahili: Jaribio la chanjo lilisitishwa katika nchi zingine, kwa nini mnalifanyia majaribio nchini Kenya?

English: The trial was temporarily paused when one volunteer developed an unexpected illness.
Kiswahili: Jaribio lilisitishwa kwa muda wakati mjitolea mmoja alipopata ugonjwa usiotarajiwa.

English: Trial pausing is a standard procedure which allows an independent body to investigate the cause of an illness that has occurred in a trial volunteer.
Kiswahili: Kusitisha kesi ni utaratibu wa kawaida unaoruhusu chombo huru kuchunguza chanzo cha ugonjwa uliotokea kwa mjitolea wa majaribio.

English: While the trial was paused, no participant recruitment was happening in Kenya.
Kiswahili: Wakati jaribio lilipositishwa, hakuna uandikishaji wa washiriki uliokuwa ukiendelea nchini Kenya.

English: Has the vaccine trial been completely stopped?
Kiswahili: Je, jaribio la chanjo limesimamishwa kabisa?

English: Following independent reviews of the cause of the trial volunteer’s illness and finding that it may not have been related with the trial vaccine, the Data Safety and Monitoring Board (DSMB), has allowed the trial to proceed.
Kiswahili: Kufuatia mapitio huru ya chanzo cha ugonjwa wa mjitolea wa jaribio na kugundua kuwa huenda haukuhusiana na chanjo ya majaribio, Bodi ya Usalama na Ufuatiliaji wa Data (DSMB), imeruhusu jaribio kuendelea.

English: This is an independent committee made up of experts in biomedical research.
Kiswahili: Hii ni kamati huru inayoundwa na wataalamu katika utafiti wa tiba ya mwili.

English: The committee members are drawn from different parts of the world.
Kiswahili: Wajumbe wa kamati wamechaguliwa kutoka sehemu mbalimbali za dunia.

English: Their work is to closely monitor safety data coming out of clinical trials.
Kiswahili: Kazi yao ni kufuatilia kwa karibu data ya usalama inayotoka katika majaribio ya kimatibabu.

English: The DSBM for this Vaccine trial includes expert scientists from Kenya.
Kiswahili: DSBM kwa ajili ya jaribio hili la Chanjo inajumuisha wanasayansi wataalamu kutoka Kenya.

English: The Kenyan approving authorities continue to be updated regarding all safety matters in the international trials.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka zinazoidhinisha Kenya zinaendelea kupata taarifa mpya kuhusu masuala yote ya usalama katika majaribio ya kimataifa.

English: How will you ensure the safety of participants?
Kiswahili: Utahakikishaje usalama wa washiriki?

English: Participants will be closely monitored during the trial to ensure that they are healthy, and any effects of the vaccine are addressed.
Kiswahili: Washiriki watafuatiliwa kwa karibu wakati wa jaribio ili kuhakikisha kwamba wana afya njema, na athari zozote za chanjo zinashughulikiwa.

English: They will be followed up for 12 months after getting the trial vaccine.
Kiswahili: Watafuatiliwa kwa miezi 12 baada ya kupata chanjo ya majaribio.

English: Are people being paid to participate in this vaccine trial?
Kiswahili: Je, watu wanalipwa ili kushiriki katika jaribio hili la chanjo?

English: Individuals who agree to volunteer in this trial will be reimbursed costs of participation such as refund of travel costs.
Kiswahili: Watu binafsi watakaokubali kujitolea katika jaribio hili watarejeshewa gharama za ushiriki kama vile kurejeshewa gharama za usafiri.

English: They will also be compensated for other study related costs they may incur, on a standardized rate as outlined in our payment guidelines.
Kiswahili: Pia watalipwa kwa gharama zingine zinazohusiana na utafiti ambazo wanaweza kupata, kwa kiwango sanifu kama ilivyoainishwa katika miongozo yetu ya malipo.

English: Reimbursing volunteer costs is an ethical requirement in research.
Kiswahili: Kulipa gharama za kujitolea ni sharti la kimaadili katika utafiti.

English: What are the possible benefits for those participating?
Kiswahili: Je, ni faida gani zinazowezekana kwa wale wanaoshiriki?

English: Participants will benefit by knowledge of their general health status, including whether they are infected with SARS-CoV-2 (the virus that causes COVID-19).
Kiswahili: Washiriki watafaidika kwa kujua hali yao ya afya kwa ujumla, ikiwa ni pamoja na kama wameambukizwa SARS-CoV-2 (virusi vinavyosababisha COVID-19).

English: Will participants access this vaccine for free if it is found effective?
Kiswahili: Je, washiriki watatumia chanjo hii bure ikiwa itaonekana kuwa na ufanisi?

English: If global data demonstrates safety and efficacy of this trial vaccine, the control group that received a rabies vaccine will be offered the ChAdOx1 nCOV-19 vaccine, once all appropriate protocols have been followed.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa data ya kimataifa inaonyesha usalama na ufanisi wa chanjo hii ya majaribio, kundi la udhibiti lililopokea chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa litapewa chanjo ya ChAdOx1 nCOV-19, mara tu itifaki zote zinazofaa zitakapofuatwa.

English: 17. Who developed this vaccine?
Kiswahili: 17. Ni nani aliyetengeneza chanjo hii?

English: The vaccine was developed by researchers at the University of Oxford, UK in partnership with AstraZeneca.
Kiswahili: Chanjo hiyo ilitengenezwa na watafiti katika Chuo Kikuu cha Oxford, Uingereza kwa ushirikiano na AstraZeneca.

English: How will the trial results be shared with the public?
Kiswahili: Matokeo ya majaribio yatashirikiwaje na umma?

English: Summaries of the outcomes of the trial will be provided during community meetings in the areas from which participants are recruited.
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa matokeo ya jaribio utatolewa wakati wa mikutano ya jamii katika maeneo ambayo washiriki wanaajiriwa.

English: In addition, information to all stakeholders will be provided through the relevant communication and engagement channels 19.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, taarifa kwa wadau wote zitatolewa kupitia njia husika za mawasiliano na ushirikishwaji 19.

English: What capacity does KWTRP have to conduct this trial?
Kiswahili: Je, KWTRP ina uwezo gani wa kufanya jaribio hili?

English: KWTRP researchers have conducted large vaccine trials over the last 2 decades such as a Malaria RTSS vaccine trial and Ebola vaccine trial 20. Who is funding this trial?
Kiswahili: Watafiti wa KWTRP wamefanya majaribio makubwa ya chanjo katika miongo 2 iliyopita kama vile jaribio la chanjo ya Malaria RTSS na jaribio la chanjo ya Ebola 20. Ni nani anayefadhili jaribio hili?

English: The trial is being funded by the Wellcome Trust and Oxford University as the sponsor 21.
Kiswahili: Jaribio hilo linafadhiliwa na Wellcome Trust na Chuo Kikuu cha Oxford kama mdhamini 21.

English: When do we expect results for this trial?
Kiswahili: Tunatarajia matokeo ya jaribio hili lini?

English: We already have a lot of information on safety and how well the vaccine works, it’s unclear when we will determine if the vaccine prevents disease.
Kiswahili: Tayari tuna taarifa nyingi kuhusu usalama na jinsi chanjo inavyofanya kazi vizuri, haijulikani ni lini tutaamua kama chanjo hiyo inazuia magonjwa.

English: This will depend on the pandemic, as cases fall it’s harder to demonstrate that the vaccine prevents disease.
Kiswahili: Hii itategemea janga, kadri visa vinavyopungua ni vigumu kuonyesha kwamba chanjo huzuia magonjwa.

English: The Institute has launched various COVID-19 related products that will be a game-changer in the fight against the pandemic in the country and region including: - Virus Transport Media (VTM).
Kiswahili: Taasisi imezindua bidhaa mbalimbali zinazohusiana na COVID-19 ambazo zitabadilisha mchezo katika mapambano dhidi ya janga hili nchini na kanda ikiwa ni pamoja na: - Vyombo vya Habari vya Usafirishaji wa Virusi (VTM).

English: COVID-19 symptoms may appear 2-14 days after exposure (based on the incubation period of MERS-CoV viruses).
Kiswahili: Dalili za COVID-19 zinaweza kuonekana siku 2-14 baada ya kuambukizwa (kulingana na kipindi cha kupevuka kwa virusi vya MERS-CoV).

English: If soap and water are not readily available, use a hand sanitizer that contains at least 60% alcohol.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa sabuni na maji hazipatikani kwa urahisi, tumia kitakasa mikono chenye angalau 60% ya alkoholi.

English: Cover all surfaces of your hands and rub them together until they feel dry.
Kiswahili: Funika sehemu zote za mikono yako na uzisugue pamoja hadi zihisi kavu.

English: Maintain social distancing Maintain at least 1 meter (3 feet) distance between yourself and anyone who is coughing or sneezing.
Kiswahili: Dumisha umbali wa kijamii. Dumisha angalau mita 1 (futi 3) kati yako na mtu yeyote anayekohoa au kupiga chafya.

English: Stay at home Keeping distance from others especially Older adults and people of any age with certain serious underlying medical conditions like lung disease, heart disease, or diabetes are at higher risk for developing more serious complications from COVID-19 illness and should seek care as soon as symptoms start.
Kiswahili: Kaa nyumbani Kujitenga na wengine hasa Wazee na watu wa umri wowote walio na hali fulani mbaya za kiafya kama vile ugonjwa wa mapafu, ugonjwa wa moyo, au kisukari wako katika hatari kubwa ya kupata matatizo makubwa zaidi kutokana na ugonjwa wa COVID-19 na wanapaswa kutafuta huduma mara tu dalili zinapoanza.

English: Cover coughs and sneezes Cover your mouth and nose with a cloth face cover when around others You could spread COVID-19 to others even if you do not feel sick.
Kiswahili: Funika kikohozi na kupiga chafya Funika mdomo na pua yako kwa kitambaa Funika uso wako ukiwa karibu na wengine Unaweza kueneza COVID-19 kwa wengine hata kama hujisikii mgonjwa.

English: It is advisable to wear a cloth face cover when going out in Public.
Kiswahili: Inashauriwa kuvaa kitambaa cha kufunika uso unapotoka nje hadharani.

English: Clean and disinfect surfaces Clean and disinfect frequently touched surfaces daily.
Kiswahili: Safisha na safisha nyuso Safisha na safisha nyuso zinazoguswa mara kwa mara kila siku.

English: This includes tables, doorknobs, light switches, countertops, handles, desks, phones, keyboards, toilets, faucets, and sinks.
Kiswahili: Hii inajumuisha meza, vitasa vya milango, swichi za taa, kaunta, vipini, dawati, simu, kibodi, vyoo, mifereji ya maji, na sinki.

English: If surfaces are dirty, clean them: Use detergent or soap and water prior to disinfection.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa nyuso ni chafu, zisafishe: Tumia sabuni au sabuni na maji kabla ya kuua vijidudu.

English: Steps to Follow - Self Quarantine/ Isolation: If you suspect you have been exposed to COVID-19 separate yourself for 14 days to monitor if the develop symptoms.
Kiswahili: Hatua za Kufuata - Kujitenga/ Kujitenga: Ikiwa unashuku kuwa umeambukizwa COVID-19 jitenge kwa siku 14 ili kufuatilia ikiwa dalili zinaanza kuonekana.

English: However, if your develop any emergency warning signs contact the Ministry of Health through its Emergency Contacts - Wear a cloth covering/ mask over your nose and mouth.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, ikiwa utapata dalili zozote za tahadhari ya dharura wasiliana na Wizara ya Afya kupitia Mawasiliano yake ya Dharura - Vaa kitambaa/barakoa juu ya pua na mdomo wako.

English: Prevent the spread of germs when caring for someone who is sick - Have the person stay in one room, away from other people, including yourself, as much as possible.
Kiswahili: Zuia kuenea kwa vijidudu unapomtunza mtu mgonjwa - Mwambie mtu huyo akae katika chumba kimoja, mbali na watu wengine, ikiwa ni pamoja na wewe mwenyewe, kadri iwezekanavyo.

English: Wash your hands immediately after removing gloves.
Kiswahili: Osha mikono yako mara baada ya kuondoa glavu.

English: Provide symptom treatment - Make sure the sick person drinks a lot of fluids to stay hydrated and rests at home.
Kiswahili: Toa matibabu ya dalili - Hakikisha mgonjwa anakunywa maji mengi ili apate maji na kupumzika nyumbani.

English: When to end home isolation (staying home) - People with COVID-19 who have stayed home (are home isolated) can stop home isolation under the following conditions: - If they will not have a test to determine if they are still contagious, they can leave home after these three things have happened: - They have had no fever for at least 72 hours (that is three full days of no fever without the use medicine that reduces fevers) AND - other symptoms have improved (for example, when their cough or shortness of breath have improved) AND - at least 7 days have passed since their symptoms first appeared - They have had no fever for at least 72 hours (that is three full days of no fever without the use medicine that reduces fevers) - If they will be tested to determine if they are still contagious, they can leave home after these three things have happened: - They no longer have a fever (without the use medicine that reduces fevers) AND - other symptoms have improved (for example, when their cough or shortness of breath have improved) AND - They received two negative tests in a row, 24 hours apart.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa kukomesha kutengwa nyumbani (kukaa nyumbani) - Watu wenye COVID-19 ambao wamekaa nyumbani (wametengwa nyumbani) wanaweza kuacha kutengwa nyumbani chini ya hali zifuatazo: - Ikiwa hawatafanyiwa kipimo cha kubaini kama bado wanaambukiza, wanaweza kuondoka nyumbani baada ya mambo haya matatu kutokea: - Hawajapata homa kwa angalau saa 72 (yaani siku tatu kamili za kutopata homa bila kutumia dawa inayopunguza homa) NA - dalili zingine zimeboreka (kwa mfano, wakati kikohozi au upungufu wa pumzi umeboreka) NA - angalau siku 7 zimepita tangu dalili zao zionekane kwa mara ya kwanza - Hawajapata homa kwa angalau saa 72 (yaani siku tatu kamili za kutopata homa bila kutumia dawa inayopunguza homa) - Ikiwa watapimwa ili kubaini kama bado wanaambukiza, wanaweza kuondoka nyumbani baada ya mambo haya matatu kutokea: - Hawajapata homa tena (bila kutumia dawa inayopunguza homa) NA - dalili zingine zimeboreka (kwa mfano, wakati kikohozi au upungufu wa pumzi umeboreka) NA - Walipata vipimo viwili hasi mfululizo, saa 24 tofauti.

English: One Health Program About One Health Program The One Health approach is looking at the interaction and linkages between human, animal and environmental health in order to address diseases particularly the one that are spread from animals to humans.
Kiswahili: Programu ya Afya Moja Kuhusu Programu ya Afya Moja Mbinu ya Afya Moja inaangalia mwingiliano na uhusiano kati ya afya ya binadamu, wanyama na mazingira ili kushughulikia magonjwa hasa yale yanayosambazwa kutoka kwa wanyama hadi kwa binadamu.

English: One of the major focus in this area is Anti-Microbial Resistance commonly referred to as AMR.
Kiswahili: Mojawapo ya mambo muhimu katika eneo hili ni Upinzani wa Kupambana na Vijidudu unaojulikana kama AMR.

English: In this area, KEMRI is working together with the government and the animal sector to understand the impact of microbial resistance in animals and its risk factors in humans.
Kiswahili: Katika eneo hili, KEMRI inafanya kazi pamoja na serikali na sekta ya wanyama ili kuelewa athari za upinzani wa vijidudu kwa wanyama na vipengele vyake vya hatari kwa wanadamu.

English: The goal of One Health approach is to ensure that the country is responding to these concerns.
Kiswahili: Lengo la mbinu ya One Health ni kuhakikisha kwamba nchi inajibu masuala haya.

English: Speaking during the event, Amref Health Africa in Kenya Country Director, Dr Meshack Ndirangu expressed his appreciation to the County Government of Kajiado for allowing the CHU4UHC project to support them in improving community health services and assured of continued support in project implementation.
Kiswahili: Akizungumza wakati wa hafla hiyo, Mkurugenzi Mkazi wa Amref Health Africa nchini Kenya, Dkt. Meshack Ndirangu alitoa shukrani zake kwa Serikali ya Kaunti ya Kajiado kwa kuruhusu mradi wa CHU4UHC kuwaunga mkono katika kuboresha huduma za afya ya jamii na kuhakikishiwa kuendelea kuungwa mkono katika utekelezaji wa mradi.

English: ‘‘I congratulate Kajiado County for being the fifth County in Kenya to enact the Community Health Services Bill.
Kiswahili: ‘‘Ninaipongeza Kaunti ya Kajiado kwa kuwa Kaunti ya tano nchini Kenya kutunga Sheria ya Huduma za Afya ya Jamii.

English: Amref will continue to offer support to the focus counties under the CHU4UHC platform, to build a motivated, skilled, equitably distributed community health workforce by working with the Government to certify a minimum of 28,000 Community Health Volunteers and train 150 Community Health Assistants’ he stated.
Kiswahili: Amref itaendelea kutoa usaidizi kwa kaunti zinazolengwa chini ya jukwaa la CHU4UHC, ili kujenga nguvu kazi ya afya ya jamii yenye motisha, ujuzi, na mgawanyo sawa kwa kufanya kazi na Serikali ili kuidhinisha angalau Wajitolea wa Afya ya Jamii 28,000 na kuwafunza Wasaidizi wa Afya ya Jamii 150 alisema.

English: “Amref will continue to offer support to the focus counties under the CHU4UHC platform, to build a motivated, skilled, equitably distributed community health workforce by working with the Government to certify a minimum of 28,000 Community Health Volunteers and train 150 Community Health Assistants”.
Kiswahili: "Amref itaendelea kutoa usaidizi kwa kaunti zinazolengwa chini ya jukwaa la CHU4UHC, ili kujenga nguvu kazi ya afya ya jamii yenye motisha, ujuzi, na mgawanyo sawa kwa kufanya kazi na Serikali ili kuidhinisha angalau Wajitolea wa Afya ya Jamii 28,000 na kuwafunza Wasaidizi wa Afya ya Jamii 150".

English: – Dr Meshack Ndirangu, Amref Health Africa in Kenya, Country Director Other documents launched during the event are the Kenya Community Health Digitisation Strategy 2020-25 and the Kenya Community Health Digital Landscape Assessment Report, which will guide the rollout of the country’s community health information system.
Kiswahili: – Dkt. Meshack Ndirangu, Amref Health Africa nchini Kenya, Mkurugenzi wa Nchi Nyaraka zingine zilizozinduliwa wakati wa tukio hilo ni Mkakati wa Uwekaji wa Kidijitali wa Afya ya Jamii wa Kenya 2020-25 na Ripoti ya Tathmini ya Mazingira ya Kidijitali ya Afya ya Jamii ya Kenya, ambayo itaongoza utekelezaji wa mfumo wa taarifa za afya ya jamii nchini.

English: ‘‘The fact that these documents are being launched at the community health unit level goes a long way to show the integral role that the community members play when it comes to achieving UHC.
Kiswahili: ‘‘Ukweli kwamba hati hizi zinazinduliwa katika ngazi ya kitengo cha afya ya jamii unasaidia sana kuonyesha jukumu muhimu ambalo wanajamii wanacheza linapokuja suala la kufikia UHC.

English: The health model outlined in this strategy will strengthen individuals, households, and eventually communities.
Kiswahili: Mfumo wa afya ulioainishwa katika mkakati huu utaimarisha watu binafsi, kaya, na hatimaye jamii.

English: This is the only way that Kenya will achieve UHC’’ shared Dr Waqo Ejersa, the National Ministry of Health representative.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo njia pekee ambayo Kenya itafikia UHC’’ alishiriki Dkt. Waqo Ejersa, mwakilishi wa Wizara ya Kitaifa ya Afya.

English: Mr Anthony Gitau, Johnson and Johnson Foundation’s Director Global Community Impact Sub-Sahara Africa urged all the platform’s partners to join efforts to ensure that every Kenyan reaps the benefits of Universal Health Coverage.
Kiswahili: Bw. Anthony Gitau, Mkurugenzi wa Wakfu wa Johnson and Johnson wa Global Community Impact Sub-Sahara Africa aliwasihi washirika wote wa jukwaa hilo kujiunga na juhudi ili kuhakikisha kwamba kila Mkenya anavuna faida za Bima ya Afya kwa Wote.

English: ‘I would like to take this moment to appreciate all the Community Health Volunteers (CHVs), Community Health Assistants (CHAs), and partners of the CHU4UHC platform who are represented here today.
Kiswahili: ‘Ningependa kuchukua muda huu kuwashukuru Wajitolea wote wa Afya ya Jamii (CHVs), Wasaidizi wa Afya ya Jamii (CHAs), na washirika wa jukwaa la CHU4UHC ambao wanawakilishwa hapa leo.

English: I am positive that together we will achieve equal health for all, he added.
Kiswahili: Nina uhakika kwamba kwa pamoja tutafikia afya sawa kwa wote, aliongeza.

English: He applauded the CHVs and CHAs present for their relentless support in stopping the spread of COVID-19 and shared Kajiado’s commitment to not only ‘allocate more resources to pay monthly stipends to the CHVs but also build the capacity of individuals and households in order to provide community health services as outlined in the Constitution of Kenya, 2010.
Kiswahili: Aliwapongeza CHV na CHA waliokuwepo kwa msaada wao usiokoma katika kuzuia kuenea kwa COVID-19 na akashiriki ahadi ya Kajiado ya 'kutenga rasilimali zaidi ili kulipa posho za kila mwezi kwa CHV lakini pia kujenga uwezo wa watu binafsi na kaya ili kutoa huduma za afya ya jamii kama ilivyoainishwa katika Katiba ya Kenya, 2010.

English: The Kenya Community Health strategy was formulated by consulting different players in the community health space after the evaluation of the previous strategy.
Kiswahili: Mkakati wa Afya ya Jamii wa Kenya uliundwa kwa kushauriana na wadau mbalimbali katika sekta ya afya ya jamii baada ya tathmini ya mkakati uliopita.

English: The strategy underwent various discussions by the national government, counties, workforce, and partners.
Kiswahili: Mkakati huo ulipitia mijadala mbalimbali na serikali ya kitaifa, kaunti, wafanyakazi, na washirika.

English: Other areas in which Amref Health Africa in Kenya will offer support to actualise the strategy include: strengthening legal frameworks and legislation to support the delivery of community health services at national and county levels, increasing sustainable financing for community health, strengthening the delivery of integrated comprehensive and high-quality community health services, and investing in information management systems to increase availability, quality, demand and utilisation of data.
Kiswahili: Maeneo mengine ambayo Amref Health Africa nchini Kenya itatoa msaada ili kutekeleza mkakati huu ni pamoja na: kuimarisha mifumo ya kisheria na sheria ili kusaidia utoaji wa huduma za afya ya jamii katika ngazi za kitaifa na kaunti, kuongeza ufadhili endelevu kwa afya ya jamii, kuimarisha utoaji wa huduma jumuishi za afya ya jamii zenye ubora wa juu na jumuishi, na kuwekeza katika mifumo ya usimamizi wa taarifa ili kuongeza upatikanaji, ubora, mahitaji na matumizi ya data.

English: Amref Health Africa teams up with African communities to create lasting health change.
Kiswahili: Amref Health Africa inashirikiana na jamii za Kiafrika ili kuleta mabadiliko ya kudumu ya kiafya.

English: Vaccines are among the most effective public health tools, preventing serious illnesses, disabilities, and deaths in … Kenya News about Amref Health Africa in Kenya.
Kiswahili: Chanjo ni miongoni mwa zana bora zaidi za afya ya umma, kuzuia magonjwa makubwa, ulemavu, na vifo nchini … Habari za Kenya kuhusu Amref Health Africa nchini Kenya.

English: Healthy food supports healthy people.” For many people, organic waste is … - When the fire broke out at Utumishi Girls School, it changed lives in an instant.

English: At Amref Health Africa in Kenya, we believe that sustainable change happens when we work together.
Kiswahili: Katika Amref Health Africa nchini Kenya, tunaamini kwamba mabadiliko endelevu hutokea tunapofanya kazi pamoja.

English: Whether you’re a government institution, corporate organisation, philanthropic foundation, research partner, or community group, there’s a role for you in building healthier, more resilient communities.
Kiswahili: Iwe wewe ni taasisi ya serikali, shirika la makampuni, taasisi ya uhisani, mshirika wa utafiti, au kikundi cha jamii, kuna jukumu lako katika kujenga jamii zenye afya na ustahimilivu zaidi.

English: Join us in advancing locally led solutions, driving innovation, and delivering impact where it matters most.
Kiswahili: Jiunge nasi katika kuendeleza suluhisho zinazoongozwa na wenyeji, kuendesha uvumbuzi, na kutoa athari pale inapohitajika zaidi.

English: Let’s build a future where no one is left behind.
Kiswahili: Tujenge mustakabali ambapo hakuna mtu atakayeachwa nyuma.

English: The Annual Learning Forum is Amref Health Africa in Kenya’s flagship platform for institutional learning and knowledge exchange.
Kiswahili: Jukwaa la Mwaka la Kujifunza ni jukwaa kuu la Amref Health Africa nchini Kenya la ujifunzaji wa kitaasisi na ubadilishanaji wa maarifa.

English: It brings together programmes, projects, and support functions to reflect on lessons, innovations, and opportunities shaping Kenya’s health landscape.
Kiswahili: Inakusanya pamoja programu, miradi, na kazi za usaidizi ili kutafakari masomo, uvumbuzi, na fursa zinazounda mazingira ya afya ya Kenya.

English: Held under the theme “From Insight to Impact,” the Forum provided a dynamic space to translate evidence and field experience into actionable strategies that strengthen health systems at both national and county levels.
Kiswahili: Jukwaa hilo lililofanyika chini ya mada "Kutoka kwa Ufahamu hadi Athari," lilitoa nafasi inayobadilika ya kutafsiri ushahidi na uzoefu wa shambani kuwa mikakati inayoweza kutekelezwa ambayo inaimarisha mifumo ya afya katika ngazi za kitaifa na kaunti.

English: Each year, the Forum brings together stakeholders from across Amref’s various programmes, including Family and Reproductive Health (FRH), Disease Control, Prevention, and Management (DCPM), and Population, Health, and Environment.
Kiswahili: Kila mwaka, Jukwaa hili huleta pamoja wadau kutoka katika programu mbalimbali za Amref, ikiwa ni pamoja na Afya ya Familia na Uzazi (FRH), Kudhibiti, Kuzuia, na Kudhibiti Magonjwa (DCPM), na Idadi ya Watu, Afya, na Mazingira.

English: (PHE), as well as key support functions such as Communications, Monitoring and Evaluation, Strategic Partnerships, Finance, Transport, Procurement, and ICT.
Kiswahili: (PHE), pamoja na kazi muhimu za usaidizi kama vile Mawasiliano, Ufuatiliaji na Tathmini, Ushirikiano wa Kimkakati, Fedha, Uchukuzi, Ununuzi, na TEHAMA.

English: Through high-level dialogues, case studies, and interactive learning sessions, participants examine what succeeds, what needs to change, and how collective efforts can speed up progress towards universal health coverage.
Kiswahili: Kupitia mazungumzo ya kiwango cha juu, tafiti za kesi, na vipindi shirikishi vya kujifunza, washiriki huchunguza kinachofanikiwa, kinachohitaji kubadilika, na jinsi juhudi za pamoja zinavyoweza kuharakisha maendeleo kuelekea huduma ya afya kwa wote.

English: Voices from various sessions offered powerful insights on resilience, innovation, and accountability, reinforcing Amref’s dedication to a people-centred, system-driven approach to health.
Kiswahili: Sauti kutoka vikao mbalimbali zilitoa maarifa yenye nguvu kuhusu ustahimilivu, uvumbuzi, na uwajibikaji, na hivyo kuimarisha kujitolea kwa Amref kwa mbinu ya afya inayozingatia watu na inayoendeshwa na mfumo.

English: Community Health Worker Demystifies the COVID-19 Vaccines Friday, 12 November, 2021 As COVID-19 continues to spread, Community Health Workers (CHWs) in Kenya are playing a pivotal role in educating communities on disease prevention and monitoring contacts and those under home-based Care.
Kiswahili: Mfanyakazi wa Afya ya Jamii Afichua Chanjo za COVID-19 Ijumaa, Novemba 12, 2021 Huku COVID-19 ikiendelea kuenea, Wafanyakazi wa Afya ya Jamii (CHWs) nchini Kenya wana jukumu muhimu katika kuelimisha jamii kuhusu kuzuia magonjwa na kufuatilia watu waliowasiliana nao na wale walio chini ya Huduma ya Nyumbani.

English: The rollout of COVID-19 vaccines presents another task for CHWs.
Kiswahili: Utoaji wa chanjo za COVID-19 unawasilisha jukumu lingine kwa wahudumu wa afya wa jamii (CHWs).

English: They have doubled their efforts to fight myths and misconceptions that spread like wildfire in communities.
Kiswahili: Wameongeza juhudi zao maradufu kupambana na hadithi potofu na dhana potofu zinazoenea kama moto wa nyikani katika jamii.

English: The communities have been exposed to false, inaccurate, or misleading information about the vaccines, hence, leading to slow uptake.
Kiswahili: Jamii zimeathiriwa na taarifa za uongo, zisizo sahihi, au za kupotosha kuhusu chanjo, hivyo kusababisha unywaji polepole wa chanjo.

English: In the southern part of Nyanza, along the shores of Lake Victoria – Africa’s largest Freshwater Lake – meet Millicent Anyango, a Community Health Worker (CHW) leading the Arudho Community Unit.
Kiswahili: Katika sehemu ya kusini ya Nyanza, kando ya mwambao wa Ziwa Victoria - Ziwa kubwa zaidi la Maji Safi barani Afrika - hukutana na Millicent Anyango, Mfanyakazi wa Afya ya Jamii (CHW) anayeongoza Kitengo cha Jumuiya ya Arudho.

English: She has been at the forefront in the fight against the virus by creating awareness on the vaccines to a total of 225 households.
Kiswahili: Amekuwa mstari wa mbele katika mapambano dhidi ya virusi hivyo kwa kutoa uelewa kuhusu chanjo kwa jumla ya kaya 225.

English: Millicent and other CHWs in her area have taken on the responsibility of informing the community on the process and benefits of vaccination.
Kiswahili: Millicent na wahudumu wengine wa afya ya jamii katika eneo lake wamechukua jukumu la kuifahamisha jamii kuhusu mchakato na faida za chanjo.

English: Despite such ongoing awareness efforts, there are people who still remain hesitant for various reasons.
Kiswahili: Licha ya juhudi hizo zinazoendelea za uhamasishaji, kuna watu ambao bado wanasitasita kwa sababu mbalimbali.

English: According to Millicent, lack of knowledge, and negative perceptions on the vaccines largely contribute to vaccine hesitancy and low uptake of vaccination services.
Kiswahili: Kulingana na Millicent, ukosefu wa maarifa, na mitazamo hasi kuhusu chanjo kwa kiasi kikubwa huchangia kusitasita kwa chanjo na utumiaji mdogo wa huduma za chanjo.

English: “Many people are concerned about possible side-effects or reactions to the vaccines such as infertility and blood clots,” she says.
Kiswahili: "Watu wengi wana wasiwasi kuhusu madhara au athari zinazowezekana kwa chanjo kama vile utasa na kuganda kwa damu," anasema.

English: “Others complain about the inaccessibility of the sites, decrying lack of transport to the vaccination sites.” Every day, Millicent worries about high levels of vaccine hesitancy among her community.
Kiswahili: "Wengine wanalalamika kuhusu kutofikika kwa maeneo hayo, wakilalamikia ukosefu wa usafiri wa kwenda kwenye maeneo ya chanjo." Kila siku, Millicent ana wasiwasi kuhusu viwango vya juu vya kusitasita kwa chanjo miongoni mwa jamii yake.

English: However, together with other CHWs, she remains committed to ensuring that each member of her community is immunized and protected.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, pamoja na wahudumu wengine wa afya ya jamii (CHWs), bado amejitolea kuhakikisha kwamba kila mwanajamii wake anapata chanjo na ulinzi.

English: “I am fully vaccinated and serve as a good example,” she says.
Kiswahili: "Nimechanjwa kikamilifu na ni mfano mzuri," anasema.

English: With little knowledge about COVID-19, Millicent initially did not have the confidence to address her community’s information needs.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa na ufahamu mdogo kuhusu COVID-19, Millicent mwanzoni hakuwa na ujasiri wa kushughulikia mahitaji ya habari ya jamii yake.

English: However, through training by Amref Health Africa in Kenya, she is fully empowered to promote vaccine awareness.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, kupitia mafunzo kutoka Amref Health Africa nchini Kenya, amewezeshwa kikamilifu kukuza uelewa wa chanjo.

English: With the financial support of the Government of Canada through Global Affairs Canada, over 17,095 CHWs in Kenya have been trained on COVID-19 prevention, management, and control, including key messages on vaccination.
Kiswahili: Kwa usaidizi wa kifedha wa Serikali ya Kanada kupitia Global Affairs Canada, zaidi ya wahudumu wa afya wa jamii 17,095 nchini Kenya wamefunzwa kuhusu kinga, usimamizi, na udhibiti wa COVID-19, ikiwa ni pamoja na jumbe muhimu kuhusu chanjo.

English: “Convincing people to take the vaccine is an uphill task, but there is significant progress – we are almost reaching the desired destination.
Kiswahili: "Kuwashawishi watu kutumia chanjo ni kazi ngumu, lakini kuna maendeleo makubwa - karibu tunafikia lengo tunalotaka."

English: I will not give up until all my community members are vaccinated,” Millicent confidently says.
Kiswahili: Sitakata tamaa hadi wanajamii wangu wote watakapochanjwa,” Millicent anasema kwa kujiamini.

English: “I urge all leaders to ensure we have enough vaccine supplies at the facilities so that our work does not go in vain.” Ends Story by Maureen Cherongis, Communications Officer, External Relations at Amref Health Africa
Kiswahili: "Ninawasihi viongozi wote kuhakikisha tuna vifaa vya kutosha vya chanjo katika vituo ili kazi yetu isiende bure." Mwisho wa Hadithi na Maureen Cherongis, Afisa Mawasiliano, Mahusiano ya Nje katika Amref Health Africa

English: Talking Book Changing the Face of Health Seeking Behaviour among Kenyan Pastoralist Communities Friday, 15 November, 2019 While social and cultural norms are the backbone of any behaviour in communities, lack of knowledge and information is one of the key barriers to access and utilisation of health services.
Kiswahili: Kitabu cha Mazungumzo Kinachobadilisha Uso wa Afya Kutafuta Tabia Miongoni mwa Jamii za Wafugaji Kenya Ijumaa, 15 Novemba, 2019 Ingawa kanuni za kijamii na kitamaduni ndizo uti wa mgongo wa tabia yoyote katika jamii, ukosefu wa maarifa na taarifa ni mojawapo ya vikwazo muhimu vya upatikanaji na utumiaji wa huduma za afya.

English: When working on effective social and behaviour change messaging for nomadic pastoral communities, it is necessary to take into account that these are groups largely burdened by: - Low literacy levels – only 18.1% and 28.9% of the residents of Turkana and Samburu respectively can read and write; well below the national average of 66.4% [KIHBS 2015].
Kiswahili: Wakati wa kufanya kazi katika ujumizi mzuri wa mabadiliko ya kijamii na tabia kwa jamii za wafugaji wahamaji, ni muhimu kuzingatia kwamba haya ni makundi yanayolemewa kwa kiasi kikubwa na: - Viwango vya chini vya kusoma na kuandika - ni 18.1% na 28.9% tu ya wakazi wa Turkana na Samburu mtawalia wanaoweza kusoma na kuandika; chini ya wastani wa kitaifa wa 66.4% [KIHBS 2015].

English: increase equitable access and utilisation of family planning, reproductive, maternal, new-born, child and adolescent health; nutrition; water, hygiene and sanitation services) included the use of technological innovations like the digisomo talking book.
Kiswahili: (Kuongeza upatikanaji na matumizi sawa ya uzazi wa mpango, uzazi, uzazi, mama, watoto wachanga, afya ya mtoto na kijana; lishe; huduma za maji, usafi na usafi wa mazingira) ilijumuisha matumizi ya uvumbuzi wa kiteknolojia kama vile kitabu cha mazungumzo cha digisomo.

English: Components of Digisomo With the support of USAID through the Afya Timiza project, Amref Health Africa has so far loaded 34 radio dramas in Nga’turkana and Samburu local languages covering the above thematic areas into 348 talking books.
Kiswahili: Vipengele vya Digiso Kwa usaidizi wa USAID kupitia mradi wa Afya Timiza, Amref Health Africa hadi sasa imepakia tamthilia 34 za redio katika lugha za wenyeji za Nga’turkana na Samburu zinazoshughulikia maeneo ya mada yaliyo hapo juu katika vitabu 348 vya kuongea.

English: The talking books are distributed to community health volunteers, who use them to disseminate messages in households, peer group meetings including mother support groups and father support groups.
Kiswahili: Vitabu vya mazungumzo vinasambazwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii, ambao huvitumia kusambaza ujumbe katika kaya, mikutano ya vikundi rika ikijumuisha vikundi vya usaidizi wa mama na vikundi vya usaidizi wa baba.

English: To date, a total of 46,365 beneficiaries have accessed social behaviour change messages via the talking book.
Kiswahili: Hadi sasa, jumla ya wanufaika 46,365 wameweza kupata jumbe za mabadiliko ya tabia za kijamii kupitia kitabu cha mazungumzo.

English: Benefits of the Digisomo Talking Book - This is a specially designed audio computer for passing audio messages to low literate audiences in remote or hard to reach areas.
Kiswahili: Faida za Kitabu cha Kuzungumza cha Digisomo - Hii ni kompyuta ya sauti iliyoundwa mahususi kwa ajili ya kupitisha ujumbe wa sauti kwa hadhira ya chini ya kusoma na kuandika katika maeneo ya mbali au magumu kufikiwa.

English: Kenya Health Forum 2019: Partnering for Universal Health Coverage Tuesday, 20 August, 2019 Amref Health Africa in Kenya and other health stakeholders were ably represented at the 2019 Kenya Health Forum convened by the Ministry of Health on 14 and 15 August.
Kiswahili: Jukwaa la Afya la Kenya 2019: Kushirikiana kwa Bima ya Afya kwa Wote Jumanne, Agosti 20, 2019 Amref Health Africa nchini Kenya na wadau wengine wa afya waliwakilishwa vyema katika Jukwaa la Afya la Kenya la 2019 lililoitishwa na Wizara ya Afya mnamo tarehe 14 na 15 Agosti.

English: Held against the backdrop of a series of conversations and processes of national dialogue on Universal Health Coverage and under the theme ‘Partnering for UHC: Delivering affordable quality healthcare for all,’ the two-day forum brought together stakeholders who included national and county governments, development partners, private sector and other non-state actors to discuss how Kenya can deliver affordable quality health care and achieve UHC.
Kiswahili: Uliofanyika dhidi ya muktadha wa mazungumzo na michakato ya mazungumzo ya kitaifa kuhusu Ufikiaji wa Afya kwa Wote na chini ya mada ‘Kushirikiana kwa UHC: Kutoa huduma ya afya bora kwa bei nafuu kwa wote,’ kongamano hilo la siku mbili liliwakutanisha wadau waliojumuisha serikali za kitaifa na za kaunti, washirika wa maendeleo, sekta binafsi na watendaji wengine wasio wa serikali ili kujadili jinsi Kenya inavyoweza kutoa huduma ya afya bora kwa bei nafuu na kufikia UHC.

English: One of four goals outlined in President Uhuru Kenyatta’s Big 4 Agenda, the universal health coverage goal seeks to provide affordable health care for all.
Kiswahili: Mojawapo ya malengo manne yaliyoainishwa katika Ajenda Nne Kubwa ya Rais Uhuru Kenyatta, lengo la bima ya afya kwa wote linalenga kutoa huduma ya afya ya bei nafuu kwa wote.

English: For UHC to be achieved there is need for equitable health access and improved quality of health services.
Kiswahili: Ili UHC ifikiwe, kuna haja ya upatikanaji sawa wa afya na ubora ulioboreshwa wa huduma za afya.

English: “Universal Health Coverage means much more than health care.
Kiswahili: "Bima ya Afya kwa Wote ina maana zaidi ya huduma ya afya."

English: It means ensuring that all Kenyans can get quality health services, where and when they need them, without suffering financial hardship,” said Health Cabinet Secretary Mrs Sicily Kariuki.
Kiswahili: Inamaanisha kuhakikisha kwamba Wakenya wote wanaweza kupata huduma bora za afya, popote na wakati wanapozihitaji, bila kupata shida za kifedha,” alisema Waziri wa Afya Bi. Sicily Kariuki.

English: Setting the tone for the 2019 forum, Chairperson of the Development Partners in Health Kenya (DPHK) Ms Tessa Matholie said, “Universal Health Coverage is a once in a lifetime opportunity thanks to the big four agenda.
Kiswahili: Akiweka msingi wa jukwaa la 2019, Mwenyekiti wa Washirika wa Maendeleo katika Afya Kenya (DPHK) Bi. Tessa Matholie alisema, “Utoaji wa Huduma za Afya kwa Wote ni fursa ya mara moja tu maishani kutokana na ajenda kuu nne.

English: Therefore Kenya needs to transform the way things are done in order to achieve UHC.” Under the Bill of Rights in Kenya’s Constitution, citizens are entitled to the fundamental right to the highest attainable standards of health and the UHC agenda seeks to deliver on this right.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo Kenya inahitaji kubadilisha jinsi mambo yanavyofanyika ili kufikia UHC.” Chini ya Sheria ya Haki katika Katiba ya Kenya, raia wana haki ya haki ya msingi ya viwango vya juu zaidi vya afya vinavyoweza kufikiwa na ajenda ya UHC inatafuta kutekeleza haki hii.

English: It is also in line with Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 3.8 “achieve universal health coverage, the Astana Declaration on Primary Health Care (PHC) 2018 that aims at ensuring a people- centred care that offers universal access, social equity and financial protection with a PHC-led approach among other global commitments on health.
Kiswahili: Pia inaendana na Lengo la Maendeleo Endelevu (SDG) 3.8 “kufikia huduma ya afya kwa wote, Azimio la Astana kuhusu Huduma ya Afya ya Msingi (PHC) la 2018 ambalo linalenga kuhakikisha huduma inayozingatia watu ambayo inatoa ufikiaji wa wote, usawa wa kijamii na ulinzi wa kifedha kwa njia inayoongozwa na PHC miongoni mwa ahadi zingine za kimataifa kuhusu afya.

English: “The constitutional architecture of our country demands of us to cultivate and nurture formidable cooperation and partnership between two levels of Government.
Kiswahili: "Usanifu wa kikatiba wa nchi yetu unatutaka kukuza na kukuza ushirikiano na ushirikiano mkubwa kati ya ngazi mbili za Serikali."

English: Both national and county governments have defined roles that are critical and symbiotic in the delivery of health services.
Kiswahili: Serikali za kitaifa na za kaunti zote zina majukumu yaliyofafanuliwa ambayo ni muhimu na ya kutegemeana katika utoaji wa huduma za afya.

English: For Universal Health Coverage to succeed in Kenya, we must make investments in all health building blocks.
Kiswahili: Ili Bima ya Afya kwa Wote ifanikiwe nchini Kenya, ni lazima tuwekeze katika vipengele vyote vya ujenzi wa afya.

English: Key amongst them Human Resources and Health products and technologies,” added the CS.
Kiswahili: Miongoni mwao ni bidhaa na teknolojia muhimu za Rasilimali Watu na Afya,” aliongeza Waziri huyo.

English: Globally, given the diverse socio-political and cultural contexts and capacities, there is no standard formula for UHC.
Kiswahili: Duniani kote, kutokana na miktadha na uwezo mbalimbali wa kijamii na kisiasa na kitamaduni, hakuna fomula sanifu ya UHC.

English: However, many countries are taking actions to accelerate progress towards UHC, or to maintain their gains.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, nchi nyingi zinachukua hatua za kuharakisha maendeleo kuelekea UHC, au kudumisha mafanikio yao.

English: Even in countries where health services have traditionally been accessible and affordable, governments need to constantly strive to respond to the ever-growing health needs of their populations and other threats, including developing financial sustainability to endure economic shocks.
Kiswahili: Hata katika nchi ambazo huduma za afya zimekuwa zikipatikana kwa urahisi na kwa bei nafuu, serikali zinahitaji kujitahidi kila mara kujibu mahitaji ya kiafya yanayoongezeka ya idadi ya watu wao na vitisho vingine, ikiwa ni pamoja na kuendeleza uendelevu wa kifedha ili kuvumilia mshtuko wa kiuchumi.

English: These are: cross-sector collaboration for one country-driven platform, evidence-based measurable data collection and expanding areas of results application.
Kiswahili: Hizi ni: ushirikiano wa sekta mtambuka kwa jukwaa moja linaloendeshwa na nchi, ukusanyaji wa data unaopimika unaotegemea ushahidi na maeneo yanayopanuka ya matumizi ya matokeo.

English: Korea is implementing the concept of ‘Effective Coverage’ that aims to close the gap in health especially for people who need the services.
Kiswahili: Korea inatekeleza dhana ya 'Ulinzi Bora' ambayo inalenga kuziba pengo katika afya hasa kwa watu wanaohitaji huduma hizo.

English: Over the two days, discussions and feedback among the health stakeholders resulted into a number of key resolutions on issues in health service delivery.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hizo mbili, majadiliano na maoni miongoni mwa wadau wa afya yalisababisha maazimio kadhaa muhimu kuhusu masuala ya utoaji wa huduma za afya.

English: Amref Health Africa was represented at the Health Forum by Group Chief Executive Officer Dr Githinji Gitahi, Amref Health Africa in Kenya Country Director Dr Meshack Ndirangu, Health Systems Strengthening Programme Director Dr Elizabeth Wala and Afya Timiza Chief of Party Gilbert Wangalwa.
Kiswahili: Amref Health Africa iliwakilishwa katika Kongamano la Afya na Afisa Mkuu Mtendaji wa Kundi Dkt Githinji Gitahi, Mkurugenzi wa Amref Health Africa nchini Kenya Dkt Meshack Ndirangu, Mkurugenzi wa Mpango wa Uimarishaji wa Mifumo ya Afya Dkt Elizabeth Wala na Mkuu wa Afya Timiza Mkuu wa Chama Gilbert Wangalwa.

English: Unusual Partnerships: Rangers and Scouts at the Frontline of Improving Maternal and Child Health Friday, 15 November, 2019 “When a woman dies during pregnancy or child birth, it is considered a bad omen and the community does not support any burial rights or conversations regarding the death.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano Usio wa Kawaida: Askari na Skauti Wako Mstari wa Mbele wa Kuboresha Afya ya Mama na Mtoto Ijumaa, 15 Novemba, 2019 "Mwanamke anapofariki wakati wa ujauzito au kujifungua, inachukuliwa kuwa ishara mbaya na jamii haiungi mkono haki zozote za mazishi au mazungumzo kuhusu kifo hicho."

English: It is also believed that a woman who loses her child during pregnancy or child birth is weak and an object of bad luck,” explains Josephine Lenasaya, speaking about some of the myths surrounding maternal and infant deaths in Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Pia inaaminika kwamba mwanamke anayepoteza mtoto wake wakati wa ujauzito au kujifungua ni dhaifu na ni kitu cha bahati mbaya,” anaelezea Josephine Lenasaya, akizungumzia baadhi ya hadithi potofu zinazozunguka vifo vya akina mama na watoto wachanga katika Kaunti ya Samburu.

English: Josephine, who works as a radio operator at the Kalama Conservancy, borrows heavily from her day-to-day work as she advocates for family planning, reproductive, maternal, new born, child and adolescent health (FP/RMNCAH) services.
Kiswahili: Josephine, ambaye anafanya kazi kama mwendeshaji wa redio katika Hifadhi ya Kalama, anakopa sana kutokana na kazi yake ya kila siku anapotetea huduma za uzazi wa mpango, uzazi, uzazi, afya ya mama, watoto wachanga, afya ya watoto na vijana (FP/RMNCAH).

English: Her work involves coordinating rescue teams tracking wildlife or poachers in the area.
Kiswahili: Kazi yake inahusisha kuratibu timu za uokoaji zinazofuatilia wanyamapori au majangili katika eneo hilo.

English: The Grévy’s Zebra is one of the exotic zebra species dying in the conservancy.
Kiswahili: Pundamilia aina ya Grévy ni mmoja wa spishi za pundamilia wa kigeni wanaokufa katika hifadhi hiyo.

English: Although rangers in the conservancy are trained to protect all wildlife, flagship species such as the Grévy’s Zebra receive special attention.
Kiswahili: Ingawa walinzi katika hifadhi wamefunzwa kulinda wanyamapori wote, spishi kuu kama vile Grévy's Zebra hupewa kipaumbele maalum.

English: When the Grévy’s Zebra is about to give birth, it seeks shelter in homesteads, away from predators such as the hyena until its colt is strong enough to fend for itself.
Kiswahili: Wakati pundamilia wa Grévy anapokaribia kuzaa, hutafuta kimbilio katika mashamba, mbali na wanyama wanaowinda kama vile fisi hadi punda wake awe na nguvu ya kutosha kujitunza.

English: “This is the example I use when sharing knowledge and information on the importance of mothers accessing and utilising maternal health services.
Kiswahili: "Huu ndio mfano ninaotumia ninaposhiriki maarifa na taarifa kuhusu umuhimu wa akina mama kupata na kutumia huduma za afya ya uzazi."

English: The loibor kurum (Grévy’s Zebra) protects its unborn baby by seeking shelter in the communities’ homes similar to why all pregnant women should seek antenatal, delivery and postnatal services at a health facility,” says Josephine.
Kiswahili: Loibor kurum (Grévy’s Zebra) humlinda mtoto wake ambaye hajazaliwa kwa kutafuta hifadhi katika nyumba za jamii kama vile kwa nini wanawake wote wajawazito wanapaswa kutafuta huduma za ujauzito, kujifungua na baada ya kujifungua katika kituo cha afya,” anasema Josephine.

English: During community gatherings, Josephine and her colleagues explain to men and women that there are health workers trained to diagnose and offer lifesaving treatment to women and their children at the health facility.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa mikusanyiko ya kijamii, Josephine na wenzake huwaeleza wanaume na wanawake kwamba kuna wafanyakazi wa afya waliofunzwa kutambua na kutoa matibabu ya kuokoa maisha kwa wanawake na watoto wao katika kituo cha afya.

English: To demystify the cultural beliefs surrounding maternal and perinatal deaths and miscarriages, the rangers sensitise women on how regular screening during pregnancy can detect and prevent complications such as hypertension and pregnancy diabetes; both of which can dramatically affect the growth and development of the foetus.
Kiswahili: Ili kufafanua imani za kitamaduni zinazozunguka vifo vya mama na mtoto kabla ya kujifungua na kuharibika kwa mimba, walinzi huwahamasisha wanawake jinsi uchunguzi wa mara kwa mara wakati wa ujauzito unavyoweza kugundua na kuzuia matatizo kama vile shinikizo la damu na kisukari cha ujauzito; yote ambayo yanaweza kuathiri pakubwa ukuaji na ukuaji wa mtoto mchanga.

English: Best nutrition and important vitamins There are certain foods that should not be consumed by a pregnant woman including uncooked meat and unpasteurized milk, which contain proteins and enzymes that are dangerous to a developing foetus.
Kiswahili: Lishe bora na vitamini muhimu Kuna vyakula fulani ambavyo havipaswi kuliwa na mwanamke mjamzito ikiwa ni pamoja na nyama isiyopikwa na maziwa ambayo hayajapakwa mafuta, ambayo yana protini na vimeng'enya ambavyo ni hatari kwa mtoto mchanga anayekua.

English: During health sessions with women peer groups, Josephine emphasises on the need for proper cooking of all meats and family consumption of healthy diets including fruits and vegetables.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa vipindi vya afya na vikundi vya wanawake, Josephine anasisitiza hitaji la kupika nyama zote vizuri na kula vyakula vyenye afya kwa familia ikiwemo matunda na mboga.

English: She educates pregnant women about prenatal vitamins which play a big part in the health of their children and the additional key nutrients found in folic acid and pregnancy multivitamins which help support the baby’s development and prevention anaemia.
Kiswahili: Anawaelimisha wanawake wajawazito kuhusu vitamini vya ujauzito ambavyo vina jukumu kubwa katika afya ya watoto wao na virutubisho muhimu vya ziada vinavyopatikana katika asidi ya foliki na vitamini vingi vya ujauzito ambavyo husaidia kusaidia ukuaji na kuzuia upungufu wa damu kwa mtoto.

English: Revitalized lands In many conservancies and much of northern Kenya, poorly planned grazing by domestic livestock has had a devastating impact on the landscape and led to constant migration of the pastoralists in the rangelands in search of water and green pastures.
Kiswahili: Ardhi zilizofufuliwa Katika hifadhi nyingi na sehemu kubwa ya kaskazini mwa Kenya, malisho yasiyopangwa vizuri ya mifugo yamekuwa na athari mbaya katika mandhari na kusababisha uhamiaji wa mara kwa mara wa wafugaji katika maeneo ya malisho wakitafuta maji na malisho ya kijani kibichi.

English: To curb this, rangers have been trained to empower the communities living within conservancies on rangeland management.
Kiswahili: Ili kukabiliana na hili, walinzi wa wanyamapori wamefunzwa kuwawezesha jamii zinazoishi ndani ya hifadhi kuhusu usimamizi wa nyanda za malisho.

English: This includes allowing land to rest for four months without grazing and bunching of livestock (bringing large herds together in one place for limited periods to allow over grazed land to revitalize).
Kiswahili: Hii inajumuisha kuruhusu ardhi kupumzika kwa miezi minne bila malisho na kukusanya mifugo (kukusanya makundi makubwa ya mifugo pamoja mahali pamoja kwa muda mfupi ili kuruhusu ardhi iliyolishwa kupita kiasi kufufua).

English: The nomadic community is characterized by patriarchy that deters women from making independent decisions including when and how many children to give birth to.
Kiswahili: Jumuiya ya wahamaji ina sifa ya mfumo dume unaowazuia wanawake kufanya maamuzi huru ikiwa ni pamoja na lini na idadi ya watoto wa kujifungua.

English: “Allowing land to revitalize over time echoes the recuperation period of a woman’s body after delivery.
Kiswahili: "Kuruhusu ardhi kufufuka baada ya muda kunarudia kipindi cha kupona kwa mwili wa mwanamke baada ya kujifungua."

English: We have been sensitising men on the importance of child spacing despite the cultural belief that women are reproduction vessels.
Kiswahili: Tumekuwa tukiwaelimisha wanaume kuhusu umuhimu wa kuacha nafasi kati ya watoto licha ya imani ya kitamaduni kwamba wanawake ni vyombo vya uzazi.

English: Spacing births at least two years apart has proven to improve birth outcomes and the survival of infants,” opines Joseph Lesooto, a ranger and Chairman of Kalama Conservancy Rangers Committee.
Kiswahili: Kuweka nafasi kati ya kuzaliwa kwa angalau miaka miwili kumethibitika kuboresha matokeo ya kuzaliwa na kuishi kwa watoto wachanga,” anasema Joseph Lesooto, mlinzi na Mwenyekiti wa Kamati ya Walinzi wa Hifadhi ya Kalama.

English: “The same way the pastoralists prioritize the wellbeing of their animals should be the same way they safeguard the health of mothers and children,” Joseph adds.
Kiswahili: "Jinsi wafugaji wanavyoweka kipaumbele ustawi wa wanyama wao ndivyo wanavyopaswa kulinda afya ya mama na watoto," Joseph anaongeza.

English: Josephine and Joseph are among the rangers trained by the USAID funded Afya Timiza project with the aim of increasing access and equitable utilisation of family planning, reproductive, maternal, new born, child and adolescent health (FP/RMNCAH) services for the communities living within conservancies.
Kiswahili: Josephine na Joseph ni miongoni mwa walinzi waliofunzwa na mradi wa Afya Timiza unaofadhiliwa na USAID kwa lengo la kuongeza upatikanaji na matumizi sawa ya huduma za uzazi wa mpango, uzazi, uzazi, afya ya watoto wachanga, watoto na vijana (FP/RMNCAH) kwa jamii zinazoishi ndani ya hifadhi.

English: The project trained a total of 25 rangers and scouts from seven conservancies (Namnyak, Sarara, Kalama, Westaget, Ngilai, Naruon and Lreteti) in Samburu East.
Kiswahili: Mradi huu ulitoa mafunzo kwa jumla ya walinzi na skauti 25 kutoka kwa hifadhi saba (Namnyak, Sarara, Kalama, Westaget, Ngilai, Naruon na Lreteti) huko Samburu Mashariki.

English: To improve health outcomes for communities living within the conservancies in Samburu East, Afya Timiza partnered with the Northern Rangeland Trust through the USAID Partners for Resilience and Economic Growth (PREG) platform.
Kiswahili: Ili kuboresha matokeo ya kiafya kwa jamii zinazoishi ndani ya hifadhi huko Samburu Mashariki, Afya Timiza ilishirikiana na Northern Rangeland Trust kupitia jukwaa la USAID Partners for Resilience and Economic Growth (PREG).

English: The partnership identified rangers and scouts who volunteered to be trained on FP/RMNCAH technical modules and share knowledge and information with the communities.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano huo uliwatambua walinzi na skauti waliojitolea kupata mafunzo kuhusu moduli za kiufundi za FP/RMNCAH na kushiriki maarifa na taarifa na jamii.

English: The rangers were provided with audio and visual tools that contain the health messages to support them in disseminating the information.
Kiswahili: Walinzi walipewa vifaa vya sauti na taswira vyenye jumbe za afya ili kuwasaidia katika kusambaza taarifa hizo.

English: They also offer counselling and referral services.
Kiswahili: Pia hutoa huduma za ushauri nasaha na rufaa.

English: “One of the guiding principles of a ranger is discipline which goes hand-in-hand with the commitment to serve the community.
Kiswahili: "Mojawapo ya kanuni zinazoongoza mlinzi ni nidhamu inayoendana na kujitolea kuitumikia jamii."

English: When on duty, I also act as an intermediary between the community and nearby health facilities for referrals and emergency rescue cases.
Kiswahili: Ninapokuwa kazini, mimi pia hufanya kazi kama mpatanishi kati ya jamii na vituo vya afya vilivyo karibu kwa ajili ya rufaa na visa vya uokoaji wa dharura.

English: In a day’s work I rescue wildlife and save the lives of mothers and children,” concludes Josephine.
Kiswahili: Katika kazi ya siku moja mimi huwaokoa wanyamapori na kuokoa maisha ya akina mama na watoto,” anahitimisha Josephine.

English: Nairobi, Kenya, 12 May 2026 — The United Nations Population Fund, UNFPA, in partnership with the Government of Japan, today launched two new projects aimed at strengthening sexual and reproductive health and rights, preventing and responding to gender-based violence, and empowering women and young people in Kenya.
Kiswahili: Nairobi, Kenya, 12 Mei 2026 — Shirika la Idadi ya Watu la Umoja wa Mataifa, UNFPA, kwa ushirikiano na Serikali ya Japani, leo limezindua miradi miwili mipya inayolenga kuimarisha afya ya ngono na uzazi na haki, kuzuia na kukabiliana na ukatili wa kijinsia, na kuwawezesha wanawake na vijana nchini Kenya.

English: Funded through the Government of Japan’s Supplementary Budget and the Tokyo International Conference on African Development (TICAD) framework, the projects will directly benefit more than 195,000 people in Nairobi, Narok, Turkana, and Garissa counties over the next year.
Kiswahili: Miradi hiyo ikifadhiliwa kupitia Bajeti ya Nyongeza ya Serikali ya Japani na mfumo wa Mkutano wa Kimataifa wa Tokyo kuhusu Maendeleo ya Afrika (TICAD), itawanufaisha moja kwa moja zaidi ya watu 195,000 katika kaunti za Nairobi, Narok, Turkana, na Garissa katika mwaka ujao.

English: The projects will support training for frontline service providers, strengthen accountability and survivor support systems, improve access to menstrual health products, and provide livelihood and economic empowerment opportunities for women and youth, including GBV and FGM survivors.
Kiswahili: Miradi hiyo itasaidia mafunzo kwa watoa huduma walio mstari wa mbele, kuimarisha uwajibikaji na mifumo ya usaidizi kwa walionusurika, kuboresha upatikanaji wa bidhaa za afya ya hedhi, na kutoa fursa za kujikimu na uwezeshaji kiuchumi kwa wanawake na vijana, ikiwa ni pamoja na walionusurika GBV na FGM.

English: They include an initiative aimed at strengthening access to integrated health and protection services for refugees and host communities in Kakuma and Dadaab municipalities, which is expected to benefit 107,136 people and support peaceful coexistence through improved access to quality sexual and reproductive health information, maternal health care, family planning services, psychosocial support, and survivor-centred GBV prevention and response services.
Kiswahili: Zinajumuisha mpango unaolenga kuimarisha upatikanaji wa huduma jumuishi za afya na ulinzi kwa wakimbizi na jamii zinazowahifadhi katika manispaa za Kakuma na Dadaab, ambao unatarajiwa kuwanufaisha watu 107,136 na kusaidia kuishi kwa amani kupitia upatikanaji bora wa taarifa bora za afya ya ngono na uzazi, huduma za afya ya uzazi, huduma za uzazi wa mpango, usaidizi wa kisaikolojia, na huduma za kuzuia na kukabiliana na GBV zinazozingatia manusura.

English: The second initiative, “Kenya-Japan ARISE: Action for Resilience, Innovation, Sexual Reproductive Health and Rights and Empowerment for Women and Youth,” will leverage technology and innovative digital solutions to reach 88,500 adolescents, youth and women in Nairobi and Narok Counties with sexual and reproductive health, gender-based violence prevention, menstrual health management and economic empowerment support services.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa pili, “Kenya-Japan ARISE: Hatua ya Ustahimilivu, Ubunifu, Afya ya Uzazi wa Ngono na Haki na Uwezeshaji kwa Wanawake na Vijana,” utatumia teknolojia na suluhisho bunifu za kidijitali ili kuwafikia vijana, vijana na wanawake 88,500 katika Kaunti za Nairobi na Narok kwa huduma za afya ya ngono na uzazi, kinga dhidi ya ukatili wa kijinsia, usimamizi wa afya ya hedhi na usaidizi wa uwezeshaji kiuchumi.

English: The initiative will also foster collaboration between Kenyan and Japanese youth, researchers and private sector actors to co-design solutions addressing harmful practices such as female genital mutilation (FGM), adolescent pregnancy and technology-facilitated gender-based violence.
Kiswahili: Mpango huo pia utakuza ushirikiano kati ya vijana wa Kenya na Japani, watafiti na watendaji wa sekta binafsi ili kubuni suluhisho zinazoshughulikia vitendo hatari kama vile ukeketaji wa wanawake (FGM), mimba za vijana na ukatili wa kijinsia unaosababishwa na teknolojia.

English: Speaking during the launch, H.E.
Kiswahili: Akizungumza wakati wa uzinduzi huo, Mhe.

English: Hiroshi Matsuura, Ambassador of Japan to Kenya, said, “Japan is proud to partner with UNFPA and the Government of Kenya in advancing the health, dignity, and empowerment of women and young people.
Kiswahili: Hiroshi Matsuura, Balozi wa Japani nchini Kenya, alisema, “Japani inajivunia kushirikiana na UNFPA na Serikali ya Kenya katika kuendeleza afya, utu, na uwezeshaji wa wanawake na vijana.

English: These projects reflect Japan’s commitment to human security, which is the guiding principle for Japan’s assistance, aimed at empowering individuals and communities, especially the most vulnerable, to live with dignity and security.” Dr. Pilar de la Corte Molina, UNFPA Kenya Deputy Representative and Officer in Charge, emphasized the urgency of investing in women and young people, particularly in underserved and crisis-affected areas.
Kiswahili: Miradi hii inaonyesha kujitolea kwa Japani kwa usalama wa binadamu, ambayo ndiyo kanuni inayoongoza kwa usaidizi wa Japani, inayolenga kuwawezesha watu binafsi na jamii, hasa walio katika mazingira magumu zaidi, kuishi kwa utu na usalama.” Dkt. Pilar de la Corte Molina, Naibu Mwakilishi wa UNFPA Kenya na Afisa Mkuu, alisisitiza uharaka wa kuwekeza kwa wanawake na vijana, hasa katika maeneo ambayo hayajahudumiwa vya kutosha na yaliyoathiriwa na migogoro.

English: “These projects come at a critical moment for Kenya, where too many women and girls still face barriers to accessing lifesaving sexual and reproductive health information and services.
Kiswahili: "Miradi hii inakuja wakati muhimu kwa Kenya, ambapo wanawake na wasichana wengi sana bado wanakabiliwa na vikwazo vya kupata taarifa na huduma za afya ya uzazi na ngono zinazookoa maisha."

English: Through the generous support of the Government of Japan, UNFPA and partners will strengthen sexual and reproductive health and protection systems, expand opportunities for young people, and support communities to build resilience.” Kenya continues to face significant sexual and reproductive health and protection challenges.
Kiswahili: Kupitia usaidizi mkubwa wa Serikali ya Japani, UNFPA na washirika wataimarisha mifumo ya afya ya ngono na uzazi na ulinzi, kupanua fursa kwa vijana, na kusaidia jamii kujenga ustahimilivu.” Kenya inaendelea kukabiliwa na changamoto kubwa za afya ya ngono na uzazi na ulinzi.

English: The country’s maternal mortality ratio remains high at 355 deaths per 100,000 live births, while adolescent pregnancy and gender-based violence continue to disproportionately affect women and girls, especially in informal settlements, arid and semi-arid counties, and refugee-hosting areas.
Kiswahili: Uwiano wa vifo vya akina mama nchini unabaki kuwa juu kwa vifo 355 kwa kila watoto 100,000 wanaozaliwa wakiwa hai, huku mimba za vijana na ukatili wa kijinsia ukiendelea kuathiri wanawake na wasichana kwa kiasi kikubwa, hasa katika makazi yasiyo rasmi, kaunti kame na zenye ukame, na maeneo yanayohifadhi wakimbizi.

English: As of March 2026, Kenya hosts one of the world's largest refugee populations, totaling 841,207 individuals.
Kiswahili: Kufikia Machi 2026, Kenya ina mojawapo ya idadi kubwa zaidi ya wakimbizi duniani, ikiwa na jumla ya watu 841,207.

English: In recognition of the scale of this humanitarian commitment, the Government, in coordination with development partners, established the Shirika Plan.
Kiswahili: Kwa kutambua ukubwa wa ahadi hii ya kibinadamu, Serikali, kwa uratibu na washirika wa maendeleo, ilianzisha Mpango wa Shirika.

English: The Japan Supplementary Budget Emergency Humanitarian Assistance will contribute towards the Shirika Plan, which is designed to provide essential services to both refugees and host communities, with health and protection identified as paramount priorities.
Kiswahili: Msaada wa Dharura wa Kibinadamu wa Bajeti ya Nyongeza ya Japani utachangia katika Mpango wa Shirika, ambao umeundwa kutoa huduma muhimu kwa wakimbizi na jamii zinazowahifadhi, huku afya na ulinzi vikitambuliwa kama vipaumbele muhimu.

English: The projects will be implemented in collaboration with county governments, Kenya Red Cross Society, Africa Coordinating Centre for Abandonment of Female Genital Mutilation (ACCAF), and Japanese private sector partners, including Unicharm Corporation and Pigeon Baby Lab Kenya, Nagasaki University, and the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA).
Kiswahili: Miradi hiyo itatekelezwa kwa ushirikiano na serikali za kaunti, Chama cha Msalaba Mwekundu cha Kenya, Kituo cha Uratibu wa Afrika cha Kuachana na Ukeketaji wa Wanawake (ACCAF), na washirika wa sekta binafsi wa Japani, ikiwa ni pamoja na Unicharm Corporation na Pigeon Baby Lab Kenya, Chuo Kikuu cha Nagasaki, na Shirika la Ushirikiano wa Kimataifa la Japani (JICA).
