English: The climate crisis is no longer a future threat but a present reality within the East Africa Rift System and Lake Victoria Basin.
Kiswahili: Mgogoro wa hali ya hewa si tishio la siku zijazo tena bali ni ukweli uliopo ndani ya Mfumo wa Ufa wa Afrika Mashariki na Bonde la Ziwa Victoria.

English: Unprecedented water level increases and backflow have created a persistent state of inundation across Kenya’s major inland water bodies.
Kiswahili: Kiwango cha maji kisicho cha kawaida huongezeka na kurudi nyuma kwa maji kumesababisha hali ya mafuriko katika miili mikubwa ya maji ya ndani ya Kenya.

English: Far from just an ecological disaster, this rising tide has fueled a profound humanitarian crisis, systematically eroding the safety, health, and dignity of hundreds of thousands of people.
Kiswahili: Mbali na janga la kiikolojia tu, wimbi hili linaloongezeka limechochea mgogoro mkubwa wa kibinadamu, na kuharibu usalama, afya, na heshima ya mamia ya maelfu ya watu kimfumo.

English: When floodwaters rise, the fragile systems protecting women and girls are often the first to submerge.
Kiswahili: Maji ya mafuriko yanapoongezeka, mifumo dhaifu inayowalinda wanawake na wasichana mara nyingi huwa ya kwanza kuzamishwa.

English: The destruction of local health centers has severed essential maternal health services, cutting off prenatal care and skilled birth attendance, as well as access to contraceptives.
Kiswahili: Uharibifu wa vituo vya afya vya eneo hilo umekatiza huduma muhimu za afya ya uzazi, na kukatiza huduma za ujauzito na mahudhurio ya wataalamu wa kujifungua, pamoja na upatikanaji wa dawa za kuzuia mimba.

English: For women in labor across the Rift Valley, submerged roads and ruined infrastructure cause severe "referral fatigue".
Kiswahili: Kwa wanawake wanaojifungua kote Bonde la Ufa, barabara zilizozama na miundombinu iliyoharibika husababisha "uchovu mkubwa wa rufaa".

English: Unable to reach emergency obstetric care during the critical "Golden Hour," pregnant mothers face a rising risk of maternal mortality.
Kiswahili: Kwa kutoweza kufikia huduma ya dharura ya uzazi wakati wa "Saa ya Dhahabu" muhimu, akina mama wajawazito wanakabiliwa na hatari inayoongezeka ya vifo vya akina mama.

English: “The floods did not just wash away our house; they stripped away my dignity, my health, my time with my children, and our sense of security,” shared one female survivor from Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: "Mafuriko hayakuifuta nyumba yetu tu; yaliniondolea heshima yangu, afya yangu, muda wangu na watoto wangu, na hisia zetu za usalama," alisema mmoja wa manusura wa kike kutoka Kaunti ya Nakuru.

English: “Economic stress has brought violence into my home, and I continue to live with the physical and emotional consequences of this crisis.” A surge in exploitation and gender-based violence Besides health, the rising tide has amplified protection risks.
Kiswahili: "Msongo wa mawazo wa kiuchumi umeleta vurugu nyumbani kwangu, na ninaendelea kuishi na matokeo ya kimwili na kihisia ya mgogoro huu." Ongezeko la unyonyaji na vurugu zinazotokana na jinsia Mbali na afya, wimbi linaloongezeka limeongeza hatari za ulinzi.

English: Displacement has forced thousands of families into crowded, informal camps.
Kiswahili: Kuhama kumelazimisha maelfu ya familia kuingia katika kambi zilizojaa watu na zisizo rasmi.

English: In these settings, a lack of proper lighting and partitioned sleeping areas leaves women and adolescent girls acutely vulnerable to sexual assault.
Kiswahili: Katika mazingira haya, ukosefu wa taa zinazofaa na maeneo ya kulala yaliyogawanywa huwaacha wanawake na wasichana vijana katika hatari kubwa ya kushambuliwa kingono.

English: At the same time, the destruction of lakeside farms and fishing sites has triggered deep economic distress, reviving harmful survival mechanisms.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo, uharibifu wa mashamba na maeneo ya uvuvi kando ya ziwa umesababisha dhiki kubwa ya kiuchumi, na kufufua mifumo hatari ya kuishi.

English: In some Lake Victoria communities, the "Jaboya" system, where women are forced into transactional sex for fish to secure food, has resurfaced.
Kiswahili: Katika baadhi ya jamii za Ziwa Victoria, mfumo wa "Jaboya", ambapo wanawake hulazimishwa kufanya ngono ya kibiashara ili kupata chakula, umeibuka tena.

English: The crisis has also destabilized households from within.
Kiswahili: Mgogoro huo pia umeathiri uthabiti wa kaya kutoka ndani.

English: Intimate Partner Violence has escalated as men battle psychological stress over lost land and assets.
Kiswahili: Vurugu za Wapenzi wa Karibu zimeongezeka huku wanaume wakipambana na msongo wa mawazo kuhusu ardhi na mali zilizopotea.

English: To cope with these devastating losses, some rural families have turned to child marriage to secure a dowry or reduce the number of dependents.
Kiswahili: Ili kukabiliana na hasara hizi kubwa, baadhi ya familia za vijijini zimegeukia ndoa za utotoni ili kupata mahari au kupunguza idadi ya wategemezi.

English: For adolescent girls, the floodwaters frequently result in a permanent exit from school, exposing them to early pregnancy, gender-based violence, and female genital mutilation.
Kiswahili: Kwa wasichana waliobalehe, mafuriko mara nyingi husababisha kufukuzwa shuleni kabisa, na kuwaweka katika hatari ya kupata mimba za mapema, ukatili wa kijinsia, na ukeketaji wa wanawake.

English: An assessment conducted at Lake Nakuru revealed that 67.7% of households report flood-related illnesses, while 87.1% experience significant trauma from displacement.
Kiswahili: Tathmini iliyofanywa katika Ziwa Nakuru ilionyesha kuwa 67.7% ya kaya zinaripoti magonjwa yanayohusiana na mafuriko, huku 87.1% zikipata majeraha makubwa kutokana na kuhamishwa.

English: These invisible human costs, including chronic mental health crises, a loss of ancestral livelihoods, and a massive surge in unpaid care work that adds an extra 9.4 hours daily to a woman's burden, amount to USD 1,346,000 in Non-Economic Losses.
Kiswahili: Gharama hizi zisizoonekana za kibinadamu, ikiwa ni pamoja na migogoro sugu ya afya ya akili, upotevu wa riziki ya mababu, na ongezeko kubwa la kazi za utunzaji zisizolipwa ambazo huongeza saa 9.4 za ziada kila siku kwa mzigo wa mwanamke, zinafikia dola za Kimarekani 1,346,000 katika Hasara Zisizo za Kiuchumi.

English: Additionally, the public health burden is valued at USD 2,452,464 in Disability-Adjusted Life Years (DALY) loss.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, mzigo wa afya ya umma una thamani ya dola za Marekani 2,452,464 katika hasara ya Miaka ya Maisha Iliyorekebishwa kwa Ulemavu (DALY).

English: Turning evidence into action and funding Traditional climate adaptation measures are no longer enough to buffer communities against these severe losses.
Kiswahili: Kubadilisha ushahidi kuwa vitendo na ufadhili Hatua za jadi za kukabiliana na hali ya hewa hazitoshi tena kulinda jamii dhidi ya hasara hizi kubwa.

English: In response, the Government of Kenya, through its Climate Change Directorate, has submitted a comprehensive funding request (U$ 21,400,000) to the Fund for Responding to Loss and Damage (FRLD).
Kiswahili: Katika kujibu, Serikali ya Kenya, kupitia Kurugenzi yake ya Mabadiliko ya Tabianchi, imewasilisha ombi kamili la ufadhili (U$ 21,400,000) kwa Mfuko wa Kukabiliana na Hasara na Uharibifu (FRLD).

English: Kenya’s approach to climate change-induced loss and damage is country-owned and needs-based, targeting not only economic losses but also, crucially, non-economic losses, including psychosocial stress, human mobility, the breakdown of social protection systems, and the loss of cultural heritage.
Kiswahili: Mbinu ya Kenya kuhusu hasara na uharibifu unaosababishwa na mabadiliko ya tabianchi inamilikiwa na nchi na inategemea mahitaji, ikilenga sio tu hasara za kiuchumi bali pia, muhimu zaidi, hasara zisizo za kiuchumi, ikiwa ni pamoja na msongo wa mawazo, uhamaji wa binadamu, kuvunjika kwa mifumo ya ulinzi wa kijamii, na kupotea kwa urithi wa kitamaduni.

English: The focus of Kenya's funding request is the rising water levels (backflow) in the Rift Valley Lakes and Lake Victoria, which have caused devastating displacement and the loss of livelihoods across counties such as Kisumu, Turkana, Marsabit, Nakuru, and Busia.
Kiswahili: Lengo la ombi la ufadhili la Kenya ni kuongezeka kwa viwango vya maji (kurudi nyuma) katika Maziwa ya Bonde la Ufa na Ziwa Victoria, ambavyo vimesababisha kuhama makazi na kupoteza riziki katika kaunti kama vile Kisumu, Turkana, Marsabit, Nakuru, na Busia.

English: To ensure these efforts protect the most vulnerable, UNFPA has partnered with Kenya's Ministry of Environment, Climate Change, and Forestry to place maternal health and GBV risks at the center of national climate disaster responses.
Kiswahili: Ili kuhakikisha juhudi hizi zinawalinda walio hatarini zaidi, UNFPA imeshirikiana na Wizara ya Mazingira, Mabadiliko ya Tabianchi, na Misitu ya Kenya kuweka hatari za afya ya mama na GBV katikati ya majibu ya kitaifa ya majanga ya tabianchi.

English: “This robust, evidence-based approach strengthens Kenya’s case for international climate finance and underscores the urgent need for targeted interventions to support affected populations,” said James Thonjo, Senior Climate Change Officer at Kenya’s Climate Change Directorate.
Kiswahili: "Mbinu hii thabiti na inayotegemea ushahidi inaimarisha kesi ya Kenya kwa ajili ya ufadhili wa kimataifa wa hali ya hewa na inasisitiza hitaji la dharura la hatua zinazolengwa ili kusaidia idadi ya watu walioathiriwa," alisema James Thonjo, Afisa Mkuu wa Mabadiliko ya Hali ya Hewa katika Kurugenzi ya Mabadiliko ya Hali ya Hewa ya Kenya.

English: UNFPA remains committed to mobilizing resources and specialized expertise in demographic intelligence, sexual and reproductive health and rights, mental health and psychosocial support, population dynamics, and gender analysis.
Kiswahili: UNFPA bado imejitolea kuhamasisha rasilimali na utaalamu maalum katika akili ya idadi ya watu, afya ya ngono na uzazi na haki, afya ya akili na usaidizi wa kisaikolojia, mienendo ya idadi ya watu, na uchambuzi wa kijinsia.

English: Through continued partnership with the Ministry of Environment and Climate Change, and other actors, including community voices, UNFPA is ensuring that the "invisible" victims of climate change are finally seen, heard, and supported by the global community.
Kiswahili: Kupitia ushirikiano unaoendelea na Wizara ya Mazingira na Mabadiliko ya Tabianchi, na wahusika wengine, ikiwa ni pamoja na sauti za jamii, UNFPA inahakikisha kwamba waathiriwa "wasioonekana" wa mabadiliko ya tabianchi hatimaye wanaonekana, wanasikika, na kuungwa mkono na jumuiya ya kimataifa.

English: The maternal mortality ratio, the number of women dying of pregnancy-related causes, stands at 355 deaths per 100,000 live births.
Kiswahili: Uwiano wa vifo vya akina mama, idadi ya wanawake wanaofariki kutokana na sababu zinazohusiana na ujauzito, ni vifo 355 kwa kila watoto 100,000 wanaozaliwa wakiwa hai.

English: Given the current annual births, this means that there are nearly 5000 women and girls dying annually due to pregnancy and childbirth complications.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuzingatia idadi ya watoto wanaozaliwa kila mwaka kwa sasa, hii ina maana kwamba kuna karibu wanawake na wasichana 5000 wanaokufa kila mwaka kutokana na matatizo ya ujauzito na kujifungua.

English: While access to skilled birth attendance has improved from 62% to about 70% over the last seven years, over 80% of maternal deaths are attributed to poor quality of care.
Kiswahili: Ingawa upatikanaji wa huduma za uzazi zenye ujuzi umeongezeka kutoka 62% hadi takriban 70% katika kipindi cha miaka saba iliyopita, zaidi ya 80% ya vifo vya akina mama husababishwa na ubora duni wa huduma.

English: Additionally, many more women and girls survive with severe morbidity including obstetric fistula and mental health complications UNFPA supports capacity building of the health facilities to ensure universal access to patient-centered, skilled midwifery care to end preventable maternal and perinatal deaths, particularly to those at risk of being left behind including those in informal urban settlements and rural areas.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, wanawake na wasichana wengi zaidi wanaishi na magonjwa makubwa ikiwa ni pamoja na fistula ya uzazi na matatizo ya afya ya akili. UNFPA inasaidia ujenzi wa uwezo wa vituo vya afya ili kuhakikisha upatikanaji wa huduma ya ukunga inayolenga wagonjwa na yenye ujuzi ili kukomesha vifo vya akina mama na watoto vinavyoweza kuzuilika, hasa kwa wale walio katika hatari ya kuachwa nyuma ikiwa ni pamoja na wale walio katika makazi yasiyo rasmi ya mijini na maeneo ya vijijini.

English: UNFPA supports several interventions aimed at ending preventable maternal deaths in Kenya: - Advocacy and policy dialogue on ending preventable maternal and perinatal deaths - Improvement of midwifery training and practice as per International Confederation of Midwifery standards, including support for improving community-based maternal and newborn care - Scale-up of emergency obstetric and newborn care, focusing on improving facility readiness - Prevention and management of obstetric fistula, to integrate fistula treatment within the routine health service delivery.
Kiswahili: UNFPA inasaidia hatua kadhaa zinazolenga kukomesha vifo vya akina mama vinavyoweza kuzuilika nchini Kenya: - Utetezi na mazungumzo ya sera kuhusu kukomesha vifo vya akina mama na vya wakati wa kujifungua vinavyoweza kuzuilika - Uboreshaji wa mafunzo na utendaji wa ukunga kulingana na viwango vya Shirikisho la Kimataifa la Ukunga, ikiwa ni pamoja na usaidizi wa kuboresha huduma ya mama na mtoto mchanga inayotegemea jamii - Kuongeza huduma ya dharura ya uzazi na mtoto mchanga, ikilenga kuboresha utayari wa vituo - Kuzuia na kudhibiti fistula ya uzazi, ili kuunganisha matibabu ya fistula ndani ya utoaji wa huduma za afya za kawaida.

English: HIV and AIDS remain a health and development challenge for Kenya.
Kiswahili: VVU na UKIMWI bado ni changamoto ya kiafya na maendeleo kwa Kenya.

English: HIV prevalence dropped from 7.1 % in 2007 to 4.5 % in 2020, although new infections remain fairly high, at 41,700 per year.
Kiswahili: Kiwango cha maambukizi ya VVU kilipungua kutoka 7.1% mwaka 2007 hadi 4.5% mwaka 2020, ingawa maambukizi mapya yanabaki kuwa juu, kwa 41,700 kwa mwaka.

English: HIV incidence among adults aged 15+ years declined from approximately 2.8 per 1000 in 2010 to 1.2 per 1000 in 2020.
Kiswahili: Kiwango cha maambukizi ya VVU miongoni mwa watu wazima wenye umri wa miaka 15+ kilipungua kutoka takriban 2.8 kwa kila 1000 mwaka 2010 hadi 1.2 kwa kila 1000 mwaka 2020.

English: This decline is attributed to several factors among them the scale-up of various prevention and treatment programmes.
Kiswahili: Kupungua huku kunachangiwa na mambo kadhaa miongoni mwao ikiwa ni pamoja na kuongezeka kwa programu mbalimbali za kinga na matibabu.

English: Adolescents and youth aged 15-24 years contributed about 35% of all the new infections.
Kiswahili: Vijana na vijana wenye umri wa miaka 15-24 walichangia takriban 35% ya maambukizi yote mapya.

English: The total number of people living with HIV (PLHIV) is estimated at approximately 1.5 million in 2020, which includes 106,807 children <15 years old, 145,471 youth aged 15-24 years, and 1,256,127 adults aged 25+ years old.
Kiswahili: Jumla ya watu wanaoishi na VVU (WAVIU) inakadiriwa kuwa takriban milioni 1.5 mwaka 2020, ikiwa ni pamoja na watoto 106,807 walio chini ya umri wa miaka 15, vijana 145,471 wenye umri wa miaka 15-24, na watu wazima 1,256,127 wenye umri wa miaka 25+.

English: The youth 15-24 years of age accounted for 12% of the total number of people living with HIV while adolescents aged 10-19 years old represented 91,634 (8%) of the total number of people living with HIV.
Kiswahili: Vijana wenye umri wa miaka 15-24 walichangia 12% ya jumla ya idadi ya watu wanaoishi na VVU huku vijana wenye umri wa miaka 10-19 wakiwakilisha 91,634 (8%) ya jumla ya idadi ya watu wanaoishi na VVU.

English: UNFPA Interventions - Procurement of male and female condoms including their availability in emergencies and advocacy for domestic financing of condoms - Strengthen national and county institutions’ capacity to provide integrated HIV prevention/SRH services for adolescents, young people, and sex workers.
Kiswahili: Hatua za UNFPA - Ununuzi wa kondomu za kiume na kike ikiwa ni pamoja na upatikanaji wake katika dharura na utetezi wa ufadhili wa ndani wa kondomu - Kuimarisha uwezo wa taasisi za kitaifa na kaunti wa kutoa huduma jumuishi za kinga dhidi ya VVU/SRH kwa vijana, vijana, na wafanyakazi wa ngono.

English: This includes support for the development of policies, strategies, and guidelines for service delivery.
Kiswahili: Hii inajumuisha usaidizi kwa ajili ya uundaji wa sera, mikakati, na miongozo ya utoaji wa huduma.

English: Patrick Ngigi was working as a teacher in Narok County, Kenya, nearly 30 years ago when a student asked him for help.
Kiswahili: Patrick Ngigi alikuwa akifanya kazi kama mwalimu katika Kaunti ya Narok, Kenya, karibu miaka 30 iliyopita wakati mwanafunzi mmoja alipomwomba msaada.

English: It would change the direction of his life.
Kiswahili: Ingebadilisha mwelekeo wa maisha yake.

English: “In 1997, I was working as a head teacher when a girl came to me and pleaded for help so she wouldn’t be married off,” he says.
Kiswahili: "Mnamo 1997, nilikuwa nikifanya kazi kama mwalimu mkuu wakati msichana mmoja aliponijia na kuniomba msaada ili asiolewe," anasema.

English: “I took her to my mother’s house because we didn’t have any rescue centres available.
Kiswahili: "Nilimpeleka nyumbani kwa mama yangu kwa sababu hatukuwa na vituo vyovyote vya uokoaji vilivyopatikana."

English: Over the years, his rescue centre has helped around 3,500 girls avoid female genital mutilation, child marriage, rape and other forms of gender-based violence.
Kiswahili: Kwa miaka mingi, kituo chake cha uokoaji kimewasaidia takriban wasichana 3,500 kuepuka ukeketaji, ndoa za utotoni, ubakaji na aina nyingine za ukatili wa kijinsia.

English: The centre now accommodates up to 120 girls across two facilities.
Kiswahili: Kituo hicho sasa kinahudumia hadi wasichana 120 katika vituo viwili.

English: Patrick is proud to make a difference, but says it remains an uphill struggle “There is no positive impact of undergoing female genital mutilation…only suffering that lasts.” Across Narok County, more than half of girls are known to be subjected to female genital mutilation, a painful and potentially deadly human rights violation.
Kiswahili: Patrick anajivunia kuleta mabadiliko, lakini anasema bado ni mapambano magumu "Hakuna athari chanya ya kufanyiwa ukeketaji wa wanawake ... ni mateso tu yanayodumu." Kote katika Kaunti ya Narok, zaidi ya nusu ya wasichana wanajulikana kufanyiwa ukeketaji wa wanawake, ukiukwaji wa haki za binadamu unaoumiza na unaoweza kusababisha kifo.

English: Despite a national ban, it remains common, particularly in rural areas, and is prevalent among the local Maasai community.
Kiswahili: Licha ya marufuku ya kitaifa, bado ni jambo la kawaida, hasa katika maeneo ya vijijini, na limeenea miongoni mwa jamii ya Wamasai.

English: One way Patrick and partners are working to change this is through the power of community dialogues.
Kiswahili: Njia moja ambayo Patrick na washirika wake wanafanya kazi ili kubadilisha hili ni kupitia nguvu ya mazungumzo ya kijamii.

English: These can include male engagement sessions for Maasai elders and young men, known as Morans, as well as wider community dialogues involving survivors of female genital mutilation and other advocates.
Kiswahili: Hizi zinaweza kujumuisha vikao vya uchumba wa wanaume kwa wazee na vijana wa Kimasai, wanaojulikana kama Wamorani, pamoja na mijadala mipana ya kijamii inayowahusisha manusura wa ukeketaji wa wanawake na watetezi wengine.

English: Patrick believes education is the greatest force for change.
Kiswahili: Patrick anaamini elimu ndiyo nguvu kubwa zaidi ya mabadiliko.

English: These activities are part of the UNFPA-UNICEF Joint Programme on the Elimination of Female Genital Mutilation.
Kiswahili: Shughuli hizi ni sehemu ya Mpango wa Pamoja wa UNFPA-UNICEF kuhusu Kutokomeza Ukeketaji wa Wanawake.

English: The largest global programme to accelerate the elimination of the harmful practice, it operates across 18 countries.
Kiswahili: Mpango mkubwa zaidi wa kimataifa wa kuharakisha kutokomeza tabia hiyo hatari, unafanya kazi katika nchi 18.

English: Back at the rescue centre, girls and young women are being supported to fulfil their potential.
Kiswahili: Wakiwa wamerudi katika kituo cha uokoaji, wasichana na wanawake vijana wanasaidiwa ili kutimiza uwezo wao.

English: They can return to an education that they had to abandon when they left their families, and learn skills in a supportive, familial environment.
Kiswahili: Wanaweza kurudi kwenye elimu ambayo iliwabidi kuiacha walipoacha familia zao, na kujifunza ujuzi katika mazingira ya usaidizi na kifamilia.

English: Cynthia, 23, escaped female genital mutilation at the age of 11.
Kiswahili: Cynthia, mwenye umri wa miaka 23, alitoroka kukeketwa akiwa na umri wa miaka 11.

English: The centre has been her home for 13 years, and she is now employed there, offering encouragement and support to girls.
Kiswahili: Kituo hicho kimekuwa nyumbani kwake kwa miaka 13, na sasa anafanya kazi huko, akiwatia moyo na kuwasaidia wasichana.

English: She has studied supply chain and procurement management and sees herself becoming a successful businesswoman in the future.
Kiswahili: Amesomea ugavi na usimamizi wa ununuzi na anajiona kuwa mfanyabiashara mwanamke aliyefanikiwa katika siku zijazo.

English: “I come from a very large family.
Kiswahili: "Ninatoka katika familia kubwa sana."

English: For many girls, early marriage and female genital mutilation were decided for them before they could choose anything for themselves.
Kiswahili: Kwa wasichana wengi, ndoa za mapema na ukeketaji wa wanawake ziliamuliwa kwao kabla ya kuchagua chochote kwa ajili yao wenyewe.

English: My younger sister and I escaped at dawn without my father knowing.
Kiswahili: Mimi na dada yangu mdogo tulitoroka alfajiri bila baba yangu kujua.

English: It was the only way to protect our future and continue our education.
Kiswahili: Ilikuwa njia pekee ya kulinda mustakabali wetu na kuendelea na elimu yetu.

English: When the community found out we were in a safe house, my mother paid the price – she was mocked, isolated and disowned because of us,” she says.
Kiswahili: Jamii ilipogundua kuwa tuko katika nyumba salama, mama yangu alilipa gharama - alidhihakiwa, kutengwa na kukataliwa kwa sababu yetu,” anasema.

English: I support younger girls, help them stay in school and remind them that their future matters.
Kiswahili: Ninawaunga mkono wasichana wadogo, ninawasaidia kubaki shuleni na kuwakumbusha kwamba mustakabali wao ni muhimu.

English: There is no positive impact of undergoing female genital mutilation; what girls talk about is pain, bleeding and suffering that lasts.” “I loved education, so I ran for my life.” Cecilia, 24, also a resident at the centre, has just earned a diploma in counselling psychology, and her housemates and staffers are celebrating with her.
Kiswahili: Hakuna athari chanya ya kufanyiwa ukeketaji wa wanawake; kile wasichana wanachozungumzia ni maumivu, kutokwa na damu na mateso yanayodumu.” “Nilipenda elimu, kwa hivyo nilikimbia kuokoa maisha yangu.” Cecilia, 24, ambaye pia ni mkazi wa kituo hicho, amehitimu tu katika saikolojia ya ushauri nasaha, na wafanyakazi wenzake wa nyumbani na wafanyakazi wanasherehekea naye.

English: “I loved education, so I ran for my life,” she says.
Kiswahili: "Nilipenda elimu, kwa hivyo nilikimbia kuokoa maisha yangu," anasema.

English: “They still stigmatize me,” she says of her community, “but I don’t care.
Kiswahili: "Bado wananinyanyapaa," anasema kuhusu jamii yake, "lakini sijali."

English: I wanted to change my life.” Her decision to study counselling was driven by her personal experience of being a girl in need of help.
Kiswahili: Nilitaka kubadilisha maisha yangu.” Uamuzi wake wa kusoma ushauri nasaha ulichochewa na uzoefu wake binafsi wa kuwa msichana anayehitaji msaada.

English: “I now want to be that help.” Every single girl’s escape from female genital mutilation and child marriage, along with their achievements, are successes celebrated by the entire centre – and the wider movement against female genital mutilation, both locally and globally.
Kiswahili: "Sasa nataka kuwa msaada huo." Kutoroka kwa kila msichana kutokana na ukeketaji wa wanawake na ndoa za utotoni, pamoja na mafanikio yao, ni mafanikio yanayosherehekewa na kituo kizima - na harakati pana dhidi ya ukeketaji wa wanawake, ndani na kimataifa.

English: “You isolate yourself completely, even from your own family.
Kiswahili: "Unajitenga kabisa, hata na familia yako mwenyewe."

English: You can’t focus, and you spend your days in darkness and crying.” These are the words of Josephine Mitty, one of many women UNFPA met at the Kenyatta National Hospital in Nairobi during a free fistula repair camp held to commemorate the International Day for the Elimination of Obstetric Fistula.
Kiswahili: Huwezi kuzingatia, na unatumia siku zako gizani na kulia.” Haya ni maneno ya Josephine Mitty, mmoja wa wanawake wengi ambao UNFPA walikutana nao katika Hospitali ya Kitaifa ya Kenyatta jijini Nairobi wakati wa kambi ya bure ya ukarabati wa fistula iliyofanyika kuadhimisha Siku ya Kimataifa ya Kutokomeza Fistula ya Uzazi.

English: Despite notable progress in maternal health, obstetric fistula remains a devastating condition affecting women in Kenya.
Kiswahili: Licha ya maendeleo makubwa katika afya ya uzazi, fistula ya uzazi bado ni hali mbaya inayowaathiri wanawake nchini Kenya.

English: The country records about 3,000 new cases each year, and fewer than 50% of affected women reach treatment.
Kiswahili: Nchi hiyo inarekodi takriban visa vipya 3,000 kila mwaka, na chini ya 50% ya wanawake walioathiriwa hupata matibabu.

English: More than 100,000 women are estimated to be living with this injury across the country today.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya wanawake 100,000 wanakadiriwa kuishi na jeraha hili kote nchini leo.

English: This burden is fueled by late access to emergency obstetric care, reliance on unskilled birth attendants, and adolescent pregnancies.
Kiswahili: Mzigo huu unachochewa na upatikanaji wa huduma za dharura za uzazi kwa kuchelewa, kutegemea wakunga wasio na ujuzi, na mimba za vijana.

English: Harmful traditional practices also play a role, while weak referral systems and limited community awareness leave women without timely support.
Kiswahili: Mila za kitamaduni zenye madhara pia zina jukumu, huku mifumo dhaifu ya rufaa na uelewa mdogo wa jamii ukiwafanya wanawake kukosa usaidizi kwa wakati unaofaa.

English: Society looks away Beyond physical suffering, obstetric fistula imposes daily social violence.
Kiswahili: Jamii hupuuza Zaidi ya mateso ya kimwili, fistula ya uzazi hulazimisha vurugu za kijamii kila siku.

English: Survivors often suffer shame, isolation, and discrimination, causing them to withdraw from society for fear of being judged or rejected.
Kiswahili: Mara nyingi walionusurika hupata aibu, kutengwa, na ubaguzi, na hivyo kuwafanya wajiondoe katika jamii kwa hofu ya kuhukumiwa au kukataliwa.

English: For Josephine, her journey to the fistula camp was not only for surgery, but to reclaim her life.
Kiswahili: Kwa Josephine, safari yake hadi kambi ya fistula haikuwa tu kwa ajili ya upasuaji, bali pia ili kurejesha maisha yake.

English: Her partner left because of her condition, leaving her to face isolation and a tremendous family responsibility alone.
Kiswahili: Mwenzi wake aliondoka kwa sababu ya hali yake, na kumwacha akikabiliwa na upweke na jukumu kubwa la kifamilia peke yake.

English: Her story is similar to that of Felistas Syombua, who also underwent the life-changing fistula repair surgery at the camp.
Kiswahili: Hadithi yake inafanana na ile ya Felistas Syombua, ambaye pia alifanyiwa upasuaji wa kurekebisha fistula uliobadilisha maisha yake kambini.

English: Her fistula developed in 2012, during the birth of her first child.
Kiswahili: Fistula yake ilianza mwaka wa 2012, wakati wa kuzaliwa kwa mtoto wake wa kwanza.

English: “For 14 years, I had to hide this condition from everyone, including my mother and friends.
Kiswahili: "Kwa miaka 14, ilinibidi kuficha hali hii kwa kila mtu, ikiwa ni pamoja na mama yangu na marafiki."

English: The only person I could trust with my secret was my husband, who always supported me,” she says, tears in her eyes.
Kiswahili: Mtu pekee ambaye ningeweza kumwamini kwa siri yangu alikuwa mume wangu, ambaye aliniunga mkono kila wakati,” anasema, huku machozi yakimtoka.

English: When she gave birth again, stigma intensified her suffering.
Kiswahili: Alipojifungua tena, unyanyapaa ulizidisha mateso yake.

English: Some healthcare workers noticed but never informed her.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya wafanyakazi wa afya waligundua lakini hawakuwahi kumjulisha.

English: Others informed her, and sometimes blamed her or cruelly suggested she should expect her husband to leave.
Kiswahili: Wengine walimjulisha, na wakati mwingine walimlaumu au kwa ukatili walipendekeza kwamba angetarajia mumewe aondoke.

English: To survive at work and hide her ongoing incontinence, Felistas lived in constant anxiety, constantly running to the toilet.
Kiswahili: Ili kuishi kazini na kuficha kutoweza kujizuia, Felistas aliishi kwa wasiwasi wa kila mara, akikimbilia chooni kila mara.

English: The pressure eventually cost her a stable job, pushing her into informal work to support her family.
Kiswahili: Shinikizo hilo hatimaye lilimgharimu kazi imara, na kumsukuma kufanya kazi isiyo rasmi ili kuisaidia familia yake.

English: With her fistula repaired, she now hopes to fully reintegrate into society.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa fistula yake imepona, sasa anatumaini kujumuika kikamilifu katika jamii.

English: Josephine and Felistas: two lives, one demand Through Josephine and Felistas, one truth becomes evident.
Kiswahili: Josephine na Felistas: maisha mawili, hitaji moja Kupitia Josephine na Felistas, ukweli mmoja unadhihirika.

English: While free surgery is essential, full recovery can only be realized through holistic care, which includes economic empowerment, psychosocial support, and community education to address deep-rooted stigma.
Kiswahili: Ingawa upasuaji wa bure ni muhimu, kupona kabisa kunaweza kupatikana tu kupitia utunzaji kamili, ambao unajumuisha uwezeshaji wa kiuchumi, usaidizi wa kisaikolojia, na elimu ya jamii ili kushughulikia unyanyapaa uliokita mizizi.

English: "Surgical intervention closes the physical wound, but a comprehensive, multi-sectoral systems approach is what restores the woman," says Dr. Pilar De La Corte Molina, UNFPA’s Deputy Representative and Officer in Charge in Kenya UNFPA works collaboratively with partners to implement interventions aimed at eliminating obstetric fistula in Kenya by 2030.
Kiswahili: "Uingiliaji kati wa upasuaji hufunga jeraha la kimwili, lakini mbinu kamili na ya kina ya mifumo ya sekta nyingi ndiyo inayomrejesha mwanamke," anasema Dkt. Pilar De La Corte Molina, Naibu Mwakilishi na Afisa Mkuu wa UNFPA nchini Kenya. UNFPA inafanya kazi kwa ushirikiano na washirika kutekeleza hatua zinazolenga kuondoa fistula ya uzazi nchini Kenya ifikapo mwaka 2030.

English: This includes strengthening maternal health systems and expanding emergency obstetric care for the prevention of fistula, as well as addressing underlying drivers such as early childbearing and FGM.
Kiswahili: Hii inajumuisha kuimarisha mifumo ya afya ya uzazi na kupanua huduma za dharura za uzazi kwa ajili ya kuzuia fistula, pamoja na kushughulikia vichocheo vikuu kama vile uzazi wa mapema na ukeketaji.

English: Through investments in prevention, timely treatment, and socioeconomic reintegration of survivors, women like Felistas Syombua are empowered to step out of isolation, leave the shame behind, and reclaim their lives.
Kiswahili: Kupitia uwekezaji katika kuzuia, matibabu ya wakati unaofaa, na kuwaunganisha upya kijamii na kiuchumi wa manusura, wanawake kama Felistas Syombua wanawezeshwa kutoka katika upweke, kuacha aibu, na kurejesha maisha yao.

English: Lodwar, Turkana County, 20 April 2025 – The Government of Japan and the United Nations Population Fund, UNFPA, have reaffirmed their commitment to delivering life-saving health and protection services to women and girls in Turkana County, including refugees and host communities living in fragile and humanitarian settings.
Kiswahili: Lodwar, Kaunti ya Turkana, 20 Aprili 2025 - Serikali ya Japani na Shirika la Idadi ya Watu la Umoja wa Mataifa, UNFPA, wamethibitisha tena kujitolea kwao kutoa huduma za afya na ulinzi zinazookoa maisha kwa wanawake na wasichana katika Kaunti ya Turkana, wakiwemo wakimbizi na jamii zinazowahifadhi wanaoishi katika mazingira magumu na ya kibinadamu.

English: The renewed commitment follows a high-level visit by Japan’s Ambassador to Kenya, H.E.
Kiswahili: Ahadi hiyo mpya inafuatia ziara ya kiwango cha juu ya Balozi wa Japani nchini Kenya, M.E.

English: Hiroshi Matsuura, to Turkana County, where he toured maternal health and gender-based violence recovery facilities in Kakuma Refugee Camp and Kalobeyei Integrated Settlement.
Kiswahili: Hiroshi Matsuura, hadi Kaunti ya Turkana, ambapo alitembelea vituo vya afya ya uzazi na unyanyasaji wa kijinsia katika Kambi ya Wakimbizi ya Kakuma na Makazi Jumuishi ya Kalobeyei.

English: The facilities are supported through funding from the Government of Japan.
Kiswahili: Vifaa hivyo vinasaidiwa kupitia ufadhili kutoka Serikali ya Japani.

English: Japan has provided more than US$4.2 million through funding to UNFPA between 2022 and 2025 to expand access to sexual and reproductive health services and strengthen the prevention and response to gender-based violence in some of Kenya’s most vulnerable counties, including Turkana, Garissa, Mandera, Tana River, and Nairobi.
Kiswahili: Japani imetoa zaidi ya dola milioni 4.2 za Marekani kupitia ufadhili kwa UNFPA kati ya 2022 na 2025 ili kupanua ufikiaji wa huduma za afya ya ngono na uzazi na kuimarisha kinga na mwitikio wa ukatili wa kijinsia katika baadhi ya kaunti zilizo hatarini zaidi nchini Kenya, ikiwa ni pamoja na Turkana, Garissa, Mandera, Tana River, na Nairobi.

English: Japan’s support has delivered measurable impact.
Kiswahili: Usaidizi wa Japani umetoa athari inayoweza kupimika.

English: More than 100,000 pregnant women have accessed skilled delivery services, helping to reduce the risk of maternal and newborn deaths.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya wanawake wajawazito 100,000 wamefikia huduma za kujifungua zenye ujuzi, na kusaidia kupunguza hatari ya vifo vya akina mama na watoto wachanga.

English: Nearly 400,000 women and girls have been reached with modern contraception information and services, empowering them to make informed reproductive health choices.
Kiswahili: Karibu wanawake na wasichana 400,000 wamefikiwa na taarifa na huduma za kisasa za uzazi wa mpango, na kuwawezesha kufanya maamuzi sahihi kuhusu afya ya uzazi.

English: At the same time, over 20,000 survivors of gender-based violence have received psychosocial care and protection services.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo, zaidi ya manusura 20,000 wa unyanyasaji wa kijinsia wamepokea huduma za kisaikolojia na ulinzi.

English: Safe spaces for women and girls have been established and strengthened, while community-based systems have been reinforced to prevent and respond to violence and harmful practices.
Kiswahili: Maeneo salama kwa wanawake na wasichana yameanzishwa na kuimarishwa, huku mifumo ya kijamii ikiimarishwa ili kuzuia na kukabiliana na vurugu na vitendo vyenye madhara.

English: Support from Japanese company Panasonic Corporation has also contributed to the distribution of 500 solar lanterns to households without connection to electricity.
Kiswahili: Usaidizi kutoka kwa kampuni ya Japani Panasonic Corporation pia umechangia katika usambazaji wa taa 500 za nishati ya jua kwa kaya zisizo na umeme.

English: “The partnership with UNFPA and the County Government of Turkana reflects Japan’s unwavering commitment to safeguarding the health, rights, and dignity of women and girls, especially in times of crisis,” said H.E.
Kiswahili: "Ushirikiano na UNFPA na Serikali ya Kaunti ya Turkana unaonyesha dhamira isiyoyumba ya Japani ya kulinda afya, haki, na utu wa wanawake na wasichana, hasa wakati wa mgogoro," alisema Mhe.

English: “We are encouraged to see Japan’s support continue to deliver impact and build resilience within communities.” The delegation met with Deputy Governor Turkana County, H.E.
Kiswahili: "Tunatiwa moyo kuona usaidizi wa Japani ukiendelea kutoa athari na kujenga ustahimilivu ndani ya jamii." Ujumbe huo ulikutana na Naibu Gavana Kaunti ya Turkana, M.E.

English: Dr. John Lopeyok Erus, who expressed gratitude to the Government of Japan for the continued investment towards social protection and health initiatives in the county.
Kiswahili: Dkt. John Lopeyok Erus, ambaye alitoa shukrani kwa Serikali ya Japani kwa uwekezaji unaoendelea kuelekea mipango ya ulinzi wa kijamii na afya katika kaunti hiyo.

English: “We believe direct support to the county government in integrated service delivery is key, and we are optimistic that we can continue to build on the relationship between Kenya and Japan.‘ As climate change intensifies and humanitarian needs grow, Japan and UNFPA are placing increased emphasis on resilience and sustainability.
Kiswahili: "Tunaamini usaidizi wa moja kwa moja kwa serikali ya kaunti katika utoaji wa huduma jumuishi ni muhimu, na tuna matumaini kwamba tunaweza kuendelea kujenga uhusiano kati ya Kenya na Japani." Kadri mabadiliko ya tabianchi yanavyozidi kuongezeka na mahitaji ya kibinadamu yanavyoongezeka, Japani na UNFPA zinaweka msisitizo zaidi katika ustahimilivu na uendelevu.

English: Support has been provided to the Turkana County Government to integrate sexual and reproductive health and gender-based violence services into disaster preparedness and response systems, ensuring continuity of care during emergencies.
Kiswahili: Usaidizi umetolewa kwa Serikali ya Kaunti ya Turkana ili kuunganisha huduma za afya ya ngono na uzazi na ukatili wa kijinsia katika mifumo ya kujiandaa na kukabiliana na majanga, na kuhakikisha huduma endelevu wakati wa dharura.

English: UNFPA is also working closely with partners, including UNHCR, Kenya Red Cross Society, International Rescue Committee, and Peace Winds Japan, in supporting refugee and host communities living in Kakuma and Kalobeyei.
Kiswahili: UNFPA pia inafanya kazi kwa karibu na washirika, ikiwa ni pamoja na UNHCR, Chama cha Msalaba Mwekundu cha Kenya, Kamati ya Kimataifa ya Uokoaji, na Peace Winds Japan, katika kuwasaidia wakimbizi na jamii zinazowahifadhi wanaoishi Kakuma na Kalobeyei.

English: Looking ahead, additional funding from the Government of Japan in 2026 will support the delivery of integrated sexual and reproductive health and gender-based violence services in Kakuma and Dadaab municipalities, reaching both refugee and host communities.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuangalia mbele, ufadhili wa ziada kutoka Serikali ya Japani mwaka wa 2026 utasaidia utoaji wa huduma jumuishi za afya ya ngono na uzazi na unyanyasaji wa kijinsia katika manispaa za Kakuma na Dadaab, na kuzifikia jamii za wakimbizi na wenyeji.

English: “Japan’s support has enabled us to strengthen health and social protection systems for long-term impact,” said Dr. Pilar de la Corte Molina, UNFPA Deputy Representative and Officer in Charge in Kenya.
Kiswahili: "Usaidizi wa Japani umetuwezesha kuimarisha mifumo ya afya na ulinzi wa kijamii kwa athari ya muda mrefu," alisema Dkt. Pilar de la Corte Molina, Naibu Mwakilishi wa UNFPA na Afisa Mkuu nchini Kenya.

English: “As Kenya advances the Shirika Plan, UNFPA remains committed to working with the Government and partners to ensure equitable access to quality sexual and reproductive health and protection services for all.”
Kiswahili: "Kadri Kenya inavyoendelea na Mpango wa Shirika, UNFPA inabaki imejitolea kufanya kazi na Serikali na washirika ili kuhakikisha upatikanaji sawa wa huduma bora za afya ya ngono na uzazi na ulinzi kwa wote."

English: UNFPA's work on improving sexual and reproductive health is a key effort towards achieving Sustainable Development Goal 3, which calls for good health and well-being.
Kiswahili: Kazi ya UNFPA kuhusu kuboresha afya ya ngono na uzazi ni juhudi muhimu kuelekea kufikia Lengo la 3 la Maendeleo Endelevu, ambalo linahitaji afya njema na ustawi.

English: It also advances Goal 5, which calls for gender equality, as well as many of the other goals included in the 2030 Agenda.
Kiswahili: Pia inaendeleza Lengo la 5, ambalo linatoa wito wa usawa wa kijinsia, pamoja na malengo mengine mengi yaliyojumuishwa katika Ajenda ya 2030.

English: UNFPA works with the government, other UN agencies, civil society, and donors to develop comprehensive efforts to ensure universal access to sexual and reproductive health care.
Kiswahili: UNFPA inafanya kazi na serikali, mashirika mengine ya Umoja wa Mataifa, asasi za kiraia, na wafadhili ili kuendeleza juhudi kamili za kuhakikisha upatikanaji wa huduma za afya ya ngono na uzazi kwa wote.

English: We advocate for integrating the delivery of these services into primary health care, so it is as accessible as possible.
Kiswahili: Tunatetea ujumuishaji wa utoaji wa huduma hizi katika huduma ya afya ya msingi, ili iweze kupatikana kwa urahisi iwezekanavyo.

English: This means, for instance, that a woman could address her family planning, antenatal care, HIV testing, and general health needs all in one place.
Kiswahili: Hii ina maana, kwa mfano, kwamba mwanamke anaweza kushughulikia masuala yake ya uzazi wa mpango, huduma za ujauzito, upimaji wa VVU, na mahitaji ya afya kwa ujumla yote katika sehemu moja.

English: We additionally work with governments and communities to strengthen health systems, including supporting the implementation of reproductive health programmes, improving the quality of reproductive health care, and strengthening human resources.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo tunafanya kazi na serikali na jamii ili kuimarisha mifumo ya afya, ikiwa ni pamoja na kusaidia utekelezaji wa programu za afya ya uzazi, kuboresha ubora wa huduma ya afya ya uzazi, na kuimarisha rasilimali watu.

English: UNFPA also works to make sure reproductive health commodities are available where needed, and that a functioning logistics system is in place.
Kiswahili: UNFPA pia inafanya kazi kuhakikisha bidhaa za afya ya uzazi zinapatikana inapohitajika, na kwamba mfumo wa vifaa unaofanya kazi upo.

English: The Maternal Health Thematic Fund and UNFPA Supplies are just two examples of UNFPA’s work in strengthening health systems and quality services.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Mada ya Afya ya Mama na UNFPA Supplies ni mifano miwili tu ya kazi ya UNFPA katika kuimarisha mifumo ya afya na huduma bora.

English: While strengthening national systems, UNFPA also puts special emphasis on increasing access for disadvantaged groups, including young people, the urban poor, rural communities, indigenous populations, and women and girls with disabilities.
Kiswahili: Huku ikiimarisha mifumo ya kitaifa, UNFPA pia inaweka msisitizo maalum katika kuongeza ufikiaji kwa makundi yaliyo katika mazingira magumu, ikiwa ni pamoja na vijana, maskini wa mijini, jamii za vijijini, watu wa kiasili, na wanawake na wasichana wenye ulemavu.

English: Key aspects of UNFPA's work in Kenya include: Strengthening reproductive health services We support improving reproductive health services, ensuring that women have access to services that can help them have a healthy pregnancy, safe delivery, and a healthy baby.
Kiswahili: Vipengele muhimu vya kazi ya UNFPA nchini Kenya ni pamoja na: Kuimarisha huduma za afya ya uzazi Tunaunga mkono uboreshaji wa huduma za afya ya uzazi, kuhakikisha kwamba wanawake wanapata huduma zinazoweza kuwasaidia kupata ujauzito wenye afya, kujifungua salama, na mtoto mwenye afya njema.

English: Improving supply chains for contraceptives We work to ensure the availability and accessibility of safe and effective contraceptive methods for individuals to make informed choices about their sexual and reproductive health.
Kiswahili: Kuboresha minyororo ya usambazaji wa dawa za kuzuia mimba Tunafanya kazi ili kuhakikisha upatikanaji na upatikanaji wa njia salama na bora za kuzuia mimba kwa watu binafsi kufanya maamuzi sahihi kuhusu afya yao ya ngono na uzazi.

English: This is meant to strengthen reproductive health commodity security, focusing on supply-chain management and last-mile assurance.
Kiswahili: Hii inalenga kuimarisha usalama wa bidhaa za afya ya uzazi, ikizingatia usimamizi wa mnyororo wa ugavi na uhakikisho wa mwisho.

English: Advocacy against gender-based violence We engage in advocacy efforts to prevent and address gender-based violence, ensuring that individuals are informed and empowered to protect themselves from sexually transmitted infections.
Kiswahili: Utetezi dhidi ya ukatili wa kijinsia Tunashiriki katika juhudi za utetezi ili kuzuia na kushughulikia ukatili wa kijinsia, kuhakikisha kwamba watu binafsi wanaarifiwa na kuwezeshwa kujikinga na magonjwa ya zinaa.

English: We additionally scale up services to address GBV and harmful practices, including referral mechanisms, mental health, and psychosocial support, through a life-course approach.
Kiswahili: Pia tunaongeza huduma ili kushughulikia GBV na desturi zenye madhara, ikiwa ni pamoja na mifumo ya rufaa, afya ya akili, na usaidizi wa kisaikolojia, kupitia mbinu ya maisha.

English: Adolescent sexual and reproductive health We focus on addressing the challenges faced by adolescent girls and the youth, such as lack of information about sexual and reproductive health, teen pregnancy, and new HIV infections.
Kiswahili: Afya ya ngono na uzazi kwa vijana Tunalenga kushughulikia changamoto zinazowakabili wasichana na vijana, kama vile ukosefu wa taarifa kuhusu afya ya ngono na uzazi, mimba za vijana, na maambukizi mapya ya VVU.

English: UNFPA recently launched a $10.1 million Adolescent Sexual and Reproductive Health Development Impact Bond (ASRH DIB) to fund the delivery of high-quality, adolescent, and youth-friendly sexual and reproductive health services in ten counties.
Kiswahili: Hivi majuzi UNFPA ilizindua Dhamana ya Athari ya Maendeleo ya Afya ya Ngono na Uzazi kwa Vijana (ASRH DIB) yenye thamani ya dola milioni 10.1 ili kufadhili utoaji wa huduma bora za afya ya ngono na uzazi kwa vijana, zinazowafaa vijana, na zinazowafaa vijana katika kaunti kumi.

English: We additionally advocate for comprehensive sexuality education and the elimination of harmful practices that affect the sexual and reproductive health of young individuals.
Kiswahili: Pia tunatetea elimu kamili ya ngono na kuondolewa kwa desturi hatari zinazoathiri afya ya ngono na uzazi ya vijana.

English: Integrating sexual and reproductive health services within Universal Health Coverage UNFPA supports the government of Kenya in integrating sexual and reproductive health services within Universal Health Coverage, aiming to improve access to priority services and minimize the incidence of STIs, HIV, and other reproductive health issues.
Kiswahili: Kuunganisha huduma za afya ya uzazi ndani ya Bima ya Afya kwa Wote UNFPA inaunga mkono serikali ya Kenya katika kuunganisha huduma za afya ya uzazi ndani ya Bima ya Afya kwa Wote, ikilenga kuboresha upatikanaji wa huduma za kipaumbele na kupunguza matukio ya magonjwa ya zinaa, VVU, na masuala mengine ya afya ya uzazi.

English: Strengthening of national and county capacity to plan and deliver the Minimum Initial Service Package for reproductive health This is to contribute to building national capacity to mainstream SRH and GBV interventions in climate change, conflict resolution, and peacebuilding strategies; and scale-up of comprehensive and high-impact interventions for SRH, HIV, and GBV integration and prevention of HIV and sexually transmitted infections.
Kiswahili: Kuimarisha uwezo wa kitaifa na kaunti kupanga na kutoa Kifurushi cha Huduma ya Awali ya Chini kwa afya ya uzazi. Hii ni kuchangia katika kujenga uwezo wa kitaifa wa kuingiza hatua za SRH na GBV katika mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa, utatuzi wa migogoro, na mikakati ya kujenga amani; na kuongeza hatua za kina na zenye athari kubwa kwa ajili ya ujumuishaji na kinga ya SRH, VVU, na GBV.

English: Community Engagement Our community-based programs encourage active participation, fostering a supportive environment for sexual and reproductive health discussions.
Kiswahili: Ushirikishwaji wa Jamii Programu zetu zinazotegemea jamii zinahimiza ushiriki hai, na kukuza mazingira ya usaidizi kwa mijadala ya afya ya ngono na uzazi.

English: Through community engagement, we aim to reduce stigma, improve awareness, and promote positive health-seeking behaviors.
Kiswahili: Kupitia ushirikishwaji wa jamii, tunalenga kupunguza unyanyapaa, kuboresha uelewa, na kukuza tabia chanya za kutafuta afya.

English: For many adolescents and young people living in Kenya’s largest informal settlement, Kibera, access to stigma-free sexual and reproductive health services can often prove challenging.
Kiswahili: Kwa vijana wengi wanaoishi katika makazi yasiyo rasmi makubwa zaidi nchini Kenya, Kibera, upatikanaji wa huduma za afya ya ngono na uzazi zisizo na unyanyapaa mara nyingi unaweza kuwa changamoto.

English: “Many young people tell us that they enter health facilities and find only older healthcare workers, and this makes them uncomfortable and reluctant to share their concerns,” says Vincent Muinde, a youth advocate and member of the ICPD25 Youth Coalition in Kenya.
Kiswahili: "Vijana wengi hutuambia kwamba huingia katika vituo vya afya na kupata wafanyakazi wa afya wazee pekee, na hii inawafanya wasiwe na raha na kusita kushiriki wasiwasi wao," anasema Vincent Muinde, mtetezi wa vijana na mwanachama wa Muungano wa Vijana wa ICPD25 nchini Kenya.

English: This fear of stigma can delay access to life-saving reproductive health information and care as young people may hesitate to ask questions, especially when they involve contraception, HIV, or gender-based violence.
Kiswahili: Hofu hii ya unyanyapaa inaweza kuchelewesha upatikanaji wa taarifa na huduma za afya ya uzazi zinazookoa maisha kwani vijana wanaweza kusita kuuliza maswali, hasa yanapohusisha uzazi wa mpango, VVU, au unyanyasaji wa kijinsia.

English: The frontline: Where Judgment dies, and Respect begins Healthcare workers at the Kibera Community Health Centre are striving to combat the stigma keeping adolescents and youth away from this much-needed care.
Kiswahili: Mstari wa mbele: Ambapo Hukumu Inakufa, na Heshima Inaanza Wafanyakazi wa afya katika Kituo cha Afya cha Jumuiya ya Kibera wanajitahidi kupambana na unyanyapaa unaowaweka vijana na vijana mbali na huduma hii inayohitajika sana.

English: With support from 2gether 4 SRHR, a joint UN regional programme implemented by UNAIDS, UNFPA, UNICEF and WHO, and funded by the Government of Sweden, the centre provides integrated sexual and reproductive health, HIV, and gender-based violence services tailored to meet the unique needs of young people.
Kiswahili: Kwa usaidizi kutoka kwa 2gether 4 SRHR, mpango wa pamoja wa kikanda wa Umoja wa Mataifa unaotekelezwa na UNAIDS, UNFPA, UNICEF na WHO, na kufadhiliwa na Serikali ya Uswidi, kituo hiki hutoa huduma jumuishi za afya ya ngono na uzazi, VVU, na unyanyasaji wa kijinsia zilizoundwa ili kukidhi mahitaji ya kipekee ya vijana.

English: “We have worked hard to ensure our facility is very youth-friendly,” explains Wilfred Liongo, the facility manager of Kibera Community Health Centre.
Kiswahili: "Tumefanya kazi kwa bidii kuhakikisha kituo chetu kinawafaa vijana sana," anaelezea Wilfred Liongo, meneja wa kituo cha Kituo cha Afya cha Jamii cha Kibera.

English: “ For example, we do not allow young people to queue as we understand that they can be impatient and may feel uncomfortable waiting.” Wilfred describes the facility’s new approach to countering access barriers, which begins right when a young person arrives at the facility’s gates.
Kiswahili: "Kwa mfano, hatuwaruhusu vijana kupanga foleni kwani tunaelewa kwamba wanaweza kuwa na subira na wanaweza kuhisi wasiwasi kusubiri." Wilfred anaelezea mbinu mpya ya kituo cha kukabiliana na vikwazo vya ufikiaji, ambayo huanza mara tu kijana anapofika kwenye malango ya kituo.

English: Once identified, they are fast-tracked through registration, referred to clinicians in private rooms, and supported with free services where possible.
Kiswahili: Mara tu wanapotambuliwa, huharakishwa kupitia usajili, hupelekwa kwa madaktari katika vyumba vya faragha, na kusaidiwa na huduma za bure inapowezekana.

English: He adds that the clinic has also adapted to the economic realities faced by young people in informal settlements when it comes to healthcare affordability.
Kiswahili: Anaongeza kuwa kliniki hiyo pia imezoea hali halisi ya kiuchumi inayowakabili vijana katika makazi yasiyo rasmi linapokuja suala la gharama nafuu ya huduma ya afya.

English: “Most young people do not have identification cards, which makes it hard to sign up for the national Social Health Insurance Fund (SHIF) program.
Kiswahili: "Vijana wengi hawana vitambulisho, jambo linalofanya iwe vigumu kujiandikisha kwa mpango wa kitaifa wa Bima ya Afya ya Jamii (SHIF).

English: Therefore, we have adopted a policy of providing services free of charge regardless of their status.” Yet even the best services can fail if healthcare workers unconsciously judge.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo, tumepitisha sera ya kutoa huduma bila malipo bila kujali hali zao.” Hata hivyo, hata huduma bora zaidi zinaweza kushindwa ikiwa wafanyakazi wa afya bila kujua wanahukumu.

English: That is why training has been central to the programme’s impact.
Kiswahili: Ndiyo maana mafunzo yamekuwa muhimu kwa athari za programu.

English: “Our healthcare providers have been empowered through training on how to provide youth-friendly services,” Wilfred says.
Kiswahili: "Watoa huduma zetu za afya wamewezeshwa kupitia mafunzo ya jinsi ya kutoa huduma rafiki kwa vijana," Wilfred anasema.

English: “These sessions have changed attitudes and improved our ability to offer respectful care.” Michelle’s testimony: Finding a voice in a space meant for listening For 18-year-old Michelle Nafula, the health center has become a safe space that offers information, opportunity, and much-needed care.
Kiswahili: "Vipindi hivi vimebadilisha mitazamo na kuboresha uwezo wetu wa kutoa huduma ya heshima." Ushuhuda wa Michelle: Kupata sauti katika nafasi iliyokusudiwa kusikiliza Kwa Michelle Nafula mwenye umri wa miaka 18, kituo cha afya kimekuwa nafasi salama inayotoa taarifa, fursa, na huduma inayohitajika sana.

English: “I visit the hospital for check-ups and treatment, and sometimes I come here to use the Wi‑Fi, especially for school-related research,” she says.
Kiswahili: "Ninatembelea hospitali kwa ajili ya uchunguzi na matibabu, na wakati mwingine mimi huja hapa kutumia Wi-Fi, hasa kwa ajili ya utafiti unaohusiana na shule," anasema.

English: Michelle has also attended youth awareness sessions that provide practical knowledge on sexual and reproductive health.
Kiswahili: Michelle pia amehudhuria vikao vya uhamasishaji wa vijana vinavyotoa maarifa ya vitendo kuhusu afya ya ngono na uzazi.

English: “I attended a session where we discussed family planning, HIV, contraceptives, and how PrEP and PEP work.” Michelle observes that more young people are seeking family planning services now than before, and she believes training and outreach efforts have helped change what young people believe is possible.
Kiswahili: "Nilihudhuria kikao ambapo tulijadili uzazi wa mpango, VVU, njia za uzazi wa mpango, na jinsi PrEP na PEP zinavyofanya kazi." Michelle anaona kwamba vijana wengi zaidi wanatafuta huduma za uzazi wa mpango sasa kuliko hapo awali, na anaamini mafunzo na juhudi za kuwafikia zimesaidia kubadilisha kile ambacho vijana wanaamini kinawezekana.

English: Inspired by what she learned at the center, she has now become a peer educator, reaching more girls in her community.
Kiswahili: Akiwa amehamasishwa na kile alichojifunza katika kituo hicho, sasa amekuwa mwalimu rika, akiwafikia wasichana wengi zaidi katika jamii yake.

English: She describes how girls, especially those aged 12 to 16, feel safe enough to speak with her on topics they are afraid to breach to adults.
Kiswahili: Anaelezea jinsi wasichana, hasa wale wenye umri wa miaka 12 hadi 16, wanavyojisikia salama vya kutosha kuzungumza naye kuhusu mada wanazoogopa kuzivunja kwa watu wazima.

English: They come to her with fears, questions, and problems that adolescents face but are often afraid to seek help for.
Kiswahili: Wanamjia na hofu, maswali, na matatizo ambayo vijana wanakabiliana nayo lakini mara nyingi wanaogopa kutafuta msaada.

English: “They are very open with me, and sometimes they ask me to speak to their parents on their behalf,” Michelle says.
Kiswahili: "Wako wazi sana kwangu, na wakati mwingine huniomba nizungumze na wazazi wao kwa niaba yao," Michelle anasema.

English: The advocate’s link: From clinic doors to the policy tables that shape them During the Nairobi Summit on ICPD25, Kenya made commitments aimed at safeguarding the health and well-being of adolescents and youth, including the elimination of teenage pregnancies, new adolescent and youth HIV infections and harmful practices such as child marriages.
Kiswahili: Kiungo cha mtetezi: Kuanzia milango ya kliniki hadi meza za sera zinazowaunda Wakati wa Mkutano wa Nairobi kuhusu ICPD25, Kenya ilitoa ahadi zenye lengo la kulinda afya na ustawi wa vijana na vijana, ikiwa ni pamoja na kuondoa mimba za vijana, maambukizi mapya ya VVU kwa vijana na vijana na desturi zenye madhara kama vile ndoa za utotoni.

English: The country also committed to ensuring universal access to friendly, quality reproductive health services and information to the youth and adolescents by 2030.
Kiswahili: Nchi pia imejitolea kuhakikisha upatikanaji wa huduma rafiki na bora za afya ya uzazi na taarifa kwa vijana na vijana ifikapo mwaka 2030.

English: The ICPD25 youth coalition keeps a scorecard that tracks Kenya’s progress towards the implementation of these commitments, ensuring accountability at policy level.
Kiswahili: Muungano wa vijana wa ICPD25 unaweka alama inayofuatilia maendeleo ya Kenya kuelekea utekelezaji wa ahadi hizi, na kuhakikisha uwajibikaji katika ngazi ya sera.

English: “One of our recurring recommendations from the ICPD25 youth scorecard is that youth-friendly health facilities should strive to have peer workers or young professionals who create a safe and welcoming environment,” says Muinde.
Kiswahili: "Mojawapo ya mapendekezo yetu yanayojirudia kutoka kwa kadi ya alama ya vijana ya ICPD25 ni kwamba vituo vya afya vinavyowafaa vijana vinapaswa kujitahidi kuwa na wafanyakazi wenzao au wataalamu vijana wanaounda mazingira salama na ya kukaribisha," anasema Muinde.

English: Under the 2gether 4 SRHR initiative, young people are also empowered to shape the quality of care through various feedback mechanisms, including service quality assessments.
Kiswahili: Chini ya mpango wa 2gether 4 SRHR, vijana pia wamewezeshwa kuunda ubora wa huduma kupitia mifumo mbalimbali ya maoni, ikiwa ni pamoja na tathmini za ubora wa huduma.

English: This ensures that young people’s voices are not only heard, but used to improve care.
Kiswahili: Hii inahakikisha kwamba sauti za vijana hazisikiki tu, bali pia zinatumika kuboresha huduma.

English: “Nothing for the youth without the youth,” Vincent emphasizes.
Kiswahili: "Hakuna kitu kwa vijana bila vijana," Vincent anasisitiza.

English: A collaborative United Nations team, comprising UNFPA, WHO, UNAIDS, the UN Resident Coordinator's Office, and the UN SDG Partnership Platform (SDG PP), has partnered with Triggerise, a nonprofit implementing organisation, to address the challenges of adolescent pregnancy, new HIV infections, and AIDS-related deaths among adolescent girls in high-burden counties in Kenya.
Kiswahili: Timu shirikishi ya Umoja wa Mataifa, inayojumuisha UNFPA, WHO, UNAIDS, Ofisi ya Mratibu Mkazi wa Umoja wa Mataifa, na Jukwaa la Ubia la SDG la Umoja wa Mataifa (SDG PP), imeshirikiana na Triggerise, shirika lisilo la faida linalotekeleza, kushughulikia changamoto za mimba za vijana, maambukizi mapya ya VVU, na vifo vinavyohusiana na UKIMWI miongoni mwa wasichana vijana katika kaunti zenye mzigo mkubwa nchini Kenya.

English: This initiative aims to mobilise private and public sector financing through the use of a development impact bond (DIB) to improve adolescent health outcomes.
Kiswahili: Mpango huu unalenga kuhamasisha ufadhili wa sekta binafsi na umma kupitia matumizi ya dhamana ya athari za maendeleo (DIB) ili kuboresha matokeo ya afya ya vijana.

English: Bridges Outcomes Partnerships is providing upfront funding and support to Triggerise to enable the delivery of high-quality, youth-friendly SRH services, including HIV testing and treatment, to adolescent girls aged 15-19.
Kiswahili: Bridges Outcomes Partnerships inatoa ufadhili wa awali na usaidizi kwa Triggerise ili kuwezesha utoaji wa huduma bora na rafiki kwa vijana kuhusu afya ya uzazi, ikiwa ni pamoja na upimaji na matibabu ya VVU, kwa wasichana vijana wenye umri wa miaka 15-19.

English: The Pooling Facility has raised $9.9m to repay the upfront funding only when specific outcomes linked to the improvement of adolescent health are achieved.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Kuogelea kimekusanya dola milioni 9.9 ili kulipa ufadhili wa awali pale tu matokeo maalum yanayohusiana na uboreshaji wa afya ya vijana yatakapopatikana.

English: The project will be implemented in ten counties across Kenya: Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu, Homa Bay, Bungoma, Migori, Kisii, Nyamira, Kakamega, and Busia, all of which experience a significant burden of adolescent pregnancy and HIV.
Kiswahili: Mradi huu utatekelezwa katika kaunti kumi kote Kenya: Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu, Homa Bay, Bungoma, Migori, Kisii, Nyamira, Kakamega, na Busia, ambazo zote zinakabiliwa na mzigo mkubwa wa mimba za utotoni na VVU.

English: Henriette Geiger, Ambassador of the European Union to Kenya, H.E.
Kiswahili: Henriette Geiger, Balozi wa Umoja wa Ulaya nchini Kenya, Mhe.

English: Caitríona Ingoldsby, Ambassador of Ireland to Kenya, H.E.
Kiswahili: Caitríona Ingoldsby, Balozi wa Ireland nchini Kenya, H.E.

English: (“End FGM Now!”) Programme, which supports Kenya’s national commitment to eliminate FGM by 2026.
Kiswahili: (“Komesha Ukeketaji Sasa!”) Programu, ambayo inaunga mkono dhamira ya kitaifa ya Kenya ya kutokomeza Ukeketaji ifikapo mwaka 2026.

English: The delegation was joined by the Cabinet Secretary, Ministry of Gender, Culture, the Arts and Heritage, Hanna Wendot Cheptum, and Presidential Advisor on Women's Rights, Ms. Harriet Chiggai.
Kiswahili: Ujumbe huo uliambatana na Katibu wa Baraza la Mawaziri, Wizara ya Jinsia, Utamaduni, Sanaa na Urithi, Hanna Wendot Cheptum, na Mshauri wa Rais wa Haki za Wanawake, Bi. Harriet Chiggai.

English: The team met with Elgeyo Marakwet County Governor H.E.
Kiswahili: Timu hiyo ilikutana na Gavana wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo Marakwet M.E.

English: Wisley Kipyegon Rotich to discuss progress and challenges in FGM eradication efforts and explored ways of strengthening collaboration between county institutions, development partners, civil society organizations, and frontline activists, who are driving change at the grassroots level.
Kiswahili: Wisley Kipyegon Rotich kujadili maendeleo na changamoto katika juhudi za kutokomeza ukeketaji na kuchunguza njia za kuimarisha ushirikiano kati ya taasisi za kaunti, washirika wa maendeleo, mashirika ya kiraia, na wanaharakati wa mstari wa mbele, ambao wanasababisha mabadiliko katika ngazi ya chini.

English: Speaking during the visit, H.E.
Kiswahili: Akizungumza wakati wa ziara hiyo, Mhe.

English: Henriette Geiger emphasized the importance of sustained partnership and local ownership in ending FGM.
Kiswahili: Henriette Geiger alisisitiza umuhimu wa ushirikiano endelevu na umiliki wa ndani katika kukomesha ukeketaji.

English: “The elimination of FGM is about transforming lives and protecting the dignity and rights of girls.
Kiswahili: "Kutokomeza ukeketaji kunahusu kubadilisha maisha na kulinda utu na haki za wasichana."

English: When communities lead, and when they are supported consistently, real and lasting change is possible.
Kiswahili: Jamii zinapoongoza, na zinapoungwa mkono mara kwa mara, mabadiliko halisi na ya kudumu yanawezekana.

English: The European Union is proud to stand with Kenya in this journey toward a future free from FGM.” The Delegation visited various communities in Iten through the “Born Perfect Caravan,” where they participated in intergenerational dialogues and survivor-led awareness sessions.
Kiswahili: Umoja wa Ulaya unajivunia kusimama na Kenya katika safari hii kuelekea mustakabali usio na ukeketaji.” Ujumbe huo ulitembelea jamii mbalimbali huko Iten kupitia “Msafara Kamilifu wa Kuzaliwa,” ambapo walishiriki katika mijadala ya vizazi mbalimbali na vikao vya uhamasishaji vinavyoongozwa na manusura.

English: These platforms showcased how cultural leaders, men, youth, and survivors are working together to challenge harmful norms and publicly declare the abandonment of FGM.
Kiswahili: Majukwaa haya yalionyesha jinsi viongozi wa kitamaduni, wanaume, vijana, na manusura wanavyoshirikiana kupinga kanuni hatarishi na kutangaza hadharani kuachwa kwa ukeketaji.

English: “Kenya has made remarkable progress in reducing FGM prevalence nationally, but significant disparities remain in certain regions,” said UNFPA Acting Representative Dr. Pilar de la Corte Molina.
Kiswahili: "Kenya imepiga hatua kubwa katika kupunguza kiwango cha ukeketaji kitaifa, lakini tofauti kubwa bado zipo katika baadhi ya maeneo," alisema Kaimu Mwakilishi wa UNFPA Dkt. Pilar de la Corte Molina.

English: “This visit reaffirms that when prevention, protection, and community engagement move forward together, we can transform the deeply rooted norms that continue to drive this harmful practice.” The Delegation also visited athletes’ training camps to discuss ongoing safeguarding initiatives aimed at preventing gender-based violence and sexual exploitation, and abuse within sports environments.
Kiswahili: "Ziara hii inathibitisha kwamba wakati kinga, ulinzi, na ushirikishwaji wa jamii vinaposonga mbele pamoja, tunaweza kubadilisha kanuni zilizokita mizizi ambazo zinaendelea kuendesha tabia hii mbaya." Ujumbe huo pia ulitembelea kambi za mafunzo za wanariadha ili kujadili mipango inayoendelea ya ulinzi inayolenga kuzuia ukatili wa kijinsia na unyonyaji wa kingono, na unyanyasaji ndani ya mazingira ya michezo.

English: These efforts are strengthening accountability, promoting ethical conduct, and creating safer spaces for young athletes.
Kiswahili: Jitihada hizi zinaimarisha uwajibikaji, kukuza mwenendo wa kimaadili, na kuunda nafasi salama kwa wanariadha wachanga.

English: “Gender based violence and femicide are a national problem which the government is committed to addressing through coordinated action.
Kiswahili: "Unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na mauaji ya wanawake ni tatizo la kitaifa ambalo serikali imejitolea kulishughulikia kupitia hatua zilizoratibiwa."

English: We thank our development partners for the support in eliminating this crime, and urge Kenyans to speak up and report incidences of GBV to the relevant authorities,” said Hanna Wendot Cheptum, Cabinet Secretary, Ministry of Gender, Culture, the Arts and Heritage.

English: Programme, funded by the European Union with a budget of KES 616 million (EUR 4 million) and implemented by UNFPA in partnership with national and county governments and civil society organizations, targets seven high-prevalence counties, including Garissa, Marsabit, Wajir, Isiolo, Elgeyo Marakwet, Tharaka Nithi, and West Pokot.
Kiswahili: Programu hiyo, inayofadhiliwa na Umoja wa Ulaya kwa bajeti ya shilingi milioni 616 (EUR milioni 4) na kutekelezwa na UNFPA kwa ushirikiano na serikali za kitaifa na za kaunti na mashirika ya kiraia, inalenga kaunti saba zenye idadi kubwa ya watu, ikiwa ni pamoja na Garissa, Marsabit, Wajir, Isiolo, Elgeyo Marakwet, Tharaka Nithi, na Pokot Magharibi.

English: The project is part of the European Union’s broader support to Kenya on gender equality and the protection of women and girls, complementing long-standing investments through the UNFPA-UNICEF Joint Programme on the Elimination of FGM.
Kiswahili: Mradi huu ni sehemu ya usaidizi mpana wa Umoja wa Ulaya kwa Kenya kuhusu usawa wa kijinsia na ulinzi wa wanawake na wasichana, ukikamilisha uwekezaji wa muda mrefu kupitia Mpango wa Pamoja wa UNFPA-UNICEF kuhusu Kutokomeza Ukeketaji.

English: The European Union and UNFPA called on all partners to maintain momentum and deepen collaboration to protect the rights, health, and futures of girls across Kenya.

English: Nairobi, 2 April 2026 –UNFPA, the United Nations Population Fund, and Britam Foundation today signed a Memorandum of Understanding to strengthen efforts towards reducing preventable maternal and newborn mortality in marginalized and vulnerable communities in Kwale and Nairobi counties.
Kiswahili: Nairobi, 2 Aprili 2026 –UNFPA, Shirika la Idadi ya Watu la Umoja wa Mataifa, na Wakfu wa Britam leo wamesaini Mkataba wa Makubaliano ili kuimarisha juhudi za kupunguza vifo vya akina mama na watoto wachanga vinavyoweza kuzuilika katika jamii zilizotengwa na zilizo hatarini katika kaunti za Kwale na Nairobi.

English: The collaboration will scale the Lea Salama Programme, a transformative initiative designed to expand access to life-saving care for pregnant women and newborns, particularly in underserved rural areas and urban informal settlements where inequities in health access remain most pronounced.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano huo utaongeza kasi ya Programu ya Lea Salama, mpango wa mabadiliko ulioundwa kupanua upatikanaji wa huduma za kuokoa maisha kwa wanawake wajawazito na watoto wachanga, hasa katika maeneo ya vijijini yasiyohudumiwa vya kutosha na makazi yasiyo rasmi ya mijini ambapo ukosefu wa usawa katika upatikanaji wa huduma za afya unabaki kuwa dhahiri zaidi.

English: Despite notable progress in strengthening maternal health services, Kenya continues to face a critical and urgent challenge: an estimated 15 mothers and 92 newborns die each day from preventable causes.
Kiswahili: Licha ya maendeleo makubwa katika kuimarisha huduma za afya ya uzazi, Kenya inaendelea kukabiliwa na changamoto muhimu na ya dharura: inakadiriwa kuwa akina mama 15 na watoto wachanga 92 hufa kila siku kutokana na sababu zinazoweza kuzuilika.

English: The national maternal mortality ratio remains high at 355 deaths per 100,000 live births, with counties such as Kwale recording an even higher rate of 431 per 100,000.
Kiswahili: Uwiano wa vifo vya akina mama kitaifa unabaki juu kwa vifo 355 kwa kila watoto 100,000 wanaozaliwa wakiwa hai, huku kaunti kama vile Kwale zikirekodi kiwango cha juu zaidi cha vifo 431 kwa kila watoto 100,000.

English: While Nairobi shows comparatively better outcomes, deep inequalities persist in low-income, densely populated communities, where access to timely, quality care remains limited.
Kiswahili: Ingawa Nairobi inaonyesha matokeo bora zaidi, ukosefu wa usawa mkubwa unaendelea katika jamii zenye kipato cha chini na zenye watu wengi, ambapo upatikanaji wa huduma bora na kwa wakati unabaki mdogo.

English: Persistent gaps, particularly in emergency obstetric and newborn services, continue to cost lives.
Kiswahili: Mapengo yanayoendelea, hasa katika huduma za dharura za uzazi na watoto wachanga, yanaendelea kugharimu maisha.

English: The new partnership directly responds to these challenges by strengthening County health systems while simultaneously increasing demand for essential maternal and newborn health services.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano mpya unajibu moja kwa moja changamoto hizi kwa kuimarisha mifumo ya afya ya Kaunti huku ukiongeza mahitaji ya huduma muhimu za afya ya mama na mtoto mchanga.

English: Under the initiative, 20 high-volume health facilities across Kwale and Nairobi will be upgraded and equipped to deliver quality maternal and newborn care.
Kiswahili: Chini ya mpango huo, vituo 20 vya afya vyenye ujazo mkubwa kote Kwale na Nairobi vitaboreshwa na kuwezeshwa ili kutoa huduma bora ya uzazi na watoto wachanga.

English: Healthcare workers will receive specialized training and mentorship in emergency obstetric and newborn care, complemented by the scale-up of innovative technologies, such as obstetric point-of-care ultrasound, to enhance the early detection and management of pregnancy-related complications.
Kiswahili: Wafanyakazi wa afya watapata mafunzo na ushauri maalum katika huduma ya dharura ya uzazi na watoto wachanga, ikikamilishwa na upanuzi wa teknolojia bunifu, kama vile ultrasound ya sehemu ya uzazi, ili kuboresha ugunduzi na usimamizi wa mapema wa matatizo yanayohusiana na ujauzito.

English: “This strategic partnership between UNFPA and the Britam Foundation reflects a shared commitment to improving maternal and newborn health outcomes in Kenya,” said Dr. Pilar de la Corte Molina, UNFPA Deputy Representative to Kenya and Officer in Charge.
Kiswahili: "Ushirikiano huu wa kimkakati kati ya UNFPA na Wakfu wa Britam unaonyesha kujitolea kwa pamoja katika kuboresha matokeo ya afya ya mama na mtoto mchanga nchini Kenya," alisema Dkt. Pilar de la Corte Molina, Naibu Mwakilishi wa UNFPA nchini Kenya na Afisa Mkuu.

English: When a mother survives childbirth, and a newborn thrives, we are not just saving lives; we are strengthening families, empowering communities, and shaping a more resilient society for generations to come,” said Catherine Karita, the Executive Director, Britam Foundation.
Kiswahili: Mama anaponusurika kujifungua, na mtoto mchanga anapostawi, hatuokoi tu maisha; tunaimarisha familia, tunawezesha jamii, na kuunda jamii imara zaidi kwa vizazi vijavyo,” alisema Catherine Karita, Mkurugenzi Mtendaji, Britam Foundation.

English: The Lea Salama programme is designed as a scalable model with the potential for expansion to other counties, offering a practical blueprint for how public-private partnerships can accelerate progress in maternal and newborn health across Kenya.
Kiswahili: Programu ya Lea Salama imeundwa kama mfumo unaoweza kupanuliwa na uwezekano wa kupanuka hadi kaunti zingine, ikitoa mwongozo wa vitendo wa jinsi ushirikiano wa umma na binafsi unavyoweza kuharakisha maendeleo katika afya ya mama na mtoto mchanga kote Kenya.
