English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, joined His Excellency the President, Dr. William Samoei Ruto, at the groundbreaking ceremony for student hostels at Pwani University.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alijiunga na Mheshimiwa Rais, Dkt. William Samoei Ruto, katika sherehe ya uzinduzi wa hosteli za wanafunzi katika Chuo Kikuu cha Pwani.

English: The project will increase the accommodation capacity at Pwani University, thereby lowering costs and promoting student convenience as they pursue their studies.
Kiswahili: Mradi huo utaongeza uwezo wa malazi katika Chuo Kikuu cha Pwani, na hivyo kupunguza gharama na kukuza urahisi wa wanafunzi wanapoendelea na masomo yao.

English: Nikkita, a law student at Kabarak University, said HELB support has eased the financial burden on her family and allowed her to focus fully on her demanding law studies without constant financial stress.
Kiswahili: Nikkita, mwanafunzi wa sheria katika Chuo Kikuu cha Kabarak, alisema usaidizi wa HELB umepunguza mzigo wa kifedha kwa familia yake na kumruhusu kuzingatia kikamilifu masomo yake ya sheria yenye mahitaji bila msongo wa kifedha wa mara kwa mara.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, graced the Nyandarua High School Prize Giving Day in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alihudhuria Siku ya Kutoa Tuzo za Shule ya Upili ya Nyandarua katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.

English: Nyandarua High School, a mixed, national-level institution, is among the country's top-performing schools, with a rich history of academic and co-curricular performance.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Upili ya Nyandarua, taasisi mchanganyiko ya kitaifa, ni miongoni mwa shule zinazofanya vizuri zaidi nchini, zenye historia tajiri ya utendaji wa kitaaluma na wa pamoja wa masomo.

English: Other leaders in attendance were the Cabinet Secretary for Tourism and Wildlife, Rebecca Miano, and the Principal Secretary for Roads, Eng. Joseph Mbugua.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wengine waliohudhuria walikuwa Waziri wa Utalii na Wanyamapori, Rebecca Miano, na Katibu Mkuu wa Barabara, Mhandisi Joseph Mbugua.

English: The Government continues to take steps and measures to promote the welfare of teachers, including increasing teacher numbers to rationalize workloads, with a record 100,000 teachers employed in the last three years.
Kiswahili: Serikali inaendelea kuchukua hatua na hatua za kukuza ustawi wa walimu, ikiwa ni pamoja na kuongeza idadi ya walimu ili kuhalalisha mzigo wa kazi, huku rekodi ikiwa na walimu 100,000 walioajiriwa katika miaka mitatu iliyopita.

English: This has facilitated career progression and created an enabling environment for teacher performance.
Kiswahili: Hii imewezesha maendeleo ya kazi na kuunda mazingira wezeshi kwa utendaji wa walimu.

English: Our education thrives because of our teachers, who teach and inspire millions of learners in our educational institutions.
Kiswahili: Elimu yetu inastawi kwa sababu ya walimu wetu, ambao hufundisha na kuwatia moyo mamilioni ya wanafunzi katika taasisi zetu za elimu.

English: Teachers are the primary custodians of the resources and investments made in the education sector.
Kiswahili: Walimu ndio walinzi wakuu wa rasilimali na uwekezaji unaofanywa katika sekta ya elimu.

English: Higher education is about creating opportunities and making education work better for every student; the Principal Secretary for Higher Education, Dr. Beatrice Inyangala, explained how the Student-Centred Funding Model works, the changes made through student feedback, and what this means for learners.
Kiswahili: Elimu ya juu inahusu kuunda fursa na kufanya elimu ifanye kazi vizuri zaidi kwa kila mwanafunzi; Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu, Dkt. Beatrice Inyangala, alielezea jinsi Mfumo wa Ufadhili Unaozingatia Wanafunzi unavyofanya kazi, mabadiliko yanayofanywa kupitia maoni ya wanafunzi, na maana yake kwa wanafunzi.

English: Following the Utumishi Girls fire tragedy, the Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Ogamba, announced hotline number 1199 for parents to report information, especially those who left with their children when they came earlier, with the line also available for counselling.
Kiswahili: Kufuatia mkasa wa moto wa Utumishi Girls, Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Ogamba, alitangaza nambari ya simu 1199 kwa wazazi kuripoti taarifa, hasa wale walioondoka na watoto wao walipokuja mapema, huku simu hiyo pia ikipatikana kwa ajili ya ushauri nasaha.

English: The Madaraka Day Thematic Session Three, themed Education in Future: Shaping the Future through Education, Innovations and Opportunities, was held on 30 May 2026 at Wagberi Primary School.
Kiswahili: Kipindi cha Tatu cha Mada ya Siku ya Madaraka, chenye mada kuu Elimu katika Wakati Ujao: Kuunda Wakati Ujao Kupitia Elimu, Ubunifu na Fursa, kilifanyika tarehe 30 Mei 2026 katika Shule ya Msingi ya Wagberi.

English: The Principal Secretary for Higher Education, Dr. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, served as guest of honour, alongside vice-chancellors and university panelists from institutions including South Eastern Kenya University, Eldoret, Meru, MMUST, and Bomet.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu, Dkt. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, alihudumu kama mgeni wa heshima, pamoja na makamu wa machansela na wanajopo wa vyuo vikuu kutoka taasisi zikiwemo Chuo Kikuu cha Kusini Mashariki mwa Kenya, Eldoret, Meru, MMUST, na Bomet.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, toured Wajir High School, the oldest secondary school in Kenya's North Eastern Region.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alitembelea Shule ya Upili ya Wajir, shule ya upili kongwe zaidi katika Mkoa wa Kaskazini Mashariki mwa Kenya.

English: During the visit, he commended the school for its long-standing contribution to education in the region, noting its role in nurturing generations of learners and producing distinguished alumni.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa ziara hiyo, aliipongeza shule hiyo kwa mchango wake wa muda mrefu katika elimu katika eneo hilo, akibainisha jukumu lake katika kulea vizazi vya wanafunzi na kutoa wahitimu mashuhuri.

English: He urged the school community to maintain its commitment to academic excellence and discipline as it continues to shape future leaders.
Kiswahili: Aliwahimiza jamii ya shule kudumisha kujitolea kwake kwa ubora wa kitaaluma na nidhamu huku ikiendelea kuwaunda viongozi wa siku zijazo.

English: As Kenya celebrated its 63rd Madaraka Day, the Ministry noted that through TVET, youths and Kenyans at large are acquiring competencies to create, innovate, compete, drive industrial growth, and transform communities, under the theme Education, Skills and the Future - One Competence at a Time.
Kiswahili: Huku Kenya ikisherehekea Siku yake ya 63 ya Madaraka, Wizara ilibainisha kuwa kupitia TVET, vijana na Wakenya kwa ujumla wanapata ujuzi wa kuunda, kuvumbua, kushindana, kuendesha ukuaji wa viwanda, na kubadilisha jamii, chini ya mada Elimu, Ujuzi na Mustakabali - Uwezo Mmoja kwa Wakati.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, attended official bilateral discussions between Kenya and South Africa, under the joint chairmanship of President Dr. William Samoei Ruto and President Cyril Ramaphosa, covering cooperation, sports and culture, as well as gender equality and women empowerment.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alihudhuria mijadala rasmi ya pande mbili kati ya Kenya na Afrika Kusini, chini ya uenyekiti wa pamoja wa Rais Dkt. William Samoei Ruto na Rais Cyril Ramaphosa, ikizungumzia ushirikiano, michezo na utamaduni, pamoja na usawa wa kijinsia na uwezeshaji wa wanawake.

English: The Cabinet Secretary signed a Memorandum of Understanding for Cooperation in the Field of Technical and Vocational Education and Training between Kenya and South Africa.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Baraza la Mawaziri alisaini Mkataba wa Makubaliano ya Ushirikiano katika Nyanja ya Elimu na Mafunzo ya Ufundi na Ufundi kati ya Kenya na Afrika Kusini.

English: The MoU provides a platform for Kenya and South Africa to reset and deepen cooperation in the TVET sector through sharing best practices, undertaking joint research, and implementing staff and student exchanges.
Kiswahili: MoU hutoa jukwaa kwa Kenya na Afrika Kusini kuanzisha upya na kuimarisha ushirikiano katika sekta ya TVET kupitia kushiriki mbinu bora, kufanya utafiti wa pamoja, na kutekeleza ubadilishanaji wa wafanyakazi na wanafunzi.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, attended the Presidential Session of the Kenya-South Africa Business Forum in Midrand, South Africa, under the patronage of President Dr. William Samoei Ruto and President Cyril Ramaphosa.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alihudhuria Kikao cha Rais cha Jukwaa la Biashara la Kenya-Afrika Kusini huko Midrand, Afrika Kusini, chini ya ufadhili wa Rais Dkt. William Samoei Ruto na Rais Cyril Ramaphosa.

English: The Forum brought together Government officials and business leaders to reflect on the state of trade between the two countries and deliberate on strategies for enhancing bilateral and regional trade.
Kiswahili: Jukwaa hilo liliwakutanisha maafisa wa Serikali na viongozi wa biashara ili kutafakari hali ya biashara kati ya nchi hizo mbili na kujadili mikakati ya kuimarisha biashara ya pande mbili na ya kikanda.

English: Regional integration is key to promoting intra-African trade to unlock massive market potential across sectors, including in education and related services.
Kiswahili: Ujumuishaji wa kikanda ni muhimu katika kukuza biashara ya ndani ya Afrika ili kufungua uwezo mkubwa wa soko katika sekta mbalimbali, ikiwa ni pamoja na elimu na huduma zinazohusiana.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, accompanied by the Principal Secretaries for Basic Education, TVET, and Higher Education, briefed the Deputy President, Prof. Kithure Kindiki, on education sector issues.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, akifuatana na Makatibu Wakuu wa Elimu ya Msingi, TVET, na Elimu ya Juu, walimpa taarifa Naibu Rais, Prof. Kithure Kindiki, kuhusu masuala ya sekta ya elimu.

English: The meeting deliberated matters of school safety and security, the rollout of Competency-Based Education, and the promotion of access and equity at all levels of education.
Kiswahili: Mkutano huo ulijadili masuala ya usalama na usalama wa shule, utekelezaji wa Elimu Inayotegemea Uwezo, na uendelezaji wa upatikanaji na usawa katika ngazi zote za elimu.

English: Team Kenya secured its first-ever Grand Prize in the Huawei ICT Competition 2025-2026 Global Final in Shenzhen, China.
Kiswahili: Timu ya Kenya ilipata Tuzo yake Kuu ya kwanza kabisa katika Fainali ya Kimataifa ya Huawei ICT 2025-2026 huko Shenzhen, China.

English: This win inspires confidence in the future of Kenya's tech-driven economy and confirms the global competitiveness of Kenya's education and training system.
Kiswahili: Ushindi huu unatia moyo kujiamini katika mustakabali wa uchumi wa Kenya unaoendeshwa na teknolojia na unathibitisha ushindani wa kimataifa wa mfumo wa elimu na mafunzo wa Kenya.

English: Competitions such as the Huawei ICT competition provide a critical platform promoting skilling in technology in Kenya and the world, and demonstrate trainees' and students' preparedness for the world of work.
Kiswahili: Mashindano kama vile shindano la TEHAMA la Huawei hutoa jukwaa muhimu la kukuza ujuzi katika teknolojia nchini Kenya na duniani kote, na kuonyesha utayari wa wanafunzi na wanafunzi kwa ulimwengu wa kazi.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, hosted the incoming Principal Secretary for Basic Education, John Lekakeny Ololtuaa, and the outgoing Principal Secretary, Amb. Prof. Julius Bitok, at the Ministry's Jogoo House B offices.
Kiswahili: Katibu wa Baraza la Mawaziri la Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alimkaribisha Katibu Mkuu mpya wa Elimu ya Msingi, John Lekakeny Ololtuaa, na Katibu Mkuu anayemaliza muda wake, Balozi Profesa Julius Bitok, katika ofisi za Jogoo House B za Wizara.

English: The Cabinet Secretary welcomed John Lekakeny Ololtuaa to the Ministry of Education and wished Prof. Julius Bitok every success in his new role.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Baraza la Mawaziri alimkaribisha John Lekakeny Ololtuaa katika Wizara ya Elimu na kumtakia Profesa Julius Bitok kila la heri katika nafasi yake mpya.

English: The FY 2026-27 Mwananchi Budget Guide allocates Ksh 61.6 billion for Free Primary and Day Secondary Education, and Ksh 38.9 billion for Junior Secondary School Capitation.
Kiswahili: Mwongozo wa Bajeti ya Mwananchi wa Mwaka wa Fedha wa 2026-27 unatenga Ksh bilioni 61.6 kwa ajili ya Elimu ya Msingi na Sekondari ya Kutwa Bila Malipo, na Ksh bilioni 38.9 kwa ajili ya Kujifunza Shule za Sekondari za Watoto Wadogo.

English: The budget also provides Ksh 8.2 billion for Intern Teachers, Ksh 7.3 billion for Technical Vocational Education Training, and Ksh 7.1 billion for the Kenya Primary Education Equity in Learning programme.
Kiswahili: Bajeti hiyo pia inatoa Ksh bilioni 8.2 kwa Walimu wa Mafunzo ya Ndani, Ksh bilioni 7.3 kwa Mafunzo ya Elimu ya Ufundi Stadi, na Ksh bilioni 7.1 kwa programu ya Usawa katika Kujifunza ya Elimu ya Msingi ya Kenya.

English: Further allocations include Ksh 5.9 billion for ongoing University Education projects, Ksh 4.9 billion for converting 20,000 intern teachers to permanent and pensionable terms from 1 January 2027, and Ksh 4.7 billion for the Kenya Secondary Education Quality Improvement Project.
Kiswahili: Mgao zaidi ni pamoja na Ksh bilioni 5.9 kwa miradi inayoendelea ya Elimu ya Vyuo Vikuu, Ksh bilioni 4.9 kwa ajili ya kuwabadilisha walimu 20,000 wa mafunzo kwa vitendo kuwa wa kudumu na wa kustaafu kuanzia Januari 1, 2027, na Ksh bilioni 4.7 kwa ajili ya Mradi wa Uboreshaji wa Ubora wa Elimu ya Sekondari ya Kenya.

English: The budget also allocates Ksh 4.1 billion for infrastructure development in primary and secondary schools, Ksh 4.0 billion for Higher Education Science, Technology and Research, and Ksh 3.0 billion for the School Feeding Programme.
Kiswahili: Bajeti hiyo pia inatenga Ksh bilioni 4.1 kwa ajili ya maendeleo ya miundombinu katika shule za msingi na sekondari, Ksh bilioni 4.0 kwa ajili ya Sayansi, Teknolojia na Utafiti wa Elimu ya Juu, na Ksh bilioni 3.0 kwa ajili ya Programu ya Kulisha Shuleni.

English: The Principal Secretary for Higher Education, Dr. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, met with representatives from Shimizu Corporation at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Harambee Avenue to explore cooperation in engineering, research, and technology transfer.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu, Dkt. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, alikutana na wawakilishi kutoka Shirika la Shimizu katika Wizara ya Mambo ya Nje kwenye Harambee Avenue ili kuchunguza ushirikiano katika uhandisi, utafiti, na uhamishaji wa teknolojia.

English: The proposed partnership will support student internships and training, faculty exchanges, and collaborative research in sustainable construction and infrastructure, aiming to unite government, universities, and industry to build technical capacity.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano uliopendekezwa utasaidia mafunzo ya wanafunzi na mafunzo, kubadilishana kwa wahadhiri, na utafiti shirikishi katika ujenzi endelevu na miundombinu, ukilenga kuunganisha serikali, vyuo vikuu, na tasnia ili kujenga uwezo wa kiufundi.

English: Also present were Ambassador Isiaya Kabira, Prof. Eng. Ayub Gitau, Vice-Chancellor of the University of Nairobi, Prof. Benedict M. Mutua, Vice-Chancellor of the Technical University of Kenya, and Shimizu representatives.
Kiswahili: Pia walikuwepo Balozi Isiaya Kabira, Prof. Eng. Ayub Gitau, Makamu Mkuu wa Chuo Kikuu cha Nairobi, Prof. Benedict M. Mutua, Makamu Mkuu wa Chuo Kikuu cha Ufundi cha Kenya, na wawakilishi wa Shimizu.

English: The Principal Secretary for Higher Education, Dr. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, witnessed the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding between Equity Bank and the European Union to expand scholarships for Kenyan students pursuing higher education at European universities.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu, Dkt. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, alishuhudia utiaji saini wa Mkataba wa Makubaliano kati ya Benki ya Equity na Umoja wa Ulaya ili kupanua ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wa Kenya wanaofuata elimu ya juu katika vyuo vikuu vya Ulaya.

English: The partnership marks a step toward empowering young people through education, strengthening global academic linkages, and opening new pathways for talent development.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano huu unaashiria hatua kuelekea kuwawezesha vijana kupitia elimu, kuimarisha uhusiano wa kitaaluma wa kimataifa, na kufungua njia mpya za kukuza vipaji.

English: Also in attendance were Her Excellency Henriette Geiger, Ambassador of the European Union to Kenya, the Principal Secretary for Innovation and Research, Shaukat Abdulrazack, and Equity Group Foundation Executive Chairman Dr. James Mwangi.
Kiswahili: Pia waliohudhuria walikuwa Mheshimiwa Henriette Geiger, Balozi wa Umoja wa Ulaya nchini Kenya, Katibu Mkuu wa Ubunifu na Utafiti, Shaukat Abdulrazack, na Mwenyekiti Mtendaji wa Equity Group Foundation Dkt. James Mwangi.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, joined the First Lady, Mama Rachel Ruto, together with the families and learners of Utumishi Girls Academy, for a requiem mass in honour of the young lives lost in the tragic fire at the institution.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alijiunga na Mke wa Rais, Mama Rachel Ruto, pamoja na familia na wanafunzi wa Chuo cha Wasichana cha Utumishi, kwa misa ya wafu kwa heshima ya maisha ya vijana waliopotea katika moto mchungu katika taasisi hiyo.

English: The event reaffirmed the Government's commitment to building a safe and secure learning environment in which all learners can thrive and realise their full potential.
Kiswahili: Tukio hilo lilithibitisha tena dhamira ya Serikali ya kujenga mazingira salama ya kujifunzia ambapo wanafunzi wote wanaweza kustawi na kutambua uwezo wao kamili.

English: The Cabinet Secretary emphasized that through a multi-stakeholder approach, the Government will continue engaging all relevant actors to develop and implement sustainable strategies aimed at preventing the recurrence of such incidents in educational institutions.
Kiswahili: Waziri alisisitiza kwamba kupitia mbinu ya wadau wengi, Serikali itaendelea kuwashirikisha wahusika wote husika ili kuendeleza na kutekeleza mikakati endelevu inayolenga kuzuia kujirudia kwa matukio kama hayo katika taasisi za elimu.

English: The Ministry of Education's State Department for Basic Education paid tribute to the late Hon. Gideon Konchella, former Kilgoris Constituency MP, noting that during his two decades of service the constituency saw remarkable transformation in education, healthcare, and economic development.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Elimu ya Msingi ya Wizara ya Elimu ilitoa heshima kwa marehemu Mhe. Gideon Konchella, aliyekuwa Mbunge wa Jimbo la Kilgoris, ikibainisha kwamba wakati wa miongo miwili ya utumishi wake, jimbo hilo liliona mabadiliko makubwa katika elimu, huduma za afya, na maendeleo ya kiuchumi.

English: Hon. Konchella championed the establishment and growth of numerous educational institutions across Kilgoris Constituency, expanding access to learning opportunities for thousands of young people.
Kiswahili: Mhe. Konchella alitetea uanzishwaji na ukuaji wa taasisi nyingi za elimu katika Jimbo la Kilgoris, akipanua upatikanaji wa fursa za kujifunza kwa maelfu ya vijana.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, on behalf of President Dr. William Samoei Ruto, graced the commemoration of the 80th Anniversary of the Thika School for the Visually Blind and the observance of International Albinism Awareness Day.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, kwa niaba ya Rais Dkt. William Samoei Ruto, alihudhuria maadhimisho ya miaka 80 ya Shule ya Thika ya Watu Wenye Vipofu na maadhimisho ya Siku ya Kimataifa ya Uelewa wa Ualbino.

English: The event celebrated 8 decades of dedicated service to learners with visual impairments while highlighting the importance of inclusion, equality, and the protection of the rights and dignity of persons with albinism and other disabilities.
Kiswahili: Hafla hiyo iliadhimisha miongo 8 ya huduma ya kujitolea kwa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu wa kuona huku ikisisitiza umuhimu wa ujumuishi, usawa, na ulinzi wa haki na utu wa watu wenye ualbino na ulemavu mwingine.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, representing Deputy President Prof. Kithure Kindiki, officially opened Kabete National Polytechnic's 4th International Research Conference, Competition, Innovation, Career Guidance and Expo.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, akimwakilisha Naibu Rais Prof. Kithure Kindiki, alifungua rasmi Mkutano wa 4 wa Kimataifa wa Utafiti wa Kabete National Polytechnic, Ushindani, Ubunifu, Mwongozo wa Kazi na Maonyesho.

English: The conference brings together a variety of players in the TVET, research and innovation ecosystems to foster contemporary sector deliberations and exchanges shaping the future of education and training.
Kiswahili: Mkutano huo unawaleta pamoja wachezaji mbalimbali katika mifumo ikolojia ya TVET, utafiti na uvumbuzi ili kukuza mijadala na mabadilishano ya sekta ya kisasa yanayounda mustakabali wa elimu na mafunzo.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, graced the Prize-Giving Day of Sironga Girls Senior School in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alihudhuria Siku ya Kutoa Tuzo ya Shule ya Wasichana ya Upili ya Sironga katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.

English: The occasion provided an opportunity to celebrate learner and teacher excellence by recognizing achievement and motivating others to excel.
Kiswahili: Hafla hiyo ilitoa fursa ya kusherehekea ubora wa mwanafunzi na mwalimu kwa kutambua mafanikio na kuwahamasisha wengine kufanya vizuri.

English: The event was attended by a host of Members of Parliament, including Hon. Steve Mogaka (West Mugirango), Hon. Jerusha Momanyi (Nyamira County), Hon. Japheth Nyakundi (Kitutu Chache North), Hon. John Bwire (Taveta), Hon. Didmus Barasa (Kimilili), Hon. Mwengi Mutuse (Kibwezi), and Hon. Renee Nyakerario (nominated).
Kiswahili: Hafla hiyo ilihudhuriwa na Wabunge wengi akiwemo Mhe. Steve Mogaka (Mugirango Magharibi), Mhe. Jerusha Momanyi (Kaunti ya Nyamira), Mhe. Japheth Nyakundi (Kitutu Chache Kaskazini), Mhe. John Bwire (Taveta), Mhe. Didmus Barasa (Kimilili), Mhe. Mwengi Mutuse (Kibwezi), na Mhe. Renee Nyakerario (aliyeteuliwa).

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, officially closed the 49th Annual Conference of the Kenya Secondary School Heads Association in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alifunga rasmi Mkutano wa 49 wa Mwaka wa Chama cha Wakuu wa Shule za Upili za Kenya katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.

English: The conference brought together senior school principals from across the country to deliberate contemporary education sector issues, including school leadership, transition under the Competency-Based Education system, and school safety and stability.
Kiswahili: Mkutano huo uliwakutanisha wakuu wa shule za upili kutoka kote nchini ili kujadili masuala ya kisasa ya sekta ya elimu, ikiwa ni pamoja na uongozi wa shule, mpito chini ya mfumo wa Elimu Unaozingatia Uwezo, na usalama na utulivu wa shule.

English: The event was also attended by, among others, the Principal Secretary for Basic Education, John Ololtuaa, the Principal Secretary for Gender and Affirmative Action, Anne Wang'ombe, the Chairperson of the Teachers Service Commission, Dr. Jamleck Muturi, and Kibra MP, Hon. Peter Orero.
Kiswahili: Hafla hiyo pia ilihudhuriwa na, miongoni mwa wengine, Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Msingi, John Ololtuaa, Katibu Mkuu wa Jinsia na Ushirikiano, Anne Wang'ombe, Mwenyekiti wa Tume ya Utumishi wa Walimu, Dk Jamleck Muturi na Mbunge wa Kibra, Mhe. Peter Orero.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education attended an event at Boys Senior School in Maua, Meru County, joined by, among others, the Cabinet Secretary for Water and Irrigation, Eric Muuga, the Governor for Meru County, Rev. Isaac Mutuma, Principal Secretaries, and a host of Members of Parliament.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu alihudhuria hafla katika Shule ya Wavulana ya Upili huko Maua, Kaunti ya Meru, akiambatana na, miongoni mwa wengine, Katibu wa Maji na Umwagiliaji, Eric Muuga, Gavana wa Kaunti ya Meru, Mchungaji Isaac Mutuma, Makatibu Wakuu, na Wabunge wengi.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, joined President Dr. William Samoei Ruto and Deputy President Prof. Kithure Kindiki to celebrate the 60th Anniversary Thanksgiving of Burieruri Boys Senior School in Maua, Meru County.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alijiunga na Rais Dkt. William Samoei Ruto na Naibu Rais Profesa Kithure Kindiki kusherehekea Sikukuu ya Shukrani ya Miaka 60 ya Shule ya Wavulana ya Burieruri huko Maua, Kaunti ya Meru.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, officially opened this quarter's national meeting of principals of TVET institutions at the Kenya School of TVET in Gigiri, Nairobi.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alifungua rasmi mkutano wa kitaifa wa robo hii wa wakuu wa taasisi za TVET katika Shule ya Kenya ya TVET huko Gigiri, Nairobi.

English: The meeting provides an opportunity for TVET principals to take stock of progress made in implementing the TVET transformation agenda through the rollout of Competency-Based Education and Training and industry partnerships through dual training.
Kiswahili: Mkutano huo unatoa fursa kwa wakuu wa vyuo vya elimu ya juu (TVET) kutathmini maendeleo yaliyopatikana katika kutekeleza ajenda ya mabadiliko ya elimu ya juu (TVET) kupitia utekelezaji wa Elimu na Mafunzo yanayozingatia Uwezo na ushirikiano wa sekta kupitia mafunzo mawili.

English: The meeting was attended by, among others, the Principal Secretary for TVET, Dr. Esther Muoria.
Kiswahili: Mkutano huo ulihudhuriwa, miongoni mwa wengine, na Katibu Mkuu wa TVET, Dkt. Esther Muoria.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, officially released the 2026/2027 universities and colleges placement results, following the successful completion of the placement exercise by the Kenya Universities and Colleges Central Placement Service (KUCCPS).
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alitoa rasmi matokeo ya uwekaji wa vyuo vikuu na vyuo vikuu vya 2026/2027, kufuatia kukamilika kwa mafanikio kwa zoezi la uwekaji wa vyuo vikuu na vyuo vikuu vya Kenya (KUCCPS).

English: The event was held at the Edge Convention Centre, Nairobi, and was attended by the leadership of KUCCPS, Vice-Chancellors, and other sector players.
Kiswahili: Hafla hiyo ilifanyika katika Kituo cha Mikutano cha Edge, Nairobi, na ilihudhuriwa na uongozi wa KUCCPS, Makamu wa Chansela, na wadau wengine wa sekta hiyo.

English: The transfer window for placement has been extended from two weeks to one month.
Kiswahili: Kipindi cha uhamisho cha nafasi kimeongezwa kutoka wiki mbili hadi mwezi mmoja.

English: Following the conclusion of the placement process, the higher education financing portal is open for application by first-time applicants at hef.co.ke or helb.co.ke.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kukamilika kwa mchakato wa uwekaji, lango la ufadhili wa elimu ya juu limefunguliwa kwa maombi ya waombaji wa mara ya kwanza katika hef.co.ke au helb.co.ke.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, presided over the groundbreaking ceremony for school infrastructure improvement projects at Kihate Comprehensive School in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, aliongoza sherehe ya uzinduzi wa miradi ya uboreshaji wa miundombinu ya shule katika Shule ya Kihate Comprehensive katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.

English: The projects are funded by the M-Pesa Foundation, underscoring the significant role of corporate partners in promoting access to quality education through infrastructure improvement and scholarship support.
Kiswahili: Miradi hiyo inafadhiliwa na Wakfu wa M-Pesa, ikisisitiza jukumu muhimu la washirika wa makampuni katika kukuza upatikanaji wa elimu bora kupitia uboreshaji wa miundombinu na usaidizi wa ufadhili wa masomo.

English: The Cabinet Secretary was accompanied by his Agriculture and Livestock Development counterpart, Hon. Sen. Mutahi Kagwe, and the Chairperson of the Safaricom Foundation, Joe Ogutu.
Kiswahili: Waziri huyo aliambatana na mwenzake wa Maendeleo ya Kilimo na Mifugo, Mheshimiwa Seneta Mutahi Kagwe, na Mwenyekiti wa Wakfu wa Safaricom, Joe Ogutu.

English: The duty to educate our children rests upon all of us as a collective responsibility, requiring a whole-of-government and whole-of-society approach.
Kiswahili: Wajibu wa kuwaelimisha watoto wetu uko juu yetu sote kama jukumu la pamoja, linalohitaji mbinu ya serikali nzima na jamii nzima.

English: The Government will continue to collaborate with communities, faith-based organizations, corporate sponsors, and alumni associations to enhance infrastructure in schools and expand access to education through bursaries and scholarships.
Kiswahili: Serikali itaendelea kushirikiana na jamii, mashirika ya kidini, wafadhili wa makampuni, na vyama vya wahitimu ili kuboresha miundombinu shuleni na kupanua upatikanaji wa elimu kupitia bursary na scholarships.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, joined his counterparts, including Davis Chirchir of Roads, at a school event to reinforce these partnerships.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alijiunga na wenzake, akiwemo Davis Chirchir wa Barabara, katika hafla ya shule ili kuimarisha ushirikiano huu.

English: All registered voters who require assistance due to disability, illiteracy or other lawful reasons are entitled to be assisted by a person of their own choice.
Kiswahili: Wapiga kura wote waliosajiliwa wanaohitaji usaidizi kutokana na ulemavu, kutojua kusoma na kuandika au sababu nyingine halali wana haki ya kusaidiwa na mtu wa chaguo lao wenyewe.

English: The person providing assistance to a voter must be eighteen years of age or older, only one assistant is permitted, and no person shall assist more than one voter.
Kiswahili: Mtu anayetoa msaada kwa mpiga kura lazima awe na umri wa miaka kumi na minane au zaidi, msaidizi mmoja tu ndiye anayeruhusiwa, na hakuna mtu atakayeruhusiwa kuwasaidia zaidi ya mpiga kura mmoja.

English: Registered voters must always have their national identity card or valid passport in their possession as the primary identification documents on polling day.
Kiswahili: Wapiga kura waliosajiliwa lazima wawe na kitambulisho chao cha taifa au pasipoti halali kama hati kuu za utambulisho siku ya kupiga kura.

English: Eligible voters are identified biometrically at the polling station using the Kenya Integrated Elections Management System (KIEMS) kit.
Kiswahili: Wapiga kura wanaostahiki hutambuliwa kwa kibayometriki katika kituo cha kupigia kura kwa kutumia kifurushi cha Mfumo Jumuishi wa Usimamizi wa Uchaguzi wa Kenya (KIEMS).

English: Taking photographs or recording videos inside the polling booth is strictly prohibited to preserve the secrecy and sanctity of the vote.
Kiswahili: Kupiga picha au kurekodi video ndani ya kibanda cha kupigia kura ni marufuku kabisa ili kuhifadhi usiri na utakatifu wa kura.

English: Capturing an image of a marked ballot for financial gain or to show allegiance is an election offence under Section 7(3)(e) of the Election Offences Act, No. 37 of 2016, punishable by a fine of up to KSh 1 million, imprisonment for up to 3 years, or both.
Kiswahili: Kupiga picha ya kura iliyotiwa alama kwa ajili ya faida ya kifedha au kuonyesha utii ni kosa la uchaguzi chini ya Kifungu cha 7(3)(e) cha Sheria ya Makosa ya Uchaguzi, Nambari 37 ya 2016, kinachoadhibiwa kwa faini ya hadi KSh milioni 1, kifungo cha hadi miaka 3, au vyote viwili.

English: Only one mark should be used on the ballot paper when voting.
Kiswahili: Alama moja tu ndiyo inapaswa kutumika kwenye karatasi ya kupigia kura wakati wa kupiga kura.

English: To vote, a person must be registered as a voter at their designated polling station.
Kiswahili: Ili kupiga kura, mtu lazima awe amesajiliwa kama mpiga kura katika kituo chake cha kupigia kura.

English: To vote, a person must present their original Kenyan national identity card or a valid Kenyan passport at their polling station.
Kiswahili: Ili kupiga kura, mtu lazima aonyeshe kitambulisho chake cha kitaifa cha Kenya au pasipoti halali ya Kenya katika kituo chake cha kupigia kura.

English: Voting Procedure, Step 1: The voter enters the polling station with their ID or passport.
Kiswahili: Utaratibu wa Kupiga Kura, Hatua ya 1: Mpiga kura anaingia kituo cha kupigia kura akiwa na kitambulisho chake au pasipoti.

English: Voting Procedure, Step 2: The voter's information is verified using the KIEMS kit.
Kiswahili: Utaratibu wa Kupiga Kura, Hatua ya 2: Taarifa za mpiga kura zinathibitishwa kwa kutumia kifaa cha KIEMS.

English: Voting Procedure, Step 3: The voter is issued with one stamped ballot paper.
Kiswahili: Utaratibu wa Kupiga Kura, Hatua ya 3: Mpiga kura hupewa karatasi moja ya kupigia kura iliyotiwa muhuri.

English: Voting Procedure, Step 4: The voter marks the ballot paper secretly.
Kiswahili: Utaratibu wa Kupiga Kura, Hatua ya 4: Mpiga kura huweka alama kwenye karatasi ya kupigia kura kwa siri.

English: Voting Procedure, Step 5: The voter casts their ballot in the ballot box.
Kiswahili: Utaratibu wa Kupiga Kura, Hatua ya 5: Mpiga kura anapiga kura yake kwenye sanduku la kura.

English: Voting Procedure, Step 6: The voter's finger is marked with indelible ink.
Kiswahili: Utaratibu wa Kupiga Kura, Hatua ya 6: Kidole cha mpiga kura kimetiwa alama ya wino usiofutika.

English: Voting Procedure, Step 7: The voter leaves the polling station.
Kiswahili: Utaratibu wa Kupiga Kura, Hatua ya 7: Mpiga kura anaondoka kituoni.

English: The public is encouraged to promote peace before, during, and after elections.
Kiswahili: Umma unahimizwa kukuza amani kabla, wakati, na baada ya uchaguzi.

English: A Register of Voters certified and published in the Kenya Gazette is the only lawful register that may be used during an election, and by law it must be displayed at every polling station at least seven days before polling day.
Kiswahili: Daftari la Wapiga Kura lililoidhinishwa na kuchapishwa katika Gazeti la Kenya ndilo daftari pekee halali linaloweza kutumika wakati wa uchaguzi, na kwa mujibu wa sheria lazima lionyeshwe katika kila kituo cha kupigia kura angalau siku saba kabla ya siku ya kupigia kura.

English: The public is encouraged to verify election-related information only through the Commission's official website or verified social media platforms, and to exercise caution about unverified claims.
Kiswahili: Umma unahimizwa kuthibitisha taarifa zinazohusiana na uchaguzi kupitia tovuti rasmi ya Tume au majukwaa ya mitandao ya kijamii yaliyothibitishwa pekee, na kuwa waangalifu kuhusu madai ambayo hayajathibitishwa.

English: The Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission (IEBC) invited the public to submit memoranda on draft Election Campaign Financing Regulations and proposed contribution, spending, and expenditure limits ahead of the 2027 General Election, as required under Article 88(4)(i) of the Constitution and the Election Campaign Financing Act.
Kiswahili: Tume Huru ya Uchaguzi na Mipaka (IEBC) iliwaalika umma kuwasilisha memoranda kuhusu rasimu ya Kanuni za Ufadhili wa Kampeni za Uchaguzi na mapendekezo ya michango, matumizi, na mipaka ya matumizi kabla ya Uchaguzi Mkuu wa 2027, kama inavyohitajika chini ya Kifungu cha 88(4)(i) cha Katiba na Sheria ya Ufadhili wa Kampeni za Uchaguzi.

English: Enhanced Continuous Voter Registration allows eligible citizens to register as voters at County Assembly Ward level, Constituency offices, Huduma Centres, and institutions of higher learning, in addition to regular Continuous Voter Registration available at Constituency offices.
Kiswahili: Usajili Endelevu wa Wapiga Kura Ulioboreshwa huruhusu raia wanaostahiki kujiandikisha kama wapiga kura katika ngazi ya Wadi ya Bunge la Kaunti, ofisi za Jimbo, Vituo vya Huduma, na taasisi za elimu ya juu, pamoja na Usajili Endelevu wa Wapiga Kura wa kawaida unaopatikana katika ofisi za Jimbo.

English: Article 38 of the Constitution guarantees every citizen the right to stand for public office, but this right is meaningful only when there is an impartial mechanism to enforce fair nomination rules.
Kiswahili: Kifungu cha 38 cha Katiba kinamhakikishia kila raia haki ya kugombea nafasi ya umma, lakini haki hii ina maana tu wakati kuna utaratibu usio na upendeleo wa kutekeleza sheria za uteuzi wa haki.

English: Article 88(4)(e) of the Constitution entrusts the IEBC with the mandate to settle electoral disputes arising from nominations, while election petitions and disputes after the declaration of results are handled by the courts.
Kiswahili: Kifungu cha 88(4)(e) cha Katiba kinaipa IEBC mamlaka ya kutatua mizozo ya uchaguzi inayotokana na uteuzi, huku malalamiko na mizozo ya uchaguzi baada ya kutangazwa kwa matokeo yakishughulikiwa na mahakama.

English: Before approaching the courts over a nomination dispute, political parties and candidates are expected to first use the IEBC's Dispute Resolution Committee, the constitutionally designated mechanism for resolving such disputes.
Kiswahili: Kabla ya kuwasilisha kesi mahakamani kuhusu mzozo wa uteuzi, vyama vya siasa na wagombea wanatarajiwa kwanza kutumia Kamati ya Utatuzi wa Migogoro ya IEBC, utaratibu uliowekwa kikatiba wa kutatua mizozo kama hiyo.

English: Democracy is not defined only by the casting of the ballot, but by the integrity of the process that leads to it.
Kiswahili: Demokrasia haifafanuliwi tu kwa kupiga kura, bali pia kwa uadilifu wa mchakato unaoiongoza.

English: A sound and enabling legal framework, strong institutions, adequate resources, and effective planning are needed for elections to be credible, since elections are a continuous process rather than a single day's event.
Kiswahili: Mfumo mzuri na unaowezesha kisheria, taasisi imara, rasilimali za kutosha, na mipango madhubuti vinahitajika ili uchaguzi uweze kuaminika, kwa kuwa uchaguzi ni mchakato unaoendelea badala ya tukio la siku moja.

English: Technology has become an indispensable tool for enhancing efficiency, transparency, and accountability in elections, but its effectiveness depends on robust legal safeguards, institutional oversight, and the goodwill of all parties to trust it.
Kiswahili: Teknolojia imekuwa chombo muhimu sana kwa ajili ya kuongeza ufanisi, uwazi, na uwajibikaji katika chaguzi, lakini ufanisi wake unategemea ulinzi imara wa kisheria, usimamizi wa kitaasisi, na nia njema ya pande zote kuiamini.

English: Legal frameworks governing elections must adequately address data protection, cybersecurity, transparency in electoral technologies, and accountability in electronic electoral processes, so that innovation strengthens rather than undermines public confidence.
Kiswahili: Mifumo ya kisheria inayosimamia uchaguzi lazima ishughulikie vya kutosha ulinzi wa data, usalama wa mtandao, uwazi katika teknolojia za uchaguzi, na uwajibikaji katika michakato ya uchaguzi wa kielektroniki, ili uvumbuzi uimarike badala ya kudhoofisha imani ya umma.

English: The strength of a democracy is measured not only by the conduct of elections but by the extent to which all citizens, including women, youth, persons with disabilities, and minority communities, are able to participate meaningfully as active participants rather than mere observers.
Kiswahili: Nguvu ya demokrasia haipimwi tu kwa uendeshaji wa uchaguzi bali pia kwa kiwango ambacho raia wote, wakiwemo wanawake, vijana, watu wenye ulemavu, na jamii za wachache, wanaweza kushiriki kwa njia yenye maana kama washiriki hai badala ya waangalizi tu.

English: Public trust in electoral processes cannot be demanded; it must be earned through integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement, and requires commitment and cooperation from all sectors of society, not the Commission alone.
Kiswahili: Imani ya umma katika michakato ya uchaguzi haiwezi kudaiwa; lazima ipatikane kupitia uadilifu, uwajibikaji, na uboreshaji endelevu, na inahitaji kujitolea na ushirikiano kutoka kwa sekta zote za jamii, si Tume pekee.

English: The IEBC Strategic Plan is anchored on the theme 'Inclusion and Participation in Deepening Democracy in Kenya,' under the call 'Your Vote, Your Voice - Kura Yako, Sauti Yako.'
Kiswahili: Mpango Mkakati wa IEBC umejikita katika mada 'Ujumuishi na Ushiriki katika Kuimarisha Demokrasia nchini Kenya,' chini ya wito 'Kura Yako, Sauti Yako - Kura Yako, Sauti Yako.'

English: Democracy must never become captive to technology; every stage of the electoral process must remain transparent and audited, since public confidence can rise or fall based on how election results are transmitted.
Kiswahili: Demokrasia haipaswi kamwe kuwa mateka wa teknolojia; kila hatua ya mchakato wa uchaguzi lazima ibaki wazi na kukaguliwa, kwani imani ya umma inaweza kuongezeka au kushuka kulingana na jinsi matokeo ya uchaguzi yanavyosambazwa.

English: For years, minority and marginalized communities have faced barriers to effective participation in Kenya's elections owing to language barriers and lack of national identity cards.
Kiswahili: Kwa miaka mingi, jamii za walio wachache na waliotengwa zimekabiliwa na vikwazo vya ushiriki mzuri katika uchaguzi wa Kenya kutokana na vikwazo vya lugha na ukosefu wa vitambulisho vya kitaifa.

English: The election of the President of the Republic of Kenya for the next General Election is scheduled for Tuesday, 10th August 2027.
Kiswahili: Uchaguzi wa Rais wa Jamhuri ya Kenya kwa Uchaguzi Mkuu ujao umepangwa kufanyika Jumanne, tarehe 10 Agosti 2027.

English: A public officer who intends to contest in the General Election must resign from public office at least six months before election day, on or before Tuesday, 9th February 2027.
Kiswahili: Afisa wa umma anayekusudia kugombea katika Uchaguzi Mkuu lazima ajiuzulu kutoka ofisi ya umma angalau miezi sita kabla ya siku ya uchaguzi, mnamo au kabla ya Jumanne, tarehe 9 Februari 2027.

English: Political parties must submit their party membership lists, and the names, dates, and venues of party primaries, to the Commission on or before Tuesday, 16th March 2027.
Kiswahili: Vyama vya siasa lazima viwasilishe orodha zao za uanachama wa chama, na majina, tarehe, na mahali pa kura za mchujo za chama, kwa Tume mnamo au kabla ya Jumanne, Machi 16, 2027.

English: A political party intending to present a candidate must conduct its primaries and resolve any intra-party disputes on or before Sunday, 9th May 2027, and a person intending to run as an independent candidate must not be a member of any registered political party by that date.
Kiswahili: Chama cha siasa kinachokusudia kumwasilisha mgombea lazima kifanye kura zake za mchujo na kutatua migogoro yoyote ya ndani ya chama ifikapo Jumapili, Mei 9, 2027 au kabla yake, na mtu anayekusudia kugombea kama mgombea huru hapaswi kuwa mwanachama wa chama chochote cha siasa kilichosajiliwa ifikapo tarehe hiyo.

English: Nomination of political party and independent candidates for the General Election takes place between Saturday, 29th May 2027 and Friday, 11th June 2027, with nomination papers delivered to the IEBC Chairperson during specified morning and afternoon hours.
Kiswahili: Uteuzi wa wagombea wa vyama vya siasa na wagombea huru kwa Uchaguzi Mkuu utafanyika kati ya Jumamosi, tarehe 29 Mei 2027 na Ijumaa, tarehe 11 Juni 2027, huku karatasi za uteuzi zikiwasilishwa kwa Mwenyekiti wa IEBC wakati wa saa maalum za asubuhi na alasiri.

English: Disputes relating to or arising from candidate nominations must be lodged with the Commission no later than Saturday, 12th June 2027, and must be determined within ten days of lodging.
Kiswahili: Migogoro inayohusiana na au inayotokana na uteuzi wa wagombea lazima iwasilishwe kwa Tume kabla ya Jumamosi, tarehe 12 Juni 2027, na lazima iamuliwe ndani ya siku kumi baada ya kuwasilishwa.

English: The campaign period for the 10th August 2027 General Election commences on Saturday, 29th May 2027 and ceases on Saturday, 8th August 2027, 48 hours before Election Day.
Kiswahili: Kipindi cha kampeni cha Uchaguzi Mkuu wa tarehe 10 Agosti 2027 kinaanza Jumamosi, tarehe 29 Mei 2027 na kuisha Jumamosi, tarehe 8 Agosti 2027, saa 48 kabla ya Siku ya Uchaguzi.

English: Organizations wishing to be accredited as Election Observers or Media Practitioners for a by-election must apply through the IEBC Accreditation Management System before the Commission's published deadline.
Kiswahili: Mashirika yanayotaka kuidhinishwa kama Waangalizi wa Uchaguzi au Watendaji wa Vyombo vya Habari kwa uchaguzi mdogo lazima yatume maombi kupitia Mfumo wa Usimamizi wa Ithibati wa IEBC kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho iliyochapishwa na Tume.

English: The public is warned to beware of fraudulent recruitment advertisements falsely claiming to be an official IEBC job intake; the Commission's only official jobs portal is jobs.iebc.or.ke, and applicants should never submit personal information through unofficial recruitment links.
Kiswahili: Umma unaonywa kuwa mwangalifu dhidi ya matangazo ya ulaghai ya kuajiri yanayodai kwa uongo kuwa ni nafasi rasmi ya kazi ya IEBC; lango pekee rasmi la kazi la Tume ni jobs.iebc.or.ke, na waombaji hawapaswi kamwe kuwasilisha taarifa binafsi kupitia viungo visivyo rasmi vya kuajiri.

English: The public is urged to disregard, dissociate from, and refrain from amplifying unverified claims by political actors alleging they will influence an election through extra-legal mechanisms, as such claims risk misleading the public and eroding confidence in the electoral system.
Kiswahili: Umma unahimizwa kupuuza, kujitenga na, na kujiepusha na kuongeza madai yasiyothibitishwa na watendaji wa kisiasa wakidai kwamba watashawishi uchaguzi kupitia mifumo isiyo ya kisheria, kwani madai kama hayo yanahatarisha kupotosha umma na kuharibu imani katika mfumo wa uchaguzi.

English: Voter education partnerships with grassroots groups such as small business and boda boda associations can help disseminate voter education, expand voter registration outreach, and promote peaceful participation in elections.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano wa elimu ya wapiga kura na makundi ya kijamii kama vile vyama vya biashara ndogo na bodaboda unaweza kusaidia kusambaza elimu ya wapiga kura, kupanua ufikiaji wa usajili wa wapiga kura, na kukuza ushiriki wa amani katika uchaguzi.

English: IEBC has registered 2.6 million new voters, bringing the total register to 24.7 million, against a target of 28.5 million ahead of the 2027 General Election.
Kiswahili: IEBC imesajili wapiga kura wapya milioni 2.6, na kufikisha jumla ya waliojiandikisha kufikia milioni 24.7, dhidi ya lengo la milioni 28.5 kabla ya Uchaguzi Mkuu wa 2027.

English: IEBC plans to expand diaspora voter registration beyond current embassy locations to 17 additional countries.
Kiswahili: IEBC inapanga kupanua usajili wa wapiga kura kutoka diaspora zaidi ya maeneo ya sasa ya ubalozi hadi nchi 17 zaidi.

English: Credible elections require coordinated action, strong voter education, and sustained public trust-building to counter digital threats such as misinformation, disinformation, and AI-driven manipulation.
Kiswahili: Uchaguzi wa kuaminika unahitaji hatua zilizoratibiwa, elimu thabiti ya wapiga kura, na ujenzi endelevu wa uaminifu wa umma ili kukabiliana na vitisho vya kidijitali kama vile taarifa potofu, taarifa potofu, na udanganyifu unaoendeshwa na akili bandia.

English: The IEBC's Strategic Plan 2024-2029 is anchored on four Key Result Areas: Managing Elections, Citizen Engagement and Participation, Equitable Representation, and Institutional Resilience.
Kiswahili: Mpango Mkakati wa IEBC wa 2024-2029 umejikita katika Maeneo Manne Muhimu ya Matokeo: Kusimamia Uchaguzi, Ushirikishwaji na Ushiriki wa Raia, Uwakilishi Sawa, na Ustahimilivu wa Kitaasisi.

English: IEBC's reforms to promote equitable electoral participation include gender inclusion measures, disability accessibility improvements, and targeted strategies for special interest groups.
Kiswahili: Mageuzi ya IEBC ya kukuza ushiriki sawa katika uchaguzi yanajumuisha hatua za ujumuishaji wa kijinsia, maboresho ya ufikiaji wa ulemavu, na mikakati inayolenga makundi maalum.

English: Each political party or candidate is entitled to only one agent per polling station and one chief agent per tallying centre; there is no legal provision for "super agents" or other unauthorized persons in polling or tallying centres.
Kiswahili: Kila chama cha siasa au mgombea ana haki ya kuwa na wakala mmoja tu kwa kila kituo cha kupigia kura na wakala mkuu mmoja kwa kila kituo cha kupigia kura; hakuna kifungu cha kisheria kwa "maajenti wakuu" au watu wengine wasioidhinishwa katika vituo vya kupigia kura au kuhesabu kura.

English: Only voters, polling clerks, presiding officers, security personnel, accredited observers, accredited media, and party or candidate agents are authorized to be present at a polling station.
Kiswahili: Wapiga kura, makarani wa kupigia kura, maafisa wasimamizi, wafanyakazi wa usalama, waangalizi walioidhinishwa, vyombo vya habari vilivyoidhinishwa, na mawakala wa chama au wagombea pekee ndio walioidhinishwa kuwepo katika kituo cha kupigia kura.

English: No person may be admitted into a polling station while wearing a badge, clothing, or any symbol signifying support for a political party or candidate.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu anayeweza kuruhusiwa kuingia katika kituo cha kupigia kura akiwa amevaa beji, nguo, au alama yoyote inayoashiria uungwaji mkono kwa chama cha siasa au mgombea.

English: State officers and public officers who are registered voters are entitled to vote only at their designated polling station and may not move between polling stations.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wa serikali na maafisa wa umma ambao ni wapiga kura waliosajiliwa wana haki ya kupiga kura katika kituo chao cha kupigia kura pekee na hawaruhusiwi kuhama kati ya vituo vya kupigia kura.

English: Polling stations open at 6:00 a.m. and close at 5:00 p.m.; any time lost during polling is recovered at closing, and voters already in the queue by closing time are allowed to vote.
Kiswahili: Vituo vya kupigia kura hufunguliwa saa 12:00 asubuhi na kufungwa saa 11:00 jioni; wakati wowote uliopotea wakati wa kupiga kura hurejeshwa wakati wa kufunga, na wapiga kura ambao tayari wako kwenye foleni wakati wa kufunga wanaruhusiwa kupiga kura.

English: At the tallying centre, Returning Officers receive results from all Presiding Officers, verify and collate them, and declare the winner in the presence of agents and accredited stakeholders.
Kiswahili: Katika kituo cha kuhesabu kura, Maafisa Wasimamizi hupokea matokeo kutoka kwa Maafisa Wakuu wote, huyathibitisha na kuyakusanya, na kutangaza mshindi mbele ya mawakala na wadau walioidhinishwa.

English: Enhanced Continuous Voter Registration (ECVR) Phase 1, conducted from 30 March to 28 April 2026, registered 2,612,725 new voters nationwide, achieving full coverage across all 290 constituencies and 1,450 wards through 30,615 registration centres.
Kiswahili: Usajili Endelevu wa Wapiga Kura (ECVR) Awamu ya 1, iliyofanywa kuanzia Machi 30 hadi Aprili 28, 2026, ilisajili wapiga kura wapya 2,612,725 kote nchini, na kufikia ufikiaji kamili katika majimbo yote 290 na kata 1,450 kupitia vituo 30,615 vya usajili.

English: ECVR Phase 1 was supported by 12,520 trained registration officials deploying 5,390 KIEMS kits nationwide.
Kiswahili: Awamu ya 1 ya ECVR iliungwa mkono na maafisa 12,520 wa usajili waliofunzwa na kusambaza vifaa 5,390 vya KIEMS kote nchini.

English: Under the "Open Kit" registration system, citizens can register as voters at any convenient registration centre, regardless of their place of origin, without needing to travel to their home county.
Kiswahili: Chini ya mfumo wa usajili wa "Open Kit", raia wanaweza kujiandikisha kama wapiga kura katika kituo chochote cha usajili kinachofaa, bila kujali mahali walipotoka, bila kuhitaji kusafiri hadi kaunti yao ya nyumbani.

English: Voter registration does not take place in electoral areas with scheduled by-elections or pending election petitions.
Kiswahili: Usajili wa wapiga kura haufanyiki katika maeneo ya uchaguzi yenye uchaguzi mdogo uliopangwa au maombi ya uchaguzi yanayosubiriwa.

English: The Election Operations Plan is a comprehensive document covering voter registration, boundary delimitation, technology deployment, logistics, staff recruitment and training, election security, and risk management and accountability frameworks.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Uendeshaji wa Uchaguzi ni hati kamili inayohusu usajili wa wapiga kura, uwekaji mipaka, utumaji wa teknolojia, vifaa, uajiri na mafunzo ya wafanyakazi, usalama wa uchaguzi, na mifumo ya usimamizi wa hatari na uwajibikaji.

English: Article 38 of the Constitution guarantees every citizen the right to join a political party, vote in free and fair elections, and vie for public office — rights given practical effect only through registration as a voter.
Kiswahili: Kifungu cha 38 cha Katiba kinamhakikishia kila raia haki ya kujiunga na chama cha siasa, kupiga kura katika uchaguzi huru na wa haki, na kugombea nafasi ya umma — haki zinazotolewa kwa vitendo kupitia usajili kama mpiga kura pekee.

English: High traffic areas frequented by foreigners and tourists in Nairobi and elsewhere in Kenya
Kiswahili: Maeneo yenye msongamano mkubwa wa magari yanayotembelewa na wageni na watalii jijini Nairobi na kwingineko nchini Kenya

English: Stay alert in locations frequented by tourists/foreigners.
Kiswahili: Kuwa macho katika maeneo yanayotembelewa na watalii/wageni mara kwa mara.

English: Review your personal security plans
Kiswahili: Kagua mipango yako ya usalama wa kibinafsi

English: Be aware of your surroundings
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu kuhusu mazingira yako

English: Monitor local media for updates
Kiswahili: Fuatilia vyombo vya habari vya ndani kwa ajili ya masasisho

English: Avoid protest areas and demonstrations
Kiswahili: Epuka maeneo ya maandamano na maandamano

English: Avoid crowds
Kiswahili: Epuka umati wa watu

English: Keep a low profile
Kiswahili: Weka wasifu mdogo

English: Keep doors locked and windows rolled up while in a vehicle
Kiswahili: Weka milango imefungwa na madirisha yamefungwa ukiwa ndani ya gari

English: Notify friends and family of your whereabouts and safety
Kiswahili: Wajulishe marafiki na familia kuhusu mahali ulipo na usalama wako

English: Prepare a plan for emergency situations

English: Around 1,300 maize farmers in Bungoma County are receiving fertilizer and seed support as part of demonstration trials teaching fall armyworm management ahead of the long rains planting season.
Kiswahili: Takriban wakulima 1,300 wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma wanapokea mbolea na usaidizi wa mbegu kama sehemu ya majaribio ya maonyesho ya kufundisha usimamizi wa viwavi jeshi wa vuli kabla ya msimu wa kupanda mvua ndefu.

English: The National Biosafety Authority reminds farmers that written approval is required before planting any genetically modified crop, in line with the Biosafety Act.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kitaifa ya Usalama wa Kibiolojia inawakumbusha wakulima kwamba idhini ya maandishi inahitajika kabla ya kupanda zao lolote lililobadilishwa vinasaba, kulingana na Sheria ya Usalama wa Kibiolojia.

English: Avocado growers are reminded that harvesting immature fruit is prohibited, and violators risk losing their export licences under tightened quality controls.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa parachichi wanakumbushwa kwamba kuvuna matunda yasiyoiva ni marufuku, na wanaokiuka sheria wana hatari ya kupoteza leseni zao za kuuza nje chini ya udhibiti mkali wa ubora.

English: Kenya's avocado production is projected to grow by close to 5 percent in 2026, supported by expanded farmland and improved yields across major growing counties.
Kiswahili: Uzalishaji wa parachichi nchini Kenya unatarajiwa kukua kwa karibu asilimia 5 mwaka wa 2026, ukiungwa mkono na ardhi iliyopanuliwa ya kilimo na mavuno yaliyoboreshwa katika kaunti kuu zinazokua.

English: Wajir County has launched a 10-day vaccination campaign targeting 250,000 animals against Foot and Mouth Disease, Peste des Petits Ruminants, and Contagious Caprine Pleuropneumonia.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Wajir imezindua kampeni ya chanjo ya siku 10 inayolenga wanyama 250,000 dhidi ya Ugonjwa wa Miguu na Midomo, Wanyama wa Kulungu wa Peste des Petits, na Caprine Pleuropneumonia ya Kuambukiza.

English: Under the e-voucher livestock vaccination programme, cattle owners can access the FMD vaccine for a subsidised fee of Sh50 per animal, while the PPR vaccine for sheep and goats costs Sh3 per animal.
Kiswahili: Chini ya mpango wa chanjo ya mifugo kwa vocha ya kielektroniki, wamiliki wa ng'ombe wanaweza kupata chanjo ya FMD kwa ada ya ruzuku ya Sh50 kwa kila mnyama, huku chanjo ya PPR kwa kondoo na mbuzi ikigharimu Sh3 kwa kila mnyama.

English: The national government is rolling out an immunisation campaign targeting 22 million cattle against Foot and Mouth Disease and 50 million sheep and goats against Peste des Petits Ruminants nationwide.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya kitaifa inaanzisha kampeni ya chanjo inayolenga ng'ombe milioni 22 dhidi ya Ugonjwa wa Miguu na Midomo na kondoo na mbuzi milioni 50 dhidi ya Wanyama wa Kulungu wa Peste des Petits kote nchini.

English: Livestock owners are assured that participation in the National Livestock Vaccination Programme remains voluntary and that no animal will be vaccinated without the owner's consent.
Kiswahili: Wamiliki wa mifugo wanahakikishiwa kwamba kushiriki katika Mpango wa Kitaifa wa Chanjo ya Mifugo kunabaki kuwa kwa hiari na kwamba hakuna mnyama atakayechanjwa bila idhini ya mmiliki.

English: The National Drought Management Authority has flagged suspected Foot and Mouth Disease cases in Baringo, Laikipia, Makueni, Meru, Narok, Wajir and West Pokot counties, urging farmers to cooperate with ongoing vaccination drives.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kitaifa ya Usimamizi wa Ukame imeripoti visa vinavyoshukiwa vya Ugonjwa wa Miguu na Midomo katika kaunti za Baringo, Laikipia, Makueni, Meru, Narok, Wajir na Pokot Magharibi, ikiwahimiza wakulima kushirikiana na kampeni zinazoendelea za chanjo.

English: Farmers in affected counties are advised that Sheep and Goat Pox has been reported in Garissa, Isiolo and Mandera, alongside anthrax cases in Meru and West Pokot.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika kaunti zilizoathiriwa wanaarifiwa kwamba tetekuwanga ya Kondoo na Mbuzi imeripotiwa Garissa, Isiolo na Mandera, pamoja na visa vya kimeta huko Meru na Pokot Magharibi.

English: Kenya has vaccinated over 10 million livestock as part of a nationwide push to modernise animal husbandry and open new export markets for meat and dairy products.
Kiswahili: Kenya imechanja mifugo zaidi ya milioni 10 kama sehemu ya juhudi za kitaifa za kuboresha ufugaji wa wanyama na kufungua masoko mapya ya nje ya nyama na bidhaa za maziwa.

English: Pastoralist communities are being urged to move herds toward areas with better pasture and water access as several ASAL counties remain in the drought alert and alarm phases.
Kiswahili: Jamii za wafugaji zinahimizwa kuhamisha mifugo kuelekea maeneo yenye malisho bora na upatikanaji wa maji kwani kaunti kadhaa za ASAL zinabaki katika awamu za tahadhari ya ukame na tahadhari.

English: A cross-border vaccination exercise between Kenya and Ethiopia aims to reach 2.7 million livestock by the end of August 2026 to control transboundary animal diseases in shared grazing areas.
Kiswahili: Zoezi la chanjo ya mpakani kati ya Kenya na Ethiopia linalenga kufikia mifugo milioni 2.7 ifikapo mwisho wa Agosti 2026 ili kudhibiti magonjwa ya wanyama yanayovuka mipaka katika maeneo ya malisho ya pamoja.

English: Smallholder farmers are encouraged to certify for export through registered cooperatives, which can reduce individual certification costs by up to 80 percent compared to certifying alone.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wadogo wanahimizwa kuidhinisha kwa ajili ya kuuza nje kupitia vyama vya ushirika vilivyosajiliwa, jambo ambalo linaweza kupunguza gharama za uidhinishaji wa mtu binafsi kwa hadi asilimia 80 ikilinganishwa na uidhinishaji pekee.

English: Coffee cooperatives exporting to the European Union are reminded that new deforestation due-diligence rules require GPS mapping of farm plots before shipment.
Kiswahili: Vyama vya ushirika vya kahawa vinavyosafirisha nje kwenda Umoja wa Ulaya vinakumbushwa kwamba sheria mpya za utunzaji wa ukataji miti zinahitaji ramani ya GPS ya viwanja vya shamba kabla ya kusafirishwa.

English: Farmers are notified that over 20 Kenyan agricultural products, including avocado, macadamia, coffee and tea, now qualify for duty-free access to Chinese markets starting May 2026.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaarifiwa kwamba zaidi ya bidhaa 20 za kilimo za Kenya, ikiwa ni pamoja na parachichi, makadamia, kahawa na chai, sasa zinastahili kupata huduma bila ushuru katika masoko ya China kuanzia Mei 2026.

English: Exporters are reminded that a KEPHIS phytosanitary certificate must be requested at least 48 hours before any produce shipment leaves the country.
Kiswahili: Wasafirishaji nje wanakumbushwa kwamba cheti cha usafi wa mimea cha KEPHIS lazima kiombwe angalau saa 48 kabla ya usafirishaji wowote wa mazao kuondoka nchini.

English: Kenya's avocado export earnings are projected to reach roughly KES 25 billion in 2026, driven by rising production and new market openings in Asia and the Middle East.
Kiswahili: Mapato ya mauzo ya nje ya parachichi nchini Kenya yanakadiriwa kufikia takriban shilingi bilioni 25 mwaka wa 2026, kutokana na kuongezeka kwa uzalishaji na fursa mpya za soko barani Asia na Mashariki ya Kati.

English: Many coffee farmers in Nyeri and Meru counties are shifting to avocado farming as coffee prices remain depressed on global markets, though industry leaders caution against abandoning coffee entirely.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wengi wa kahawa katika kaunti za Nyeri na Meru wanahamia kilimo cha parachichi huku bei za kahawa zikiendelea kushuka katika masoko ya kimataifa, ingawa viongozi wa sekta hiyo wanaonya dhidi ya kuachana kabisa na kahawa.

English: Farmers are advised to diversify markets rather than rely on a single export destination, as global commodity prices for produce like avocado and coffee can shift quickly.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kubadilisha masoko badala ya kutegemea sehemu moja ya kuuza nje, kwani bei za bidhaa za kimataifa kama vile parachichi na kahawa zinaweza kubadilika haraka.

English: The Ministry of Agriculture has launched a 'Sustainable Avocado' initiative encouraging farmers to adopt drip irrigation and rainwater harvesting to reduce the crop's environmental footprint.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo imezindua mpango wa 'Parachichi Endelevu' unaowahimiza wakulima kutumia umwagiliaji wa matone na uvunaji wa maji ya mvua ili kupunguza athari za kimazingira kwa zao hilo.

English: Farmer groups are calling on the government to invest more in agroecology, including organic fertilizer use and preservation of traditional seed systems, to build long-term food security.
Kiswahili: Vikundi vya wakulima vinatoa wito kwa serikali kuwekeza zaidi katika kilimo ikolojia, ikiwa ni pamoja na matumizi ya mbolea za kikaboni na uhifadhi wa mifumo ya mbegu za kitamaduni, ili kujenga usalama wa chakula wa muda mrefu.

English: KALRO researchers are urging wider adoption of drought-tolerant crop varieties and improved soil and water conservation methods to help farmers cope with increasingly frequent droughts and floods.
Kiswahili: Watafiti wa KALRO wanahimiza kupitishwa kwa aina mbalimbali za mazao yanayostahimili ukame na mbinu bora za kuhifadhi udongo na maji ili kuwasaidia wakulima kukabiliana na ukame na mafuriko yanayoongezeka mara kwa mara.

English: Farmer advocacy groups warn that relying on a single high-value crop such as avocado can be risky, and encourage maintaining diverse cropping systems for resilience.
Kiswahili: Vikundi vya utetezi wa wakulima vinaonya kwamba kutegemea zao moja la thamani kubwa kama vile parachichi kunaweza kuwa hatari, na kuhimiza kudumisha mifumo mbalimbali ya upandaji miti kwa ajili ya ustahimilivu.

English: Communities in avocado-growing regions such as Kandara and Thika are being asked to consider water-use impacts as intensive avocado farming expands in the area.
Kiswahili: Jamii katika maeneo yanayolima parachichi kama vile Kandara na Thika zinaombwa kuzingatia athari za matumizi ya maji huku kilimo kikubwa cha parachichi kikiongezeka katika eneo hilo.

English: Around 1,300 farmers in Bungoma County are taking part in facilitator-led farmer field schools that teach integrated pest management techniques for controlling fall armyworm.
Kiswahili: Takriban wakulima 1,300 katika Kaunti ya Bungoma wanashiriki katika shule za shambani za wakulima zinazoongozwa na wawezeshaji ambazo hufundisha mbinu jumuishi za kudhibiti wadudu waharibifu kwa ajili ya kudhibiti viwavi jeshi vya kuanguka.

English: KALRO is developing an AI-enabled call centre to give farmers round-the-clock access to agricultural advisory services through automated virtual agents.
Kiswahili: KALRO inaunda kituo cha simu kinachowezeshwa na akili bandia (AI) ili kuwapa wakulima ufikiaji wa huduma za ushauri wa kilimo saa nzima kupitia mawakala pepe otomatiki.

English: The Kenya Agricultural Observatory Platform now delivers ward-level weather forecasts and agro-advisories to farmers, reaching around 250,000 farmers a month across five counties.
Kiswahili: Jukwaa la Observatory ya Kilimo la Kenya sasa hutoa utabiri wa hali ya hewa katika ngazi ya kata na ushauri wa kilimo kwa wakulima, na kuwafikia wakulima wapatao 250,000 kwa mwezi katika kaunti tano.

English: Training sessions on soil mapping and precision agriculture are being rolled out to help farmers receive more accurate, AI-driven recommendations on soil management.
Kiswahili: Vipindi vya mafunzo kuhusu uchoraji ramani ya udongo na kilimo sahihi vinaanzishwa ili kuwasaidia wakulima kupokea mapendekezo sahihi zaidi, yanayoongozwa na akili bandia kuhusu usimamizi wa udongo.

English: Farmers, agribusinesses and researchers were invited to a five-day national conference in June 2026 to learn about new climate-smart technologies and agricultural innovations.
Kiswahili: Wakulima, biashara za kilimo na watafiti walialikwa kwenye mkutano wa kitaifa wa siku tano mnamo Juni 2026 ili kujifunza kuhusu teknolojia mpya zinazozingatia mabadiliko ya tabianchi na uvumbuzi wa kilimo.

English: Farmers in Meru County growing kale (sukuma wiki) are advised to rotate crops each season to break the cycle of Fall Armyworm.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru wanaolima kale (sukuma wiki) wanashauriwa kuzunguka mazao kila msimu ili kuvunja mzunguko wa viwavijeshi vya Fall Armyworm.

English: Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries advises farmers in Marsabit County to plant drought-tolerant bananas varieties ahead of the coming rains.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo, Mifugo na Uvuvi inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kupanda aina za ndizi zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya mvua zinazokuja.

English: Certified cotton seed is now available to farmers in Kajiado County through registered agro-dealers.
Kiswahili: Mbegu za pamba zilizoidhinishwa sasa zinapatikana kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kupitia wauzaji wa kilimo waliosajiliwa.

English: County Government Extension Services advises farmers in West Pokot County to plant drought-tolerant sunflower varieties ahead of the coming rains.
Kiswahili: Huduma za Ugani za Serikali ya Kaunti zinawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kupanda aina za alizeti zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya mvua zinazokuja.

English: Kenya National Farmers' Federation reminds onions farmers in Kericho County to test soil before applying fertilizer this planting season.
Kiswahili: Shirikisho la Kitaifa la Wakulima la Kenya linawakumbusha wakulima wa vitunguu katika Kaunti ya Kericho kujaribu udongo kabla ya kutumia mbolea msimu huu wa kupanda.

English: National Drought Management Authority reminds sunflower farmers in Nyeri County to test soil before applying fertilizer this planting season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kitaifa ya Usimamizi wa Ukame inawakumbusha wakulima wa alizeti katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kujaribu udongo kabla ya kutumia mbolea msimu huu wa kupanda.

English: Farmers in West Pokot County are urged to scout their sorghum fields weekly for signs of fruit flies infestation.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya West Pokot wanahimizwa kuchunguza mashamba yao ya mtama kila wiki ili kuona dalili za kushambuliwa na nzi wa matunda.

English: Farmers in Garissa County growing sunflower are advised to rotate crops each season to break the cycle of locusts.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa wanaolima alizeti wanashauriwa kuzunguka mazao kila msimu ili kuvunja mzunguko wa nzige.

English: Kenya National Farmers' Federation reminds millet farmers in Trans Nzoia County to test soil before applying fertilizer this planting season.
Kiswahili: Shirikisho la Kitaifa la Wakulima la Kenya linawakumbusha wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kujaribu udongo kabla ya kutumia mbolea msimu huu wa kupanda.

English: Timely planting of groundnuts in Kericho County is advised following updated rainfall forecasts from Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries.
Kiswahili: Kupanda karanga kwa wakati unaofaa katika Kaunti ya Kericho kunashauriwa kufuatia utabiri mpya wa mvua kutoka Wizara ya Kilimo, Mifugo na Uvuvi.

English: Farmers in Meru County growing passion fruit are advised to rotate crops each season to break the cycle of aflatoxin-producing fungi.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru wanaolima matunda ya passion wanashauriwa kuzunguka mazao kila msimu ili kuvunja mzunguko wa kuvu unaozalisha sumu ya aflatoxin.

English: Farmers in Siaya County growing sugarcane are advised to rotate crops each season to break the cycle of striga weed.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Siaya wanaolima miwa wanashauriwa kuzunguka mazao kila msimu ili kuvunja mzunguko wa magugu aina ya striga.

English: Timely planting of millet in Makueni County is advised following updated rainfall forecasts from County Directorate of Agriculture.
Kiswahili: Upandaji wa mtama kwa wakati unaofaa katika Kaunti ya Makueni unashauriwa kufuatia utabiri mpya wa mvua kutoka kwa Kurugenzi ya Kilimo ya Kaunti.

English: Directorate of Veterinary Services advises farmers in Narok County to plant drought-tolerant rice varieties ahead of the coming rains.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Huduma za Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok kupanda aina za mpunga zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya mvua zinazokuja.

English: Farmers in Bungoma County growing French beans are advised to rotate crops each season to break the cycle of striga weed.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma wanaolima maharagwe ya Kifaransa wanashauriwa kuzunguka mazao kila msimu ili kuvunja mzunguko wa magugu aina ya striga.

English: State Department for Cooperatives advises farmers in Nakuru County to plant drought-tolerant tea varieties ahead of the coming rains.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ushirika ya Jimbo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kupanda aina za chai zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya mvua zinazokuja.

English: Timely planting of cassava in Kajiado County is advised following updated rainfall forecasts from Agricultural Sector Transformation Programme.
Kiswahili: Kupanda mihogo kwa wakati unaofaa katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kunashauriwa kufuatia utabiri mpya wa mvua kutoka kwa Programu ya Mabadiliko ya Sekta ya Kilimo.

English: National Drought Management Authority is distributing subsidised coffee seed to smallholder farmers in Turkana County this planting season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kitaifa ya Usimamizi wa Ukame inasambaza mbegu za kahawa zilizopunguzwa ruzuku kwa wakulima wadogo katika Kaunti ya Turkana msimu huu wa upandaji.

English: FAO Kenya reminds cassava farmers in Kajiado County to test soil before applying fertilizer this planting season.
Kiswahili: FAO Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kupima udongo kabla ya kutumia mbolea msimu huu wa kupanda.

English: Timely planting of cassava in Baringo County is advised following updated rainfall forecasts from Directorate of Veterinary Services.
Kiswahili: Kupanda mihogo kwa wakati unaofaa katika Kaunti ya Baringo kunashauriwa kufuatia utabiri mpya wa mvua kutoka kwa Kurugenzi ya Huduma za Mifugo.

English: Farmers in Tharaka Nithi County growing sunflower are advised to rotate crops each season to break the cycle of striga weed.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi wanaolima alizeti wanashauriwa kuzunguka mazao kila msimu ili kuvunja mzunguko wa magugu aina ya striga.

English: Agricultural Sector Transformation Programme advises farmers in Garissa County to plant drought-tolerant wheat varieties ahead of the coming rains.
Kiswahili: Programu ya Mabadiliko ya Sekta ya Kilimo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa kupanda aina za ngano zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya mvua zinazokuja.

English: Farmers in Wajir County are urged to scout their rice fields weekly for signs of aflatoxin-producing fungi infestation.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir wanahimizwa kuchunguza mashamba yao ya mpunga kila wiki ili kuona dalili za uvamizi wa fangasi unaosababisha sumu ya aflatoxin.

English: Timely planting of beans in Embu County is advised following updated rainfall forecasts from National Cereals and Produce Board.
Kiswahili: Kupanda maharagwe kwa wakati unaofaa katika Kaunti ya Embu kunashauriwa kufuatia utabiri mpya wa mvua kutoka kwa Bodi ya Kitaifa ya Nafaka na Mazao.

English: National Cereals and Produce Board reminds beans farmers in Samburu County to test soil before applying fertilizer this planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Kitaifa ya Nafaka na Mazao inawakumbusha wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Samburu kupima udongo kabla ya kutumia mbolea msimu huu wa kupanda.

English: Certified kale (sukuma wiki) seed is now available to farmers in Tharaka Nithi County through registered agro-dealers.
Kiswahili: Mbegu za kale zilizothibitishwa (sukuma wiki) sasa zinapatikana kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi kupitia wauzaji wa kilimo waliosajiliwa.

English: Farmers in Wajir County growing beans are advised to rotate crops each season to break the cycle of maize stem borer.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir wanaolima maharagwe wanashauriwa kuzunguka mazao kila msimu ili kuvunja mzunguko wa vipekecha shina vya mahindi.

English: State Department for Cooperatives warns sweet potatoes farmers in Kajiado County against harvesting immature produce, which affects both quality and market access.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ushirika ya Jimbo inawaonya wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Kajiado dhidi ya kuvuna mazao yasiyoiva, ambayo huathiri ubora na upatikanaji wa soko.

English: Timely planting of mango in Embu County is advised following updated rainfall forecasts from FAO Kenya.
Kiswahili: Kupanda maembe kwa wakati unaofaa katika Kaunti ya Embu kunashauriwa kufuatia utabiri mpya wa mvua kutoka FAO Kenya.

English: State Department for Cooperatives advises farmers in Isiolo County to plant drought-tolerant tea varieties ahead of the coming rains.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ushirika ya Jimbo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kupanda aina za chai zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya mvua zinazokuja.

Kiswahili: Shirikisho la Kitaifa la Wakulima la Kenya linawakumbusha wakulima wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kujaribu udongo kabla ya kutumia mbolea msimu huu wa kupanda.

Kiswahili: Mbegu za ndizi zilizoidhinishwa sasa zinapatikana kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi kupitia wauzaji wa kilimo waliosajiliwa.

English: Certified passion fruit seed is now available to farmers in Isiolo County through registered agro-dealers.
Kiswahili: Mbegu za matunda ya passion zilizoidhinishwa sasa zinapatikana kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kupitia wauzaji wa kilimo waliosajiliwa.

Kiswahili: Idara ya Ushirika ya Jimbo inawaonya wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Wajir dhidi ya kuvuna mazao yasiyoiva, ambayo huathiri ubora na upatikanaji wa soko.

Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori wanaolima mtama wanashauriwa kuzunguka mazao kila msimu ili kuvunja mzunguko wa nzi wa matunda.

English: Farmers in Nakuru County growing passion fruit are advised to rotate crops each season to break the cycle of Fall Armyworm.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru wanaolima matunda ya passion wanashauriwa kuzunguka mazao kila msimu ili kuvunja mzunguko wa viwavijeshi vya Fall Armyworm.

English: Farmers in Kiambu County are urged to scout their kale (sukuma wiki) fields weekly for signs of fruit flies infestation.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu wanahimizwa kuchunguza mashamba yao ya kale (sukuma wiki) kila wiki kwa dalili za uvamizi wa nzi wa matunda.

English: Farmers in Kajiado County growing kale (sukuma wiki) are advised to rotate crops each season to break the cycle of locusts.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kajiado wanaolima kale (sukuma wiki) wanashauriwa kuzunguka mazao kila msimu ili kuvunja mzunguko wa nzige.

Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Embu kujaribu udongo kabla ya kutumia mbolea msimu huu wa kupanda.

English: Kenya Meteorological Department reminds groundnuts farmers in Tharaka Nithi County to test soil before applying fertilizer this planting season.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Hali ya Hewa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima wa karanga katika Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi kupima udongo kabla ya kutumia mbolea msimu huu wa kupanda.

English: Kenya National Farmers' Federation reminds maize farmers in Bungoma County to test soil before applying fertilizer this planting season.
Kiswahili: Shirikisho la Kitaifa la Wakulima la Kenya linawakumbusha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kujaribu udongo kabla ya kutumia mbolea msimu huu wa kupanda.

Kiswahili: Mbegu za mahindi zilizoidhinishwa sasa zinapatikana kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kupitia wauzaji wa kilimo waliosajiliwa.

English: Farmers in Nandi County growing cotton are advised to rotate crops each season to break the cycle of aflatoxin-producing fungi.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi wanaolima pamba wanashauriwa kuzunguka mazao kila msimu ili kuvunja mzunguko wa kuvu unaozalisha sumu ya aflatoxin.

English: Timely planting of mango in Baringo County is advised following updated rainfall forecasts from Kenya National Farmers' Federation.

Dholuo: Geng'o mag COVID-19 duto ni kare ne joma dongo, mine mapidho nyithindo, kendo kaluwore gi chike mag riwruok mar piny mangima mar thieth, mon ma yach bende nyalo tiyo kodgi ka laktar okonyogi.

English: Taking different types of vaccines is not recommended. After being fully vaccinated you will obtain your COVID-19 certificate  from the MOH website https://portal.health.go.ke.
Kiswahili: Kuchukua aina tofauti za chanjo haipendekezwi. Baada ya kuchanjwa kikamilifu utapata cheti chako cha COVID-19 kutoka kwa tovuti ya MOH https://portal.health.go.ke.
