Kiswahili: Mkakati wa kitaifa wa ACSM ulianzishwa ili kukuza ujumbe wa lishe na uelewa wa umma katika sekta mbalimbali.
Dholuo: Chenro mar ACSM mar piny owacho ne ochaki mondo ojiw weche mag chiemo kod ng'eyo mar oganda e yore mopogore opogore.

English: Announcing the lauch of Country plan that prioritizes maternal-child nutrition, agriculture‑education integration and multisector tracking.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza uzinduzi wa mpango wa Nchi unaoweka kipaumbele lishe ya mama na mtoto, ujumuishaji wa elimu ya kilimo na ufuatiliaji wa sekta nyingi.
Dholuo: Lando chenro manyien mar piny ma keto wach chiemo mar mine kod nyithindo, pur kod somo e rang'iny ma malo, kod luwo yore mopogore opogore.

English: Announing a nutrition education & weekly iron–folic acid supplementation delivered to adolescents across Busia, Kitui & Nakuru.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza elimu ya lishe na nyongeza ya kila wiki ya asidi ya chuma-foliki inayotolewa kwa vijana kote Busia, Kitui na Nakuru.
Dholuo: Lando wach tiegruok e weche mag chiemo kod medo yedhe mag iron ⁇ folic acid juma ka juma ne rowere e gwenge mag Busia, Kitui kod Nakuru.

English: Announcing Nairobi county initiative to fund vegetable gardens in primary schools to improve diet diversity and learning.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza mpango wa kaunti ya Nairobi wa kufadhili bustani za mboga katika shule za msingi ili kuboresha utofauti wa lishe na ujifunzaji.
Dholuo: Lando chenro mar county ma Nairobi mar chiwo pesa ne puothe mag alot e skunde mag praimari mondo okony e miyo chiemo obed mopogore opogore kod puonjruok.

English: Announcing a New opt-in SMS platform sends weekly advice on healthy diets, food safety, and portion control.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza jukwaa jipya la SMS la kujiandikisha hutuma ushauri wa kila wiki kuhusu lishe bora, usalama wa chakula, na udhibiti wa ulaji.
Dholuo: Lando chenro manyien mar SMS ma ng'ato nyalo yiero tiyogo, ma oro paro juma ka juma e wi chiemo maber, ritruok e chiemo, kod kaka ng'ato nyalo tiyo gi chiemo morome.

English: Java to offer nutrition to national teams. Men and women teams in camp for Africa Games
Kiswahili: Java kutoa lishe kwa timu za taifa. Timu za wanaume na wanawake kambini kwa ajili ya Michezo ya Afrika
Dholuo: Java mondo ochiw chiemo ne jotugo mag pinyno. Jotim tuke mag chwo gi mon e kambi mar tuke mag Afrika

English: Kenya, UNICEF, World Bank unveil Nutrition Improvement. Through Cash and Health Education programme in 11 counties
Kiswahili: Kenya, UNICEF, Benki ya Dunia yafichua Uboreshaji wa Lishe. Kupitia mpango wa Fedha na Elimu ya Afya katika kaunti 11
Dholuo: Kenya, UNICEF, kod World Bank elo dongruok e yore mag chiemo. Kokalo kuom chenro mar Cash and Health Education program e counties 11

English: Blue band kicks off the campaign in Nairobi. Campaign aims at promoting good nutrition
Kiswahili: Bendi ya Bluu yaanza kampeni jijini Nairobi. Kampeni inalenga kukuza lishe bora
Dholuo: Blue band chako kampen e Nairobi. Kampenno dwaro jiwo wach chiemo maber

English: Kenya’s Push To Promote Traditional Food Is Good For Nutrition And Cultural Heritage
Kiswahili: Shinikizo la Kenya la Kukuza Chakula cha Jadi ni Nzuri kwa Lishe na Urithi wa Utamaduni
Dholuo: Chenro mar Kenya mar jiwo chiemo ma ne chon itiyogo konyo e miyo ji chiemo maber kod rito mwandu mag oganda

English: Announcing launch of a multi-county project to reinforce nutritious food availability during shocks and crises.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza uzinduzi wa mradi wa kaunti nyingi ili kuimarisha upatikanaji wa chakula chenye lishe wakati wa mishtuko na migogoro.
Dholuo: Lando wach chako chenro mar gwenge mang'eny mar medo chiemo maber e kinde mag chandruok kod chandruok.

English: Launch of a pilot to provide free milk twice weekly to primary school children in Migori and Nakuru counties.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa majaribio ya kutoa maziwa ya bure mara mbili kwa wiki kwa watoto wa shule za msingi katika kaunti za Migori na Nakuru.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar chenro mar chiwo chak maonge chudo nyadiriyo juma ka juma ne nyithindo ma dhi e skunde mag praimari e counties mag Migori kod Nakuru.

English: Introduction of MoreMilk 2, aimed at improving milk safety and incomes via standards, training, and market access in central/western Kenya.
Kiswahili: Utangulizi wa MoreMilk2, unaolenga kuboresha usalama wa maziwa na mapato kupitia viwango, mafunzo, na ufikiaji wa soko katikati/magharibi mwa Kenya.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi MoreMilk 2, ma dwaro ni omed geng'o tuoche mag chak kod kelo yuto kokalo kuom chike, tiegruok, kod yudo thuolo mar dhi e chiro e Kenya.

English: National target set to raise annual milk yield from 5.2B to 10B liters, boosting smallholder farmer incomes.
Kiswahili: Lengo la kitaifa limewekwa kuongeza mavuno ya maziwa ya kila mwaka kutoka lita bilioni 5.2 hadi bilioni 10, na hivyo kuongeza kipato cha wakulima wadogo.
Dholuo: Chenro mar piny owacho mar medo nyak mar chak higa ka higa koa e lita bilion 5.2 nyaka bilion 10, kendo medo pesa ma jopur matindo yudo.

English: Launch of the MaziwaPlus initiative in Nyeri County to reduce mastitis incidence and curb antibiotic overuse in dairy cattle.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa mpango wa MaziwaPlus katika Kaunti ya Nyeri ili kupunguza matukio ya ugonjwa wa mastitis na kupunguza matumizi ya dawa za kuua vijidudu kupita kiasi kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar chenro mar MaziwaPlus e kaunti mar Nyeri mar duoko piny tuo mar mastitis kod geng'o tiyo gi antibayotik mokalo tong' e dhok mag chak.

English: Announcement that MoH and SUNCSA coalition will launch public health campaign integrating sanitation and nutrition messaging.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba muungano wa Wizara ya Afya na SUNCSA utazindua kampeni ya afya ya umma inayojumuisha ujumbe wa usafi na lishe.
Dholuo: Lando ni riwruok mar MoH kod SUNCSA biro chako kampen mar thieth mar oganda ka oriwo weche mag ler kod chiemo.

English: Official statement reaffirming Kenya’s commitment to front-of-pack labeling, food marketing restrictions, and cross-border policy coordination.
Kiswahili: Taarifa rasmi inayothibitisha tena kujitolea kwa Kenya katika uwekaji lebo wa bidhaa za chakula, vikwazo vya uuzaji wa chakula, na uratibu wa sera za mipakani.
Dholuo: Wach mowuok kuom joloch mag Kenya ma jiwo kaka Kenya oseng'ado mar keto alama e nyim chiemo, keto chike mag keto chiemo e chiro, kod chano yore mag kelo winjruok e kind pinje.

English: Announcement of multi-sector collaboration to support school nutrition and small-scale dairy livelihoods through public procurement.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la ushirikiano wa sekta mbalimbali ili kusaidia lishe shuleni na riziki ndogo za maziwa kupitia ununuzi wa umma.
Dholuo: Lando mar tudruok e kind migepe mopogore opogore mondo okony chiemo e skunde kod yore mag dak mar joma tiyo gi chak e okang' matin kokalo kuom chenro mar ng'iewo gik moko.

English: Public launch event held to introduce the MoreMilk 2 initiative intended to enhance milk handling and market access in key milk-producing counties.
Kiswahili: Hafla ya uzinduzi wa hadhara ilifanyika ili kutambulisha mpango wa MoreMilk2 unaolenga kuboresha utunzaji wa maziwa na upatikanaji wa soko katika kaunti muhimu zinazozalisha maziwa.
Dholuo: Chokruok ma ne itimo e lela mar chako chenro mar MoreMilk 2 ma ne dhi konyo ji ng'iewo chak e gwenge ma nigi chak mang'eny.

English: Announcement that pre‑service nursing curriculum now includes nutrition and wellness modules for community care.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba mtaala wa uuguzi wa kabla ya huduma sasa unajumuisha moduli za lishe na ustawi kwa ajili ya utunzaji wa jamii.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo ni program mar tiegruok e weche thieth sani oriwo weche mag chiemo kod ngima maber mar joma odak e alwora.

English: Public statement endorsing millet, sorghum and legumes for sustainability and dietary resilience.
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya umma inayounga mkono mtama, mtama na kunde kwa ajili ya uendelevu na ustahimilivu wa lishe.
Dholuo: Wach ma ji duto ong'eyo ma jiwo ni mondo chiemo ma ji chamo obed ma siko kendo okethre, dwarore ni ji duto ocham millet, sorghum, kod alode.

English: Announcement that clubs will offer peer-led education, counseling referrals and healthy cafeteria initiatives.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba vilabu vitatoa elimu inayoongozwa na wenzao, marejeleo ya ushauri nasaha na mipango ya mkahawa yenye afya.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo ni Clubs biro chiwo tiegruok ma jowetegi ema tayo, chiwo paro e weche mag thieth kod chenro mag kuonde chiemo.

English: Release of national media campaign explaining new front-of-pack labelling to consumers.
Kiswahili: Kutolewa kwa kampeni ya kitaifa ya vyombo vya habari inayoelezea lebo mpya za mbele kwa watumiaji.
Dholuo: Goyo kampen mar lando weche e okang' malach e piny mangima ka ilero ne joma tiyo gi gik moko weche manyien e nyim gik moko.

English: Campaign encouraging edible oil producers to reduce sodium content through voluntary pledge scheme.
Kiswahili: Kampeni ya kuwahimiza wazalishaji wa mafuta ya kula kupunguza kiwango cha sodiamu kupitia mpango wa ahadi ya hiari.
Dholuo: Kampen ma jiwo joma loso mo mar chiemo mondo odwok chien sodium ma gin - go kokalo kuom chenro mar chiwruok ma onge achune.

English: Announcement of influencer-led digital media campaign promoting self-care, destigmatization, and helpline awareness in mental wellness week.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la kampeni ya vyombo vya habari vya kidijitali inayoongozwa na watu wenye ushawishi inayokuza utunzaji binafsi, udhalilishaji, na ufahamu wa simu ya usaidizi katika wiki ya ustawi wa akili.
Dholuo: Lando mar kampen mar digital media mitayo gi joma nigi teko mar jiwo ritruok ma ng'ato owuon timo, tieko wichkuot, kendo konyo ji ng'eyo kaka ginyalo rito ngimagi e kinde mar juma mar paro.

English: Launch of hydroponic garden pilot to supply fresh vegetables in school cafeterias in dry areas.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa majaribio ya bustani ya hydroponic ili kusambaza mboga mbichi katika mikahawa ya shule katika maeneo makavu.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar tiyo gi puothe mag hydroponic e chiwo alot manyien e kafeteria mag skunde e gwenge motwo.

English: Announcement of AI-based nutrition and wellness advice service tailored for elderly citizens and caregivers.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la huduma ya ushauri wa lishe na ustawi inayotegemea akili bandia iliyoundwa kwa ajili ya wazee na walezi.
Dholuo: Lando mar AI-based nutrition and wellness advice service molos ne jodongo kod joma ritogi.

English: Announcement of SMS service sending tailored postpartum diet and wellness tips to new mothers.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la huduma ya SMS inayotuma vidokezo vya lishe na ustawi vilivyoundwa mahususi kwa akina mama wapya.
Dholuo: Lando mar SMS mar oro paro mag chiemo kod ngima maber ne mine mapod nyien.

English: Population Services Kenya launches Iron-Folate supplement and nutrition education sessions for adolescents in Busia, Kitui & Nakuru.
Kiswahili: Huduma za Idadi ya Watu Kenya zazindua vikao vya elimu ya virutubisho vya Iron-Folate na lishe kwa vijana huko Busia, Kitui na Nakuru.
Dholuo: Population Services Kenya ochako chenro mar Iron-Folate supplement kod tiegruok e weche mag chiemo ne rowere e Busia, Kitui & Nakuru.

English: Official launch of $5 billion FNRP to support food security across 24 ASAL counties, targeting 5M vulnerable Kenyans.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi rasmi wa FNRP ya dola bilioni 5 ili kusaidia usalama wa chakula katika kaunti 24 za ASAL, ukilenga Wakenya milioni 5 walio katika mazingira magumu.
Dholuo: Chiwo mar pesa mar bilion 5 mar FNRP mar siro chiemo e gwenge 24 mag ASAL, ka ichano ne jo Kenya 5M ma ok nyal kony.

English: Announcement of series of county learning forums emphasizing breastfeeding support, community hygiene, and infant diet education.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la mfululizo wa mabaraza ya kujifunza ya kaunti yanayosisitiza usaidizi wa kunyonyesha, usafi wa jamii, na elimu ya lishe ya watoto wachanga.
Dholuo: Lando chenro mar romo mag county mar puonjruok ka gijiwo kony mar miyo nyithindo ma nyiri chiemo gi kanyono, rito ler mar alwora, kod puonjo nyithindo e wi chiemo.

English: Celebrations as Kenya surpasses the WHO target with exclusive breastfeeding rates rising above 50%; commitment extended to sustain improvements.
Kiswahili: Sherehe huku Kenya ikizidi lengo la WHO huku viwango vya unyonyeshaji pekee vikiongezeka zaidi ya 50%; ahadi imeongezwa ili kudumisha maboresho.
Dholuo: Nyasi kaka Kenya okalo tarig mar WHO ka kwan mar nyithindo ma nyiri ma nyiri kende ema pidho nyithindgi gi minegi omedore mokalo 50%; chiwruok omed mondo okony dongruok.

English: Announcement of TOT training initiative for 26 health workers from four counties under BFHI supported by USAID.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la mpango wa mafunzo ya TOT kwa wafanyakazi 26 wa afya kutoka kaunti nne chini ya BFHI inayoungwa mkono na USAID.
Dholuo: Chenro mar tiegruok mar TOT ne jotich mag thieth 26 moa e kaunti ang'wen e bwo BFHI ka USAID riwo lwedo.

English: Elgeyo Marakwet County officially rolls out CNAP targeting a reduction of child stunting from 30% to 22%.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Elgeyo Marakwet yazindua rasmi mpango wa CNAP unaolenga kupunguza udumavu wa watoto kutoka 30% hadi 22%.
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Elgeyo Marakwet oseloso chenro mar CNAP ma dwaro ni odwok chien kwan mar nyithindo ma ok dhi maber kowuok 30% nyaka 22%.

English: Announcement of free school milk program for primary pupils in Migori and Nakuru to improve child nutrition and school attendance.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la mpango wa maziwa ya bure kwa wanafunzi wa shule za msingi huko Migori na Nakuru ili kuboresha lishe ya watoto na mahudhurio shuleni.
Dholuo: Lando mar chenro mar nono chak e skul maonge chudo ne jopuonjre e primari e Migori kod Nakuru mondo omed miyo nyithindo chiemo kod dhi e skul.

English: Launch of four-year dairy quality improvement initiative in central and western Kenya targeting smallholder producers.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa mpango wa miaka minne wa kuboresha ubora wa maziwa katikati na magharibi mwa Kenya unaolenga wazalishaji wadogo.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar chenro mar higni ang'wen mar medo lony e yore mag loso chak e Kenya ma yo milambo kod ma dier pinyno, ma oket ne jopur matindo.

English: Announcement setting national target to increase milk production to 10 billion liters, supporting dairy livelihoods and nutrition.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la kuweka lengo la kitaifa la kuongeza uzalishaji wa maziwa hadi lita bilioni 10, kusaidia maisha ya maziwa na lishe.
Dholuo: Lando mar keto chenro mar piny mangima mar medo chak mar chak nyaka bilion 10 lita, ka gikonyo yore mag yuto kod chiemo mag joma loso chak.

English: Official launch of a campaign integrating sanitation and nutrition messaging, coordinated via civil society coalitions.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi rasmi wa kampeni inayojumuisha usafi wa mazingira na ujumbe wa lishe, iliyoratibiwa kupitia miungano ya asasi za kiraia.
Dholuo: Chiwruok mar kampen mar chiwo weche mag ler kod chiemo, ma itimo kokalo kuom riwruoge mag oganda.

English: Launch of national Advocacy, Communication & Social Mobilization plan for better public understanding of nutrition.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa mpango wa kitaifa wa Utetezi, Mawasiliano na Uhamasishaji wa Kijamii kwa ajili ya uelewa bora wa umma kuhusu lishe.
Dholuo: Chako chenro mar lando weche mag chiemo e okang' ma malo e piny mangima.

English: Official announcement of adolescent iron–folic acid supplementation program reaching over 160,000 youth.
Kiswahili: Tangazo rasmi la mpango wa kuongeza asidi ya chuma-foliki kwa vijana linawafikia zaidi ya vijana 160,000.
Dholuo: Wach motim ayanga mar program mar medo iron ⁇ folic acid ne rowere ma kwan-gi okalo 160,000.

English: Ministry of Health hosts forum with media partners to promote breastfeeding benefits for working parents.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya huandaa jukwaa na washirika wa vyombo vya habari ili kutangaza faida za kunyonyesha kwa wazazi wanaofanya kazi.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth ochano romo gi jofwamb weche mondo gijiw ber mar nyodo ne jonyuol matiyo.

English: Official media brief on latest DHS findings showing decline; call to re-invest in maternity supports and lactation facilities.
Kiswahili: Taarifa rasmi kwa vyombo vya habari kuhusu matokeo ya hivi karibuni ya DHS yanayoonyesha kupungua; wito wa kuwekeza tena katika vituo vya usaidizi wa uzazi na unyonyeshaji.
Dholuo: Jofwamb weche mag sirkal chiwo ripot machuok e wi weche manyien ma DHS osefwenyo manyiso ni kwan mar joma nigi midekre mar kansa osedok chien; kwayo mondo ochak oket pesa kendo e yore mag konyo mine e nyuol koda e kuonde ma nyithindo thiewoe.

English: Announcement of Minitry of Health, private sector, NGOs pledge to strengthen school meals, market nutrition, and community gardens.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la Wizara ya Afya, sekta binafsi, mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali yaahidi kuimarisha milo shuleni, lishe ya sokoni, na bustani za jamii.
Dholuo: Chenro mar Ministry of Health, private sector, NGOs osingore mar tego chiemo e skunde, chiemo e chiro, kod puothe mag ji.

English: Official roll-out of grant scheme to support vegetable gardens and school nutrition across Nairobi's public primary schools.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi rasmi wa mpango wa ruzuku ili kusaidia bustani za mboga na lishe shuleni katika shule za msingi za umma jijini Nairobi.
Dholuo: Loso chenro mar chiwo kony mar konyo puothe mag alot kod chiemo e skunde e skunde duto mag Nairobi.

English: Announcement of new SMS service sending weekly nutrition tips, food safety alerts and diet guidance to subscribers.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la huduma mpya ya SMS inayotuma vidokezo vya lishe vya kila wiki, arifa za usalama wa chakula na mwongozo wa lishe kwa waliojisajili.
Dholuo: Chiwruok mar SMS manyien mar oro paro mag chiemo juma ka juma, siem mag chiemo kod weche mag chiemo ne joma ondikogi.

English: Ministry releasing comprehensive strategy following success of KNAP 2018–2022, targeting multisectoral interventions to further reduce malnutrition rates.
Kiswahili: Wizara ikitoa mkakati kamili kufuatia mafanikio ya KNAP 2018–2022, ikilenga uingiliaji kati wa sekta mbalimbali ili kupunguza zaidi viwango vya utapiamlo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche mag chiemo ne ogolo chenro moro maduong' bang' KNAP 2018 ⁇ 2022, ma ne oriwo yore mopogore opogore mag konyo ji mondo kik gichak chamo chiemo moromo.

English: Announcement about SNV pledging continued support to Kenya’s food systems transformation during Nairobi National Summit.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kuhusu SNV kuahidi kuendelea kuunga mkono mabadiliko ya mifumo ya chakula nchini Kenya wakati wa Mkutano wa Kitaifa wa Nairobi.
Dholuo: Wach mar SNV mar dhi nyime gi kony ne Kenya e loko chenro mag chiemo e kinde Nairobi National Summit.

English: Formal launch of digital advocacy initiative mobilizing influencers and civil society to promote nutrient profiling, FOP labelling, and policy change.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi rasmi wa mpango wa utetezi wa kidijitali unaowahamasisha watu wenye ushawishi na asasi za kiraia ili kukuza uainishaji wa virutubisho, uwekaji lebo wa FOP, na mabadiliko ya sera.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar chenro mar digital advocacy mar choko jogo ma nigi teko kod oganda mar oganda mondo gijiw weche mag chiemo, keto alama mag FOP, kod loko chike.

English: Announcing the launch of Kenya Market Assessment highlighting need for warning labels under new nutrient profiling model.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza uzinduzi wa Tathmini ya Soko la Kenya ikiangazia hitaji la lebo za tahadhari chini ya mfumo mpya wa uainishaji wa virutubisho.
Dholuo: Lando wach chako nono mar Kenya Market Assessment ka ginyiso ni dwarore ni ondik weche mag siem kaluwore gi chenro manyien mar nono gik ma miyo chiemo bedo maber.

English: MoH reaffirms Kenya’s commitment to spearheading East African food environment policies including front-of-pack labeling.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inathibitisha tena kujitolea kwa Kenya katika kuongoza sera za mazingira ya chakula za Afrika Mashariki ikiwa ni pamoja na uwekaji lebo kwenye pakiti.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Thieth jiwo kinda mar Kenya mar telo e weche mag alwora mar chiemo e Afrika ma Ugwe, moriwo nyaka keto alama e nyim chiemo.

English: Government and dairy sector jointly announcing reviving school milk distribution to enhance child nutrition and support local dairy industry.
Kiswahili: Serikali na sekta ya maziwa kwa pamoja wanatangaza kufufua usambazaji wa maziwa shuleni ili kuboresha lishe ya watoto na kusaidia tasnia ya maziwa ya ndani.
Dholuo: Sirkal kod joma tiyo e kembe mag loso chak kaachiel gi joma tiyo e kembe mag loso chak, lando e yo moriere ni gibiro duoko chien chenro mar pogo chak e skunde mondo gimed konyo nyithindo yudo chiemo maber kendo konyo joma tiyo e kembe mag loso chak.

English: Announcing official ratification of United Nations framework for coordinated multisector nutrition interventions to tackle malnutrition nationwide.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza kuidhinishwa rasmi kwa mfumo wa Umoja wa Mataifa kwa ajili ya uingiliaji kati wa lishe wa sekta mbalimbali ili kukabiliana na utapiamlo kote nchini.
Dholuo: Lando ratiro mar riwruok mar pinje mag ogendini e wi chenro mar riwruok mar pinje mag ogendini e weche mag chiemo e yore mopogore opogore mondo okony e kedo gi midekre mar chiemo e piny mangima.

English: Public launch of irrigated crop and fodder production in Naoros, where malnutrition cases among under-fives declined by 41% thanks to integrated agricultural-nutrition interventions.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa umma wa uzalishaji wa mazao ya umwagiliaji na malisho ya mifugo huko Naoros, ambapo visa vya utapiamlo miongoni mwa watoto walio chini ya umri wa miaka mitano vilipungua kwa 41% kutokana na hatua jumuishi za kilimo na lishe.
Dholuo: Ne ochak tich mar pidho puothe kod pidho jamni e piny Naoros, kama kwan mar nyithindo ma nigi midekre mar yuto ne odok chien gi pasent 41 nikech chenro mag pur gi chiemo.

English: Public announcement of national campaign targeting rice, flour and oil millers to adhere to micronutrient fortification standards, including awards for top performers.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la umma la kampeni ya kitaifa inayolenga wasagaji wa mchele, unga na mafuta kuzingatia viwango vya urutubishaji wa virutubisho, ikiwa ni pamoja na tuzo kwa waliofanya vyema.
Dholuo: Lando ne ji duto mar kampen mar piny mangima mar jiwo jo molos osuru, mogo, kod mo mondo oluw chike mag medo chiemo e gik matindo, moriwo nyaka chiwo mich ne joma timo maber moloyo.

English: Official launch of program training villagers including women for home gardens supplying nutrient-dense produce for households and schools.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi rasmi wa programu ya mafunzo kwa wanakijiji wakiwemo wanawake kwa ajili ya bustani za nyumbani zinazotoa mazao yenye virutubisho vingi kwa kaya na shule.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar chenro mar tiego jopiny moriwo nyaka mon e tij pidho puothe mag udi ka gichiwo chiemo ma nigi chiemo mang'eny ne udi koda ne skunde.

English: Announcement of millet and sorghum adoption to promote climate-smart, nutrient-rich diets at national policy forum.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la kupitishwa kwa mtama na mtama ili kukuza lishe bora na zenye virutubisho vinavyozingatia hali ya hewa katika jukwaa la kitaifa la sera.
Dholuo: Lando wach mar kawo millet kod sorghum mondo ojiw kit chiemo ma miyo piny bedo gi lokruok e kit yamo, kod chiemo mopong' gi gik ma miyo del bedo gi ngima maber e kinde chokruok maduong' mar piny mangima.

English: Public launch of rice products fortified with iron, folic acid, B-vitamins, iodine and zinc, aligned with government fortification standards.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa umma wa bidhaa za mchele zilizoongezewa madini ya chuma, asidi ya foliki, vitamini B, iodini na zinki, unaoendana na viwango vya serikali vya urutubishaji.
Dholuo: Chiwruok ne ji duto mar chiemo mowuok e cham mowir gi chuma, folic acid, B-vitamins, iodine kod zinc, kaluwore gi chike mag sirkal.

English: Announcement of staff health screening (BMI, blood pressure, blood sugar) and wellness baseline to shape ongoing workplace wellness programming.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la uchunguzi wa afya ya wafanyakazi (BMI, shinikizo la damu, sukari ya damu) na msingi wa ustawi ili kuunda programu zinazoendelea za ustawi mahali pa kazi.
Dholuo: Lando mar thieth mar jotich (BMI, blood pressure, blood sugar) kod ngima maber mondo okony e loso chenro mag ngima maber e kuonde tich.

English: Call for small food vendors to reformulate products to meet nutrition standards and enter competition for rewards.
Kiswahili: Wito kwa wachuuzi wadogo wa vyakula kurekebisha bidhaa ili zikidhi viwango vya lishe na kuingia katika ushindani wa zawadi.
Dholuo: Luong jo ohala matindo mag chiemo mondo gilok kitgi mar loso chiemo mondo ochop chike mag chiemo kendo gichak piem mondo giyud mich.

English: Official launch of biofertilizer to increase micronutrient content in crops grown in six counties.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi rasmi wa mbolea ya kibiolojia ili kuongeza kiwango cha virutubisho katika mazao yanayolimwa katika kaunti sita.
Dholuo: Loso chenro mar tiyo gi biofertilizer mondo omed gik makonyo e loso chiemo e pinje auchiel.

English: Announcement opening applications for grants to employers to establish gyms or fitness zones for staff.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la kufungua maombi ya ruzuku kwa waajiri ili kuanzisha maeneo ya mazoezi ya viungo au mazoezi ya viungo kwa wafanyakazi.
Dholuo: Chenro mar chako kwayo mar kony ne joma ondiko tich mondo olos kuonde timo tuke mag rieyo del kata kuonde timo tiegruok mag del ne jotich.

English: Public announcement of competition to promote local nutritious recipes using fortified or indigenous ingredients.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la umma la shindano la kutangaza mapishi yenye virutubisho vya kienyeji kwa kutumia viungo vilivyoongezwa virutubisho au vya asili.
Dholuo: Lando ne ji duto wach piem mar lando yore mag loso chiemo mabeyo e alworano kitiyo gi gik ma ne oket e alworano.

English: Launch of smartphone app to track daily steps, hydration, dietary intake, and stress levels with community leaderboards.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa programu ya simu mahiri ili kufuatilia hatua za kila siku, unyevu, ulaji wa chakula, na viwango vya msongo wa mawazo kwa kutumia ubao wa viongozi wa jamii.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar app mar smartphone mar nono okenge ma ng'ato kawo pile, pi, chiemo ma ng'ato chamo, kod pek ma ng'ato nigo kaluwore gi joma nie kanyakla.

Kiswahili: Uzinduzi rasmi wa mbolea ya kibiolojia ili kuongeza kiwango cha virutubisho katika mazao yanayolimwa katika kaunti sita.
Dholuo: Loso chenro mar tiyo gi biofertilizer mondo omed gik makonyo e loso chiemo e pinje auchiel.

Kiswahili: Tangazo la kufungua maombi ya ruzuku kwa waajiri ili kuanzisha maeneo ya mazoezi ya viungo au mazoezi ya viungo kwa wafanyakazi.
Dholuo: Chenro mar elo kwayo mag kony ne joma ondiko ji tich mondo gichak kuonde timo tuke mag rieyo del kata kuonde timo tuke mag rieyo del ne jotich.

Kiswahili: Tangazo la umma la shindano la kutangaza mapishi yenye virutubisho vya kienyeji kwa kutumia viungo vilivyoongezwa virutubisho au vya asili.
Dholuo: Lando ne ji duto wach piem mar lando yore mag loso chiemo mabeyo e alworano kitiyo gi gik ma olos gi lowo kata gik ma ne olosgo e pinyno.

Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa programu ya simu mahiri ili kufuatilia hatua za kila siku, unyevu, ulaji wa chakula, na viwango vya msongo wa mawazo kwa kutumia ubao wa viongozi wa jamii.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar app mar smartphone mar nono okenge ma ng'ato kawo pile, pi, chiemo ma ng'ato chamo, kod pek ma ng'ato nigo kaluwore gi joma nie kanyakla.

English: Public declaration of stress management, substance abuse, workplace safety, and wellness training for employers via FKE curriculum.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la umma la usimamizi wa msongo wa mawazo, matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya, usalama mahali pa kazi, na mafunzo ya ustawi kwa waajiri kupitia mtaala wa FKE.
Dholuo: Lando ne ji duto kuom tiegruok e weche mag kedo gi parruok, tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero, ritruok kar tich, kod ngima maber ne joma tiyo kokalo kuom chenro mar somo mar FKE.

English: Launch of a customizable wellness approach combining psychoeducation, screenings, group sessions, and organizational policy consulting for employee wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa mbinu ya ustawi inayoweza kubadilishwa inayochanganya elimu ya kisaikolojia, uchunguzi, vikao vya kikundi, na ushauri wa sera za shirika kwa ajili ya ustawi wa wafanyakazi.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar chenro mar ngima maber ma ng'ato owuon nyalo luwo ka oriwo tiegruok mar paro, nonro mag tuoche, romo mag grube, kod paro e wi chike mag riwruok mag jotich.

English: Announcement of Kenya’s first AI‑powered mental health & wellness platform offering tailored self-care, assessments, and access to professional counselling.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la jukwaa la kwanza la afya ya akili na ustawi linaloendeshwa na akili bandia nchini Kenya linalotoa huduma ya kujitunza, tathmini, na ufikiaji wa ushauri nasaha wa kitaalamu.
Dholuo: Lando mar Kenya's mokwongo mar AI-powered mental health & wellness platform ma chiwo ritruok ma ng'ato owuon, nonro, kod yudo kony mag joma olony.

English: Announcement that public service will now provide tele and in-person counselling services through Huduma Centres and hotline 1919.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba huduma ya umma sasa itatoa huduma za ushauri nasaha kwa njia ya simu na ana kwa ana kupitia Vituo vya Huduma na simu ya dharura 1919.
Dholuo: Lando ni sirkal koro biro chiwo tele kod weche mag ng'ato ka ng'ato kokalo kuom Huduma Centres kod hotline 1919.

English: Public invitation and details for October 2025 national conference themed “Securing the Future” on holistic mental health.
Kiswahili: Mwaliko wa umma na maelezo ya mkutano wa kitaifa wa Oktoba 2025 wenye mada "Kulinda Mustakabali" kuhusu afya ya akili kamili.
Dholuo: Luong mar ji duto kod weche ma nyiso kaka ibiro tim chokruok mar piny mangima e dwe mar Oktoba 2025 ma wiye wacho ni "Bedo gi Geno Maber ne Kinde Mabiro" ma wuoyo e wi tuoche mag paro.

English: Gertrudes Cancer Walk: Walk held to raise funds for children with Cancer. Thousands turned up for the walk in Nairobi
Kiswahili: Matembezi ya Saratani ya Gertrudes: Matembezi yafanyika ili kuchangisha fedha kwa ajili ya watoto wenye Saratani. Maelfu walijitokeza kwa ajili ya matembezi hayo jijini Nairobi
Dholuo: Wuoth mar Gertrudes Cancer Walk: Wuoth ma itimo mondo ochok pesa ne nyithindo ma nigi tuo mar Cancer. Ji gana gi gana nobiro e wuodhno Nairobi

English: Gov't increases SHA benefits for Cancer patients, adds real-time claims tracking
Kiswahili: Serikali haiongezi faida za SHA kwa wagonjwa wa Saratani, inaongeza ufuatiliaji wa madai ya wakati halisi
Dholuo: Sirkal medo kony mag SHA ne joma nigi tuo mar kansa, medo luwo kwayo e sa mowinjore

English:
World cancer day themed 'united by unique'. Experts emphasize on individualized patient-centered care. Govt called upon to ensure easy accessibility to cancer services  
Rising burden of cancer considered a threat to the economy
Kiswahili:
Siku ya saratani duniani yenye mada 'kuunganishwa na kipekee'. Wataalamu wanasisitiza huduma ya kibinafsi inayolenga mgonjwa. Serikali imeomba kuhakikisha upatikanaji rahisi wa huduma za saratani.
Mzigo unaoongezeka wa saratani unachukuliwa kuwa tishio kwa uchumi
Dholuo:
Odiechieng' mar thieth mar kansa e piny mangima ne dhi bedo gi wich mawacho ni, 'Winjruok e kind gik mopogore opogore.' Lakteche jiwo ahinya wach rito jatuwo ka luwore gi chal mare. Ne okwa sirkal mondo omi ji thuolo mar yudo thieth mar kansa e yo mayot
Medruok mar tuo mar kansa en gima kelo hinyruok ne yuto mar piny

English: Oncology clinic launched in Samburu County 10 cases of cancer reported monthly in Samburu. Barasa Centre makes cancer treatment accessible. We have been able to treat four patients
Kiswahili: Kliniki ya saratani yazinduliwa katika Kaunti ya Samburu. Visa 10 vya saratani vinaripotiwa kila mwezi huko Samburu. Kituo cha Barasa hufanya matibabu ya saratani yapatikane. Tumeweza kuwatibu wagonjwa wanne.
Dholuo: Klinik mar oncology ne ochak e Samburu County ji 10 ma nigi tuo mar kansa ne oyud dwe ka dwe e Samburu. Barasa Centre miyo thieth mar kansa bedo mayot. Wasetiyo gi yore ang'wen mag thieth

English: Government calling on employers to integrate mental wellness supports into occupational safety standards.
Kiswahili: Serikali inatoa wito kwa waajiri kuunganisha usaidizi wa afya ya akili katika viwango vya usalama kazini.
Dholuo: Sirkal ne okwayo jotend tich mondo oriw kony mag thieth mar paro gi chike mag rito ngima e tich.

English: Public communication campaign across radio and TV networks during national mental health month.
Kiswahili: Kampeni ya mawasiliano ya umma katika mitandao ya redio na televisheni wakati wa mwezi wa kitaifa wa afya ya akili.
Dholuo: Kampen mar tudruok gi oganda e redio kod TV e dwe mar thieth mar paro.

English: Announcement of wellness zones offering balanced diets, counselling, and stress-relief services in major facilities.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la maeneo ya ustawi yanayotoa lishe bora, ushauri nasaha, na huduma za kupunguza msongo wa mawazo katika vituo vikuu.
Dholuo: Lando mar kuonde ma ji nyalo yudoe ritruok maber ma chiwo chiemo mowinjore, kony, kod yore mag duoko parruok chien e kuonde madongo.

English: Health Ministry mandating provision of fruit-based snacks instead of sugary options in public primary schools by 2026.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya ikiagiza utoaji wa vitafunio vyenye matunda badala ya vyakula vyenye sukari katika shule za msingi za umma ifikapo mwaka 2026.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth dwaro ni mondo ochiw chiemo mayudore e olembe kar chiemo moting'o sukari e skunde mag sirkal e higa mar 2026.

English: Announcement that CHV-led malnutrition screenings will now include mental wellbeing checks.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba uchunguzi wa utapiamlo unaoongozwa na CHV sasa utajumuisha uchunguzi wa ustawi wa akili.
Dholuo: Lando ni CHV-led malnutrition screening koro biro riwo nyaka paro mag paro.

English: New policy by the government mandating flexible scheduling, stress management training, and wellness breaks in government offices.
Kiswahili: Sera mpya ya serikali inayoagiza ratiba inayobadilika, mafunzo ya usimamizi wa msongo wa mawazo, na mapumziko ya ustawi katika ofisi za serikali.
Dholuo: Chenro manyien mar sirkal madwaro ni ng'ato obed gi thuolo mar timo tije mopogore opogore, tiegruok e weche mag kedo gi parruok, kod yueyo mar ritruok e ofise mag sirkal.

English: Government promoting daily exercise challenge across all counties, emphasizing movement for health.
Kiswahili: Serikali inakuza changamoto ya mazoezi ya kila siku katika kaunti zote, ikisisitiza harakati za afya.
Dholuo: Sirkal jiwo chenro mar timo tiegruok mag rieyo del pile e kaunti duto, ka gijiwo mondo ji obed gi ngima maber.

English: Announcement promoting community-based mental health outreach as anchor to Kenya’s Mental Health Awareness Month theme of “Community for Support”.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la kukuza uhamasishaji wa afya ya akili unaozingatia jamii kama mhimili wa kaulimbiu ya Mwezi wa Uhamasishaji wa Afya ya Akili nchini Kenya ya "Jumuiya ya Usaidizi".
Dholuo: Lando mar jiwo weche mag thieth mar paro e kind oganda kaka gima biro konyo Kenya's Mental Health Awareness Month theme mar "Community for Support".

English: National Coordinating Committee affirming Kenya’s pledges on food system reform, nutrition financing, and wellness pathways.
Kiswahili: Kamati ya Kitaifa ya Uratibu ikithibitisha ahadi za Kenya kuhusu mageuzi ya mfumo wa chakula, ufadhili wa lishe, na njia za ustawi.
Dholuo: Komiti mar National Coordinating Committee mar Kenya ma jiwo singo mag Kenya e wach loso chenro mag chiemo, yuto mag chiemo, kod yore mag ngima maber.

English: Annoucement by Kenya National Commission on Human Rights  calling recognizing mental health as a universal human right.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la Tume ya Kitaifa ya Haki za Kibinadamu ya Kenya likitaka kutambua afya ya akili kama haki ya binadamu kwa wote.
Dholuo: Chenro mar Kenya National Commission on Human Rights dwaro ni mondo ong'e ni tuoche mag paro en ratiro ma dhano duto nigo.

English: KEMRI  unveiling pilot program training religious figures in suicide prevention as mental wellbeing outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMRI yazindua programu ya majaribio ya mafunzo kwa watu mashuhuri wa kidini katika kuzuia kujiua kama uhamasishaji wa ustawi wa akili.
Dholuo: KEMRI lando chenro mar tiego jotend din e geng'o nek kaka yor thieth mar paro.

English: Launch of digitized supply chain tool connecting farmers, schools and vendors to improve nutrition transparency in school feeding.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa zana ya ugavi ya kidijitali inayowaunganisha wakulima, shule na wachuuzi ili kuboresha uwazi wa lishe katika kulisha shuleni.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar chenro mar chiwo chiemo e yo ma digitized ma riwo jopur, skunde kod jouso mondo omed miyo chiemo obed malong'o e chiemo michiwo e skunde.

English: Launch of Jifunze Lishe SMS service sending weekly nutrition and wellness tips to 2M subscribers.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa huduma ya Jifunze Lishe ya kutuma vidokezo vya lishe na ustawi wa kila wiki kwa wanachama milioni 2.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar chenro mar Jifunze Lishe SMS mar oro paro mag chiemo kod ngima maber juma ka juma ne ji 2M.

English: Announcement of first public wellness zone offering outdoor fitness equipment, dietary kiosks, and mental wellness pods at Nairobi's stadium.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la eneo la kwanza la ustawi wa umma linalotoa vifaa vya mazoezi ya nje, vibanda vya lishe, na vifaa vya afya ya akili katika uwanja wa michezo wa Nairobi.
Dholuo: Lando mar kar rito ngima maber mar ji mokwongo ma chiwo gige timo tiegruok oko mar pacho, kuonde michiwoe chiemo, kod kuonde michiwoe paro maber e pap mar Nairobi.

English: Kenya confirms three new Mpox cases from Nairobi, Nakuru and Mombasa counties, this brings the total to 17, Health CS Barasa says.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa vitatu vipya vya Mpox kutoka kaunti za Nairobi, Nakuru na Mombasa, hii inafikisha jumla ya visa 17, Waziri wa Afya Barasa anasema.
Dholuo: Kenya onyiso ji adek manyien ma nigi tuwo mar Mpox koa Nairobi, Nakuru kod Mombasa, ma kelo kwan duto mar ji 17, Health CS Barasa wacho.

English: The Ministry of Health has assured the public that the Mpox situation in the country is not comparable to the COVID-19 pandemic.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imewahakikishia umma kwamba hali ya Mpox nchini hailinganishwi na janga la COVID-19.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth osenyiso oganda ni chal mar Mpox e piny ok nyal pim gi mar tuo mar COVID-19.

English: Kenyans have been urged to desist from handling or consuming bush meat to avoid possible contraction of Mpox disease.
Kiswahili: Wakenya wamehimizwa kuacha kushughulikia au kula nyama ya porini ili kuepuka uwezekano wa kupata ugonjwa wa Mpox.
Dholuo: Jo-Kenya osekwa mondo owe mako kata chamo ring le mag bungu mondo kik giyud tuo mar Mpox.

English: As concerns rise over Mpox outbreak, the Ministry of Health has pledged to procure two million vaccines before the end of the year.
Kiswahili: Huku wasiwasi ukiongezeka kuhusu mlipuko wa Mpox, Wizara ya Afya imeahidi kupata chanjo milioni mbili kabla ya mwisho wa mwaka.
Dholuo: Kaka parruok medore nikech tuo mar Mpox, Migawo mar Thieth osesingore ni obiro ng'iewo chanjo milion ariyo kapok higa orumo.

English: Ministry of Health launches HIV\AIDS marathon to be held on December 1, as it targets to eradicate the disease by 2030
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yazindua mbio za marathon za VVU/UKIMWI zitakazofanyika Desemba 1, huku ikilenga kutokomeza ugonjwa huo ifikapo mwaka 2030
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth chako piem mar HIV/AIDS mabiro timore Desemba 1, nikech en chenro mar tieko tuo mar HIV/AIDS e higa mar 2030

English: Empowering farmers living with HIV/AIDS a crucial step towards sustainable agriculture, community well-being
Kiswahili: Kuwawezesha wakulima wanaoishi na VVU/UKIMWI ni hatua muhimu kuelekea kilimo endelevu, ustawi wa jamii
Dholuo: Miyo jopur ma nigi AYAKI/AIDS teko en okang' maduong' e yor pur masiko, ngima maber mar oganda

English: There is no shame in seeking help for depression. In fact, seeking help is a sign of strength, not weakness. If you or someone you know is struggling with depression, please reach out to a mental health professional or a crisis hotline
Kiswahili: Hakuna aibu kutafuta msaada kwa ajili ya mfadhaiko. Kwa kweli, kutafuta msaada ni ishara ya nguvu, si udhaifu. Ikiwa wewe au mtu unayemjua anapambana na mfadhaiko, tafadhali wasiliana na mtaalamu wa afya ya akili au simu ya dharura ya dharura.
Dholuo: Onge wichkuot moro amora ka ng'ato dwaro kony kuom tuwo mar parruok. Kuom adier, kwayo kony en gima nyiso ni ng'ato otegno, to ok en gima nyiso nyawo. Kapo ni in kata ng'at ming'eyo nigi tuwo mar parruok, tudri gi laktar molony e weche mag tuoche mag paro kata tudri gi ng'at manyalo konyi

English: The COVID-19 pandemic may be causing extra stress for many people. Learn the common signs of a mental health crisis and ways you can help.
Kiswahili: Janga la COVID-19 linaweza kusababisha msongo wa mawazo zaidi kwa watu wengi. Jifunze dalili za kawaida za mgogoro wa afya ya akili na njia unazoweza kusaidia.
Dholuo: Tuo mar COVID-19 nyalo kelo parruok momedore ne ji mang'eny. Puonjri gik ma nyalo nyiso ni ng'ato nigi tuoche mag paro kod kaka inyalo konyogi.

English:
Always remember that Mental Health first aid is just as important as physical first aid.
St John Ambulance is here for you!
Kiswahili:
Kumbuka kila wakati kwamba huduma ya kwanza ya Afya ya Akili ni muhimu kama vile huduma ya kwanza ya kimwili.
St John Ambulance iko hapa kwa ajili yako!
Dholuo:
Kinde duto ng'e ni chiwo kony madwarore ne tuwo mar paro en gima dwarore ahinya mana kaka chiwo kony madwarore ne tuwo mar del.
St. John Ambulance ni ka mondo okonyi!

English: Depression is a common mental disorder and one of the main causes of disability worldwide. WHO estimates that globally 264 million people are affected by depression.
Kiswahili: Msongo wa mawazo ni ugonjwa wa kawaida wa akili na mojawapo ya sababu kuu za ulemavu duniani kote. WHO inakadiria kuwa duniani kote watu milioni 264 wameathiriwa na msongo wa mawazo.
Dholuo: Parruok en tuwo ma landore ahinya kendo en achiel kuom gik madongo makelo midekre e piny mangima. WHO wacho ni ji milion 264 nigi tuwo mar parruok.

English: 1 in 3 Kenyans will experience a mental health proplem at somepoint. Recognize and understand the symptoms.
Kiswahili: Mkenya 1 kati ya 3 atapitia tatizo la afya ya akili wakati fulani. Tambua na uelewe dalili.
Dholuo: 1 kuom ji 3 e piny Kenya biro bedo gi chandruok mar paro e kinde moro. Ng'e gik ma chandogi kendo ing'e kaka ginyalo konyi.

English: Let's talk mental health! If they stopped talking, please check on them.
Kiswahili: Tuzungumzie afya ya akili! Ikiwa waliacha kuzungumza, tafadhali waangalie.
Dholuo: We wawuo ane kuom tuoche mag paro! Kapo ni ne giweyo wuoyo, ng'i ane chal margi.

English: Cancer patients stranded at KNH. Patients left stranded after radio-therapy machine breakdown. Frustrated patients camp at the hospital for second week. KNH announces cobalt radio-therapy machine has been restored
Kiswahili: Wagonjwa wa saratani wamekwama KNH. Wagonjwa wamekwama baada ya mashine ya tiba ya mionzi kuharibika. Wagonjwa waliokata tamaa wamepiga kambi hospitalini kwa wiki ya pili. KNH yatangaza kuwa mashine ya tiba ya mionzi ya kobalti imerejeshwa.
Dholuo: Jotuo ma nigi kansa ma odong' e KNH. Jotuo ma ne odong' e osiptal bang' masinde mag thieth tiyo marach. Jotuo ma chunygi onyosore osebedo e osiptal kuom juma mar ariyo. KNH lando ni masin mar radiotherapy mar cobalt oseduok kendo

English: Garissa governor sounds alarm on cancer surge, links it to alleged nuclear waste dumping
Kiswahili: Gavana wa Garissa atoa tahadhari kuhusu ongezeko la saratani, akihusisha na madai ya utupaji taka za nyuklia
Dholuo: Gavana mar Garissa chiwo siem e wi tuo mar kansa, kendo otudogi gi wach ni yugi mag nyuklia ne owit e lowo

English: MTRH conducts its first Stereotactic Radiosurgery on brain cancer patient
Kiswahili: MTRH yafanya upasuaji wake wa kwanza wa mionzi wa stereotactic kwa mgonjwa wa saratani ya ubongo
Dholuo: MTRH otimo yeng'o mar radiochirurgi mokwongo mar stereotactic kuom jatuwo ma nigi kansa mar obwongo

English: Air pollution fuels lung cancer among non-smokers
Kiswahili: Uchafuzi wa hewa huchochea saratani ya mapafu miongoni mwa wasiovuta sigara
Dholuo: Dhano ma ok madh ndawa bedo gi kansa mar obo nikech muya mochido

English: Cervical cancer is one of the most preventable and treatable cancers when detected early. This month, let’s join hands to raise awareness, encourage regular screenings, and support initiatives for prevention and early diagnosis
Kiswahili: Saratani ya shingo ya kizazi ni mojawapo ya saratani zinazoweza kuzuilika na kutibika zaidi inapogunduliwa mapema. Mwezi huu, tuungane pamoja ili kuongeza uelewa, kuhimiza uchunguzi wa mara kwa mara, na kuunga mkono mipango ya kuzuia na utambuzi wa mapema.
Dholuo: Tuwo mar cervical cancer en achiel kuom tuoche mag kansa minyalo geng', kendo minyalo thiedh, kapo ni ofwenygi chon. Dwe ma kawuononi, weuru wariw lwedo e medo ng'eyo, jiwo chenro mar nono jotuwo pile, kendo riwo lwedo chenro mag geng'o tuoche kendo fwenyo chon tuoche

English: Polio, BCG vaccines to arrive in June after Gov’t releases Ksh.900M
Kiswahili: Chanjo za Polio na BCG zitafika Juni baada ya Serikali kutoa Ksh.900M
Dholuo: Tuwo mar polio, BCG biro chopo e dwe mar auchiel bang' sirkal golo Ksh.900M

English: MoH assures parents of vaccine safety after two children died from polio shot
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahakikishia wazazi usalama wa chanjo baada ya watoto wawili kufariki kutokana na chanjo ya polio
Dholuo: Migawo mar Yath jiwo jonyuol kuom ritruok mar chanjo bang ' nyithindo ariyo tho nikech tuo mar polio

English: MoH announces 5-day Polio vaccination campaign from October 2 to 6, 2024
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yatangaza kampeni ya chanjo ya polio ya siku 5 kuanzia Oktoba 2 hadi 6, 2024
Dholuo: Migawo mar Weche Thieth lando kampen mar ndalo abich mar chanjo tuo mar polio kochakore Oktoba 2 nyaka 6, 2024.

English: Ministry of Health confirms polio vaccines are safe after investigation into recent child deaths
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yathibitisha chanjo za polio ni salama baada ya uchunguzi wa vifo vya watoto hivi karibuni
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth wacho ni chanjo mag tuo mar polio ok nyal kelo hinyruok bang' nonro mosetim kuom nyithindo ma nyocha otho

English: Health experts from Kenya and Somalia devise ways to fight polio. Many cases of polio reported in Kenya coming from Somalia
Kiswahili: Wataalamu wa afya kutoka Kenya na Somalia hubuni njia za kupambana na polio. Visa vingi vya polio vilivyoripotiwa nchini Kenya vinatoka Somalia

Dholuo: Lok cham mari ma numu obed divai mar mor kich ma nengo ne ni malo. Fweny yoo mayot mar loko e chiro ma oko manyalore ok cham obed divai mar mor kich.

English: Transform your raw mangoes into a higher-value cassava chips. Discover simple processing methods and potential markets.
Kiswahili: Badilisha maembe yako mabichi kuwa chipsi za muhogo zenye thamani kubwa. Gundua mbinu rahisi za usindikaji na masoko yanayowezekana.
Dholuo: Lok kit lewni ma in-go obed lewni ma nengogi tek, kendo tem matek mondo itimgi obed mayot kendo ma inyalo uso.

English: Understand the importance of using certified seeds for tea to ensure high germination, varietal purity, and yield potential.
Kiswahili: Elewa umuhimu wa kutumia mbegu zilizoidhinishwa kwa ajili ya chai ili kuhakikisha kuota kwa wingi, usafi wa aina mbalimbali, na uwezo wa kutoa mavuno mengi.
Dholuo: Ng'e gimomiyo dwarore ni iti gi kodhi ma oseti mondo omi chai obed gi ndhadhu, obed maler, kendo obed gi suya mamit.

English: Upcoming training on digital farming tools and mobile-based crop monitoring.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo yajayo kuhusu zana za kilimo kidijitali na ufuatiliaji wa mazao kwa njia ya simu.
Dholuo: Mondo omi giyud tiegruok e wi gik ma nyalo konyo e pur kod rito yien e simo.

English: Urban gardening allows city dwellers to grow food. Explore techniques like container gardening and vertical growing for avocados.

Dholuo: Puodho matin mag taonde miyo ga jodak thuolo mar pidho chiemo. Tim nonro mar pidho chiemo e ii gige ting'o machalo mbugru e pidho avakado.

English: Urban gardening allows city dwellers to grow food. Explore techniques like container gardening and vertical growing for goats.
Kiswahili: Ulimaji wa bustani mijini huwawezesha wakazi wa mijini kulima chakula. Chunguza mbinu kama vile ulimaji wa vyombo na ulimaji wa mbuzi wima.
Dholuo: Rito puothe ma yudore e gwenge mosokore e taonde miyo ji thuolo mar pidho chiemo. Tim nonro mar pidho chiemo e ii gige ting'o machalo mbugru kod pitho mar diel.

English: Urban gardening allows city dwellers to grow food. Explore techniques like container gardening and vertical growing for onions.
Kiswahili: Ulimaji wa bustani mijini huwawezesha wakazi wa mijini kulima chakula. Chunguza mbinu kama vile ulimaji wa vyombo na ulimaji wa vitunguu wima.
Dholuo: Tij pur ma yudore e taonde miyo jii ok nyal pidho chiemo. Tim nonro mar pidho chiemo e mbugru  kod pith ma ochanore mar otungu.

English: Use fertilizers effectively for your beans by understanding soil needs, choosing the right type, and applying the correct amount at the right time.
Kiswahili: Tumia mbolea kwa ufanisi kwa maharagwe yako kwa kuelewa mahitaji ya udongo, kuchagua aina sahihi, na kutumia kiasi sahihi kwa wakati unaofaa.
Dholuo: Ti gi yath mameo lowo e yoo makare mondo ing'e dwaromar lowo, yiero maber moloyo kod tiyo kode e yoo maber e okang' mowinjore e kinde mowinjore.

English: Use fertilizers wisely to maximize nutrient uptake by maize and minimize environmental impact. Learn about soil testing and balanced fertilization.
Kiswahili: Tumia mbolea kwa busara ili kuongeza ufyonzaji wa virutubisho na mahindi na kupunguza athari za mazingira. Jifunze kuhusu upimaji wa udongo na mbolea iliyosawazishwa.
Dholuo: Ti gi yath mameo lowo gi rieko loso cham e yo mariek mondo omi cham ma cham kelo obed mang'eny kendo oketh alwora.

English: Use social media effectively to market your free-range eggs. Tips on creating content and engaging with customers online.
Kiswahili: Tumia mitandao ya kijamii kwa ufanisi kutangaza bidhaa zako za bure. Vidokezo vya kuunda maudhui na kuwashirikisha wateja mtandaoni.
Dholuo: Ti gi mbui e yoo maber moloyo mar manyo chiro ne tong' gwend nyaluo.  Yore mag loso kaka inyalo usu chiro mag gikmoko kod wuoyo gi jonyiepo e yor mbui.

Kiswahili: Mapendekezo mbalimbali katika mazungumzo ya upatikanaji wa soko la kilimo ya Shirika la Biashara Duniani yanaelezwa na athari zake kwa kupunguzwa kwa ushuru kwa masharti ...
Dholuo: Riwruok mar World Trade Organization (WTO) wacho ni nitie paro mopogore opogore ma biro konyo e tieko chudo mar cham.

English: Veterinary department announces livestock vaccination drive across Laikipia and Kajiado.
Kiswahili: Idara ya mifugo yatangaza kampeni ya chanjo ya mifugo kote Laikipia na Kajiado.
Dholuo: Ofis mar jopidh jamni lando ni onego omiii jamni chanjo  e pinje mag Laikipia kod Kajiado.

Dholuo: Alwora marach en  koluwore kod nyalo mar pogruok e kor lwasi. Lokruok mar alwora onego okony ji obed kod olosi  ngima maber ...

English: Warehouse Receipt Systems (WRS) allow you to store produce and use receipts as collateral for loans. Learn how WRS works for fruits.
Kiswahili: Mifumo ya Risiti za Ghalani (WRS) hukuruhusu kuhifadhi mazao na kutumia risiti kama dhamana ya mikopo. Jifunze jinsi WRS inavyofanya kazi kwa matunda.
Dholuo: ofis mar kano cham mar Warehouse Repeipt Systems (WRS)  miyowa thuolo mar kano cham kendo tiyo gi rIsitgo e kad mag pesa bang'e.

English: will strengthen the protection of farmers from exploitation by brokers through packaging and also provide the infrastructure necessary for market access.
Kiswahili: itaimarisha ulinzi wa wakulima dhidi ya unyonyaji na madalali kupitia vifungashio na pia kutoa miundombinu muhimu kwa ajili ya upatikanaji wa soko.
Dholuo: biro miyo jopur obed gi rit maber ne joma ketho yien kendo obiro miyo gibed gi chenro maber mar yudo pesa.

English: Women play a crucial role in dairy. Learn about specific programs, resources, and markets targeting women in agriculture.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wana jukumu muhimu katika sekta ya maziwa. Jifunze kuhusu programu, rasilimali, na masoko mahususi yanayowalenga wanawake katika kilimo.
Dholuo: Mine ni gi tich maduong' moloyo korka wach pidho dhok kod yuto mar chak. Puonjri kuom chenro, gik ma yudore, kod ohala ma mon timo e pur.

English: Women play a crucial role in tea. Learn about specific programs, resources, and markets targeting women in agriculture.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wana jukumu muhimu katika chai. Jifunze kuhusu programu, rasilimali, na masoko mahususi yanayowalenga wanawake katika kilimo.
Dholuo: Mon ni gi tich maduong' moloyo e pur mar chai. Puonjri kuom chenro, gik ma yudore, kod ohala ma mon timo e pur.

English: Women play a key role in fish value chain. Learn about specific initiatives and markets that support women's participation and empowerment.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wana jukumu muhimu katika mnyororo wa thamani wa samaki. Jifunze kuhusu mipango na masoko maalum yanayounga mkono ushiriki na uwezeshaji wa wanawake.
Dholuo: Mon ni gi tich maduong' moloyo e chiro mar nengo rech. Puonjri kuom chenro mar chiro ma konyo riwruok kod nyalo mar mine.

English: women play in the agricultural sector, they have unequal access to agricultural assets. ... (2020), Agricultural market access and dietary diversity in Kenya: ...
Kiswahili: Wanawake wanacheza katika sekta ya kilimo, wana ufikiaji usio sawa wa mali za kilimo. ... (2020), Upatikanaji wa soko la kilimo na utofauti wa lishe nchini Kenya: ...
Dholuo: Mon konyo malich e weche mag pur kod pith, kata kamano, gi onge kod nyalo mar bedo gi romruok mar yudo mwandu mag pur gi pith (2020), Yuto mar chiro mapur kod pith mopogore opogore e ii piny Kenya...

English: Floods are common in Kenya during rainy seasons. Learn evacuation routes, store emergency supplies, and avoid flooded areas to protect lives and property.
Kiswahili: Mafuriko ni ya kawaida nchini Kenya wakati wa mvua. Jifunze njia za kuhama, hifadhi vifaa vya dharura, na epuka maeneo yaliyofurika ili kulinda maisha na mali.
Dholuo: Ng'e yore ma inyalo golgo joma odak e pinyno, kano gik ma dwarore e kinde mag masira, kendo weyo kuonde ma pi opong'o mondo irit ngima ji kod mwandu.

English: Informal settlements are prone to fires due to congested housing and illegal electricity connections. Report hazards and use fire-safe cooking methods.
Kiswahili: Makazi yasiyo rasmi yanakabiliwa na moto kutokana na msongamano wa nyumba na miunganisho haramu ya umeme. Ripoti hatari na utumie njia za kupikia salama kwa moto.
Dholuo: Dak e mier ma ok ochan medo nyalo mar ute go mako mach nikech ngeny mar udi gi yore yuayo stima morochore. Ti uru gi yore tedo maratiro kendo chop uru weche masira kuma owinjore

English: Droughts devastate livestock and livelihoods. The government provides water trucking and livestock feeds. Report severe cases to county disaster committees.
Kiswahili: Ukame huharibu mifugo na riziki zao. Serikali hutoa huduma za maji kwa magari na chakula cha mifugo. Ripoti visa vikali kwa kamati za maafa za kaunti.
Dholuo: Oro ketho jamni kod yore mag yuto. sirkal chiwo pi mar ting'o mtokni kod chiemb jamni. Ter uru wach achiedh nade e migepe mar masira

English: Though rare, earthquakes can occur. Drop, Cover, and Hold during tremors. Avoid buildings with cracks and report structural weaknesses to authorities.
Kiswahili: Ingawa ni nadra, matetemeko ya ardhi yanaweza kutokea. Kuanguka, Kufunika, na Kushikilia wakati wa mitetemeko. Epuka majengo yenye nyufa na uripoti udhaifu wa kimuundo kwa mamlaka.
Dholuo: Kata obedo ni yiengni mag piny ok nyal timore ahinya, buog e ute motegno kendo ichop wach ne migao mochungne arita mag yiengni piny

English: Save critical numbers: *719# for Red Cross, 999 for police, and 112 for ambulance services during disasters. Share with family and neighbors.
Kiswahili: Hifadhi nambari muhimu: *719# kwa Msalaba Mwekundu, 999 kwa polisi, na 112 kwa huduma za ambulensi wakati wa majanga. Shiriki na familia na majirani.
Dholuo: Ndik namba mag sime: *719# ne Red Cross, 999 ne polis, kod 112 ne ambulans e kinde masira, kendo ikon osiepe kod wede

English: Hilly areas like Murang'a are prone to landslides. Avoid building on steep slopes and heed evacuation warnings during heavy rains.
Kiswahili: Maeneo yenye vilima kama Murang'a yanakabiliwa na maporomoko ya ardhi. Epuka kujenga kwenye miteremko mikali na zingatia maonyo ya uokoaji wakati wa mvua kubwa.
Dholuo: Lowo nyalo twal kuonde gode gode kaka Murang'a, omiyo kik igedi e kor gode madongo kendo iketh saa ma ok iringo ka lendo mag masira ochoponi

English: During floods, cholera spreads through contaminated water. Boil drinking water, wash hands, and report symptoms to health facilities immediately.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa mafuriko, kipindupindu huenea kupitia maji machafu. Chemsha maji ya kunywa, osha mikono, na uripoti dalili kwa vituo vya afya mara moja.
Dholuo: Sama ataro otimore, tuwo mar cholera landore kokalo kuom pi mochido. Omyo ne laktar mapiyo kichich ni in gi tuo cholera

English: Human activities cause most wildfires. Avoid open flames in forests and report smoke sightings to Kenya Forest Service.
Kiswahili: Shughuli za kibinadamu husababisha moto mwingi wa porini. Epuka miale ya moto iliyo wazi katika misitu na uripoti moshi kwa Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya.
Dholuo: Timbe mag dhano ema kelo mach mang'eny e bunge. Tem kik ichwe mach e bunge kendo iter ripot ne Kenya Forest Service ka ineno iro e bungu

English: Coastal communities should recognize tsunami warning signs (receding water) and move to higher ground immediately.
Kiswahili: Jamii za pwani zinapaswa kutambua ishara za onyo la tsunami (maji yanapungua) na kuhamia kwenye ardhi ya juu mara moja.
Dholuo: Joma odak e dho nam onego ong'e ranyisi mag tsunami (pi dok chien) kendo gidonj e kuonde maboyo mapiyo.

English: Basic first aid saves lives during disasters. Free training is available through St. John Ambulance and Kenya Red Cross.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya kwanza ya msingi huokoa maisha wakati wa majanga. Mafunzo ya bure yanapatikana kupitia St. John Ambulance na Kenya Red Cross.
Dholuo: Tiegruok ma onge chudo ma yudore e St. John Ambulance kod Kenya Red Cross konyo e reso ngima ji sama masira otimore.

English: Disasters disproportionately affect people with disabilities. Families should plan accessible evacuation routes in advance.
Kiswahili: Maafa huathiri watu wenye ulemavu kwa kiasi kikubwa. Familia zinapaswa kupanga njia za uokoaji zinazopatikana mapema.
Dholuo: Masiche hinyo joma nigi ng'ol e okang' malach, omiyo onego ochan chon yore ma ginyalo tiyogo e golo joma nigi ng'ol mopogore opogore.

English: Survivors of disasters often face trauma. Free counseling is available at government health centers and through NGOs.
Kiswahili: Mara nyingi manusura wa majanga hukabiliwa na kiwewe. Ushauri nasaha wa bure unapatikana katika vituo vya afya vya serikali na kupitia mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali.
Dholuo: Joma yudo masira bedoga gi buok mang'eny nikech masira magikale.  Mano emomiyo ute thieth mag sirikal kod NGOs golo kony

English: Drought-affected families can access government relief food. Report hunger cases to the National Drought Management Authority.
Kiswahili: Familia zilizoathiriwa na ukame zinaweza kupata chakula cha msaada cha serikali. Ripoti visa vya njaa kwa Mamlaka ya Kitaifa ya Usimamizi wa Ukame.
Dholuo: miere ma okale oro nyalo yudo chiemo ma sirkal chiwo. Onego chiw ripot mar oro e migao mar National Drought Management Authority

English: Homes and schools in disaster-prone areas should meet safety standards to withstand floods, earthquakes, and storms.
Kiswahili: Nyumba na shule katika maeneo yanayokumbwa na majanga zinapaswa kufikia viwango vya usalama ili kustahimili mafuriko, matetemeko ya ardhi, na dhoruba.
Dholuo: Ute kod skunde manie alwora ma masiche nyalo yudo onego obed ma nigi rit maber mondo omi kik yiengni mag pi, yiengni mag piny, kod yamo mager omedre.

English: Counties have designated evacuation centers. Locate your nearest shelter and keep emergency kits ready.
Kiswahili: Kaunti zina vituo maalum vya uokoaji. Tafuta makazi yako ya karibu na weka vifaa vya dharura tayari.
Dholuo: Kaunti oseyiero kuonde ma ji nyalo yueyoe, temuru manyo kar dak machiegni kodu kendo rituru gik ma dwarore ni utiyogo e konyo joma dwaro thieth.

English: After floods, water sources may be contaminated. Use water purification tablets or boil water before drinking.
Kiswahili: Baada ya mafuriko, vyanzo vya maji vinaweza kuwa vimechafuliwa. Tumia vidonge vya kusafisha maji au chemsha maji kabla ya kunywa.
Dholuo: Bang' koth maduong', pi nyalo bedo ma ok ler. Chuak pi modho kata uti gi yath manego kute mag pi

English: Schools should conduct regular fire drills and have emergency plans for floods, fires, and conflicts.
Kiswahili: Shule zinapaswa kufanya mazoezi ya mara kwa mara ya kuzima moto na kuwa na mipango ya dharura kwa ajili ya mafuriko, moto, na migogoro.
Dholuo: Skunde onego otim tiegruok mapile mar tieko mach kendo onego gibed gi chenro mag timo mapiyo sama pi opong', mach, kod ywaruok moro otimore.

English: Subscribe to SMS alerts from the Meteorological Department to receive real-time flood warnings in your area.
Kiswahili: Jisajili kwa arifa za SMS kutoka Idara ya Hali ya Hewa ili upokee maonyo ya mafuriko ya wakati halisi katika eneo lako.
Dholuo: Som weche ma biro e gaset mar Meteorological Department mondo iyud siem e wi pi ma biro e alworau.

English: Local committees help coordinate rescue efforts and resource distribution during emergencies. Volunteer with your village committee.
Kiswahili: Kamati za mitaa husaidia kuratibu juhudi za uokoaji na usambazaji wa rasilimali wakati wa dharura. Jitolee na kamati ya kijiji chako.
Dholuo: Komiti mag alwora konyo e chano yore mag reso ngima kod pogo mwandu mag dhano e kinde mag chandruok.

English: Improper handling of corpses risks disease outbreaks. Follow Textlines from health authorities during mass fatalities.
Kiswahili: Utunzaji usiofaa wa maiti unahatarisha mlipuko wa magonjwa. Fuata Ujumbe wa maandishi kutoka kwa mamlaka za afya wakati wa vifo vya watu wengi.
Dholuo: Ka ng'ato ok tim maber gi ringre jomotho, mano nyalo miyo tuwoche omedre. Lu chike mogol kod ute thieth mondo uchor ringre jomotho

English: Criminals may exploit chaos. Secure your property and report looters to police immediately.
Kiswahili: Wahalifu wanaweza kutumia machafuko. Linda mali yako na uripoti waporaji kwa polisi mara moja.
Dholuo: Jomahundu nyalo tiyo gi thuolo ma masira otimoree e yo marach, omiyo inyalo rito mwanduni kendo nyiso polis mapiyo

English: Livestock are critical for livelihoods. Report distressed animals to veterinary officers for feed and medical support.
Kiswahili: Mifugo ni muhimu kwa riziki. Waripoti wanyama walio katika hali ngumu kwa maafisa wa mifugo kwa ajili ya chakula na usaidizi wa kimatibabu.
Dholuo: Chiaye ber e medo yuto mar ng'ato. Omiyo ter wach ne lakteche chiaye mondo okony matuo gi modenyo e yoo makare

English: Use flashlights instead of candles to prevent fires during blackouts. Report downed power lines to Kenya Power.
Kiswahili: Tumia tochi badala ya mishumaa ili kuzuia moto wakati wa kuzimwa kwa umeme. Ripoti nyaya za umeme zilizoanguka kwa Kenya Power.
Dholuo: Ti gi torch e mudho kar msuma mondo igeng' mach e seche mag mudho.  Kow wach mar mudho ne Kenya Power

English: Avoid driving through flooded roads. Just 30cm of water can sweep away vehicles. Use alternative routes.
Kiswahili: Epuka kuendesha gari kupitia barabara zilizojaa maji. Maji ya sentimita 30 pekee yanaweza kufyonza magari. Tumia njia mbadala.
Dholuo: Kik idonj e nderni ma pi opong'o, nikech pi matin ma romo sentimita 30 nyalo ywayo mtokni.

English: Companies should have continuity plans, backup generators, and employee safety training for emergencies.
Kiswahili: Makampuni yanapaswa kuwa na mipango ya mwendelezo, jenereta mbadala, na mafunzo ya usalama wa wafanyakazi kwa dharura.
Dholuo: Kuonde ohala onego obed gi chenro mag dhi nyime, gi masinde mag loso gik moko, kendo tiego jotich e weche mag ritruok e kinde mag chandruok.

English: Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs) are vulnerable to diseases. Ensure clean water, sanitation, and medical supplies in camps.
Kiswahili: Watu Waliohamishwa Ndani ya Nchi (IDPs) wako katika hatari ya kupata magonjwa. Hakikisha maji safi, usafi wa mazingira, na vifaa vya matibabu katika kambi.
Dholuo: Joma odak e kuonde jot (IDPs) nyalo yudo tuoche mapiyo. Rituru ler mar pi kod alwora kendo chiwuru yedhe

English: Improper generator use causes carbon monoxide poisoning. Operate generators outdoors and away from windows.
Kiswahili: Matumizi yasiyofaa ya jenereta husababisha sumu ya monoksidi kaboni. Huendesha jenereta nje na mbali na madirisha.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi generator e yo maok owinjore nyalo kaw ngima ng'ato kluwore gi carbon monoxide. Ti gi generator e laro mabor gi dirishni mag ot

English: Trained volunteers assist in rescue operations. Register with Kenya Red Cross or local disaster committees.
Kiswahili: Wajitolea waliofunzwa husaidia katika shughuli za uokoaji. Jisajili na kamati za Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya au kamati za maafa za eneo husika.
Dholuo: Joma otiegore konyo e tije mag reso ji. Ndikri gi Kenya Red Cross kata migepe mar reso joma masira omako

English: Children are highly vulnerable. Ensure they know emergency contacts and have identification tags in crowded shelters.
Kiswahili: Watoto wako katika hatari kubwa. Hakikisha wanawajua watu wa dharura na wana vitambulisho katika makazi yaliyojaa watu.
Dholuo: Nyithindo nyalo bedo joma yom yom ahinya, omiyo nyaka ine ni ging'eyo joma ginyalo tudorego e saa masira, kendo ni gin gi kalatese ma nyiso kuma giwuoke

English: After floods, disinfect homes to prevent mold and diseases. Wear protective gear during cleanup.
Kiswahili: Baada ya mafuriko, safisha nyumba ili kuzuia ukungu na magonjwa. Vaa vifaa vya kujikinga wakati wa usafi.
Dholuo: Bang' koth, go udi yedhe mageng'o tuoche kiruako jwala e lweti

English: During prolonged disasters, preserve food by drying, salting, or using airtight containers to avoid spoilage.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa majanga ya muda mrefu, hifadhi chakula kwa kukausha, kutia chumvi, au kutumia vyombo visivyopitisha hewa ili kuepuka kuharibika.
Dholuo: Sama masira moro otimore kuom kinde malach, ket chiemo e bwo yiengni ma ok nyal kethore.

English: Rumors worsen panic. Rely on official updates from government agencies and verified media outlets.
Kiswahili: Uvumi unazidisha hofu. Tegemea masasisho rasmi kutoka kwa mashirika ya serikali na vyombo vya habari vilivyothibitishwa.
Dholuo: Weche mag miriambo miyo ji bedo gi luoro ahinya, kendo mano miyo giweyo weche ma sirkal wacho kod weche ma gipuonjore e wi weche ma timore e piny.

English: Snakes seek shelter in homes during floods. Use torches at night and avoid walking barefoot.
Kiswahili: Nyoka hutafuta makazi majumbani wakati wa mafuriko. Tumia mienge usiku na epuka kutembea bila viatu.
Dholuo: Sama pi opong'o piny, thuonde manyo kar buok e utegi, giti gi mach gotieno, kendo kik giwuothi gi tiendgi nono.

English: Insurance mitigates financial losses from floods, fires, or storms. Explore affordable micro-insurance options.
Kiswahili: Bima hupunguza hasara za kifedha kutokana na mafuriko, moto, au dhoruba. Gundua chaguzi za bima ndogo za bei nafuu.
Dholuo: Insuarans konyo e chulo gik makelo hinyruok nikech pi, mach, kata yamo mager. Ndikri kar insurance mondo iyud kony e saa masira

English: Vulnerable families can access government cash aid during disasters via mobile money platforms.
Kiswahili: Familia zilizo katika mazingira magumu zinaweza kupata msaada wa pesa taslimu wa serikali wakati wa majanga kupitia mifumo ya pesa za simu.
Dholuo: Joot ma nigi chandruok nyalo yudo kony ma sirkal chiwo e kinde masiche kokalo kuom chenro mag pesa mitimo gi simo.

English: Avoid rebuilding in landslide-prone areas. Government offers alternative land for affected families.
Kiswahili: Epuka kujenga upya katika maeneo yanayokumbwa na maporomoko ya ardhi. Serikali inatoa ardhi mbadala kwa familia zilizoathiriwa.
Dholuo: Kik uger kuonde ma lowo olwar ahinya, nikech sirkal chiwo lowo ma nyalo konyo joodgi ma masira mar yiengni omako.

English: Free fire safety training is available for communities to prevent and respond to fire outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo ya usalama wa moto bila malipo yanapatikana kwa jamii ili kuzuia na kukabiliana na milipuko ya moto.
Dholuo: Tiegruok ma onge chudo mar mach yudore mondo omi oganda ogeng'o kendo odwokgi e yo maber.

English: Water conducts electricity. Avoid touching power lines or electrical appliances during floods.
Kiswahili: Maji hupitisha umeme. Epuka kugusa nyaya za umeme au vifaa vya umeme wakati wa mafuriko.
Dholuo: Pi miyo ga sitima muoch, omiyo kik imul sitima kata masinde mamoko mag sitima sama pi opong'o piny.

English: Farmers should adopt drought-resistant crops and water conservation techniques to mitigate climate shocks.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanapaswa kutumia mazao yanayostahimili ukame na mbinu za kuhifadhi maji ili kupunguza mishtuko ya hali ya hewa.
Dholuo: jopur onego opidh yiende ma ok oluoro oro kendo giti gi yore mag rito pi mondo kik giwit yuto e saa masira

English: Learn to build temporary shelters using locally available materials for displaced families.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kujenga makazi ya muda kwa kutumia vifaa vinavyopatikana katika eneo husika kwa ajili ya familia zilizopoteza makazi.
Dholuo: Puonjri gero ute jot ma ji dakie ndalo masir, kitiyo gi gik ma yudore e alwora ma gidakie mondo okonygo joma masira oyudo

English: Stampedes worsen disasters. Follow authorities' instructions and avoid panic during mass evacuations.
Kiswahili: Kukanyagana huzidisha majanga. Fuata maagizo ya mamlaka na epuka hofu wakati wa uhamishaji wa watu wengi.
Dholuo: Luw chike ma sirkal chiko kendo kik ibed maluor sama itimo chenro mar golo ji e kuonde masira

English: Learn to recognize trauma symptoms and provide psychological first aid to disaster survivors.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kutambua dalili za kiwewe na kutoa huduma ya kwanza ya kisaikolojia kwa manusura wa majanga.
Dholuo: Puonjri fwenyo chal mar tuwo moro ma ne oyudo ng'ato ka en e masira kendo ikony joma oyudo masira.

English: Ensure LPG cylinders are stored in well-ventilated areas and check for leaks regularly.
Kiswahili: Hakikisha mitungi ya LPG imehifadhiwa katika maeneo yenye hewa ya kutosha na angalia uvujaji mara kwa mara.
Dholuo: Keturu osikni mag LPG e kuonde ma yamo nitie maber kendo ng'iuru machuer.

English: Older adults need tailored evacuation plans. Identify caregivers and accessible shelters in advance.
Kiswahili: Wazee wanahitaji mipango maalum ya uokoaji. Tambua walezi na makazi yanayoweza kufikiwa mapema.
Dholuo: Joma hikgi ng'eny onego otim chenro mar wuok e utegi, kendo onego ging'e joma rito nyithindgi kod kuonde dak ma ginyalo dhiye chon.

English: Village loudspeakers, SMS alerts, and radio broadcasts help disseminate disaster warnings quickly.
Kiswahili: Vipaza sauti vya kijijini, arifa za SMS, na matangazo ya redio husaidia kusambaza maonyo ya maafa haraka.
Dholuo: Auja, weche ma ji oroga kokalo kuom SMS, kod nyakalondo konyo e lando siem mag masiche mapiyo.

English: Chemicals and fuels should be stored away from homes to prevent fires and environmental contamination.
Kiswahili: Kemikali na mafuta yanapaswa kuhifadhiwa mbali na nyumba ili kuzuia moto na uchafuzi wa mazingira.
Dholuo: Mondo omi mach kik chakre kendo keth alwora, gik makelo chuk kod petrol onego okan mabor gi udi.

English: Lost family members can be traced through Kenya Red Cross and social media platforms.
Kiswahili: Wanafamilia waliopotea wanaweza kufuatiliwa kupitia majukwaa ya Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya na mitandao ya kijamii.
Dholuo: Joma olal bang' masira inyalo yud kuonde ma gintie kokalo kuom riwruok mar Kenya Red Cross kod social media.

English: Stagnant water breeds mosquitoes. Use bed nets and report mosquito infestations to health authorities.
Kiswahili: Maji yaliyotuama huzaa mbu. Tumia vyandarua na uripoti maambukizi ya mbu kwa mamlaka za afya.
Dholuo: Pi ma ok mol miyo suna nywolore, omiyo ti gi net mag nindo kendo inyis jotelo mag thieth ni suna ngeny e aluora ma intie

English: Communities should invest in boreholes and rainwater harvesting to ensure water access during droughts.
Kiswahili: Jamii zinapaswa kuwekeza katika visima na uvunaji wa maji ya mvua ili kuhakikisha upatikanaji wa maji wakati wa ukame.
Dholuo: Ji onego onyiew gige ywayo kod choko pi koth mondo omi ji obed gi pi e ndalo kech gi oro

English: Kenya's policy framework ensures coordinated disaster management. Understand your rights and government obligations.
Kiswahili: Mfumo wa sera wa Kenya unahakikisha usimamizi wa maafa ulioratibiwa. Elewa haki zako na majukumu ya serikali.
Dholuo: Chenro mar Kenya mar timo lokruok e weche mag siasa miyo ji bedo gi chenro maber mar rito masiche.

English: The national helpline 1195 is available at all times to provide immediate assistance to survivors of sexual and gender-based violence.
Kiswahili: Simu ya usaidizi ya kitaifa 1195 inapatikana wakati wote ili kutoa msaada wa haraka kwa manusura wa unyanyasaji wa kingono na kijinsia.
Dholuo: namba sime milandoe masich dhaw e kind dichwo gi dhako, en namba 1195 ma yudore e piny mangima.

English: Intimate partner violence often escalates gradually. Early recognition and training for frontline professionals support prevention and safe referrals.
Kiswahili: Vurugu za wapenzi wa karibu mara nyingi huongezeka polepole. Utambuzi wa mapema na mafunzo kwa wataalamu wa mstari wa mbele husaidia kuzuia na rufaa salama.
Dholuo: Kinde mang'eny dhap dhako gi dichuo modak kanyakla medo bedo marach mosmos. Omiyo chop lendo mag dhao e migepe mohangi ne jopiny

English: Prompt reporting of gender-based violence protects survivors and preserves evidence. Specialized Gender Desks handle cases sensitively and survivors have rights to medical care, protection, and legal support.
Kiswahili: Kuripoti haraka kuhusu ukatili wa kijinsia huwalinda waathiriwa na kuhifadhi ushahidi. Madawati Maalum ya Jinsia hushughulikia kesi kwa usikivu na waathiriwa wana haki ya kupata huduma ya matibabu, ulinzi, na usaidizi wa kisheria.
Dholuo: Ka ng'ato olando mapiyo weche mag mahundu ekind dichwo gi dhako, mano nyalo miyo orit joma notony. Sirikal miyo joma otony rit e buo chik kod ratiro mar yedhe

English: All public health facilities in Kenya offer free medical services for gender-based violence survivors.
Kiswahili: Vituo vyote vya afya vya umma nchini Kenya hutoa huduma za matibabu bila malipo kwa waathiriwa wa unyanyasaji wa kijinsia.
Dholuo: Ute thieth duto mag Kenya chiwo thieth maonge chudo ne joma osetho nikech timbe gero.

English: Personal safety plans help individuals prepare for dangerous situations by identifying safe locations and strategies for protection.
Kiswahili: Mipango ya usalama wa kibinafsi huwasaidia watu kujiandaa kwa hali hatari kwa kutambua maeneo salama na mikakati ya ulinzi.
Dholuo: Chenro mag rito ngima konyo ng'ato mondo oikre ne chal matek kuom fwenyo kuonde ma ginyalo dakie kendo tiyo gi yore ma ginyalo ritogo ng'ato.

English: Community support networks assist survivors by providing safe spaces, trained volunteers, empowerment programs, and coordinated referrals while prioritizing safety and confidentiality.
Kiswahili: Mitandao ya usaidizi wa jamii huwasaidia waathirika kwa kutoa nafasi salama, watu wa kujitolea waliofunzwa, programu za uwezeshaji, na marejeleo yaliyoratibiwa huku ikipa kipaumbele usalama na usiri.
Dholuo: Oganda ma konyo ji konyo joma otony kuom chiwo kuonde ma ginyalo dakie, joma otiego, koda chenro mag konyo ji mondo obed gi teko, kendo gikonyogi e yo mochanore ka giketo weche motudore gi ritruok kod weche mopondo obed motelo.

English: Workplace policies and training prevent sexual harassment by establishing clear definitions, reporting channels, investigations, and support services based on national legal frameworks.
Kiswahili: Sera na mafunzo mahali pa kazi huzuia unyanyasaji wa kijinsia kwa kuweka ufafanuzi ulio wazi, njia za kuripoti, uchunguzi, na huduma za usaidizi kulingana na mifumo ya kisheria ya kitaifa.
Dholuo: Puonj migolo kuonde tich kod tiegruok mag geng'o timbe mag nindruok, yore mag chiwo ripot, timo nonro, kod konyo ji oketi kaluwore gi chike mag piny.

English: Child protection systems must prevent sexual abuse and exploitation and provide full support for affected children.
Kiswahili: Mifumo ya ulinzi wa watoto lazima izuie unyanyasaji wa kingono na unyonyaji na kutoa msaada kamili kwa watoto walioathiriwa.
Dholuo: Migepe kod dwonde mag rito nyithindo nyaka geng' timbe mag nindruok kendo nyaka giriw lwedo mar konyo nyithindo ma chandore.

English: Healthcare workers require specialized training in trauma-informed care, evidence collection, mandatory reporting, and coordinated referrals for survivors.
Kiswahili: Wafanyakazi wa afya wanahitaji mafunzo maalum katika utunzaji unaozingatia majeraha, ukusanyaji wa ushahidi, kuripoti kwa lazima, na rufaa zilizoratibiwa kwa waathirika.
Dholuo: Joma tiyo e weche thieth dwaro tiegruok makende e weche mag rito joma oyudo masira, choko gik manyiso ni githo, chiwo ripot e yo ma ratiro, kod chiwo paro e yo mochanore ne joma otony.

English: Safe houses and shelters offer secure temporary accommodation for survivors and their children.
Kiswahili: Nyumba na makazi salama hutoa malazi salama ya muda kwa manusura na watoto wao.
Dholuo: Ute jot miyo jomotony kuom mahundu matimore e kind dichuo gi chiege kar dak

English: Digital spaces can expose individuals to online abuse. Laws criminalize cyberviolence and support services help survivors secure devices, report incidents, and remove harmful content.
Kiswahili: Nafasi za kidijitali zinaweza kuwaweka watu katika hatari ya unyanyasaji mtandaoni. Sheria zinaharamisha vurugu za mtandaoni na huduma za usaidizi huwasaidia walionusurika kupata vifaa salama, kuripoti matukio, na kuondoa maudhui hatari.
Dholuo: Omiyo oseket chike mag rito twak ewi mbui

English: Engaging men and boys in prevention programs promotes healthy relationships and challenges harmful gender norms.
Kiswahili: Kuwashirikisha wanaume na wavulana katika programu za kuzuia maambukizi huendeleza mahusiano yenye afya na hupinga kanuni hatari za kijinsia.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar chwo gi yawuowi e chenro mag geng'o chwanyruok  e kind mon gi chuo miyo winjruok bedo maber kendo kelo pek e chike motelone kwe e kind chwo gi mon.

English: Legal aid services ensure survivors access justice through free or subsidized representation.
Kiswahili: Huduma za usaidizi wa kisheria zinahakikisha walionusurika wanapata haki kupitia uwakilishi huru au ruzuku.
Dholuo: Kony mar ratiro miyo wa thuolo mar yalo e kot.

English: Educational institutions must implement prevention programs that address harassment, assault, and exploitation in learning environments.
Kiswahili: Taasisi za elimu lazima zitekeleze programu za kuzuia zinazoshughulikia unyanyasaji, unyanyasaji, na unyonyaji katika mazingira ya kujifunzia.
Dholuo: Skunde mag somo nyaka ket chenro mag geng'o chandruok, timbe mahundu, kod tiyo gi mwandu marach e kuonde tiegruok.

English: Economic abuse limits financial independence. Financial institutions should recognize warning signs and support affected customers.
Kiswahili: Unyanyasaji wa kiuchumi hupunguza uhuru wa kifedha. Taasisi za fedha zinapaswa kutambua ishara za onyo na kuwasaidia wateja walioathiriwa.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi mwandu marach dwoko chien chenro mag yuto
